sngon 'gro'i gtam/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lo ngo bzhi stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus ldan la/ de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi gso rig rmang gzhir byas thog rgya gar rgya nag ta zig la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas nas grub pa zhig yin la/gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhing lag len gyi myong byang phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par bkra ba'i gso dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin pas na/ snga mo zhig nas 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi gso rig smra ba rnams kyis gdeng 'jog chen po gnang mus su mchis/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la gzhung dang lag len gyi bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa ste/ de ni nang don gyi thad gso rig lo rgyus dang /rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ nad thog lag len/ sman rdzas sdeb bzo/ lus khams bde srung la sogs rig tshan yongs su 'dus yod pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod cig lags/ de la tang dang srid gzhung gi thugs 'khur dang brtsi mthong chen po'i 'og nye lor bod kyi gso ba rig pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gang legs byung yod la/ gna' gzhung gang mang zhig kyang dpe skrun 'grems spel byas zin yod/ yin na yang da dung gna' dpe mang po zhig sngar bzhin 'bus zos rul gog thebs pa'am/ yang na mi'i rtsol ba'i dbang gis gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ gang myur sgos srung skyob ma byas tshe rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gna' dpe gang mang zhig rtsa brlag rgyun chad du 'gro nyen che/de la bod kyi gso ba rig pa nyid phyogs yongs nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar 1

mtshams sbyor ba'i gtam/kha ba ri bo'i bcu phrag rig gnas zhes bya ba ni bod mi rigs kyis 'jig rtenaspyi'i phan bde gzhi mar gyur pa'i blo'i rig pa mtha' dag spyi la btags pa'i ming zhig yin la/ de las gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i gangs can gso ba rig pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis srol rgyun dar spel mdzad cing 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig yin stabs/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa'i las don kho na sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig tu 'khums shing spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ji 'dra zhig gi nang du'ang mkho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin pa ni don dngos kyi steng nas grub pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pas mi su dang su zhig gis kyang bsnyon 'ding dang khyog bshad bya bar mi nus so/ / rang re'i lo rgyus yig tshang dang da yod bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ltar na/ g.yung drung bon lugs kyi drang srong dpyad bu khri shes nas sman pa dung gi thor cog can bar dang / rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po nas gter ston gra ba mngon shes kyi bar/ be+e ro tsa na nas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i skabs/ byang zur rnam gnyis nas kong sprul yab sras/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che nas sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu la thug pa'i drang srong mkhas grub rim byon bgrang gis mi langs pa rnams kyi sku drin las/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso byas pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa rang gis mjal na dad pa'i 1
spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'dug'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang po zhig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zog kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcos lag tu zin to cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i 2

dag sgrig pa'i gsal bshad/bod zal mo sgang ba zhes su grags pa 'dzam gling gi yang stong du gnas pa'i mi rigs nyid la gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sngon byon dran dbang dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ dam pa'i chos kyis gtsos pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i shes rig bang mdzod ni srid pa'i mthar yang nub pa med pa zhig mchis pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med do// de las gnas bcu'i ya gyal gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ rje g.yu thog chen pos/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig ste/ der lo rgyus kyi dus yun ha cang ring zhing gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang yin pa ma zad/ sman dpyad kyi rigs lam khyad du 'phags shing man ngag nyams myong phun sum tshogs shing gya nom pa zhig mchis stabs/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu tshan rig pa mkhas can dag gis phyogs yongs nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi gom stabs mgyogs len byed bzhin pa dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas kyang tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i las don nyid sgo kun nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gnang ste nyams dga'i yul khams shig tu bskyal yod/ 'on kyang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang 1
re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa gang mang nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang nga tshos mig mthong lag zin du 'khums shing /bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid gna' bo'i rig gnas shig yin pa'i ngos nas zhu na/ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i gzhung man ngag gi gsung rab de rnams sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig bcas byed rgyu ni thog mar bsgrub dgos pa'i rmang gzhi'i las ka gal chen zhig ste 'o skol tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi phrag la rang bzhin gyis babs pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri zhig lags/ de'i phyir nga tshos lo rgyus kyi las 'gan dang dus rabs kyi blang bya ltar mdo dbus mtho sgang zhes pa'i thun min khor yug khrod du 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gna' bo'i gso dpyad rig pa 'di'i srog dbugs rgyun bsrings byed cing / bod kyi gso dpyad rig par sbyang brtson dang zhib 'jug byed par spro ba brtas pa'i rnam dpyod can mang por rgyu cha mkho sprod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa/ rang lugs kyi gzhung rkang 'dzin pa la sngar bas sman thogs thub pa/ nyam thag nad pa'i lus srog la gzir ba'i nad rigs rtsa med du 'joms par nus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten dang man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa tshig thub kyi skor mang du btsal nas nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par rngo thogs pa bcas mdor na gangs can gso ba rig pa 'di nyid ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin legs po zhig byed pa'i ched du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis 'brel yod ched mkhas mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe dag sgrig gi mi sna ched bskos byas te/ lo rgyus yig cha dang / gzhung lugs bstan bcos/ man ngag lag len/ sman sbyor myong byang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe/gnam rig skar tsis sogs kyi dpe rgyun dkon po'i rigs gtso bor bzung thog 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa 2

le'u gnyis pa/ mkhrig nad gso ba/mkhris pa mig sprin mig gi dkar sa/ tsha mkhris la mgo na ba sogs tsha ba'i nad rtags yod/ 'ga' zhig 'brum thor rdol na chu ser 'byung ba'ang yod/ grang mkhris 'khru ba mang / mkhris thang gi a ru ni gser mdog yin/se ba ni mdzo mo nu shing yin/ se rgod tsher ma leb mo zur sum can/ se g.yung ni de min pa/ gar nag ni ga bur nag po ste phag phrug nu zho tsam la brten [bsten]skabs kyi brun pa/ brag zhun ni pha wang gi brun te pha wang gshog pa'i ko lhab bsgyangs [ brgyangs] na dbyibs gru bzhi spu chung yod pa kho rang gi dbyibs ci tsam dang 'dra ba/ de'i brun 'bur bor yod pa chu nang gdus nas snyigs ma dor te dwangs ma khaṇ+ḍar byas pa dril du btub pa na grod pur 'jogdom mkhris nyo skabs kha'i pags pa gnyen mnyed 'ong ba ni nor ba'i rtags/mkhris sbyongs kyi sbyor sde'i nang du ded dpon bzhi ka tshang bar byed pa lag len yin/ 'di skabs tsha la'i chu gcod tshul tsha la skyogs nang me steng du bzung na zhu ba sobs se 'ongs pa ni chu bcad pa yin/ rus chag sbyor skabs chu ma bcad pa 'phen/ rgya snag bzang po dang zangs phye tshwa la gsum lde gu byas nas dud 'gro yan lag chag pa la blud na de shi tshe chag mtshams na snag tsha rim pa re dang zag sa rim re byas sbyor yod pa mthong zhes 'ga' zhig zer/ 'di skabs dngul chu dang mu zi mang nyung med pa byas dngul chu mu zi bzhus pa'i nang du blugs nas lcags thur gyis dkrugs pas khab btsugs na sdod skabs me nang nas len/ ya sri na gyi skabs su dngul chu zha nye bzhus pa'i nang blugs nas
dkrugs pas dbyer med du bsres pa dgos/ khur mang zhwa ser lta bu'i 'o ma can chung ngu de yin/ rtsa mkhris ni de las che/ rgya khur ni de las kyang che ba yin tse nang du skye/ sa gi wang chu nang du dkrugs nas snyigs ma dor dwangs de la dwangs snyigs phyer bcug nas kha'i chu snyigs ma'i nang du gi wang ngo ma cung zad btab nas skag bcug pas gi wang gi dod rung par bshad/ pu shel tse ni rtse gcig na tsi tse'i mjug ma lta bu mang bo yod pa dur ba lta bu de yin/ se 'bru nyo na gang bu can la yang lci bltas nas lcid yod pa ni rul med pa'i rtags yin/ yang na khab kyis btsugs nas sprugs na rul yod tshe thal ba shur se 'ong / se 'bru gtor yod pa'ang brag ltar gyi 'bras bu dang nor nyen yod pas khar myang na brag ltar 'bras bu la mngar nyams dang se 'bru mngar la skyur nyams yod/ bong dkar bcu gsum/ gar nag bcu ba/ gser mdog lnga pa rnams nges par sdebs dgos/ tsan dan ga bur rim par bsnan pa ni/mkhris tshad sel ba'i gur gum bdun steng tsan dan bsnan pa'i tsan dan brgyad pa dang / ga bur bsnan pa'i ga bur dgu ba/ 'u su ni rgya'i ldum rar skye ba khyan tse zer/ rtsangs rgya ris dang chu 'gag phyogs kyi rlung zab de rtsangs pa yin/ mkhris pa'i rtags mi 'gyur ba ni chu dkrugs na wu ba'ang ser sob se 'ong ba wu mtha' ser ba/
le'u gsum pa/ bad gan nad gso ba/bad kun gsar thog 'bru gsar/ gser can ni ma smin pa ste sa 'dir tsun tshos zer ba sogs bad gan can la mi 'gyur ba'i rtags lce snyil dang mig glu ba mthong / dang ga mi bde ba sogs nad rtags gzhan rnams kyang 'ong /dzegs dam pa ni sha rbos [sbos]pas tshigs mi mngon pa/ wa ba rmen lta bu 'ong = yin kyang ma mthong / lhen gyi nad rtags 'di bad gan can gyi ma zhu ba /'ang mthong / glo yu ni gre ba ste skad 'ong sa/ mid pa ni zas mid sa de /nyis mi gcig rke [ske]stong ni mdun phyogs kyi tsa ra khung / tshigs rnams / ba yin nam/ mgul 'gags zas skom mid tshe na zug gis mig chu 'ong ba /thong ba mthong ste/ gre ba mid pa na 'dzer ba yod par bshad/ zas mid / sa cung zad bsdad nas phyir 'ong ba'ang mthong / mid pa log pa ni mid rme'i zas log pa yin nam dpyad/ mgul 'gags 'di gdug rtsub che/ bad /na ser po can ser po snabs 'dra ba kham skyug byed pa dang ser po rkyang pa (/gas pa'ang mthong / 'di mkhris pa rkyang pa min pa chu las shes/ bde byed phyo/mas ldan dang kun ldan bde byed yang ldebs dgos/ sre 'bru bcu gsum ni /ga ser gnyis ma gtogs bad gan thams cad la 'gro ba'i sman mchog /cig yin/ kha bsgyur tshul ni bad kun tsha ba can sogs sman gsum re snon/ke dod nyams dogs can la cong zhi'i 'tshab tu se 'bru gtong / sman lha [sga] nga dong gra ni bca' lha [sga]yin/ sga skya ni rgya nang dang dbus su nyo rgyu yod/]na ldan bde byed kyis 'bru lnga pa ni bca' lga [sga ]bsnan pa yin/ gur gum
bsnan pa'i se 'bru lnga pa ni tsha ba can/ smin pa nas gtong rung / yi ga med pa la yig 'byed par gtong / sman la gtong rgyu'i la phug ni lnga pa drug par blangs pa dgos/ sha rbab ni sha rbos [sbos] pa/ sbos pa ni pho ba sbos pa yin nam/ chu 'gag ni grang dus chu dgag pa/ byang sems dkar po'i 'tshab tu cong zhi gtong / rdo zhun dang rdo thal ni rdo phyag be ste/ de che ba rnams bcom nas chung ngur byas te mer bsregs pas ngang ser lta bur gyur tshe zangs gzhong lta bur bzhag nas chang thigs pa re tsam dal bus blugs pas tshos pa rnams steng nas kog ste thal khu lta bur 'gyur/ de ras lta bu'i tshags kyis btsag nas ma tshos pa rnams dor de dal bu byas chog tshe de ltar skam bcug myur dgos na gdus nas skem bcug de tsha phab yin/ chu blugs pa grab phab zer/cong zhi mer bsregs nas dmar por gyur skabs snod nang nyi ma kha shas bzhag na bye mar 'gro/ de rgod btul yin/ bsregs nas chang gis tsha phab chus grang phab/ dar bas phab na snyoms phab zer/ thang stong ril dkar gsham du yod/ ltag pa sprad pa ni sman gnyis res mos kyis gtong ba yin/ deng sang mang nyung med par bsres nas gtong ba 'dug bya rgod kyi brun srogs brun pa'i rigs nus ldan du bsregs pa gtong / 'gron bu shwa ru rnag dang chu ser skems skabs dkar seng du bsregs pa dgos/ de min nyi ma nas bsregs te du ba yal ba na blangs chog dur thod kyang de dang 'dra/ 'phrul thal dang skran gyi skabs kyi skran sman rigs mdas bsnun pa gnyis ltag sprad/ lhen gyi skabs bshal ni ma zhu ba dang skran gyi skabs kyis bshal gyis cho ga 'dra skyugs phyi rgyud nas len/ tsha ba lnga dang sngo yi tsha ba gsum gyi dbyi mong gnyis zlos pas dpyad/ ri sho ni ldum bu kho shog gi rtsa ba/ spyang tshar [tsher]mdzos tsher ril mo zhig rlung gis khyer 'gro ba de'i rtsa ba/ zhal rgyud phyag len gyi spang ma ni ljang yin/ lcang shog ni ris zhag yin kyang ser po zhes pa dpyad/ rdo zho cong zhi'i
chu tshan ni/ gong ltar phab pa'i khu ba gdus nas 'thung / ltar bu pañtsa la spyang tsher bsnan pa ni lud pa 'dren ched 'dir rke [ ske] stong bsregs pa sogs bshad kyang pha dam pa'i skya bo bcos pa'i gdams ngag tu dma' sa nas mtho sar rim gyis bsregs pa sogs man ngag mang / yol gong ni lug gi o ri kyog ste gre ba'i tshod ma'am thug pa/ 'di'i se 'bru bzhi pa ni phyi [phye] ma yin/tsha grang rtas bsgyur ni ka ra dang bu ram/ se 'bru brgyad pa ni/ ma zhu mig ser sel ba'i se 'bru brgyad pa yin/ stod 'tshang skabs a gar brgyad nas sman gsum phri zhes pa'i skabs a ga ru zhes pa ma dag gam a ru sha chen yin nam dpyad/ gzer 'joms gsang sman la bya 'phur leb spu dang bcas pa gtong /rlung kha mtho na rtsi chen ni shing kun/ tsa ra khug tu chu mda' sogs dpyad/bad kun gyi nad so sor se 'bru bcu gsum steng kha 'dzin gtong tshul bzang drug so sos don snod so sor kha bsgyur ba yin nam dpyad/
le'u bzhi pa/ smug po'i nad gso ba/smug po rtas brdabs khrims kyi dbyug pas brdung ba'am gtor ba'agrams khug['khrugs]/ chu ljang ba ma mthong / ro stod kyi mdun rgyab sbrags nas na ba smug po can phal cher ma mthong / sgal tshigs na ba nya dri ste 'dam dri bro ba/brang tsha ba ste pho skyur langs ba/ mgo sogs na ba las gas thang chad nas rngul ba grangs rjes na gzer chen po 'ong ba dri ma skam nas 'dor dka' ba sogs kyang mthong / tsha rtags dang mkhris rtags sogs sna tshogs ston kyang mi 'gyur ba'i rtags ni pho mchin na ba yin/ rgya shal [bshal]skyug pa ma mthong / dang po mchin pa na bas de tsha bas dus dang sbyor rung / pho ba dang rgyu mar gnas pa tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus dang sbyor rung ngam dpyad/ long du gnas pa grang dus gnyis sbyor/ 'on kyang pho mchin rgyu long so sor gnas pa shes dka'/ lus thams cad la byer ba zhig med snyam/ bshul sha phrig pa ste sha 'gul/ brla sul ni brla'i phyi'i gshong / mnyam gnas lam 'gag dpyad/ bai sngon ltar bar rgyu ma la byas na de nas skyugs tshul dpyad/ skyi 'brum ni skye rdo rti'i 'bras bu yin zer/ chu rtsa'i sdong bu gzhon dus btus pa/ dmar ba [po]sum thang btsod rgya skyegs 'bri mog gsum steng zhu mkhan bsnan pa zhes ur lug zer 'di ldebs [sdebs]dgos/ ut+pal sngon po ni shis dar sngon po/ se yab ni 'ching ba la'i lta bu'i chung ngu khri gar yod zer/ sbrang sbyar ni sbrang tsi phye mar bsres/ cong zhi nyer lnga nyer gcig zla shel myu gu rnams sdebs dgos/ smug po tsha ba'i dus lta bur gtong na nyer lnga'i steng tsan dan gi wang snon/ cong zhi
nyer lnga'i sbyor tshad chig brgyud du med pas 'di rigs sbyor tshad mi gsal ba rnams la gtso bo nyis 'gyur dang / gzhan rnams cha mnyam byed pa 'gre'o//pho mchin rgyu long bzhi rang gnas bsam se'i mkhal ma sogs gzhan gnas zer/ cong zhi nyer gcig sogs skabs cong zhi mdzo mo'i 'o mar 'dam btags byas na rlung la mi gnod zer/ rgod btul sogs mi dgos/ rgyud kyi gangs thig [thigs] bcu drug dar tshur dam tshur/ lcags phye dang a ru gnyis mnyam du chu nyung ngu'i nang gdus nas zhag gcig bsnyal na thal khu lta bur 'gyur ba skam/ a ru mi 'dzom na 'om bu'i khu bar gdu/ mi'i sog thal nus ldan/ lug ru dmar smug pho mchin gyi se 'bru bzhi pa phyi ma yin/ rgyu ma'i bu ram bdun pa ni rgyu long rgod tshad sel ba'i bdun pa yin/ rgyu ma'i bshal la'ang ded dpon bzhi dang bcu [cu]gang rigs snon/ g.yu ril bcu gsum/ thang chen gyi ma nu me tog dkar po can sa 'dir med pas deng sang lag len la ma nu'i me tog lo ma rtsa ba gsum thun tshad re 'phen/ chu skol tshan mo kur [dkar] yol du blugs par thang chen btab pa cung zad bzhag nas btung ba bsam 'grub byed/ 'dus rtags rtsa chu la tsha ba'i rtags 'char/mtshal dkar mtshal nag las cung skya ba yod/ byer ba'i bshal phyi rgyud kyi smug po'i bshal gang rigs len/ khrag gcod kyi rgya mtshal cog la ma yin/ tshig brgyud dus pu shel la sug smel gsungs pa dpyad/ khrag gcod la em chi'i zhal gdams kyi go ro bdun pa thams cad la 'gro/ bya rkang pa ni tig ta nag po pho rog mda' khur zer ba de yin/ de la khar skye ba lo tsan pa zer/'gyings na se 'bru brgyad pa zhes pa phyi rgyud smug po gab pa sel ba'i se 'bru brgyad pa/ ru rta drug pa phyi rgyud ru rta drug pa sbyor tshad dag las shes sam dpyad/ cong zhi tsha sbyor ni tsha phab yin nam/ ze tsha sho'u ste mtshal zho gang /chu rtsa'i lo ma dang brag skya ha bo bcos [bcas] pa'i drod dugs/ sbrul sha'i
dug 'don ni chu nang du gla rtsi cung zad btab pa'i nang du zhag gcig 'jogsmug po 'di la sman bcos kyis phan skyed myur bar 'ong ba shin tu dka' bas sman gyi phan min yang mi shes pa lta bu yin/ lus drang por byas pa lag g.yas rna ba'i rgyan 'dogs pa gung 'dzub [mdzub] gnyis kyi bar bzung nas rgyab rtsib srubs su gru mo sleb mtshams mchin pa'i rgyab/ dkyil mchin gsham mdun gru mo sleb pa mchin mdun yin/ g.yon phyogs nas de ltar gzhal nas mtsher gsang /
le'u lnga pa/ ma zhu ba'i nad gso ba/ma zhu bad kun gzhi la yod kyang be+e snabs rkyen dbang gis gsar du 'phel/ bad kun yun gyis 'byung / ma zhu ba glo bur du 'byung / ma zhu mkhris ldan la mgo na ba dang grang shum byed pa sogs tsha ba'i rtags ston/ rims kyis 'debs ni cham pa lta bu yin gyi cham pa min/ lhen 'og tu na zug che ba 'byung / mchil ma mang po 'ong ba dang so rtsa la skyur nyams 'char ba 'ong ste 'di bad ldan yin 'dra/ pho ba tsha ste skyur langs pa/ ma zhu bad ldan la lce rnyil dang mig skya ba mthong / zas skom gyi bcud zungs khrag tu ma gyur par yun ring mchin par gnas pa dwangs ma ma zhu yin pas 'ga' re'i mchin thad kyi tsib ma g.yas dang / 'ga' re'i g.yon na ba mthong / rgyu ma'i tsi med na dri ma la sra chags mi nas pas de bsrung ched 'ju sla brten [ bsten]/ rdo dang so phag tshwa sogs bsros nas phying ba'i nang btum drod dugs/ phyi yi me gnyis bod kyi tshab bul dog [ tog] yin/ lha [ sga] pi shing gsum chang la phabs bzhin nyung ngu 'di sdebs pa yod/ ril dkar ril lu byas na mi 'ju bar chu'i nang nas thon 'ong bas phye ma byas na bzang / rdo zho chang gis phabs pa ro shen tu rtsub pas ril bu byas pa yin snyam/ ma zhu 'bring po'i se 'bru lnga pa ni bca' lga [sga]bsnan pa yin/ lga [sga]rgod dgu pa'i se 'bru bzhi pa ni phyi ma len/ ma zhu ba'i skabs zhi drug dang sga rgod dgu pa gtso bor sbyor dgos/ sha ma zhu na sha khus sman rta byed/ so bya ni mtsho khar yod pa'i bya nag po/ sog ma'i tshigs pa gdus thang / ma zhu gang la'ang sman med na rang gi dri chu legs/
mi rang bzhin gyi sa rdo za ba yod/ dug ril la khyung lnga med na khyung phye bsnan pa yin/ dwangs ma ma zhu'i skabs dwangs ma gnas 'jog dgos pas gur gum bsnan pa'i se 'bru lnga pa yin/ 'di'i skyur rtsabs ni zho'i ru ma yun ring bzhag pa yin/ bde byed snyoms ldan dzā ti sogs bsnan pa drod can/ gzhan gsum bsil/ se 'bru lnga pa tsha grang ni bca' lga [sga] bsnan pa tsha ba yin bu ram rta/ gur gum bsnan pa bsil ka ra'i rta'o// ma zhu'i 'bras bu skran dang skya rbab sogs la dang por se 'bru lnga pa gtong /
le'u drug pa/ skran gyi nad gso ba/skran thigs nya mig ni wu ba/ skran gyi mi 'gyur ba'i rtags skran steng dreg pa ste tshi chags pa/ tsha skran phal cher la mgo na ba grang shum dang kha 'gag pa sogs tsha rtags ston/ tsha rtags mi mngon pa grang skran yin/ snod gras [gyi]mkhris pa la skran byung ba lus thams cad la sag ri nag po rtsub pa chags pa mig dang chu ser ba sogs mkhris rtags ston pa mthong / rgyu mar mkhris pa zags nas skran byas pa rgyu ma'i mkhris skran/ pho ba dang long la grang skran 'byung / mkhris pa rgyu ma mngal gyi khrag skran sogs tsha skran/ glo ba chu skran dang rnag skran shas cher 'byung / mchin par chu skran dang rdo skran shas cher 'byung / ldang dub gzer ni res gzer res mi gzer/ tshur gnyis ni ser tshur nag tshur/ de steng ltar bu mdze tsha bsnan/ sde dge'i gces bsdus kyi tshwa sbyor chen mo dang / phyi rgyud 'phrul thal chung ngu gnyis skran thams cad la 'gro bas skran skabs gtso bor de sbyor/ rta mig nas g.yag rgod rus pa'i bar mer bzung na rtsi hrog tsam tshig pa na de brad yang bsregs brad pa sbyor sder gtong / rwa brdung dgos na thal tshan du bcug dros pa na brdung phye mar byed sla/ rnag 'bug la phug ron gyi brun gtso bo khyim bya ste bya pho'i brun bye'u nas zan gyi brun rnams dang dung thal nyung ngu btab pa chang nang gdus pa la bor gyur pa na rma dang mnyam pa'i pags pa spu breg pa zhig gi ngos su bskus rma'am skran steng sbyar/de steng phying ba dang skud pa sogs kyis mi 'chugs par byas/ snga dro phyi dro lta bur bzhag nas chang bskams pa na slar yang chang bskus/ de ltar byas na skran
dang mkhal ma sur ya sogs zhag gsum bzhi nas rnag tu khug spyang ki'i brun dang pho ba mi brun brgyad pa ldebs [ sdebs] pa yod/ tsabs ru tsha'i ngos 'dzin tshol/ ma zhu zas skran gyi se 'bru bzhi snga ma yang rung 'dra/
le'u bdun pa/ skya rbab kyi nad gso ba/skya rbab ni/ kha gdong sogs skrangs pa chu dang 'dra yang gsus pa mi skrangs pas shes/ rngam 'degs dbugs 'tshang ba lce rnyil sogs kyi mdangs shor te skya log ge gro yos ni gro rngos pa'i yos/ glo ba skya rbab can mang po mthong bas de la rgyud kyi lcags phye bcu pa dang / cu gang nyer lnga gtso bo nyer lnga sogs ltag sprad byin/ byi sran ma dag byi srad/ nyi 'bras dang lcags phye gnyis ka gtso ba 'dra ste/ bod pas chu dang skya rbab can la lcam pa'i lo tshod ster ba mthong / tshi gu ni nang snying /
le'u brgyad pa/ 'or nad gso ba/'or ni 'og ces pa yin pa 'dra ste/ rkang lag gi rtse nas rim pas skrangs/ nad pa dgur nas cung bsdad na mdun phyogs skrangs pa mthong /'og tu gang bstan skrangs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rtags/ brang gsus skrangs kyang dmu chu dang mi 'dra ste/ chu skrangs steng bem tol rgyab na nang gi chu'i sgra krig krig byed pa shes/ 'di la de 'dra med/ 'di la nang khrol chu nang du lhungs med pas yin/ tsha 'or gur gum bdun pa ni/ tsha ba de don lnga snod drug gang la byung ba'i gnyen por sbyor ram dpyad/ dud pa ni bya bad ma zer ba chu nang skye ba yod/ dud pa yan cha gcig dang / rgya zhun gnyis cha gcig yang na lga tig gnyis cha gcig
le'u dgu pa/ dmu chu'i nad gso ba/dmu chu sha dang pags pa sogs chus zin nas ngo bo dbyer med du gyur yod/ gtar kyang rim gyis zags pa las dus gcig la mang po yod [yong]rgyu med/ bud med bu btsas phral ['phral] zhag drug bdun tsam la dmu chu cher bsog pa mthong ste 'di bco lngar ma 'dus/ 'di bsam se'u nas zags 'dra/ pho ba'i zags chu khog ma gsar ba'i nang chu blugs na phyi zil ba khrom me ba dang 'dra bar zags/ zungs ma shor bas spangs yod med mi shes na/brang zhol dang rgyab kyi bcu drug mdo sogs nas 'theb [mtheb]rjes len min gyis shes/ rtses pa myur bar 'phar ba mthong ste snying btegs pas yin/dbugs thung ngur len/ glo mang yi ga med pa mig ser sogs nad lci yang 'tsho ba mthong / mig lcibs sogs res skrangs res zhib pa mthong chu babs chung ni dri chu nyung ba/ glo mchin sogs dang po gang ma bde ba de na ba mthong / tsha grang gi khyad yan lag skrangs mi skrangs kyis shes/ chu bsog nas lus ma theg par langs mi nas pa'ang mthong / 'bras bu chus khengs nas skrangs pa mthong / pho yul 'phel 'grib/ bsreg rdzas kyang nyal kha sogs su rum la bdug pa yin/ bod pa shig la a bhi drug thang 'bol smon [sman]sogs byin pas phan skyed cher ma byung yang lus la chu bur mang po byung / de nas lhan thabs kyi bshal gyis 'drongs/ gzhon pa zhig la bde byed chu bsgyur thun bzhi tsam phyin pas chu lam nas 'drongs ste nyin rer chab bsil chab to bcu tsam yong zer/ gcig la sbyor sde kha 'thor gyi gso byed bdud tsi grang
'joms mang po dang chu bsgyur byin pas sos// pi ling 'brum pa ha cang 'bur med na bzang / gser bye thams cad du yod kyang hang nga chu sngon phyogs chu nang bye ma'i steng 'od lem me yod/ de bye ma 'dres pa blangs sbyin chu cung blugs nas bsgul na gser bye zur du 'ong / tsha rtags che na 'bol sman ha cang mang po 'thung / glang sna ni deng sang 'jib tsi zer ba de dang 'dra ba de las ring ba yin/ 'jib rtsi zer ba'ang glang sna yin 'dra/ lcam 'bru bcu drug pa tsha chu grang ba'i grogs yod la rim gyis nyung ngu re cha bskyed nas gtong /a sho ni ba spru ba/ drod sman ni pi ling / tsha na bsil ba gur gum dang sngo gnyis bskyed dgos 'dra/ grang na ni shing tsha sug smel/ gze ma sogs skyed/rkyal ba chu thub sogs mi shes pas chu tsi nyer lnga sdebs ma myong / them bral chang rdza'i zhabs su them pa zhes mchu lta bu zhig yod pa de'i kha gcod blangs ba/ ra mo she'i skabs bsil drod man ngag ni grang chu la se 'bru shing tsha tsi tra ka sug smel sdig srin sogs drod rigs bskyed pa dang / tsha chu la sngo rnams dang / skyu ru shing mngar rnams bskyed pa yin nam/ byi'u srad ma nag po ni srad ma'i rigs chung shos/ sngo spyi zhur [bzhur]mi shes/ 'jam dbyangs stag gdong ni bdud rtsi 'od ldan zer ba yin nam/ ga dur rgya kha ni sman pa rnams li ga dur ngos 'dzin pa bon po'i gshung ba 'dra zer de'o// gser khang nas ga dur mtshan rigs shig la ngos bzung / rang rang sman ni glo zags mchin zags sogs don snod rang rang sman dang sprad ba yin nam/ lab son ni la phug sa bon/ phug ron sgong skogs kyi nang du chud tsam btab/ bre ni bod pa'i bre chung / 'di skyur yin pas gtong ma nus/ zangs dreg ni zangs me la dngar nas brdung skabs steng nas shog gu tsam kog pa/ dong ga ni dbus su nyo khrag rgyu skam po 'dra ba gang bu ring thung khru re'am de las lhag pa phyi nas mi shes kyang bcag na gang bu'i nang tshigs pa mang ba tshigs 'khor re la 'bras bu kham bu'i
'bras bu 'dra yod pa yin/ sngon bu ni me tog thams cad kyi sngon du 'char ba me tog sngon po chung ngu de yin/ zhes bla brang zer/ bdag la dur byid dang skye dbyibs mtshungs pa me tog med pa rkang de las phra ba 'o ma can zhig bstan/khron bu ni lo ma las me tog zur du med pa mtho gang ngam/ de las lhag pa ting ba'i lo ma ljang khu rtse'i lo ma rim gyis ser po/ 'jam mo'i rgyab rka nang du skye/'brog byi khung sgor skye 'o ma 'bab/ byang ba ni 'bu byang khra gshog pa ma bskyangs [brkyangs]na dbyibs spur pa 'dra ba/ che chung sbur nag gam de las chung rgya nang sogs su nyo rgyu yod/ mchu snyung ni mchu ring bo can/ khrom rtsa ni dug srad yin/ srad dkar de las me tog dkar ba reg bya 'jam pa yin/lcag rgyam tsha'i chu skol byas chog snyam/ skem sman sgron shing sogs byed myong ste sman thams cad bye mar byas blug por nang bzhag kha 'dag pas sbyar skam steng 'og mes bkab ste bsregs/ nas ldan bsregs pa thams cad 'di ltar bsregs/ srin bya ni 'ug rgan dang 'ug chung yin 'dra/ cog la ma ni dngul chu ma phyung ba'i mtshal/ bse ru dkar po kha dog dkar nag po nag bye ma mar khu'i nang lde gu byas/ lan tshwa tshad rtags che na mi bsten/ sdebs bral ni chang la ka ra bur sogs ma btab yin nam bsnyug reg sogs 'ga' the tshom/zho dkrugs ma ni zho dkrugs pa'i dar ba yin nam/ chu ma chang 'thung mi rung /skem sman sogs kyis bskam zin phral me btsa' dgos/ lte ba'i bu ga nas yar tshon do bcal ba'i kha gsum ni pho gsang dbus ma/ lteb man chus skrangs pa la rkang ba'i mthe 'ong dor ba'i sor mo gzhan gyi bar thal byung du 'bug par bshad pa ltar phug kyang chu 'bab mod phan skyed dka' ba mthong /
le'u bcu pa/ gtsong chen zad byed kyi nad gso ba/zad byed can ma mthong / 'phyen ni bshang ba la rlan ster mkhan be snabs dang phyogs tsam mtshungs pa yod/ bu ga 'khrug pa ni dwangs ma rgyu ba'i bu ga bkag pa'o// skra sen skye myur gre ba sub phrag pa sogs skrangs nas che ba/stobs chen nad rjes kyi zad byed la bla gnyan 'byung ba yod/ bcud len ni ro tsa'i bcud len/
le'u bcu gcig pa/ tsha ba spyi'i nad gso ba/tsha ba spyi zas kyis bskyed pa'i 'grams pa yod snyam/ gzer ba gcig tu 'gril ni gzer ba gnas gcig tu sdod pa/ gnas kyi tsha ba don lnga snod drug so so dang sha pags/ rtsa rgyus sogs gang zhugs blta/ gtar khrag dang zungs khrag so sor phye ba'i ri mo yod pa/ lud pa mi thon kyang sor sgra thos pa ni gre bar bsog pa/ chad po nag tsigs dpyad/ dbugs ma bskyod ni ma 'bul ba/'brum pa khong du 'thems pa dang / tsha ba snying la zhugs pa sogs zungs 'bring byis pa'i tsha ba zas sman 'jam pos gnyen ltar bsten/ rgas pa'i tsha ba rlung bcos dang sbrags bu ltar gso/ rnying tshad rims gyis ma gtogs mi thon/stongs tshad rlung 'phud byed bcud kyis gso/ tsha ba gnad du babs ni tsha ba shin tu lci ba smin par bsgugs na 'chi bas ma smin gong nas gnyen po bsten/sman ser che ba nged lag mi rgyug rta zi gi wang nyer lnga sogs ma sbyar/ thun re sman thur gyi mgo gang re yin nam/ sbyong sman gsum phri ni thar nu chu rtsa re lcag gsum/ spang tsi do bo ni rkang mtho re tsam me tog se se me tog gnyis sam gsum 'ong ba/ kham pa'i rdzar skye'i spang tsi bum pa can ni/ rkang de las sbom pa me tog dang nye bar lo ma mang po brtsegs nas zlum por gnas pa'i lo ma'i rtse cung dmar ba dri che ba yod de legs pa 'dra/ ba sha ka dbus su nyo rgyu yod/de'i sdong bu rtse rting gnyis ka bcad nas khrag nang btsugs na rtse nas khrag thon pa khrag 'dren nus pa che zer/ sa 'dir ldum nag dom 'khris zer ba yod/man ngag bsil sbyor tshad 'jug [mjug]spyi dang mig snyis [rnyil]dkar ba'i
bad tshad can gyi tshad 'jug [ mjug] la lhag par bzang / rims tshad ni gnyan dang ldongs [sdongs] pa'i mgo ru mkhris pa rtsar rgyug ni rtsa la gram pa mgo ru yod/ tsha stongs ni stongs tshad/ rlung rims 'dar bu ni rlung dang tsha ba can dran pa dang skad cha rang bzhin pa lus shin tu 'dar nas me btsas kyang mi phan par nyin 'ga' nas 'chi ba mthong / smin rjes 'khru na tsha ba snod du babs/ lhog pa rma mtha' spra ba ril mos bskor bsreg rtser me btsa' zer/tsha ba'i nad lce ba can myos na tsha smyor 'jog gam tshad nad can la grang smyo 'byung ba med snyam/ des lkugs pa sogs rigs 'gre/ tsha smyo la bcos 'di bzang tsha ba che yang gzhug chung khu ba ga bur rgyal blon dang sbyar ba'i skyon med/mtshogs ga'i gsang skra mtshams nas sor bzhi bcal ba'i dbus/ chu lcag ni chus brang kha sogs rgyab sngangs bcug pa/ sor rtse'i ri mo la ne'u le zer/sgog chab sgog pa brdung chur bsdus rtsam pa btab cung gdus pa btang ba yin bcos 'di legs/ spyang snying sbyor ba rgyud 'grel legs/ gnyid kyis 'thib par bka' rgya mar du bas bdug pa'i bcos shig bshad/ mgo gzer smin dus kyang ma bzhag na dpral rtsa gtar las lhag med/ ltag pa'i sdud sgo ni gnya' sko[ rko]/ mgo bo 'khyoms pa ni mgo bo dpyangs 'gro ba yod/ de la bcos 'di dang tsha ba'i gnyen po sbrags dgos/ sna khrag la go ro bdun pa 'thung ba dang sgrungs nas shing bal la bskus te snar 'tshang ba las lhag med/kha lce skam par ka ra shing mngar sogs mur bcug skyigs bu la chus sngangs pa dang / nya'i sha dang rus pa du ba ltar khar 'then nas du ba mid na shin tu legs/ gzer la stod gzer skabs bshad pa'i sle tres gsum thang las lhag med/ a gar brgyad pa ni phyi rgyud/ byis par glo mang na byis ler bshad pa'i glo tshad kun sel las bzi rnams dor ba legs/ pho rog mig gi rtsa ba ni pa yag pa'i rtsa ba/ 'di'i a grong [krong]ni mkhan pa gser mgo tsha 'khru la rgyu
tshad skabs bshad pa'i in+d+ra bco lnga da trig bdun pa legs/ 'khru gcod bzhi par dan rog yod pa dpyad/ rmag [smag]ni 'bal mdo sogs su tsher skya'i gseng skye ba lo ma me tog sogs gang yang med pa lce lta bu'i dmar zhing leb pa ring thung mtho re'am/ de las lhag lag pas reg na steng nas dmar la zhig pa zhig 'thor 'gro ba yod/ 9mon char shing be nag gi tshi ba ste thang chu yin par bshad kyang / des 'dir ma 'ong bas be 'bras kyis 'thus/ skyug pa tsha grang gang la'ang phyi rgyud kyi shing mngar drug pa bas lhag med/ de thun gcig btang / de rtsa zhag tshod yang gcig gtong ba sogs brtud [bstud]na legs te sman sdam tshe skyug kyang 'phro cung lus pas so// rta'i sbangs btsir ba'i khu ba/chu 'gag rang ler sman dang / rgya tsha ril mo chu lam du 'dzud pa dang sog ma'i nang rus pa bcug nas 'dzud pa sogs kyi dpyad mod/ rmig steng brad/ dri ma 'gag na a ru bul tog lcum rtsa gsum tsha [cha]mnyam gyi bsdus thang shin tu legs/ ldum bu rna'u [sne'u] zer ba dngul chu'i rgyur rung ba steng du thal ba dngul mdog can lo ma sogs sngo ba bod sne dmar ba rgya sne zer/ de las lo ma che ba mde'u che ba'i dbyibs can la sne rgod zer/ lus drod shor nas grang nyams las dros rgyu med pa gcig la thang chen nyer lnga gur gum bsnan/ se 'bru lnga pa chu rdu la phud pas bde ba gcig mthong / zhi 'bras zer ba 'bras chung ba de phol mig yin tsha grang gal mdor mkhris pa slong ba'i rgyu rkyen bsten pa nas drod bcud yun du bsten pa'i bar bdun ka tshang ba la bad rlung gi nad mi 'byung ba lta bu zhig gsung mod/ de 'dra srid pa sa dpyad/ phan tshun 'dres pa ni mi dar ma zhig ngad can rlan can yul du gnas pa lta bu/ dwangs ma ma zhu la tsha bas khyab pa med snyam/ bai sngon du ngo bo grang ba la mkhris tshad sogs bshad pa dpyad/ rtags kyi ngo glan ni/ rtags ga nga byung gi bcos phran bu bya ba/
—le'u bcu gnyis pa/ ri thang mtshams bstan pa/ri thang mtshams/ spyir bad nad glo tshad gag lhog sogs rims tshad stobs chen la zas spyod sogs gzhung las bshad pa bzhin byed pa gzhir bzhag na ma smin pa zhag gsum smin pa zhag bzhi rgyas tshad zhag bzhi ste bcu gcig 'das nas bcu gnyis pa ri thang mtshams su sleb pas zas glod par bshad kyang / nged [ded]kyis rlung shas che snyam pa'i tsha ba la zhag bcu gsum par snga dro tsha sman btang / dgung ka rtsam thang nang 'o ma phran bu dang mar gsar 'phang ba btang rjes a gar so lnga dang bco lnga gang rigs btang /phyir nyin chu dang sgul bskyod sogs je dgar song 'dug na snga dro tsha sman/ phyi dro sha gsar dang rus gsar phran bu rtsam thang nang 'phen pa sogs kha bstod/je dgar song min mi shes na tsha sman dang sbrags phyi dro sha gsar phran bu rtsam thang nang gdu ba gtong / de'i phyir nyin ji thur song na 'phro bcad/ ji bder song na tsha sman dang sbrags nas zas glod/ tsha ba stobs can la zhag nyi shur gnyen po nges par bsten dgos/ mkhris shas che snyam pa la zhag bcu bzhi nas kha sngar ltar gtong / bad kun shas che snyam la bco lnga bcu drug nas kha e 'phrod blta/ 'di bsrings kyang tsha ba skye rgyu med pas so// tshad gzhug rlung gis bus rtags chu mdog dmar dwangs wu ba che ba mthong / lce dmar 'jam rlon na nad bral bden/ rgas pa nas bsil gtar gnyen pos tsha gnya' chag pa'i bar tshad pa la tshad mjug cung zad yod tshe zas kyis rlung bcos med par bsil bcos kho na byas na rlung gis tsha ba slar 'phel ba rlung gi zhu 'khyags/
dar ma nas tsha ba bad rlung grogs med kyi bar tshad pa la tshad mjug zad mtshams nas rlung bcos ma byas par bsil ded pas tsha ba rlung gis slar 'phel pa mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags/ byis pa nas byer ba'i bar tshad pa la tshad mjug ma thon gong grang rtags 'ong ba la 'khrul nas zas glod pas gab tshad du 'gyur ba bad kun zhu 'khyags yin nam snyam dpyad/ rtsa spubs stong pa dang zas tshad nus ba sogs dpyad/
le'u bcu gsum pa/ ma smin tsha ba'i nad gso ba/ma smin/ mkhris tshad can mgo shin tu na/ gzer mi 'pho zhing zug che/gzhan gyis bslangs kyang mi phan par gnyid kyis 'thibs/ sha mdangs gzi brjid che/ bser bu 'phog mi bzod pa'i grang shum/ mig dmar dbugs thung len byed btung ba 'thung bas mi ngoms pa'i skom dad/ bad tshad la mgo na yang cung 'jam gzer med gnyid dang grang shum yang snga ma tsam med/ ngo mdangs med mig skya/ lus lci bas 'gul na mi 'dod/ na rgyu cher med skom ma 'thungs kyang sran tshugs pa/ mchil ma mang zhing 'byar bag che/ rlung tshad mgor mun 'thibs rna bar kur sgra khong na rbo [sbo] gzer yod kyang 'pho/nyal sa nas rkang lag brkyangs bskums yang yang byed dgos pa/ yan lag brkyangs bskum gyi tshe tshigs nang sgra grag mgo phyogs gcig la yo 'gro ba 'dra ba'i snang ba 'byung / rtsa thog mar ma smin dus mi gsal zhing myur bar 'phar ba rtsa'i stod smad gang rigs mi gsal/ bal bcos kyis smin dus rtsa gsal zhing ji sbom song ba lta bu mthong / yang thog mar sbom pa la bcos byas pas ji phrar 'gro ba'ang mthong / mkhris tshad la chu dmar ser 'bag to bse dri dugs pa mthong / rnyog ma can ma mthong / bcos byas pas dmar ser so na gnas kyang 'bag to je dwangs su song na bcos skyed byung ba'i rtags/ bad tshad la nad med kyi chu kho na lta bu mthong / mkhris tshad la lce steng bad kun dkar ser 'thug pos g.yog pa dang bad tshad lce skya ba mthong / lus dod mi snyoms pa ni res 'gas dros res 'ga' grang ba lta bu/ tsha ba gang la'ang sman pa mkhas pa
med na chu skol kho na yang yang 'thungs na nad gzhan la mi 'phog rjes sor sman gyis bcos sla/ tsha ba la thog ma nas thang la gnyen po ltag sprod du byin nas smin sdud gsod gsum res gcig la byed rgyu zhig sman pa phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len la byung yang / tsha ba stobs can la thog mar ma nu bzhi thang lan 'ga' dang / de rjes spang rtsi sogs gnyen po bsten pa nges par dgos/ tsha ba stobs chung la ma nu bzhi thang dang spang rtsi bcu gnyis khyung sngon lta bu res gcig la ltag sprod byin pas chog kha zas la ma 'dzem pas je thur song ba la bdun thang ltag sprod byin na legs/ ma nu bzhi thang dang 'bras bu gsum thang so sor ldebs [sdebs] nas bdun thang dgos tshe cung zad re bsres/ thang thams cad la thun che dgos/ thog mar thang dang chu skol dro 'jam las tshan mo 'di 'thung rngul mi 'byin/ tsha ba stobs ldan thog mar rngul gyis 'don mi nas/ stobs chung la thog ma nas rngul gyis phan/ zas nas tshag [chag]tshe'i thug pa/ nas phye'i go re skyur med pa dang thug pa/ gro phye la kho rang grang gzhi dang srin sogs la dogs pa med na gro phye'i nang sran phye cung bsres ba skya srab dang go re zangs gor legs/ tsha ba smin pa'i mjug nas brngos pa'i tshag [chag]tshe'i thug pa'ang rung / nad pa snum/ la 'dod pa che na mar skya zi gsar pa cung zad re yang rung tsam/ bcung ba'i dod du tshag [ chag] tshe'i khu ba 'thung na legs/ smin rtags la mgo mi na gzer je chung dbugs je bder 'gro grang shum mi 'byung / tsha ba stobs chung la thog ma nas bdun thang btang kyang chog snyam/ zhag nyi shu phan lon pa'i rnyings tshad la bdun thang tshan mo la ga bur nyer lnga ltag sprod phyin nas rngul 'byin/ ltag sprod ni thang gar [dkar]yol gang tsam 'thung ba'i mjug gi kham bu gang dos sman phul ba'o//
le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rgyas tshad kyi nad gso ba/rgyas tshad kyi rgyu'i mkhris pa ni/ me drod kyi cha shas rgyas tshad kyi rtags la nges pa med kyang / smin rtags byung ba dang / spang rtsi bcu gnyis dang /rims la gtso bo spru nag nyer dgu lta bu pho ba mi bde dogs yod na chu dro 'jam dang / pho ba sra na bskol grang gis phul/ dbye thang sogs ma byas/ spang rtsi bcu gnyis rims la gtong na ga dur bsnan nas gi wang dang brag zhun gzhan gyi phyed ka re 'phen/ thengs gsos dgu pa yang sdebs dgos/ na so dang zungs kyis lcogs na cung bzi na bzang / rgas pa byis pa sbrum ma rnams la bzi mi rung bas de dag la smin pa'i gnyen por gtso brgyad ga bur bsnan pa legs/ de dag la spang ñtsa sogs gtong mi rung / glo snying sogs so sor tsha ba rgyas pa shes na rang rang gi gnyen po'i gur gum bdun pa bsten kyang shes dka'/ rgyas tshad skabs gnyen po thun che dgos/ ri thang mtshams nas thun je chung dang je nyung gtong dgos/
le'u bco lnga pa/ stongs tshad kyi nad gso ba/stongs tshad can ma mthong / dbugs sngar bde ba je thung / gzer sngar med gsar 'pho ba byung / 'di'i bye ma rnams sdebs ma myong /
le'u bcu drug pa/ gab tshad kyi nad gso ba/gab tshad mi shes/ tsha stobs can la tsha rtags mang zhing / grang stobs can grang rtags kho na ston/ glo ba khrag rgyas e yin snyam pa zhig la glo snying 'dom rtsa gtar bas khrag gi khar lcags g.ya'i lta bu'i nag po chags pa mthong /se 'bru bzhi ni phyi ma/ sman des grang rlung mgo mnan nas gting tshad mngon du gyur te gnod nyams byed/ zungs bzang na yun thung / 'di'i skabs kyi sbyor sde ldebs [sdebs] ma myong / rgyab kyi snying pho mkhal gsang / mdun na snying pho las mkhal gsang med/
le'uXbacu bdun pa/ rnying tshad kyi nad gso ba/rnying tshad dang po dros 'khyags lta bu byung nas bde ste yun ring lon nas ja rgod lta bu rkyen byas te mi bde ba'ang yod/ kha 'byar ba dang / 'gul na glo snying 'phar ba yan lag bzhi lci ba sogs kyang yod mod/ skom 'thung ba dang nyal ba sogs kyi tshe rngul kha snyi ba ni mi 'gyur ba'i rtags/ gyong bo rlan spang dang hong len brgyad pa gnyis nges par ldebs dgos/ rgya gar hong len rtsa ba thal mdog phyi nang gang nas bltas kyang rul ba lta bu gcig la'ang rkang du ma re 'ong ba/ ro ha cang btsan pas 'di thun log tu gtong mi nyan/ gzhan rnams las cung mang ba byed/ 'bras gsum cha mnyam/ ma nu sle tres cha mnyam ste zho gang re lta bu la kun+da ka ri nyis cha ste zho do lta bu lga [ sga] skya tsha 'debs tsam ste zho byed [phyed]dam sen mo re lta bu/ 'di skabs bdun thang tshan mo 'thung ba'am/ chu skol btung ngam tshan mo rdza kor lta bu'i nang blugs ras ljegs ras kha bkab rlangs pa bdug pa sogs kyis rngul 'byin pa shin tu gal che/ cong zhi'i chu tshan la sdod/
le'u bco brgyad pa/ rnyogs tshad kyi nad gso ba/rnyogs pa nad gzhi'i thog tu lhung ba ni// tsha ba chu ser la babs pa yin nam/ chu ser shas che ba'i mi la tsha ba byung na rnyogs tshad kyis khyab bam dpyad/rnyogs tshad can mi shes/ nad stobs che na glo snying sogs don la rnag chu bsog grang rnyogs dmu chu dang rtags phal cher 'dra/ myu gu bcu gsum sogs ma sdebs/ se 'bru lnga ni gur gum bsnan pa/
le'u bcu dgu pa/ 'grams tshad kyi nad gso ba/'gram pa rkyen de las gsar du byung ba dang / sngar tsha ba byung yod par rkyen de dag las 'gram tshad du gyur pa'ang yod snyam/ byer ba dang 'gram pa ni kram pa'i don/ lhang lhang gzer/ mgo pa'i srubs thod pa'i ri mo yod pa 'gram tshad can mi shes/ lag pa'i rgyab kyi bsgrims na rus pa mthong ba la chu ba zer/ lag pa'i gru mo dang rkang ba'i pus mo man la chu rgyus shes/ de yan nas dgyes te so so'i mgor sha 'byor/ rnam par yu gu shing ni/ sa dma' sar skye sdong bu'i steng spu chung 'thibs pa/ yal ga mang ba me tog ut+pal ltar 'dab ma ring ba mang ba brtsegs pa mdog gur gum ltar dmar ser/ ring thung khru re las lhag pa'ang yod mdzes pa yod/ sa mtho sar ring thung gru gang tsam pa sdong bu'i steng bal dkar po yod pa yal ga snga ma las thung ba me tog sogs sngar 'dra yod/ de gzer 'joms ser po yin/ 'khrugs glo kun sel sdebs 'di ro stod gzer zhing kha lce skam pa lu yang lud pa mi thon pa'i 'khrugs lu can la ster/ cham pa tsha ba sogs drag nas yun ring lon yang lu ba mi 'jog pa la'ang bzang / nged kyis de steng khyung sngon cung zad re bsnan pa yin no rang bzo/ tshos sna tshos btsod zhun dmar po tshos btsod 'dri ['bri]mog 'byar ni sbyin snyi mo'i nang 'byar chen bcu pa sogs sman btab/de nang gro bye zhig mo btab brdzis skrangs steng rnag phyir 'don dgos na dbus su mi bsku de min skrangs thams cad la bskus steng / spu'am gso ma'am rtsid pa sogs sbyar/ 'di 'bras sur ya mtshon rma 'byar rung rnams la dgos/btso lums ni rtso lums/
le'u nyi shu ba/ 'khrugs tshad kyi nad gso ba/'khrugs tshad mi shes/ za zi ni ngos zin mi zin 'ong ba khrag 'khrugs kun sel sdebs te 'di la gtar kha dgos snyam yang gtar mi nas pa la byin/nad pa gang la'ang gtong mi rung rgyu med/ ga bur dgu pa khrag tshad sel ba yin snyam/
le'u nyer gcig pa/ rims tshad kyi nad gso ba/rims/ dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman pa ni dgun de tsam mi 'khyags pa/lhag pa ni grang ba sngar rgyun las lhag pa/ log pa ni shin tu dro ba lta bu/ rgyud chen drug zug gu rul de la dpyad/ bsrung ba la sbyor sde kha 'thor gyi nag po dgu sbyor gtso bo byed/ rims smin dang rgyas rtags thams cad bden/ de steng dang po nas smyo tshul ston/ smyo lab lag pa nam mkhar snyob pa yod/ rna bar chu chen po'i kur sgra lta bu 'byung / rgyas dus grang sha dang mgo rkang lag na ba sogs bzhag nas lus lci bas 'gul mi 'dod par lhung 'gro/ lce mchu sogs drag pa 'brad rgyu yod pa chags/ mu 'gram ni/ yer bu 'gros tshul ni mtshan gos kyi nang nas zur du gcer bur nur 'gro/ thag ring bros 'gro ba'ang yod/ ya mchu'i steng thor ba 'ong ba ni tsha ba phal cher la mthong ste/ de byung drag pa la nye rtags/ 'di'i rlung mkhris bad kun gyi rims la gong gi rlung tshad mkhris tshad sogs kyi rtags kyang yod/ ham pa ni sha rul ba'i steng chags pa'i bal lta bu'i dkar bo/ chu skol dang bzhi thang nang gang rung /dgung gsum la lar gsum re gtong / phur mong khan ṭa byed mi nus na phur thal chog de ba la g.yer ba'am drug pa sogs dus tshod la mi ltos bar nags 'dab sogs su sdong bu mtho gang ngam de las thung ba me tog dbyibs dang mdog spang rgyan sngon po 'dra ba sdong bu re la me tog gnyis gsum 'ong ba la sngo de ba zer/ snag sha nag po dmar sprug can dkar po lo ma reg na dbyar bag can me tog rgya kha 'a char/ a gar zhes rigs gsum sogs gsal kha med pa
thams cad ar nag yin/ shu dag ces dkar nag gi gsal kha med pa thams cad shu dag nag po yin/ ming can nag po ni ldum bu bse bo/ ming can ser po na nang skye/ lo ma ring ba ljang nag sdong bu/ me tog che ba se 'bru skya log ge'i mthar 'dab ma ring ba gcig gshar 'thor nas yod pa/ chig brgyud kyi kha skong bsnan na so gsum du 'gyur ba dpyad/ nged kyis tshig brgyud kyi de ma bsnan/ 'di yang nyin rer thun gsum re gtong skabs su spang tsi re gtong /sman thun chung ngu can 'ga' blud nas mi rang bzhin bzi kha sla mi sla brtag nas mi bzi na thun bskyed/ bzi rnams la sman chen sogs cha mnyam yin na sbyor tshad dang bstun chog sman chen nus pa ha cang che ba la dogs pa dgos/byis pa lo brgyad man la spru nag mi rung bas dgos na spang rtsi chung ngu re gtong /chig thub dkar po tshig thub yin snyam/ ba ra mdzo mo be'u khrid kyi 'o ma mar skya si sogs btang kyang rung / mdzo mo yar ma dang 'bri 'o mi rung / chang zer ba thams cad chang ser yin/ chang nag la a rag ces yod/ ar brgyad ni phyi rgyud kyi spru nag nyer lnga ma dag gam/
le'u nyer gnyis pa/ 'brum pa'i nad gso ba/'brum pa glo snying brdung ba ste 'phar ba/ zas dang chu wu pa can skyugs pa mthong / khrag skam 'phel te dmar zhib zhig 'byung / zangs gzer dang po thon dus nas mgo na rko cho yod/ 'di gnyis dkar po'i khrod du re gnyis 'byung ste skrag mi dgos/ glang gnya'i rma mdog nag ngam se 'jigs rung /spyi zlum 'chol ba ni nar nar yon po sogs/ dkar po bgos kyang mi 'go bar yun ring song nas skrags sngangs shig la brten nas 'go ba mthong / sle tres 'bras gsum sogs kyi thang 'di btang ba yin/ gzhan lha 'brum 'dzugs pa'i man ngag zur ba yod pa ltar sbyor sde bcos pa yin/ g.yer shing mi shes/ lug sho kho shog sdong bu ring bo can/ lug ril chang btsos kyis tugs [dugs]nas rngul 'don/ dkar nag kha bsgyur gyi chig brgyud dpyad/mañdzir ni lug rwa mon tho gug pa dang dbyibs dang chu gnyer 'dra ba'i rdo sman yod/ rang shi'i thod pa ni sman ma song bar 'brum bas shi ba'i thod pa/ myos khu ni chang / tsha la chu bcad dngul chu tsha 'dul/ ka la bdun thang mi shes/bse ru ko ba glang po che'am med na glang dmar ser ko ba/ gnya' ba'i nad 'bras nad ma zhes pa'i sman gyi 'bras bu/ gsang sman gsum chig brgyud du ma tshang ba tshol/
le'u nyer gsum pa/ bag ge'i nad gso ba/bag ge lnga byag ces pa thams cad a byag gzer 'joms dang / tsher sngon zhes pa a byag tsher sngon la go dgos/ mgo thang gsum pa phyi rgyud gsal/dpa' bo bcu gsum sdebs/ tshar bong mkhan pa 'bras bu che ba mod po yin/
le'u nyer bzhi pa/ cham pa'i nad gso ba/cham pa rna rtse rnag dpyad/ brang nad dpyad/ dpa' bo bcu bzhi sdebs pa yod/ gsang sman rnyi ba ni/ sa mtho sar skye ba lo ma rgya lcang gi lo ma ltar rtse phra ba/ cung dkon/ sgong thog pa gar yang skye ba yungs dkar lta bu gnam ma mthong ba ni btu tshe steng du ras gur bub btus/ mug mur ni do bo 'dra ba las gcig tu mang po re phyogs gcig tu skye ba reg na 'byar ram snyam pa yod/thang khrom la 'bras bu zhes dmigs bsal med pa la rtsa ba btang na chog thang khrom gtub nas skyogs mgo'i nang mer cung zad dros bcug nas dug 'don byed/ khyung sngon sdebs/ gtum po ni sman chen de nyis 'gyur/ gzhan rnams cha mnyam/ 'di gnyan tshad thams cad la gtong / thun chung ngu byed stag sham ni stag sha lab khu la phug khu ba/ gre cham gyi a krong mkhan pa/ skyor kong [gong] rtsa 'theb 'dzub [ mtheb mdzub] gnyis ki bar gyi sha'i steng gi rtsa/spang rgyan bco lnga sdebs glo tshad can la'ang gtong gnyan kha chog nas/ spang rgyan dkar po dgos kyang sngon po yang chog sre long spre'u gdong bris pas mig phur/nag pos dkris/ na gi ni chu srin sder mo/ sha tshil sha ba'i tshil /
le'u nyer lnga pa/ ya ma klad gzer gyi nad gso ba/ya ma klad gzer/ rta bla ni sam myig lus zungs zos pas yin nam/brgyud par dpyad/ gnya' ba'i shwa la babs nas mgo ltag par dgye zhing sis 'khyig nas 'dzum pa lta bu/ ba bla yung zhes ba'i yung ba sga ser/ ha la dang sbrel ni/ man ngag gzhan zhig myur smad ni nyi ma nub kha/ mgo'i 'phar rtsa/mig sprin ni mig gi dkar sa/ mi thod btsa' ma dur nang nas blangs pa mer bsreg nas du ba sang de dkar sang du ma song skabs blangs pa dgos/ phur mong nag po/ gong gnyis ni sman chen dang thang khrom/ thang khrom gyi khaṇ+ḍa/ gla hrū cha drug gur khyung ni gur gum bsnan pa'i khyung lnga/ mtshog ma thod pa'i ri mo'i sum mdo sde/ skra mtshams nas sor brgyad song ba/ pad+me byang khra/ ha shig rdo ba rag ta/ hal ge ni phying ba sogs/ rtsa lto sbrags/ chu lam gshang lam gnyis ka/ mgo drang bor tshal bar bgos pa'i g.yas g.yon gang rung shin tu na ba mthong / chu ser gyis gang ba gtar kyang mi phan ci yin ma shes/
le'u nyer drug pa/ gag pa'i nad gso ba/ gag pa pho gag mdog dkar po leb mo dkyil rko ba lta bu'i mtha' khra sob be byed pa mthong / mo gag mdog dmar po 'bur bo/ bu gag zho gtor ltar khra zhig ge mthong / 'di gsum la skrangs rgyu med/ zas mid pa shin tu dka'/tsha ba'i rtags yod pa gzhir bcas/ gnyan gag rke rkyang [ske skrang] du grags pa ste mgrin pa'i phyi skrangs pas bsdams nas dbugs gcod/ ral gri sna ma so gnyis te de'i gzhung 'bur ba/ rmigs pas gyong sar 'od lam me byed pa yod/skyi 'bru skye rdo ti'i 'bras bu/ rgya g.yer g.yer ma/ spang rtsi bcu gnyis li shi gtso bor bsnan pa legs/ smyug sbubs yo bar bcad pa 'jam po'i nang sman snyung ngu re blugs phu 'debs 'di legs/ mgo bo skrangs par chu med par sngags skam po 'debs/ rjes nywa sogs su babs na rlon pa/ sbyongs kyi rigs kun la ded dpon bzhi gzhir bzhag ma byas par sbyongs mi nus/ma zhu bad kun gag pa gsum 'dus shig la 'di'i khyung lngar stag sha sogs bsnan pa dang /ma zhu'i sbyongs gnyis bsres nas byin pas phan de blo bzo/ lhog dug dpyad/dug sug pa sman chen me tog yin nam/ pho tshos ni mdog nag gam me byed pa yod/ 'di mo tshos la rin chung / ser mtshur dang nag tshur gnyis/ ser mtshur dbus su yod kyang de'i dod du tshur dkar gyis chog dral thug tshag [chag] tshe'i thug pa/ rna rtse gnyis dang skra mtshams nas yar sor gang re gzhal ba'i mtshams g.yas g.yon dang mdun gyi sdud sgo/ ltag pa'i sdud sgo 'di'i sdud sgo gang yin dpyad/
le 'u nyer bdun pa/ glo tshad kyi nad gso ba/glo tshad/ rgyas 'khrugs kyi rtags kun tshang / rgyab tu gzer ba'ang yod kyang phal cher la mdun gzer mang / g.yas phyogs kyi nu ma nas mchan bar gzer 'pho ba yod g.yon phyogs la'ang 'dra 'pho ba yod/ g.yas g.yon thams cad nas gzer gyis rgyog na mi 'tsho/ g.yas phyogs glo ma'i rtse thur 'phyang ba mchin dri'i khugs su yod pa gzer na mchin tshad dang nor/ g.yon la gzer mig byung na mtsher tshad dang nor nyen yod/ g.yas kyi glo ma dang g.yon gyi glo ma/ snying gi mtha' skor gyi glo bu sogs gang la tsha ba rgyab pa de'i thad nas gzer/ phal cher rtses pa dang phrag mgo gzer ba mthong / ba spu ldog pa ni gzings pa/ yams thabs ni 'go ba ste nged kyis 'go ba ma mthong /snying sogs la babs pa ni glo tshad kyi mjug snying sogs la shor ba'o// rtsibs [rtsib]thung tsug gu thung ba gnyis re tsug gu thams cad kyi 'og ma yin/ sog dbrag rgyab kyi sog pa'i bar/ bshul sha tshigs pa'i g.yas g.yon 'bur po/lud pa dkar sob dmar po dud khu rnams mthong / mjug tu rnag 'dra ba 'ong na glo tshad drag kyang glo bar skyon zhugs rtags/ glo tsha dug thabs dpyad/lud pa dud khu can 'tsho ba mthong / dbugs thung len byed pa gzer gyi stabs yin skyon med/ lud pa mid par bsog nas mi thon/ thog mar gzer gyi dbang gis lu mi nas pa thams cad la mthong / sle tres sogs kyi thang shin tu legs par nges par gtong / ru 'dzim pa gtsor byas bcu gcig steng kha 'dzin la rlung gzer sogs gang yin mi shes stabs dzā ti sogs kha tshar 'dzom
tshad thams cad nyung ngu re bsnan pa yin 'di shin tu legs/ ming can nag po cung mang ba byed/ bse ba rtse dri kha bas rtsa ba gtong / khun gros dang khun pa thang khrom dkar po/ bong nga nag po/ lhog pa dang ya ma sogs stong du byung na zhes pa'o// chu rdo dang rmos lcags zad po glan pa yin/ gzer shin tu ngan pa la byang khog ras lta bus cung bsdams na phan pa mthong / rgya shog ni rang re'i shog gu/ kha la rgyas 'debs ma bya sa/ mchin tshad yin nam snyam pa'i gzer che ba cher mi lu ba zhig 'dzim pa sogs bcu gcig tsam byin pas phan/bzi'i rigs 'di sman thun chung ba byas nas gcig rtsar zhag gam snyam pa'i tshor la gcig bsnan gtong / skyugs gtong ba yod kyang skyugs rung yang blud pa yin/ bzi sman gang yin kyang bzi song na brag skya ha bo dang a ru nag chung gdus 'khyag blud na bzi kha lon/ de min rtsam thug 'khyag pas kyang phan/'di sogs gnyan tshad stobs can la zhag brtswa lnga tsam nas kha glod e chog blta/ka ra dor/ tsan dan gnyan kha chogs pa nasogs bdun kha tshar can dang / spang rgyan bco lnga mjug tu nges par gtong / kha btang rjes su yang thun je chung btang gtong / zhi byed lhogs [lhog] pa dpyad/ gnyan kha chogs tshad mgo yan lag na ba dang gzer mig sogs na zug chog nas ji bder song ba yin/sha drod da dung mi 'jog gnyan tshad lci ba rnams khyi chu dmar la nag pa mar nag dwangs mo 'dra ba 'bag tho rlangs pa ma yal gong log pa/
le'u nyer brgyad pa/ glang thabs kyi nad gso ba/pho glang ngam gnyan glang dang glang thabs gnyis kyi khyad par mgo rkang na ba sogs gnyan tshad skyes na pho glang / glang thabs che ba cher med/ gzer che bas mi re gnyis kyis ma mnan na lag nas shor 'gro/ dres me'i [ ma'i] ge sar ni me tog gsang sman se spur ni 'bu bse bo/ bying bying thu lu ni 'bu ser po sgra thos na rta 'bros ba rta 'bur grags pa/ khyung lnga'i khyung phye dang / ru rta bcu pa gnyis bsres nas gcig rjes su gcig bstud nas btang na shin tu legs/ ltag sprod ni gnyis res mos su btang ba/ ru rta bcu pa glang thabs tsam la'ang legs/
le'u nyer dgu pa/ rgyu gzer gyi nad gso ba/rgyu gzer za khu ni/ khams dkar po lta bu bcar la thebs byin pa ste nywa ste snod kyi tsi te rgyu ma'i nang ngos na brun sra mi yod pa/ thur mgo gang ni khrag po gang 'di bya myong / in+d+ra bzhi steng gi wang sogs bcu gcig bsnan pa shin tu legs/ bong nga zhes gsal kha med pa bong dkar/ 'dzim pa me togsman nad thon pa ni bzi nas mi bde ba bskyed pa/ zla ba ni sman chen me tog cadakar po can gyi me tog me tog dmar po'i khu ba gur gum/ bsrung 'khor yang lags/ mon cha ra be nag thang chu deng sang be 'bras 'phen/ gcod ཿbyed la sbyin dwangs mo nyung ngu phye btab gdus pa blud na legs/ 'di rgyu nad ridang sbyongs brgyab nas ma chod pa la phan/ sgrom tshos dpyad/ mar mig dpyad/'go yams yin pas 'dzem/
le'u sum bcu pa/ me dbal gyi nad gso ba/me dbal byung ba mgo yan lag byang khog sogs nges pa med/ me dbal lce ba la tsha ba ngan/ yang ba tsha ba mi skye ba yod/ mchan dang ther khug sogs mtha' 'khor na lci/ ma mog yam me ba snum cung yod pa zhig gis mtha' bskor me sgron par bshad pa mthong / 'di la spang rtsi bcu gnyis las lhag mi dgos/ byug sman em chi'i reg pa bde byed sogs legs/ btsag pa btsag dmar po/ sran ma shin tu chung ba leb mo/
le'u so gcig pa/ rmen bu'i nad gso ba/rmen bu rke [ske] rna rtsa sogs la byung ba mthong / yun ring 'gor nas skabs skabs su gnyan kha skyes pa na tsha ba yang skye/ res tsha ba bzhag rmen bu so na gnas pa mthong / sne sa ni sum mdo gsang gnas kyi ltag g.yas g.yon/ser ba rus ni pus mo'i rus pa ril mo de la zer/ nad de ma mthong yang mgo yan lag byang khog thams cad 'bur bo che chung sna tshogs kyis gang / thang rub la ma gtogs/ na zug med pa zhig mthong bas de yin nam/ nas btsos phab btab bsnyal zhag gnyis gsum nas chu blugs/ btsag ran tshe bzhur ba gar la slar chu rgyab bzhur ba sings po zer/ 'bam po sngo zhiglug ngal ba ngos 'dzin med/ phug ron brun chang ser ram ma rnyed na chang nag nang gdus/ dung thal cung zad btab pags pa spu cung zad yod pa zhig gi ngor sbyar glan bcings skam e 'gro snyam tshe blangs te chang gis rlon pa byas yang glan rnag 'gugags 'di 'bras sug [ sur] ya sogs rigs 'gre/skrangs mdog dmar nag mthong / skrag mi dgos/
le'u so gnyis pa/ nywa log gi nad gso ba/nywa log gzhan ma mthong / tsha ba skyes shing nywa bzhi rgyug nas zug bzod glags med pa mthong / de 'khru skyugs mi byed/ ban+de'i mkhris pa ni ngang pa'i mkhris pa/ ske stong ske bdun sko ba/ mkhar po dpyad/ nywa mjug yan lag gi rtse'i phyogs/ ngar btags pa bzlas phu btab pa/
le'u so gsum pa/ lhog pa'i nad gso ba/lhog pa tsha bang na skrangs mdog dmar nag skrangs tsog tsog min pa mthong / shin tu tsha ba ni skrangs kyi drod/: phal cher mgo dang yan lag la 'byung ba mthong / gsob pa ni 'bol ba/ mi brtan ni yar mang [mar]spor ba/ phyi yul grang ni sha drod chung ba/ ldang dub ni 'phar 'bug nad drag po 'khor la 'phro ni 'go ba/ 'dol 'bol yin nam/ khra ba ma dpyad/ khyung lnga dang dngul chu bco brgyad gnyis shin tu legs/ dngul chu bco brgyad rgyud chen dang 'dir bshad 'dra/ sbyor tshad em chi ltar byed/ gnyan dug dpyad/so thog pa sdong ring ba yal ga mang ba me tog lta bu ldum bu khyi rnga'i dbyibs can mdog skegs ltar dmar ba yang skya'i thang skye/ mgar pas lcags mgar tshe lcags steng dreg pa lta bu kog pa la'ang so thog zer 'dir 'di yin/ dud pa bya bal khang rnying nang sdom pa thag steng dud pa chags pa la zer yang / 'dir chu nang gi ljang khu lang long de yin nam/ skrangs rgyug pa 'gog ched khyung lnga chur sgrungs skud pa sbom po der byan skrangs med mtshams nas bsdams na legs/ shog bu skrangs 'dab pha rol nas sbyin dang phye gdus bskus shog gu sbyar/ spu nan ni spu sbyar phyi nan dpyad/ rma rnag gis pags pa'i 'og phyogs su zos pa la rnag med sa nas phye sbyin byugs steng gtso ma sbyar sang —bkog mdog dpyad de rnag yod sar spo ba sogs rim gyis nang bsnur/ spu dang shog gu sogs 'dra/ sman byug 'thug sra ba shog gu tsam yod tshe shog gu sbyar/ rdol med slar yang shog gu bkog bskus yin nam/ 'byung mthun ni sa lhog sogs/
nag po gsum dpyad/ dud 'gror byung ba la yan lag gang gis reg pa de kur byung ba mthong / sos rjes kyi rma ro 'dzer ma 'dra ba dang har da'i mjug ma gdus 'thung na legs kha bshad yod/ skrangs pa'i mthar mar byugs ste spra ba ril mos mtshams med par bskor mer sgron/ de rjes dbus su me btsa' bzhag ces ur lug zer/ lung pa'i mdo gnam lcags dpyad/
le'u so bzhi pa/ 'bras kyi nad gso ba/'bras rtsar babs yin nam/ rkun bu ni mi gsal ba/ sha 'bras tsha ba che zug che/ rus 'bras 'gram rus dang so ting sogs la byung / zug chen po'i rjes rdol bar rus pa mdog 'gyur nas ljang gur 'gro ba mthong mi 'tsho ba mthong / rus pa'i tsi ni brla'i mgo'i rnyi ba de lta bu/ thog mar spang rtsi bcu gnyis 'ga' btang gnyan tshad chogs nas khyung lnga dang dngul chu bco brgyad/srin 'joms dngul chu dgu pa sogs btang nas em chi'i rma bcos ltar byas na legs/ rnag tu 'gugs na lhos 'bras skabs kyi gu gul mu zi sogs kyi rnag/ 'gugs de legs/ rdol ran tshe brdol na bzang / glum glad [klad]ni sbang ma btsir ba'i dkar po/ go tsan dpyad/ 'bras rdol phral sha la 'dzem mi dgos/
jile'u so lnga pa/ gnyan nad gso ba/ltag dgye byung zer thos pa yod/ gas byed skar ma rgyal/ shug tsher can lag tshegs rkang / khrag rkang pa ni myang rtsi sbas [spras]te rgya'i hong len zhes rtsa ba gdus na ser po 'ong ba zhig btsong rgyu yod/ del [tel] ba me btsa' ste lcags kyi del [tel]ba brdung ba yod/rgya nad byang sman gdon zhig phyi rol nas rngul sgor zhugs/ bad gan gyi phul tsha bas bzung nas 'phrog glo rlung dpyad/ rlung gis spyad dpyad/dbugs rgyu ba zhan/ chu khong nas log pa mthong ma shi mgo tshigs shin tu na 'khrul nas kha blas lag pa brkyangs nas gang zin la sbar bas 'thams mal nas phyir 'bud/ mig 'gram pa rke [ske] sogs ser ba 'tsho ba mthong dri dugs so dregs chags ( pa ) mthong / mchin mkhris steng gzer 'dril/rang gnas srog rtsar sleb/ sna khrag 'dzag dang lu ba mthong / thog mar ma nu bzhi thang 'ga' btang / spru nag nyer dgu dang ga bur nyer gsum btang legs/ ga bur nyer gsum ni tsha ba stobs ldan spyi la legasathun chung 'jug/nyer dgu ni/ spru nag ya 'ud med ni khyad par med/ tsha stobs ldan rigs la ma smin dus mgo gzer ba chos nyid yin kyang smin rjes mgo na mi 'jog na mgor babs yin/ de la dpral rtsar cung gtar las dga' med/ sngo lga ngos 'dzin med/ srin khung dpyad/ shing sngon spyi zhur[bzhur]/ thog rus thog gis bsad pa'i dud 'gro'i rus pa'ang chog snyam/nang lhog mi shes/ chu sri ni gtong rgyu yod snyam med pa/ skad 'thams
skad mi thon yin nam/ long khrag dpyad/ sgos kyi gsang sman phur nag yin nam/ gla rtsi dri yod tsam/ nad phog ma thag tsha na de ni pho ris sam/ byi sa ni byi long gi sa/kha med mi shes/ chu so chu lam/ chu lam nas khrag chu ser 'dzag ra dug pa ni sman chen me tog nag po can sa 'dir med/ rtsa sna ste bsam ses dang 'brel sna sogs gang gnyan pa/ji'khyams po rker [sker]'bur bo byung rtsed tsha zhib rdzas rdol nang du rdol shi ba mthong ste yin min ma shes/ lkog ma ma le'i 'og 'jing sdebs gnya' rko yin nam/ rtsa phreng sogs dpyad/ mkhan pa nag po dri dugs can yin nam/ spang spyang brun yin nam/'bar 'bur ma shes/phus 'debs rna sbubs gzer shing sgor skrangs rdol shi ba mthong de yin nam mi shes/ bar rta grum bar rta tsha mjug 'bras skrangs sman bzhi sbyor tshol/ngam du [ru]mi shes/ gre ba tshe ba'i nyams/ ljan ljin pho ba'i nang la sbyor ram/ rngabs rwa 'jib rwa/ stod gsang dpyad/0 lang tsho ldan khrag gzhon nu ma'i mngal khrag gam dpyad /mgo phyed mar bgos pa'i phyed gzer zhing skrangs pa 'jib rwa btsugs gtar yang mi phan pa mthong / za 'gram mur 'gram sogs don gcig mgo thang gsum dang man ngag gur gum bcu gsum legs pas sdebs/ thang khrom yod pa'i sman btsan bzi zhing ja tshan mo 'thung na slar yang bzi/ kha lce skam mig gis thag ring mi mthong / rta sbangs nus ldan bsreg gza' nyi ma shar tshe kham bu'i nang snying brngos nas btsir na mar yod/: a rag ni rang re'i chang /glum gyi nye'u sbang ma'i nang snying / chu klung gi khar skye ba'i shob nya dkar mo yin
nam/ ba ru'i sdong bo'i rtsa ba/ zha nye brdar ba'i chu/ dbyar zho bskus yin nam/ bre ga gar yang skye ba'i sngo zhig
le'u so drug pa/ mgo srin gyi nad gso ba/mgo srin dang mgo nad khyad par shes dka'/ ra ni ra 'bur/ rgya srubs ni thod pa'i ri mo yod pa/ mkhar gong ni rdo dkar po cong zhi las srab/dwa ba ngos 'dzin med ri skyes dwa rgod zhing skyes dwa g.yung 'bras bu byi ru ltar dmar ba bshad/ ldum bu nag ba sha 2 long du dpyad/ gzer 'joms gsum ni tsher sngon a byag ming can nag po/ drod sman pi pi ling / kun rkyal du mgo dpyang nas sna nas blugs na klad par 'gro/ phan pa kun ldan sbyor myong / dpral mtshams nas thad sor tha gus bsdams yan la sman bskus thang khug gis g.yogs tha gu man nas bcings par bshad pa mthong / zug med ma dag bug med/ dag byed sug pa zer ba'i dri 'dag byed sngo zhig khyi gi them sogs yod/ sbang lums thang khug phyi nas byugs/
le'u so bdun pa/ dbang bo sgo lnga'i nad gso ba/mig skra ngan ma chag bu long zhig srod long mtshan mi mthong / gnyan gyi 'khris/ ling thog dmar po dang skya ba mthong chu bur 'dra/ mthong byed ni rno/ling thog la zug che/ sha mdzer mig nang nas 'bur bo skyes te rtsa nas khrag 'ong pa mthong ste na zug cher med 'dra/ rgya tsha brdung 'ob bcin lta bu mer bsregs dmar po song tshe steng btab steng li ting kha sbubs mtha' sa skam pos g.yogs/ li ting nang la du ba chags pa de ling thog la shin tu legs/ nyin 'gar btab chu bur rdol sangs/ sbyor sde kha 'thor na ti tsha ste dpya brdung dong tsi se ra srab mo gnyis mang nyung bsres blugs phor kha phyes nang bzhag ba la [ba bla]rdo lta bu'i sa gsum bzhag steng cung phred bzhag so ba brtsigs sbud pa btang nang dud pa mtshar bo chags pa snga phyir blangs mthar ti tsa [tsha]med 'gro/ dud pa de sman gzhan dang bsres nas btang na ling thog la legs/mig nad rims can la spang rtsi bcu gnyis thengs 'ga' blud rjes skyer khaṇa bskus na legs/ mig lcibs kyi nang logs la rtsub mo zhig byung nas zug che bas 'byed 'dzum dka' bas de la rna ba'i sgo'i 'bur mtho dman gnyis yod pas thog ma dma' ba'i steng me btsa' chung ngu bzhag legs/ rkang pa'i dreg mtshams la me btsa' byed pa'ang mthong / mig chu ni mig 'bur gyi nang gi chu/phyi 'grib shun lpags phyi nas bsgrigs/ nang 'grib mig chu'i nang nas sgrib/sbrul sha gar gtong yang gla tsi cung btab pa'i chu nang du zhag gcig bzhag pa'i dug 'don dgos/ ti tsa [tsha]ser po ma mthong / sha pho ru rta sha ra khrag can/
dung srin med/ a wa lcags gcod zer ba rgya nang btsong rgyu sen mo 'brad thub pa yod/ 'jigs med gser mdog 'dra ba mjug ldum ba/ shel rgyal ka ra shel dkar ram/ khyi la wa ri seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa ste dbus su nyo rgyu yod/ bar ga ta dmar po smug po sna tshogs yod/ sa ram tsi zho zangs la bskus g.ya' chags pa/ a ru brdung gdus lcags sag brdar brgyab phye ma btab zhag 'gar bsnyal na phye phal cher zhu ba la nang btsag 'dam btags ni de nang sgrungs brdung skam tshe yang blugs brdung lan gsum bzhi re byed/ nur ni ma chadapa/ ba [pa] ru ni snod cig em chi'i rgyal mo chu 'byed yod/ dar dmar btums sbyar ba'am sbags sam/ ra rgya'i rgyu/ rag rdo rag 'byung ba'i rdo/ lcags sbrul mig mtshar ba mthong / spos reng g.yag mkhris nya mkhris gnyis brtsis pa'i so gsum yin nam/ gsal byed so gsum pa'i mdung rtse gong ma dmar po/ mig sman sangs rgyas zhim thig le/ thun thal ldab ni thams cad sdom pa'i nyis 'gyur/ lcags kyi dreg pa ni lcags kyi btsa'/ dug med sbrang dkar gyi sbrang smyon 'don tshul sbrang rtsi gar [dkar]yol gang chu gar [dkar]yol gsum gdus/ sbrang shad byed na chu mod dgos de min ji ltar 'tshams/ rim gyis khar mar lta bu chags pa bal lta bus blangs te btsir/lde gu sogs mgul du mid/ dpral rtsa dang gser mdung dngul mdung sogs gtar ba yin/ smin gong rus bzhi ldebs steng tha gus bsdams ltag gong nas shing bus gcus na rtsa 'bur/ sha srubs shor mi gsal na mjug tu gcig myang nas gcig gis 'og tu reg pas mer mer byed par rtsa yod/ spang ni ljang /bal 'dab bal dum/ bud ma grod dpyad/ ba nu cong zhi lta bu brag ngo nas mar 'phyab ['phyang]ba nu ma'i dbyibs can spos rdzong du yod/ mchil ba nas zan/ 'gron bu pho mo'i khyad mi shes/ brun gyi pho dkar mgo dkar po/ ra ni tsog tsog sha ru btsa' ma skam po yun lon/ 'bri mar sogs rkang par byugs/
mig rigs drug dpyad/ bya'u rta chung sogs skar ma/ gar sha ni 'theb 'dzub [mtheb mdzub]bar gyi sha/ gangs dpyad/ nang dus chang / skyar mo ni ngang skya zhes chu nang kho nar sdod pa/ gra ma ni kye ma/ chu yi 'khor lo grang dugs/'dir rna nad dbye bar byas pa dpyad/ rna ba'i nad la mkhal ma'i bcos gal che bas sug smel bcu pa sogs bsten/ khrag rjes dbugs 'ongs tshe dang pa'i tha ma ni mtha' yan nam/ rna ba ni phyogs lug gi'ang de phyogs/rma bya'i sgro dang 'ug sgro sogs sgro'i rigs lcags leb mer bsros steng bsregs pa yin/ bsregs nas tshig bcug min/ byi rug pa ldum bu khol mgo/ tshig brgyud gser khu dpyad/ me 'jam ste me mur/ ag rgo khu dpyad/ se sbur bsregs dud g.yer chu dang chang skyur/sna nad sna sub ni 'tshub/ sna nad chu bur lta bus gang ba dang cham mjug la'ang de 'dra mthong / sna shu rma dmar po leb mos khebs dang sha lu sna mang nas sha skye ba mthong / rang gar rnag 'dzag mthong 'di la tshur dkar nus ldan bsregs pa'i thal ba btab pas sos/ bya bal ni chu nang gi gong bshad/ dag byed sug pa/ big ban tshur sngon po la zer kyang tshur nag rdo rigs bcag ljang shas 'dre ba de yin/ lcags zad po'i steng mchil ma brlan/tshur cung bzhag 'dzub [mdzub]mos mnyes na dmar po dmar po 'gro/ ri thang mtshams kyi big pan sgog gcig nus ldan bsregs thal/ mu zi smug sbyor dpyad/ tshad ro glad par bros/ rlangs dpyad/ smin dbrag ni bar/ dpung 'dzum ni dpung ba'i tshigs pa'i mdun phyogs 'gul na gshong 'bid ['bud]sa/ sna khrag zla mtshan sogs khrag gcod thams cad la em chi'i go ro khrag gcod bdun pa legs pas sdebs/ dong ral brag spos mtshal dkar dngul chu blangs ma blangs gnyis yod skya shed yod/ tshos rgya rgya tshos yin 'dra/zab ni gos bsregs thal/ rta lpags sngo zhig sna khrag bsres pa'i zan gzhu
'then pa thabs/kha nad bad chu skya tshos ni/ kha glo der kham bar blangs btsags [gtsags]bu 'ga' rgyab gtar khyung phye dang spang rtsi sogs btab pa yin/ shwa re ni kha sho/ lce skrangs lce 'og tu chu thum/ lce'i srab 'thug yod pa sogs mthong / btsar bu rgyab chu blangs yang cung bsog pa blangs te lan 'gas phan 'di lce bam/ lce 'og skrangs pa gtar na rnag cung zad re 'ongs pa mthong /lce chung je ring song ba/ kha nad rims ni kha lang pa/ rtsib rus bsregs sbyar na 'byar/ a ru btso ba thal tshan tsi hrog tsam bsregs pa/ thal tshan bsregs pa'i tshig [tshigs] ma mid pa tshun chad nas skrangs 'bur yang yang rdol rnag 'ong mthong / gre 'bras sam lce chung gcod na lcags kyi sgam chung gi kha leb kyis dang / bsreg na snyu/gas [smyug] sbubs tshigs mtshams su bug gcig byas phyir ras chus sbang dkris de nang lcags thur tshan mo bcug bsregs/ 'di rgya rma 'thor ba sogs la'ang 'dra/ kha lang na spang rtsi bcu gnyis legs/ gnyan ldum kha chog phra la tha [thu] gu rgya gram 'then me btsa'/stag bya leb 'phur gtsos kyi khragso nad grang bas gnod pa dang drod kyis gnod pa so sor mthong / so na ba phye mar tshan mos reg ma thag bzhag pa'ang mthong / so na na 'gram pa'i phyogs su rtsa 'phar ba mthong / srin can pa byi tang ga bdun pa ma mog khug kha nang bzung legs/ stug [rtug]skam skabs kyi spyi 'joms 'di dang gag srin sogs la legs/ sngags dbu chen 'di 'gram par btags na phan pa myong grub/ gu yu ni gu gul go yu yin nam/ mig 'bras ni mig dkyil sran ma tsam yod/ rnam par yu ga [gu]shing / seng khrom spyi zhur[bzhur]/ rnyil rnag gis za ba dang / skrangs nas so dang mnyam pa mthong / dom mkhris rgya skyegs sogs kyi mkhur bkang legs/ kha lang yul lugs la rta'i 'o ma dang rta gseb
kyikha nang gi kha mur tshan mo kha nang 'jog pa dang / byis pa chung ngu la shug srab stong ha k+ṣa ma la sogs kyi bskor dbus me btsa' bzhag spyi bor bzung dros tsam byed rten 'brel me btsa' zer/wa ba g.yang wa zer ba dbyibs mdzes mthong / spang rgyan dkar po yongs grags dkar la ser mdangs cung zad can/ wa tsha gyang ngor chags pa dang tshwa ngan gru bzhi yod pa'ang chog yol mdud ni yo'u ri skyog nang yangs ni mid pa dgag pa sogs je yangs yin nam/ lug gi ska'i [ske'i] rmen bu yin nam/ mon nas 'ongs pa ma mthong / spyi yol dpyad/ rmen bu'i tsha ba ni thug pa yin nam/ hal ge dmar po ste bi la'i zhan nye bstan nas sker gon pa mthong /
le'u so brgyad pa/ don snod kyi nad gso ba/snying 'phyos dang srog rlung gnyis nad rtags phal cher 'dra bas so sor ngos 'dzin dka'/ snying nad la srog 'dzin bcu bcig a gar so lnga/ spyi [phyi]rgyud a gar brgyad sogs ster/ kha yeng ni mthong che sa/ pus dkar mu la a gar dzi ta/glo ba zo mar ni zom ngos 'o ma yun ring chags pa/ rlung glo dgos [dgong]dang tho rangs mang ba/ lud pa skya ga sob wu ba can gting nas mi lur kha nas thung thung lu ba mthong / glor khrag rgyas lud par khrag 'dre ba mthong / byi la'i mgul 'dra ni lud pa khar ma 'ongs pa'i nyams/ glo bar skyon yod na dgun dus na ba dang mtshan mo thu ba nges par 'ongs/ 'bras gsum tshos btsod 'bri mog sro lo'i thang 'di glo nad gang la'ang thog mar nges par gtong / a krong zhes gsal kha med pa ni mkhan pa gser mgo ba yags [ yag] la 'byar nas skye ba me rtog chung ngu sngo la dmar mdangs can gang bu mdong mdong nor bu 'dra ba bya rog nor bu zer/ nags tshang ni rdza mgor rtso rdzogs 'dra ba/ tshad dus lto ran dus dgung gnyis dpyad/ cu gang nyer lnga dang gtso bo nye ra lnga glo nad can thams cad la btang ba yin/ 'di'i gwa dor sha ra khrag can/ gwa dor rnam gsum zhes par bse ru kha shar sha'i ra gsum/ bse ru sag gdar rgyab nas brdung dgos/ bse ru nyer lnga sdebs myong / rlung glor a gar so lnga brgyad pa sogs ster/ khrag lu ba zhig la glo snying 'dom rtsa gtar bas phan pa mthong ste smyo rtags/ pho shing stag pa/ mo shing glang ma yin/ khram shing glud lag bzhag skur ram ma shes/
glo rnag can mgo sgur nas sdod pa dang gang na rnag yod phyogs kyi dpung ba dpyang pa/ gzer chung ngu 'pho ba skad gdangs zhan zhing skad cha bshad tshe skad kyi mjug dbugs kyis mi lcogs pa/ lce rnyil sen mo dkar ba lud pa'i nang rnag ser po yung 'bru tsam re 'ongs pa mig lcibs cung sbos pa/ kha rlangs las dri ngan 'byung ba sogs nges par 'ong ba'i rtags/ glo nad dang po byung ba nas sos rag bar chu dmar ba mthong / cham pa kha shor ba'i mjug glo rnag tu 'gro ba dang / glo tshad gnyan kha chog pa nas sos thag ma chod bar der kha shor na rjes nas glo rnag tu 'gro/ 'di phal cher 'chi/ chu sprin 'dra ba dang gar ba ste 'bag tho/ tang kun ni lo ma'i mdog go snyod 'dra ba la nag ngam se byed pa sdong bu'i rtser yal ga gyes pa me tog chung ngu dkar sob se byed pa me tog yod pa pho tang / med pa mo tang / glo rnag mchin dri'i steng du rdol 'phral 'chi ba mthong / spang tshan spu ru skye dbyibs bya rgod sug pa 'dra ba la sbom dang ring thung de tsam med pa mdog cung dmar se ba mthong / gtso nyer lngar mtshal dang bdud rtsi sdoms pas sbyor ba gcig gi tshad 'phen/ 'di'i glo rnag la rgya ru'i tshab spos bar/ cig shos ni pa yag rtsa ba/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin/'dam bu ka ra chu nang skye ba zhig bya rog nyung ma ma shes 'di la em chi'i tsan dan bcu drug steng gsang sman bzhi bsnan pa rnag skem 'dren la mchog rta bong bu ba'i 'o ma gsum rkyang pa'ang glo rnag can la legs/ glo dum bur chad nas lud pa'i nang 'ongs ba yod/ bya rog nor bu pa yag min na dpyad/sbrang rtsi thug rdor [sdor]tsam rgyab/ so bya chur gnas so can tu bshad/ grod par chu blug pas brdung / khong sman dang bud [bul] spel/ ge sar gnyis nag pad+ma gnyis/ rkang gang sogs dpyad/ rna mchog dpyad/ 'ga' zhig byang ba'i bar gshog la dug yod pas dor zer/ 'bri gung gces bsdus su bar gshog bcas 'phen dgos pas dug 'don la g.yer ma rdog gsum re
'phen gsung / yog mo mkhan rigs spra ba dang dbyibs 'dra ba yod/ a krong sogs sman rnams ra'u glo nang bcug pa la rgyangs pa zer/ sro lo sgrungs pa'i chu rgyab pa la bsings pa zer/mchin nad lus drang bor byas g.yas 'dzub [ mdzub] gung gnyis kyi rtses rna shal bzung gru mos sleb tshad 'di mchin gnas yin pas de la gzer 4drag po glo tshad dang 'dra/ mchin pa skrangs snyamakhyad pa/ mig mchin pa'i me tog yin pas dmar/ mchin nad can la smin mar 'gyu lu babs 'chi rtags/snying nad can lce thung gas/ glo nad sna zhom/ mtsher cad [nad]mchu brdzes/mkhal nad can rna rgyab 'byar na 'a chi rtags yin pa ni rang rang gi me tog yin pas so// bol gong nywa ste ga dong kha'i rtsa ba gshong / mchin nad tsha ba can la gur gum bdun pa a ru bcu pa sogs sdebs/ phyi ma 'di mkhal tshad la'ang legs/ dong ga khrag rgyu skam po 'dra ba'i 'a bru sman/ g.yu gsar skya shas che ba rdo dkar bo 'dre ba zhig yin/ g.yu snying [ rnying] ni bzang po/gser gyi phud bu skyur ba mgo bcad 'dra ba nag po steng rtsa'i dra bas g.yogs pa che chung dan rog tsam pa yod/ ri ṣi'i chur bsdad mchin nad la legs/mtsher mchin thad g.yon phyogs gzer mchu sogs rtags mtsher nad 'di cher mi 'byung / ri tshos ni 'bro mog sman zhu rjes dbugs 'tshub ma bcug gos kyis klubs nas dros su gzhug pa spyir dros phud tshul yin/ da lis sug dkar gyi me tog go/mkhal/ mi theg khur ba dang / gad kha nas thang la brdab pas mkhal mar skyon zhugs pa mthong / mkhal skyed kyi sha rus bar na gzer 'a khyug ltag pa'i chu ba gnyis kyi 'gram gnyis// rke [ ske] bsgyur mi shes pa 'di dang rtsa dkar la'ang mthong / dpyi dang brla gnyis 'brel mtshams rked pa man 'greng nas lag pa bsrings na sor mo sleb tshad yan thams cad na ba mthong /
sbrid pa byung tshe dpyi mig la na zug bzod glags med pa dang / nam stod spyi dang khyad par sa rub ma thag zug lhag par che ba mkhal nad thams cad la mthong / mkhal tshad la em chi'i a ru bco brgyad pa legs/ a ru bcu pa sdebs/ mkhal ma grang shas che la sug smel bcu pa legs/ go yu ni mkhal ma go yu/ go yu bdun pa tsha grang thams cad la sdebs/sa bon 'dzag tsha ba byung rjes sa bon 'khru rkyen las 'di 'byung ba sogs mthong / pho mtshan 'greng ba dang chab bsil dus chu sor zug che ba bden/ sa bon rgyun 'dzag mthong / khrag 'dzag ma mthong / lcam pa mdog glo kha 'dab ma phyi nang mang po can mo lcam/ nag ngam me ba 'dab ma rim pa gcig can pho lcam/ tsha 'dzag na zug shin tu che/ grang bar zug de tsam med kyang tsag shad 'byung / khams chab bsil 'dres 'ong btang 'phral mdog skya ba la cung bzhag khams zhabs su snyigs/ mdog ldan lcam pa/ sar khyung 'dzag sdom dang sa ra'i myong grub sdebs/ tsher ma can shug tsher/ 'dzeg sdom la mkhal nad gos ba'ang zhor la nges par byed dgos pas/ tsha ba la em chi'i sar khyung bco brgyad pa dang / a ru bcu pa dang bco brgyad pa sogs ltag sprod byed/ grang 'dzag la sar khyung bco brgyad dang sug smel bcu pa ltag sprod byed/ gso byed dbang lag bcu sdebs myong / bal ser ljang sogs tshos kyis bsgyur/ 'khor lo 'bri myong / 'dzag rigs la je thur 'gro na'ang yun dang / ji dgar 'gro na'ang yun ma gtogs sman sogs kyis phral du phan gnod mi 'byung / gyen ldog sdebs myong / pad rag zla mtshan/ thal chen mi grir shi bsregs thal/ 'bras sbyor bcu gcig la gcig me long / gsha' tshe dkar po ti tsha dkar po/ tril tril log log zhad tsam nyung ngu tsam/ gun 'dar ha ra sogs dpyad/pho ba bad kun dang phyogs 'dra bas 'di sger du shes dka'/ zhi drug
steng 'ga' zhig bsnan pa'i em chi'i ltar dang / brag zhun dgu pa sogs legs/ sbrul sha mgo mjug bcad de dor shun lpags dor/ dug 'don byas/dgos tshe sha rus khyad med gtong / grang ba la bad kun skabs kyi se 'bru'i rigs 'phrod snyam/ tsha sbyor thams cad la me mnyam zer/ bzhi gsum dpyad/seng ldeng se 'bru gdus khus rta byas/rgyu nad lte bug man chad yin pas gnas kyis cung zad shes dri ma skam nas shwa ril 'dra ba/ spu 'khril spus dkris pa/ dru bu bru gu yin nam/ 'phren dpyad/ 'phrul thal chung ngu sdebs myong / 'di la 'khru gcod se 'bru dgu pa ta trig bdun pa rgyu gzer skabs kyi in+d+ra bco lnga sogs legs/ snya lo rdza mgor khru gang tsam lo ma lcang lo 'dra yod cung dkon/ dbyu gus tha ga pa la dal bus bsnun na nang 'gro/ lto tshil phyir don pa'i skag na mtshams tshwa sna btab rta rngas bsdams gcod/rgyu rgan yun ring song ba gang zos 'khru ba be snabs yang 'khru ba skabs skabs na zug yang yod pa mthong / na zug med par gang zos gshang ba 'dor ran tshe 'khru ba 'ang mthong / zug med par 'khru la yung ba lcum sogs sdebs myong / na ram tha ram ram bu'i rigs/ me tog sngon po dril ldang 'dra ba sngo klu bdud rdo rje shang dril dbyibs de 'dra la dmar po dang ser po mthong /long lte bug thad yin 'di 'dra ma mthong / bca' dgos na zhi drug steng ru rta drug pa dang bcu gcig sogs snon gtong /mo mtshan khrag mngal du 'khyigs na ja lha'i [ bca' sga'i] tshig thang btang / de rjes zhi drug steng rgya tsha sbrul sha sdig srin ltar bu 'ol mo se ste rtsa rgya ba'i 'bras bu bsnan pa'i bcu gcig pa gtong / byis pa btsa' ran btsa' ma thub pa la 'di chang gis rta byas btang legs/ sha ma ma thon pa la'ang 'di btang legs/ zla mtshan rgyun 'dzag ma chod pa la em chi'i khrag gcod sogs
