le'u so dgu pa/ thor nad gso ba/skad 'gag tsha ba can la li shi drug pa sogs bzang / thor nad kyi rigs 'di phal cher tsha ba dang grang ba sogs nad stobs can gzhan gyi steng du 'ongs/ rang rkyang 'byung ba'ang re gnyis yod/yi ga 'byed pa la sga gur bsnan se 'bru lnga pa legs pas tsha ba can la'ang tsha sman dang 'di gnyis res mos su ltag sprod gtong /skom dad la bcos 'dir bshad gang rigs/skyigs bu nad gzhan steng 'ong ba dang rkyang par byung nas bcos kyi mi 〈na par 'chi ba mthong ste/ skabs shig sgra 'don mi nus bar bskyod pa chen po yin 'dra/ skyigs bu phal cher la nya sha ye 'phang gis du ba ltar 'then pa zhon tu legs/ nyam chung sogs skyigs chen po byung na bcos spang / rus pa phu mo sna nang btang sbrid pa 'ong / sle dres [tres]phye ma sna do ltar 'then kyang sbrod 'byung / skyigs bu can gcig la ske stong me btsa' ring la phra ba dang /ston steng me lnga tshom bzhag zhi drug steng kha 'thor gso byed nyi ma'i dkyil sprukhor dang / rje gser khang pas mdo smad grags pa'i gso byed bdud tsi grang rajoms gnyis bsnan btang pas phan te rang bzo/ chen po la ci byas kyang mi 〈na/ sman dang skom yang mi thar ba mthong / a gar sogs bdug pa bya myong /spre spos ngos 'dzin med kyang sngo dri shin tu zhim pa mthong yin nam/ spra tshil bu dam bskol ba'i zhag lta bu yin/dbugs mi bde phal cher glo nad can la 'byung zhing phyi ra 'byin pa las
nang du rngub pa dka' ba mthong / gzha' ba dpyad/ li shi bcu gcig legs snyam/ li shi drug pa dang rgun 'brum bdun pa la shing mngar cung ’[ cu gang]gnyis pa lnga ba yod pas re re byas bcu gcigglang thabs smug po sogs kyi steng du 'byung ba dang / rkyang par 'byung ba mthong / mchin glang mchin tshad dang mi nor ba'i rtags glang thabs gzer drag po re rgyab/ yang cung bde snyam yang gzer rgyab de 'dra byed pa dang /khong pa'i nang sbos gang snyam byed pa mi 'gyur ba'i rtags/ 'og rlung mi thon skad 'don mthong / smug pa'i glang thabs can rgyab gzer bud sgal steng mi gcig 'greng mnan kyang mi non pa mthong / dru bu bru gu pho ba'i glang thabs phal cher ma zhu ba'i glang thabs yin/ lte ba'i g.yas phyogs gzer na khrag glang dang / g.yon phyogs gzer na srin glang yin/ rgyu ma'i glang thams cad srin glang yin/ sreb ba ni yun ring ba zhi drug ma nu zho gsum sga zho do a ru zho lnga/lcum bu gnyis zho gsum re cong zhi zho bzhi byas pa yin/ lhum bu la drug 'gyur sbyar na 'khru/ pho ba'i ma zhu ba'i glang thabs la zhi drug steng ru rta drug pa bsnan btang na legs/ ru rta bcu gcig pa bsnan yang chog long dang rgyu ma'i srin glang la khyung phye'i steng du ru rta drug pa'am zhi drug bsnan gtong bcu gcig pa bsnan kyang chog smug glang la sprug po'i sman dang ru rta drug pa'am bcu gcig pa ltag sprod/ bcu gcig pa thang khrom yod pas thun chung dgos/ nad pa drang bor byas nas sman gsum bzhi re bstud/ skyugs kyang blud na khong du sman lhag cung zad re lus pas phan/ glang thabs sman ma rnyed pa la rang gi dri chu tshan mo 'thung na legs/ 'di ma zhu glo bur ba skyugs ma nus pa'ang legs/srin bu/ lag mthil du dngul chu cung zad blugs mar nag dang gnyis bsres 'dzub [mdzub]mos dang por dal bus phur/ rim pas shed kyis phur 'dres sngo mur song skabs slar yang mar nag blugs chosgrungs skud pa la phur/
skud pa rked bcings na shig la legs/ 'di'i dkar po chig thub rdza mtho sa'i thang khrom yin nam/'khru bar grang 'khrur phyi rgyud se 'bru dgu pa dang da drig [trig] dgu pa legs/ tshad 'khrur in+d+ra bco lnga legs/skyug tsha grang gang la'ang phyi rgyud shing mngar drug pa legs pas nad gzhan gyi steng du byung na nad de'i gnyen po dang 'di gnyis ltag sprod gtong /sog ka pa sngo 'bras bu'i gang bu sog pa'i dbyibs can yod/ na ra si pi ling /'bras yos 'bras brngos pa/ dri 'gag stug [rtug] pa skam nas ma thon pa yin pas 'di la a ru sogs gsum thang legs pas 'di gcig pus kyang chogspyi 'joms kyang 'di dang gag srin sogs la legs/ phye ril phye ma'am ril bu/re ral ni shug pa'i shing mngar zhes ja byed pa/ shug tsher sogs bzhi bsdoms zho do/ gla tsi sogs nyung ngu re btab pa yin/ phye ma byed na mtshal snon dgos/bzhi nam ni zho gang gi bzhi cha'am dpyad/ ngu gcin 'gag la sho 'u gdus blud na legs/ tsha sbyor chen mos phan pa mthong / chu spur chu nang du khar yod pa la sdig sgra lta bu byas na drang bor thur du mgyogs par 'gro ba yan lag dmar po can yod/ nyi dga' lcam pa/ a sho gan+ta ba spru pa/ gser phye brgyad pa byed myong / tsabs ru tsha ma mthong spyi 'joms dang sug smel bcu pa legs/ bza' btung nang du spu song ba chu lam du 'dril nas rde'ur song ba yin pas phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa las phyi rdel blangs choggcin snyi ni nad gzhan gyi mjug tu dang / thig le 'dzag pa dang mnyam du 'byung ba'ang mthong / dri chu dor phral yang 'gro dgos pa'o// chu nang ku ya lta bu'i rnyog pa can dri mnam pa gcin shul sbrang ma 'du ba sog sa mthong /'bras gsum rtsa lnga sogs sdebs myong yang yun ring bas phral du ngo lon pa zhig
min/ tshos shing ni rgya tshos kyi shing /rgya nad tshad 'khru ma shes zur ba/ thun lnga ba ni nyis 'gyur/dreg nad thog mar rkang pa'i 'the [mtheb]bong na bas de dus bcos na phan/ de tshe ma bcos na rim gyis rgya tshig [tshigs]dang pus mo sogs la nur/de rjes lag pa'i gru mo 'dzu [ mdzub] gu sogs na/ 'di dus bcos kyang mi phan/ 'dzu [mdzub] gu'i tshig [tshigs] dang lag tshigs sogs phar 'khyog tshur 'khyog 'chol 'gro ba mthong / na zug che zhing 'phar tshe nyal sar ltung drag rgyu med cing yun ring bas grum bu las kyang thu/ 'di rigs brgyud la 'byung ba'ang mthong / 'ga' zhig la na sar rngabs ra [ rwa] btsugs nas gtar na lo re gnyis la phan pa mthong / spos khyung bco lnga bldab [brdab]skyon gnyis la khyi la dang gul nag bsnan pa 'dra/ ge sar gnyis na ga pad+ma gnyis be do la be 'bras 'phen/ bong khrag nyer lnga grum bu dang 'di gnyis gar bzang bas sdebs/ bong thor khal 'gel ma myong ba'i khrag dgos/ dud ni du ba ral ba/ gsor bdug ni gsos te bdug pa yin nam/ bya thal ni brun nus ldan bsregs pa/ shu ti ni spru nag pa'i 'bras bu yin nam dpyad/'theb [mtheb]chung dreg rtsa rtsad gcod/ grum bu tsha ba bcud shor lta bur tsha ba byung nas zla ba gnyis tsam song ba na grum bur 'gyur/ dang po grang shum dang rkang lag na ba sogs mthong / sod [srod] nas zug je thur song ste mi nyal rgyab lta bu nas cung bde ba'ang mthong / grum bu gdong lhogs [lhog]gi thang bsten dgos/ klu bdud bco brgyad sdebs myong yang bcu bdun las med pa dpyad/ stong zil stong ri zil ba zhes sngo zhig yod/ glang shu ni khyi sder zhes rma'i dkyil sos shing mtha' mched nas zos 'gro ba yod/ za rkong ni sha kong mor gting la zos 'gro ba'i rma zhig yin/ dngul chu dug bral ni mu zis btul ba dngul chu dang khyung lnga sbyar ba 'di sdebs/ tsha grang kha bsgyur gzhung
ltar mkhal khung nas zug drag po byung ba la a ru bcu steng sle dres [tres]bong khrag bsnan pa gtong / byang nag byang ba nag khra/ ja btung ba sogs kyis tshegs med du rngul ba rnyings tshad kyi rtags yin pas/ de 'dra'i rngul chad dus ga bur sogs bsten tshad ces pa yin nam dpyad/grum gsar tsha ba gsar du byung tshe gnyid shor ba sogs kyi rkyen dang chang 'thung drag pa las byung ba dang / deng sang mang ba gdon rkyen gyis glo bur byung ba'o// stod gzer sogs bla gnyan 'di'i steng du snon pa srid/ 'di la sman bong khrag nyer lnga dang nyer lnga rnyings tshad la brten [bston]dgos/ mon sran dre'u ni nas nang gi sran ma chung ngu sngo leb pa de la zer/ a sa ni skyo ma snum ldan/chu ser 'brum phran mang po phyogs gcig tu 'tshogs nas leb mor 'ongs ba dang / me nyis dros na za 'phrug 'ongs 'phrug na chu ser 'dzag pa mthong / 'ga' zhig la thor phran gyis lus khyab cing chu ser 'dzum pa sen mos phral nas btsir na chu ser 'dzag pa mthong / chu ser can thams cad sha mdog sngo ba mthong / dngul chu 'bru bcud chang / chu ser la dngul chu bco brgyad gtso bor bsten dgos/ gsum ya ni gsum lta bu cha min pa/ yug [yugs]ni rdo kham pa brdar na dmar po 'ong ba yod/ bdud rtsi spos dkar dang sbrang rgyus dpyad/ du ba ral ba ni khang rnying gi dud pa dpyang ba/ btsag sa dmar rdo 'dre ba shin tu dmar ba/ bong ba zhes gsal kha med pa rnams sman chen/ kham bu'i tshi gu ste nang snying / chur zhugs na grang ber lta bus lus khyab 'gro ba de chu ser dkar po yin nam/rtsa dkar sogs kyi rtsa'i gnas tshul dpyad/ nad rtags gzhan rnams ma mthong yang / yan lag byang khog thams cad bsgul bskyod mi nus par nyal sar lhungs nas bsgul na zug che ba zhig la zug gar yod sar me btsa' mang
du bzhag pas phan pa mthong / byung nas 'gor na dang por me bum rgyab gtar nas chu ser zhig blangs rjes me btsa' byas na phan pa mthong / ske dang mgo la byung nas ske dkyog ['gyogs]'gul gtan mi nus pa zhig la gang na sar me btsa' byas pas phan pa mthong / stod kyi rtsa 'gyus gsar pa la dpung 'dzum nas mnan na sog pa'i me long dkyil de tsha bas de dang dpung 'dzum gnyis la me btsa' dang / sdud sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi rus pa 'bur bo'i logs mnan na na sa der me btsa' byas pa tsam gyis phan pa mthong bsam 'phel nor bu 'di dang dreg grum gza' mkhal nad thig le 'dzag pa sogs rtsa nad thams cad la phan pa'i spyi sman yin pas sdebs/ yongs grags khyung phye yang btang chog mu tig gi tshab tu nya phyis 'phen/ sle ba ni sha 'then/ yan lag gi sul thams cad la zug che ba zhig bcos kyang ma phan par shi ba mthong /gtsang ma'i byang sems dmar po'i dod la sin+dhu ra dang dkar por cong zhi byed/rdo a ba lhang tsher lta bu nyo rgyu yod/ gas rbab rtsi sogs ma shes/ mda' 'phang sogs na sar hub brdal ba ltar byugs/ nya skyogs 'bu skyogs sam/mkhal rtsa bral ba khog stod la mi bde ba med par mkhal ma dang rkang pa la zug che zhing langs mi nus pa la me btsas phan pa mthong ste de yin nam/sman sug smel bcu pa/ bsam 'phel gser skud ser po 'phyang yod pa ldum rtsad lta bu btsong rgyu yod/pags nad shu ba srab pa ma gtogs glang shu dang 'dra/ srin thor ni ngo la dmar bos khyab pa ngo shig ngo mdangs dkar po can la rme lta bus nag pos khobs pa/ khabs dang khye ma ma shes/ dbyi mong sman la gtong rgyur me tog dkar po 'char ba lo ma nyi ma ma log gong btus pa dgos/ me tog ser po dang mthing kha 'char ba sman du gtong mi rung / chu tsi chu ma tsi/ bur smug dbus su sgor mo las che ba yod/ ba ru'i mar ba ru ra'i tshi gu brngos te btsir

dom gyi mkhris pa ltar bu hong len dang // tsha la bzang po 'gron bu tshul bzhin bsregs// zhib btags gar nag bcu gcig sbyor ba 'dis// rgyu ma la sogs snod kyi skran gyi rigs// gsar rnying spyi dang bud med bu btsas rjes// mngal skran chags sogs tsha skran rigs kun dang // khyad par mkhris pa'i nad la thengs pa ste sleb pas chog/ pho ba dang ldong nyi /sna ni sprug po'i skabs ltar bcos// maX'i skran la phug ron byi ba mchil ba'i brun gsum pa yag rtsa ba nad ma rigs gsumagang rnyed sbang ma dang sbyar bas bsros la mang du bdug/ de rjes phyi rgyud nas rgya tsha rgyam tsha lce myang tsha kha ru tsha rtsabs ru tsha dwa tsha shing tsha mdze tsha thal tsha ya bag ra rnams cha gcig sga pi pho rnams cha gcig a bar skyur gsum cha gcig ste thun gsum ril bus bshig pa'i rjes// mo nad skabs kyi phyi nang lto gsher chung ba'am// rtsa gsher gang rigs skabs dang bstun te sbyang khrag ro 'don khrag rnag she rul ba sha'i skyo ma lta bu thon na 'tsho/ lca ba til mar la bskol ba'i khu ba la sga pi yang nyams yig las mtsho tsha ste byang tsha lhad med bul tog ces pa'ang bdugpho gsum dang bu ram mar bcas btab pas mngal skran gsar ba yod na 'jig thang ma sgron shing gi rtsa ba pi ling rtsa ba ka rañdza dang pi pi ling ngo bo rang gi phye ma rnams til mar la bskol ba'i lde gus mngal skranarnams 'joms zhig [shing]grub nas khrag 'dzag mi bcad la lus zangs bcud kyis bsrung ba dang / rjes la rtsa ba ra mnye nye shing ba spru ba gze ma ste lnga yi sman mar sbyar zhing / zas skom dang spyod lam shin tu dro bas bcos par bya'o/ / gzhan yang skran rigs sbyor ba rgyud nang bzhin//'phrul thal rdo zhun khyung lnga gang rigs sdebs pas/ / mjug gcod rlung gi lhen skran
zad re bton kyang zug la phan pa mthong / khong sman dngul chu bco brgyad dang stag sha brgyad pa bsten/ 'dra bcos gris 'dra ba/ rus sbos ni rus pa sbos pa lta bu/ 'jig zas ni nya dang phag gi sha yin snyam/ dwa tsha shi tsha 'thug po 'bras la thog mar spang rtsi bcu gnyis re gnyis bsten rjes dngul chu bco brgyad bsten na legs/ rma rnag tu smin rung gi rigs la thog mar khyung lnga blud na smin dka' ba mthong /gzhang 'brum ni zug che zhing tsag shad rgyug pa za 'phrug 'ong ba srod la lhag par na ba mthong / a ru byi tang dbyi mong sogs sdebs myong / gnyer ma gsum yod pa'i rim pa phyi ma la byung na gso sla/ bar ma gso rung tsam na mang gso dkar [dka']bshad/ gzhang lugs [lug] nas 'khyid gang tsam nar ba/ dang po chu dro 'jam gyis sbang de rjes 'bru mar gyi byugs/ rkang pa thag pas nam mkhar btegs 'phongs cung zad bteg tsam byas/ 'phong 'og skyor ma bzhag thag pa la dbyu gus cung zad cung zad bsnun na lugs [lug]pa phyir 'gro/ de rjes phying pa 'phong la ran pa snum byas 'phong du bcugphying pa'i ting pa la skud pa btags te snga phyir btags nas mi lhungs pa byas na legs/ yas mas tshon gang ni rgyab mdun/ lhod pa gshang ba shor 'gro ba/gzhang srin te 'bus tshang byas la tsha khu zur med pa'i ril mo byas mer bsregs/'khyags pa gshang lam du bcug na za 'phrug gsod/ sa dkar yang min/ sa nag kyang min pa'i sa gyo gyo'i gyig tshe skam po'am gad pa'i dum bu mer bsregs sbyar na bzod tsam pa'i tshe 'phong du dugs rgyab na legs/ gro si ni yi/ rdo ni rdo smyon zer ba g.yu byur brdar na lhag par chod pa de yin nam/ bshad rgyud du bshad pa'i cha spyad [byad ]des rma gar yod btsal nas rdo de la 'jogme dbal yang ba gos kyis reg na brtsed pa las gzhan gnod rgyu med pa'ang yod/ tsha ba can thog mar nang nas zug gzer drag po byung rjes zhag
———— — —gnyis gsum nas phyir brdol ba mthong / nang gnas zhes pa phyir rdol rgyu med pa zhig yin snyam/ me dbal la spang tsi bcu gnyis thun 'ga' bstud nas bzir 'jug pa gal che/ spos kyis bsregs na spos thur byas pa min/ spos mang po 'byar ba sgron nas rma la ma reg tsam nas bsros na legs/ yang ba la zas spyod 'dzem dang sman mi dgos/ ra gsum ni 'bras gsum/ rlon ni chu grang mo'i nang du btab la rlon thang zer bas de yin nam/ chu ngan pho mo'i 'khrig skabs sbyor mtshams nas 'ongs pa'i chu/sur+ya nu ma'i steng dang mchan dang mkhal ma'i steng sogs su 'ongs pa mthong / glo sur ya ma lu rgyu yod/ gzhan tsha ba'i rtags sogs mi bde ba med/skrangs ba shin tu che bas 'bras dang mi 'chugs/ skrangs la na zug shin tu che/'di la nges par rnag 'gugs byed dgos pas rnag 'gugs sbyar nas drod la sgor[skor]0/ skam e 'gro snyam skabs blangs te chang gis brlan/ zhag gnyis gsum nas yang phug brun dang dung thal cung zad re bsnan te sbyar bas zhag bdun brgyad nas rnag tu khugs/ phug brun nang nas zan gyi brun chung bsres kyang legs/ rnag tu khug pa'i rtags skrangs steng ba spu'i sgo mi mngon zhing gnyer ma chung ngu 'ongs/ rma sgo che na legs pas btsag [ gtsag] bu byis [bye'u]sgro mas snying stobs bskyed de bsnun nas cung zad gshag pa lta bu byed dgos/ rma sgo btsal dgos zhes nad pa'i mgo skor nas dral na legs/ 'og phyogs nas chu rnag gyen du 'dren pa dka' bas rma sgo 'og phyogs nas btod nus na legs/ rnag gar [ dkar] yol gsum bzhi re 'ongs pa mthong nad pa yun ring yin na nad la srog gnas pas rnag zad par mi btsir shul du cung zad 'jog rma sgo dzes nas 'byed pa'i slad du rus pa ras skud kyi long bu can rma sgo la ran pas rma kha gcod/ phyir nyin btsir dgos na btsir rjes 'byar byed dgos bas/ rma rgya chen la sbyin sra mo bskol te mtshon rma'i
skabs kyi 'byar sman 'debs sam ma btab kyang phye bzang po btab ste lcags khegs lta bus 'og phyogs gtso bo byas te skrangs kyi pha rol nas bskus stong gtso ma gtub bam/ bal gyi kha chu gtub pa sbyor/ phyir nyin bkog nas sngar bzhin nang du bsnur nas sngar nyin bzhag pa yang cung zad khebs pa byas sbyor/dbyar dus sngo rma yang sbyar chog sur+ya 'di rang rdol du mi 'gro ba mthong /spyir rang rdol du 'gro rgyu'i rtags su skrangs kyi dkyil du mdangs che ba zhig 'byung ba mthong / mkhal ma surla thibs 'og chud pa rtas brdab g.yang lhungs sogs kyi rgyu byas te 'ongs/ 'bras gsum sle tres sogs kyi thang gtong /khong sman dngul chu bco brgyad gtso bo yin/ glo bar tsan dan bcu drug mkhal mar sug smel bcu pa dang bsam 'phel nor bu sogs rig pas dpyad/ brla steng pus mo yan skrangs nas rnag 'gugs byas pas rdol ba mthong ste/ nad ci yin ma shes/ 'bam pa ni 'bam po yin snyam/ 'di'i rnag 'gugs nang spru nag rtsa ba cung bsre/ rnag ting ma chod na slar rdol ba'ang mthong /men bu mdog dmar bas wa ba dang mi 'dra/ lhan skyes kyi rmen bu la brten nas skrangs/ rlung gis bus pa 'dra/ 'bras phreng dpyad/ sra la smin dka' so gas la bcos spang / na zug cher med pa mthong / zhun sla ba dang /nan gar ba'i 'byar lta bu/ surla dang men bu nang du brdol na 'chi/rligarlug tsha rkyen can bar rta ni tsha ba byung nas zhag bco lnga nyi shu nas skrangs/ de la a gar so lnga'i steng khyung phye cung zad bsnan nas phyin [byin]na zhag gsum bzhi nas ngo lon/ grang rkyen can yun ring ba 'bras bu 'khyags nyams shar nas mer bsros kyang dros med pa de sman gyis ngo lon dka'/ sne sa'i 'og dang 'bras shun gyi bar de nyogs nas rgyu ma sgong shun nang lugs [lug]pa la rgyu lugs [lug]snyi zhing 'bom zer te ma tshegs shing dros na yal 'gro/ 'khyags shing tshegs na mar lugs[lug]/ de bca' na yar song tshe sne
sa'i 'og der 'byar brgyab khong du sos sman blud na e bzang bsam/ sbal ku dpyad/ tshigs pa bco brgyad pa'i mtshams ni 'bur bo'i 'og gi gshong yin/ser rgya ni rgya ser rkang pa'i mthe 'ong [bong] spu skyes/ tiṣ+ṭha ta sogs ma shes/grang rkyen la so phag bsros ba'i drod dugs dang / tsha khu brngos pa phying ba'i nang blugs dugs rgyab na bzang snyam/ grang rkyen can skrangs pa shin tu sra/tsha rkyen de las snyi snyam/ rgyu lugs [lug]shin tu snyi/rkang bam brtan pa dung chu lta bu g.yung ba dal bur 'gro ba/ 'theb [mtheb]rjes len pa skrangs pa thams cad la 'ongs/ 'bam can gyi chu dmar ba mthong 'bag tho'ang srid/ sir mgo pus mgo skrangs steng dmar po khyad le khyid le 'ongs pa'i me lce ris mthong / skam zug ni skam khol/ thog mar rnyil skrangs sngo skya rul nas khrag 'dzag bza' btung tshe zug che/ de rjes glo bur babs lud pa mang / de rjes rkang bar babs pa mthong / gzhan na rgyu med par rkang pa skrangs pa'ang mthong / treb dang btsan thabs ma shes/ dri chus bkrus pas dmar thig sogs 'byung ba 'bam rtags dang khrid ni rim gyis khrid/ dam se sngags lcag tha la dpyad sman dkar la phug khrag ni khrag khrob pa ste/ ban+de tshod ma'am ldum bu lcag zer/ sbrang smyon blangs pa'i sbrang dkar sgur dus 'dir mi skye/ bar ba ta sngo zhig sdig srin dkar nag bcu bdun pa la bco brgyad 'dug pa dpyad/ sman dang po gnyan kha yod na dngul chu bco brgyad thang 'ga' bsten rjes gso byed bdud rtsi grang 'a joms bsten na legs/ la phug gsha' rtser rgyab khu ba btsir ba kur [dkar]yol tsam tho'u'i nang blugs/ kha che gur gum pri yang ku gca' dkar zhes zhing tshigs su skye ba byis pas 'cha' ba'i rtsa ba de gsum btab kha bcad/ sla nga'i nang phye ma skam po'i nang rdza4 bzhag yang dza'u gcig nang chu lab khu'i tshod tsam blugs bzhag pa de tshod zin ched yin/ me bus dkar yol rked tsam yod tshe 'thung
dgos pas sha khu bzang po zhig 'thung rjes lab khu 'thung drod por btum/'di bsam grub phyag len/ chab 'dren gzhon nu srad ma me tog sngon po can de yin nam/ chu yi snying po rgya tsha/ ti tsa [tsha] ser ma mthong / gdags kyi g.yo rul nyin gyi g.yam pa zhib bu/ g.ya' rta dpyad/ byin snying ni byin pa'i sha 'bur bo rdo chu ni phyag ge'i chu khol yin nam/ ñtsa chen ni thigs pa brgyad pas rtsi dkar po zhig chag pa/ mu zi ljang gus gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga/'khyugs ni 'bam srog rtsar 'chor zhes pa yin nam dpyad/mtshan bar rdol ma mthong /
le'u zhe gcig pa/ byis pa'i nad gso ba/byis pa btsa' thabs bka' rgya mar rgyas/ dku ni dbyi mgo gong gi /shong / brla rked sogs na mtshan ma phye dud pa bdug pa/ sho gcig la mig gu bzos/ mo bal dpyad/ skyes pa'i rmob [rmongs]spu'i bsregs thal ldud /ra bshad pa mthong / tshas dpyad/ mngal du lus sha ma'i nang chu ba sog /'i nang du gnas/ skye khar dral nas btsa'/ sha ma zhag gcig tsam nas /ngas 'gro/ ma lhungs na mi rung bu rog kyang zer/ zla ba gnyis pa drug pa /cu pa gsum la byang /nyer spyod/ lugs 'byung mi na bar rkang pa sngon 'ong mi shis/ btsas rgal mtshogs ma'i thad kyi thod pa ma 'grub par yod pas de che na mi legs/ste ba'i nang khrag byis pa'i khog la btsir sor do'i mtshams skud pas bcings/chi'i phyir sor do nas bcad 'di yun ring ma lhung na lte 'khor zhes nad du 2gyur/ skan mar zhes khyim gtsang byis pa ma shi sa nas len/ sri'u zla re'i dang ming spo/ a mṛ ta bdud rtsi rig bu yin nam/ phywa tshan mi rta khyi gsum skyes 5 thag pa'i brun dang po/ sdig nag ra tsa/ zo sha zo mar/ sman mar de la dbyangs can mar zer/ tsog por bslangs pa sngas na mchin pa thur du dpyang nas nad 'gyur/ byis nad shwa ni kha sho gang na sar byis pa'i lag pas 'ju/ tsha bsubs ne yam thabs lta bur yang 'ongs dang por tsha ba skyes/ dbugs nang du rngub ma bcug par bstud nas lu bas mthar dbang po shor 'gro snying khar chu lcag
dang / phu 'debs pa sogs byas na skabs shig dbugs che ba zhig rngub nas ngu ba mthong / sna khrag ma mthong 'phar sgo dpyad/ lte ba'i 'khor skud pa'i bsdams pa nas bcad mtshams bar mig 'byed pa/ lag sor bcing nas mi 'byed pa/ nu ma khar bzhag kyang shor 'gro ba/ mchur dreg pa chags pa/dbugs thung ba mgo'i srubs phye nas shur 'bab/ rna rtsa rna mkhar khar slebs pa sogs 'chi rtags su mthong / ltag mig phyi mig bshal rjes 'bras phyin [byin]na shis/ ma nu bzhi thang gtong / blon po sum sbyor sdebs/ glo tshad kun sel nges par sdebs/ 'di byis par ma zad/ rgan pa smug po'i glo dang 'khrugs lu sogs phal cher la legs/ byis par ster na 'dzim pa shin tu nyung pakhyed/ tsha 'khru mkhris phye bdun pa/ grang da trig bdun pa/ skyug la shing mngar drug pa sogs ster/ phye ma la kur btab nas mgo skor ba'am/ hu mar skud pa sogs legs/ gla ba gla rtsi/ gzhung du ma bshad ga ba ser nad ces lus thams cad ser po sha zhu pas yan lag phra ba lto ba sbos che ba lag pas kha sna sogs 'thog pa yod pas de la sman gyis mi phan/ ser bcos zhes yungs kur la sngags btab pa ster rgyu yod/ skya bcos zhes rnam 'joms la bsten pa'i khrus lta bu yod/ 'di byis pa tsha mjug lus pa thams cad la bzang / nad med kyi rna rtsa dmar la phra yin/ nad can dmar la dwangs na bzang / smug pa dang nag na mi legs/ sbom na mi legs rtsa la yal ga gyes pa dang / rtsa snol mar yod na gdon rtags/ snol ma ris mig babs na 'chi rtags su bshad/ rtsa rna'i kha rgyud la bud na 'chi rtags/ zhags pa lta bu dang zor ba lta bu mthong ste gdon rtags/ chung dpyad kyi skor bka' rgya mar rgyas/byis pa'i tshad par phyi rgyud kyi kri ka hen legs/ byis gdon gnas lta bu yin nam/ zla ba du lon gyi grangs mnyam gyi gom pa/ zhum dpyad/ gdon nad la rim gro bsgrub par gdams/
bya 'dre ma mthong / pha ma bu ni gdon rigs gsum mi 'gul bar zha/rkang 'khril skya btab pa/ chu sri yin nam/ sor mo gzhan gyis 'theb [mtheb]chen bcings nas sbe/ skad chen bong bu/ gzugs mo snying / pa ṇi dpyad/ lus dri ldan pa ni tri lo/ brog yo sogs dpyad rgyu mang /
le'u zhe gnyis pa/ mo nad gso ba/mo nad res gcig la dang po khrag tshabs dang yun lon nas rlung tshabs su 'gyur ba lta bu/ snying glo sogs so so'i nad rtags shes dka'/ rtse'u 'greng rtses pa ris/ zla mtshan be snabs lta bu 'dzag pa yod/ rus khol snying mi bde/ mgo 'khor ling thog mang ba sogs mthong / sha mdangs bar sha lpags bar/ zla mtshan rgyun du 'dzag nas nyam thag pa mthong bem/ khri'u ni snga phyi/ phang 'bras tsher ma skya bo'i mgor sos dmar po yod/ grog zhing gyang ngos spang lta bu zhig chag [chags] pa/ a 'bras sogs smad kyi 'bras gsum kun phan bde byed sdebs myong / rmeng mnyam ldan dpyad/ mar las byas pa'i chang 'bras gsum sman mar/ smyug ma gzhon nu'i shun pa sngon po/ ra tsha ni lan tshwa brdung ba ra'am gna' ba'i ra'i nang brdzang kha bcad thal tshan nang bsregs pa/ zla mtshan 'khyigs pa sogs mo nad khrag tshabs spyi la em chi'i zhi byed bcu gcig pa legs/ zla mtshan rgyun du 'dzag pa la cong zhi nyer gcig lta bu smug po'i sman thun gcig gnyis btang rjes em chi'i go ro khrag gcod bdun pa mang du btang na legs/ rlung tshabs la em chi'i lcum rtsa brgyad pa sogs gtong /mo nad kha 'thor/ mngal du skran byed pa mang de la 'phrul thal chung ngu ster/ dal mo dang rked pa/ mdzal skran dang po byis pa dang nor nyen yod/mo nad phal ba mngal chags nas zhag nyer brgyad nas nying lo ste dum bu 'byung / 'di dus bu 'khri ba'i nad 'byung / lte bsgyur gyi bcos thabs bya
nyer bdun pa/ dri 'gags gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/a ru lcum rtsa bul tog bsdus pa'i thang // dri ma skam pa gang yang rlan par byed// yang na sman chen rgya tsha zho re re// shug tsher re ral spang spos gur gum bzhi// zho do gla tsi k+ti wang dom mkhris gsum// bzhi nam tsam re mtshal gyi na bza' gsol// ril bu hru 'joms rdo rje can zhes pa// zur sman mkhas pa'i lugs yin phan yon ni// ma smin pa dang byer sdud la sogs pa'i//grangs 'das gsungs kyang rtsa chu 'gags pa la// khyad thon 'dug pas 'di
le'u zhe gsum pa/ gdon gyi nad gso ba/smyo byed yid 'jug pa'i rtsa dhati'i 'og na yod pas de bkag bral ba'i gnyen de dran rkyen/ rnga bran de rnga phrug ṅgā [sge]gsher bca' lha [sga]la byed dgos/ dpa' bo ser bo dang / dbus su nyo rgyu yod/brjed byed glo bur du 'gyel nas 'gul 'phrig sogs med par gnas pa brgyal ba sangs dus nad med lta bu dang / glo bur du brgyal nas yan lag rnams yun ring 'dar rjes dran med du 'gul rgyu med pa mthong ste mir khri dang 'di gnyis gang yin ma shes/ khyi spre ni khyi'i mtshan ma'i khar chags pa'i mig skyag lta bu/ rkang lag gi sor mo nyi shu'i ne'u le'i ri mo sogs bsregmir khri phag pa 'i sna bdud rtsi lo ma wa dang ra [ri]bong gsum gyi dri chu/gza' rgyal mo 'dal nas je cher song ba lta bu/ lce 'og gi rtsa sngo rgyud g.yas pa lug ma dang / g.yon la ra ma zer/ mig sprin steng gi rtsa la dmar thig lta bu 'byung ba/ rgas pa la phog na lbi ba dang / yun ring song rjes srin lag skam nas 'chi ba mthong / dkar khra men gzi mig dgu can/ rgyu dus nad pa'i go sar bong bu btags nas nad pa gzhan du byol bar bshad pa yod/sha jen sogs dpyad/ bcos glags bcos skabs/ gza' dug rnyed dka' bas deng sang gza' dug can gyi sbyor sde byed na pri yang ku lo tsan pa sogs phur bu nyi ma sogs gza' brgyad kyi dug brgyad ka 'phen/ tsha'u dung sho dpyad /kha gdang ni kha ldang / gza' bcos thor bu dam dum yod par gsar du bsad phral gyi rtso dang pags pa'i lums byed par gza' bcos zhig tu bshad/
klu za thang ni longs spyod/ bsrul pa ni rul pa/ sgong ma shes/ da smin dbrag te smin ma'i bar/ rtags ngan rnams byung nye 'brel sogs la gsang /sha lpags 'then nas btang na de bzhin sdod/ me tog sbos rjes skam na bcos pa'i dus las 'das pa/0 tol ni rgya khur/ sman nad mi ldang na a ru phri ba gtong / mdze steng pho la mig 'bras lta bu dkyil na bu ga yod par sha rlon bzhag na ldad pa'i rnam 'gyur byed ces thos/ chu ser sman gsum sder bzhi'i dod/ gla ba'i shing / rwa rgya'i tshil/ byang ba dug dang phral na bar gshog len/'bri gung gces bsdus su bar gshog blangs na nas pa med pas de'i gnyen por g.yer ma 'phen par bshad/ dan rog dang dan khra phye brdzis pa'i nang bcug go re bsregs tshos phral blangs pa dug 'don/ dur byid yos tshan blangs phral nang bcug thar nu ba chur gdus rang skam bya/ dur thar gnyes kho na steng rlangs btsos byas pa'ang dug 'don/ se zho shrī khaṇ+ḍa/ sir sha ma shes/ bur shud phi shi stag ros/ gri lcags kyi a long srin lag la gon na sngar byung gi rjes gcod dang / ma byung ba la bsrung bar legs/ gzugs mo byi dur [thur]ging [sgang]/
le'u zhe bzhi pa/ rma spyi gso ba/rma spyi bcad pa so rgyag lta bus thad chod/ rnam bcad de las thu pa rus pa la'ang chod pa lta bu/ 'phyang ba bkog nas dpyad [dpyang] pa/ lhung ba bcad de lhung ba/ grum pa rdos brgyab te rus pa grum pa lta bu/ mdas phug pa mtshon rma nang du sdub pa dang rma kha phyir log pa mi bzang / cher mi gnod pa lta bu dang rma la lag pas reg na tsha zug med pa lta bu mi bzang / reg mi bzod pa bzang / rma mdog dmar ba dang lcags g.ya' lta bu'i sngon pos mtha' bskor pa legs/ mtshon rma che ba la dang po zhag gsum du em chis bshad pa'i 'gyogs [mgyogs]me zhes gla rtsi gur gum dom mkhris sogs rar+sākhug tu bcug pa chur sbang ba'i khu ba 'thung bcug khrag ma chod na phying pa chur sbang ba rma kha chod pas glan steng srad bus bsdams/ skam e 'gro snyam cho bal lta bus chu brlan phabs/ mig sogs gshong lta bu yin na phying pa lta bu sko sko de'i nang la ran pa zhig chur sbang ste der sbyar steng phying pas dkris bsdams/skabs skabs su a sa ste phye mar dron pos dugs yang yang rgyag zhag gsum nas snga dro sbang ma dang mkhan skya dā dmar khug mar bcug pas 'jib sbyor/tsha ba zhes nas em chis bshad pa ltar tshar ru spu bregs nas spu yam me ba yod pa zhig gi 'os la rus 'dul gyi sman srab mo bskus te sbyar/ phyi dro de blangs nas dā dmar chur sbang ba bzhi lteb rma stong bkab nas 'jog yang phyir nyin sngar gyi 'jib 'jog pa sogs nyin rer res mos byed/ 'jib lan gsum bzhi re nas spor na chog 'dul tshar gcig nas spor dgos pas 'dul
blangs phral sman dang rnag ro sogs gris bzhar/ slar 'jog tshe srab mo zhig bskus te sbyor/ rma tshad skyes nas gnyid mi khog pa sogs byung na spang rtsi bcu gnyis gtong / gnyan kha'i dogs pa yod na dngul chu bco brgyad gtong /em chi'i rdo rtsa sngo sbyor 'dres ma dang bcad 'byor gyi sman sogs gtong / kha zas dang po zhag bdun khrag gi dus/ bar zhag bdun chu ser dus/ tha ma zhag bdun rnag gi dus yin pas rma che ba la zhag bcu bzhi nas sha sogs glod/zho sngar nas bsten bcug chog tshwa la 'dzem/ chang 'gag ni chang langs nas ma btsag gong gi sbang ma/ sings pa'i rjes nas chu brgyab skabs kyi sbang ma la chu nas bton pa zer/ sbang lums 'jog drags na sha'u gsar skyes gcod/rlig steng yin na 'phyang / byad sogs yin na chu rgyas rul/ lug ngal ngos 'dzin med/ rma la tsha ba che bas na zug che ba la chu 'khyag zangs te ma lta bu'i mchus blugs nas reg pa mi tshor ba'i tshod tsam byas na zug zhi ba mthong /mer ba sogs rnag 'dus sa/ bre gu ser thig dpyad/ rma che ba la kha 'gug nus na bzang / khrag 'byor sha'u skye mi dgos par thad sor 'byor pa/ rma gzha' ba dang red pa sogs rma skyon/ chu 'khyag btung na tsha ba gcog kyang pho ba ngan la gnod pa sogs skyon yon gnyis re/ ri bong shas rma 'byer bas mi legs kyang rus 'dzer 'gog la phan/ skrangs zhib pa sogs nas zas bcud can dang sman bsil ba sbrags/ sred sbor dpyad/ gaṅgā chung / dri chu mang po bsog pa mdong mo'i nang brugs/ kha zhabs rked gsum du bu ga btod/ kha bcad dwangs snyigs phyes rjes bu ga dang po phyes te cha dang po gzag bcug de nas bu ga bar ba phyes nas snod nang 'ongs bcug pa/mgo rma sog ka ste sog pa'i dbyibs can/ mtshul ba ni/ gdong ba bungs tshangs [tsha nga]ste klad pa dum bu dum bur chags pa/ gdung ni sgang ste ltas) pro nas dadral ba'i bar zhong sor bzhi pa je la zhur bo sing zer do'i
g.yas su sor bzhi dang g.yon du sor bzhi la rus pa'i rtsibs zer/ de'i mtha' ma rna ltag lhag ma zer/ dar ni klad rgyas ste klad pa'i shun pa lta bu/shing lo'i steng na 'dab gyes pa mang po yod pa/ rtse nag rtses pa'i 'phar rtsa dang / gnyid log gi rtsa rgyud ske na'ang yod pas byis sker bsgags na dbang bo 'chor/ chu rtsa 'jab ['ja'] byed rat+na ldad byed sum mdo ris sogs dpyad/ za 'gram pa'i ngos bldad na 'bur bo 'ongs pa/ ltag rtsa phyi ljon/stag [ltag]ral mchul rtsa mthong byed sogs rtsad chod/ mig phor smin ma yod sar sdebs te ra skye sa'i 'bur/ 'thems pa ni gcur ba/ sha gdan rus pa la 'byar sa/ kog skad ni 'og stong pa'i sgra/ so zho ni so skyag 'og chag ni lha pa'i 'og gi rus pa/ rgya srubs zhig pa'am 'thor ba ni mgo yang gtor ba zer ba de yin te lab col smra zhing gom pa bzhag na 'dod sa der 'jog mi nus par 'khyol/ mgo 'khor ba sogs mthong / bar gyi rgya ber ni klad rgya thod pa'i ngos nas kog pa/ mtsho 'khyoms ni klad pa phyogs gcig la 'chol ba/srubs zhig pa dang klad pa 'chol ba sogs la gyig tse mtho dma' na ba'i steng shing leb bkan mo sne gnyis zur g.yas g.yon du bud pa byas bzhag sne gcig gi 'og la 'theb bzhag steng nad pa 'greng rkang pa gshibs 'dug sno gcig nas gcig la shed kyis mnon bcug nas cig shos kyi 'theb blangs/mnan yod sa der shing rtum [gtum]zhig bzhag rtser tho bas dang po dal bus brdung rim gyis shed kyis brdung ste gan nyis brgya sum brgya brdung / de rjes stan 'thug po la nas lta bu blugs pa'i ras khugs la mgo dang ran pa'i skong mo byas pa ngos zhig la gtad nas sngas kyi dod byas/ nad pa kun rkyal rkang pa brkyangs/ pus steng gcig gis mnan rkang mthil shing leb glan steng shing rtum [gtum]rtser tho bas dang por dal bus dang rim gyis shed ji cher btang nas nyis brgya sum brgya brdung / de nas spyi gtsug 'tshogs ma ltag pa ste
srubs kyi 'dus so gsum dang / g.yas g.yon gyi srubs kyi sne la skra bzhar dgos na bzhar nas lcags de la 'jog 'di ur lug lag len de bzang /sha rus bye ni rus steng sha kog pa/ skyon yod pa'i phyogs kyi mig chung / zas za tshe dal bus 'jab yang na rngam/ sran ma sos chom na mgo skyon med zer/ bye dmar ni bye'u brang dmar po can de yin nam/ steng ni lha ba'i phyi/ sbang ma gar po 'dag rgyu 'dag pa'i ra co lta bu/ sogs [sog] pa'i khrung khrung sogs dpyad/ sgo yi lcibs sa ni sgo'i lte ba 'bab sa'i skong mo'i nang gi sa/ dud pa sogs kyi sman bag phye bsdus par btab/ sa dmar dang bsres bong spu'i 'dam rtsi byas/ mtshe bsdus khur sbyin blugs pa dang bsres sbyar ba 'di byis ba'i srubs 'thor la bzang ngam snyam/ a bi ṣa ngos 'dzin med kyang lha ris rgyal mtshan zer ba'i dmar bo de yin zhes 'jigs med bsam gten gsung /ha'u ba ba dpyad/ dar ya gan [gan]'dir bye brag pa dgos 'dra/ri 'ju tsi spri btsan sogs dpyad/ thigs kun sdem pa ste sdom a'u tsi dpyad/ 'thems pa gseng ba ste gsob pa bros 'gugs ni sha rus sogs kog pa sbyor ba/ lha khrag sprad dpyad/ spyi gtsug nas rna ba'i g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhir tshon gang re bcal ba re thag bzhi'i sne zer ba zhig thos/ lha khrag sprad ni lha khrag phan tshun 'dres par byas pa/ rtsa 'brum ni rtsa steng 'bur bo 'ongs pa/ rnying skyon nam log te nam ji thur song ba/ dras 'khor rma dang 'tshams pa'i kor mo/bal med sar sor mos mnan/ lha khrag skyon med ma byung bar sag brdar gyis rus pa brdar/ bal ye ni 'bri mog bskud spyad lta bu/ 'jab lce ste 'jab tse/rdzogs pa ni sha rus thams cad chod pa/ gtam zug phu rgyugs la rma kha nas nas gang gi phyi rol du 'bos ltar brus/ sha'u zam pa ltar phan tshun 'brel ba e yin/ nya lcibs ni gnam gi sha ro zer ba yin snyam/ dkar sbyor dpyad/ bre gu ser thig ma shes/ rdo rje gru bzhi ni gru bzhi kham kham bcag na gser —
mdog med pa 'bal gyi cha gan u sur yod/ da chu ni dngul chu/ rdo bye'u mgo khra mgo 'dra ba las mchu/ dbus su yod/ske la an stong tshigs pu dang po dang ltag rus the ba'i 'phang lo lnga/ltag rus dang 'phang lo 'og ma 'brel mtshams de rus pa thams cad kyi rtse 'dus pa'i gnad yin zhes pa yin nam/ ol kong te o'u ri kyog phog snga 'gyel snga ni phog pa dang 'gyel ba dus mnyam/ rgya 'khyil ni khrag gcod lta bu/nya tsa mo dpyad/ sne bsnol g.yas pa chod na g.yon na ba sogs nad rtags 'chol ba/ gcud ni bsdams pa lta bu/byang khog lha ru tsi brang rus kyi g.yas g.yon la thog pa'i rus pa thung ngu rnams/ mkhar ni 'phang lo bya 'dab ni gshog pa lta bu/ mdun tsa ra khung nas gsang gnas bar drang bor thig gdab/ dpung pa gdang nas phyi nang du khyer na gshong 'ongs sa dpung 'dzum nas thad sor thig gdab/ nu ma gnyis nas nang du thad drang la tshon re gzhal ba'i sa 'gab kyi gru gnyis dang ske stong nas 'og tu sor bzhi gzhal ba la gru gcig byas te gru gsum thig btab pa snying gi yul/ de'i gru gsum ka nas phyir tshon gang re gzhal bar gru gsum du btab pa glo bu'i yul te gru gsum phyi rtse pa gru gsum nang ma'i rtse nas thad drang du btab pa'i gru gsum de mdzo sna/ de man gru gsum phyi ma'i g.yas g.yon gyi gling gnyis thad drang la bcad nas cha bzhi ba zhir bgos pa rim bzhin bya sgab thugs khab rte mig dgra lce bzhi'o// nu ma gnyis nas 'og drang bor tshon gang dang de nas phyir tshon gang bcal ba nas ske stong bar sngar bzhin gru gsum du btab pa glo ma'i mtha' gnas pa'i yul/ glo ma gnyis sgal tshigs phyogs su rtse gnyis phan tshun 'dud pa ske stong 'og dang mtha' gnyis bgrad pa gru gsum phyi g.yas g.yon gyi gru'i thad sor yod pa tha snyad so sor byed/ glo bu rnams glo ma'i ngos la 'byar ba 'dzub [mdzub]mgo lta bu'i 'bur bo chung ngu re snying gi
mtha' skor lta bur yod/ glo bu rnams kyi mdun phyogs kyi dkyil du snying yod mdun gyi yol gong glo bur zug de man med/ mid pa glo ma'i rgyab gyi gshong nas pho bar 'brel/ gru gsum phyi ma'i phan tshun gyi gru gnyis nas phrag bar gyen thur la drang bor thig btab pas dmar gtor zur gsum mgo thur bstan lta bu gnyis byung ba phug ron gsang te sa stong / chag dang tshon sogs kyi tshad sde srid dang em chi mthun/ lhen zhes brang gi mjug ma kha khyim lta bu de dang brang rus 'brel mtshams nas rgyab kyi tshigs pa bcu gsum bar rim gyis chu gzar ltar gzhol pa 'i thigs pa btab pa mchin dri nag po'i yul/ rgyab kyi tshigs pa dgu pa mchin dri'i gsang yin pas de nas rtsib ma g.yas g.yon gyi mtha'i rtsib thung gcig pu'i steng gi rtsib ring de nas gyen du tshon gang bcal ba sngar gyi chu gzar ltar btab pa dang mthun pas de nas lhen rus 'brel mtshams bar btab pa mchin dri dkar po'i yul/ mchin dri'i mdun phyogs sha'i rang bzhin yin pas nag po zer/ rgyab phyogs sha min pags min skyi mo lta bu yin pas dkar po zer/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsib ma mar de gnyis 'brel mtshams la khra bo zer/ mchin dri'i mtha' skor thams cad g.yas g.yon dang phan tshun gyi ngos la 'byar yod/ nag po'i skabs rgyab kyi tshigs pa bcu gsum pa nas gzhal ba rtsib ma g.yas g.yon gyi mchin dri'i khug pa yod sa'i tshod zin ched ma gtogs nag po bcu gsum pa'i thad gar 'brel ba min 'dra/ rgyab kyi tshigs pa dgu pa nas bzung mchin dri dkar po'i skabs kyi thig 'bab sa de mchin dri'i 'byor mtshams yin 'dra/ sde srid kyi tshon bdun phyed bcu gcig steng ma gsum 'das mtshams sogs dpyad/ nu ma gcig nas gzhung thig bar 'then pa'i thig tshad de gas lhen sna nas pho ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi zur gnyis su btab pa dang / yang thig tshad de ka ma nor bas zur de gnyis nas lte bug bar btab pa mnyam dgos/ de nyid pho ba'i yul yin/ lhen sna nas
lte bug bar dpangs su sor brgyad dang zur phan tshun gyi zheng la sor bcu gnyis/ pho ba ni la phug rtse nas cha bzhir bcad pa'i cha gcig ltar zur gsum gyi rnam pa la ngos gcig mdun du bstan pa de rgya che zhing sul gnyis yod pa zur gnyis g.yas g.yon dang / zur gcig rgyab kyi srog rtsar reg pa rgyab phyogs kyi ngos gnyis rgya chung zhing sul re re yod par grags/ lus drang por byas g.yas pa'i 'dzub [mdzub]gung gnyis kyi bar la rna shal bzung nas gru mos pho ba'i zur gyi mdun ngos nas rgyab kyi rtsib mar gar sleb pa mchin pa'i yul/ mchin pa zlum po'i rnam pa lta bu leb mo mtha' la nye bar sha leb mo zhig gi mchin par btags mar dpyang yod pas phyogs gcig gis pho ba'i mdun gyi zur kheb yod/ de'i pho ba la ltos pa'i ngos gcig na mkhris pa mchin pa'i ngos la 'byar nas 'gab mchin pa'i 'og na cung zad bud yod/g.yon gyi dal khug la nye ba'i rtsib thung rtse nas mdun la sor bzhi bcal ba pho ba'i ngos la mtsher ba 'byar yod mar dpyad pa'i ring thung sor lnga dang zheng sor phyed gsum 'di mchin dri la 'byor med/ pho ba la me gsang bzhi las 'ongs tshul med pas gsang kha gsum gsum dgu la phyed dam dgu dpyad/ pho ba'i dkyil dbus yin nam be+e sngon lhan [lhen]rtse nas tshon do zhes pa dang mthunasnyam pas de nas g.yas su sor bdun bcal bar mkhris pa mchin pa la btags yod pas de nas thur la dpyang yod pa'i ring thung sor drug dang zheng sor gsum yod/ mkhris pa pho ba las thur du sor do bud yod/ lte bug gi steng dang 'og tu tshon gang re bcal ba logs kyi zheng dang g.yas g.yon du 'khyog nas yod pa'i ring thung la tshon brgyad yod pas pho ba'i zheng las kyang sor bzhis che/gsum 'khyog gsum ka tshon brgyad kyi sar sleb pa min 'dra/ pho ba lugs nas lte ba'i thad gar sleb cing long yang mdun rgyab gang rigs su lte gong tshon gang gi sar yod 'dra/ lte 'og tshon gang nas g.yas g.yon du tshon bzhi re ste
brgyad gzhal ba nas 'og drang bor tshon do re bcal ba rgyu ma'i g.yas g.yon gyi mtha' gnas pa'i yul yin/ rgyu smad kyi mtha' zur de gnyis la gru gnyis dang mtshan ma'i steng la gru gcig byas te gru gsum du sgang ba'i yul/ pho ba long rgyu ma gsum rgyun gcig yin pas pho ba nas zas ma zhu ba'i gnas dang zhu ma zhu'i mtshams dang / zhu ba'i gnas gsum yod pas de gsum brgyud long du sleb long nas zas kyi snyigs ma la gar sla phye nas ska ba rgyu mar brgyud de snabashang sgor thon/ sla ba rgyu grog zer ba rgyu ma dang mnyam du 'gro ba'i rtsa de nas brgyud de lgang bar babs chu lam du thon/ long rgyu ma las sbom zhing long gi sne dngos phu ldug yin pas sne dang nye sa zhig nas rgyu mar 'khrol dud 'gro la mthong / zas pho bar ma zhu na pho bar zug skye zhing kham skyug sogs byed/ de nas rim gyis long du sleb nas na zug dang / de nas rgyu mar sleb tshe 'khru ba myong / lgang ba dri chu mang tshe che gnye ma dang bsam se gnyis brgyud ma gcig la tha snyad so sor byas 'dra/ bsam se yar sne mkhal ma g.yon la 'byar zhing mar sne nas byang sems 'bab pa'i rtsa zhig chu lam gyi g.yon ngos la zug rgyab tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa'i g.yas g.yon la sor bdun re btsal ba na mkhal 'bras tshil gyis btums nas yod pas 'bur bo gnyis g.yas g.yon la bstan zhing mkhal ma'i rtsa thag gis sgal tshigs ngos la 'brel ba gyen 'greng du yod pa'i dpangs la sor lnga/ be+e sngon du zhes sor bdun sogs gsungs ba dpyad/ snying gi dkar nag mtshams snying tshil dang snying 'brel mtshams/ bud med la sgo dgur ma 'dus pa'i sgo gcig lhag pas rgyab kyi bu snod kyi sgo'am mngal sgo de bha ga'i bshang lam phyogs su yod/ lgang ba'i sne chu lam de bha ga'i mdun ngos na yod/ srog rtsa dkar po la klad rtsa zhes bshad pas sgal rnag yin nam snyam ste sgal rnag de klad pa'i rang bzhin de'i shun pa'ang klad rgyar mtshungs/dbus kyi rtsa'i sne la snying thogs/ glo ba'i nang rtsa shin tu mang / glo rnag tu song
na rnag skem lta bu byas/ de glo yu nas lud pa'i nang rnag thon te byang na 'tsho ba yod/ mchin dri'i steng du rdol na 'chi/ bai sngon du tshigs pa dgu pa nas rtsa gnyis mchin drir 'brel zhes pa mchin dri'i gsang la bsam 'dra/ 'dis mtshon rtsa 'grel mi mthun pa mang / rtsa rnams thams cad shes dka'/ gnyan gong ni 'phang lo'i steng gi gshong / sgab khung ni sgyid khug glo ma'i rtsa rnams kyang rang rang gi thad sor med/ dpyi'i kha gzar/ brla'i phyi sul ni brla'i phyi langs nas shur yod sa/ phyi nang gyen thur zhes pa skor ru kha lta bur yod dam/ sog pa me long dkyil ni sog pa'i rus pa srab sa ste/ de'i 'og gi sha la dra sha zer/ sog pa'i mgo'am yu ba dpung ba 'phrod tshad tshigs dpyad/ sne khud ni sne sa'i khug mchin dri'i khug bdun ni gnyer ma yin 'dra bas de [re]re'i bar 'dzub [mdzub] re tshud pa'i gsang / nu 'og tshon gang dang sgal 'dab g.yas g.yon du rtse sor te sor mo'i rtse nas gzhal ba'i sor bzhi phug kyang don la mi sleb/ sdod lugs sogs kyis nges pa med/ snod rnams tshol mtshon tshe cung zad 'gros pas mi zin pa srid/ don rnams 'phar gyin yod pas mtshon nye bar sleb tshe rtser skyon pas thu/ thur mas dbye ba'i gsang du mtshon phog na mtshon blang rjes khrag thon 'ongs pas rjes sor rnag gsog pa thur mas phug nas gsang dbye mi dgos/ glo ma so so'i rgyab thigs ma shes ༷sna snadzo twā nāXrnyi ṅgi 'byos 'azlo ༵༵la na ༵ /yi༈ (pa /khugā (bya/nyi/sa sprisna tsho gsum gnyis kyi bar nas mdun ngos sor bzhi bcal bar rtsib ma bcu gcig pa'i go bar te go bas 'brel mtshams de nas mdun sor gang bsnur ba rtsib ma rnams kug yod pas bcu gcig pa 'das nas bcu gnyis pa/ a long kha nas phyir sor bzhi yin nam/ sems brgyud pa ni/ lpags pa'i nang sgal tshigs rus 'bur gyi rtser ā+o yod pa de yin pas sleb pa'i de thad chod byas pa yin
nam/ rtsib ma chag pa zug che zhing dbugs len rgyu shin tu dka' bas khyi nyi mas gdungs pa'i dbugs lta bu mthong / de la dang por 'phang chung ngu'i nang dbor bcug rim gyis 'phang ji cher btang nas lan gsum bzhi zhig spor rjes 'phang chen po'i nang dpor thub tshe/ skyi mor sbyin sra mo bskus pa chag steng sbyar na nang du ldeb pa dbugs kyis phyir bkar pa skyin gyis nang 'gror mi 'jug glo ma mtshon gyis cung zad zin pas lud pa'i nang khrag 'dre yang 'tsho ba mthong / phyi bshul dang bzhag sha ma gtogs thal gong gnya' sha sogs phyi ma rnams 'a bring / mtshon lam ring ba ni mtshon gting la ring du song ba/rtsar zin nyung de phyir ces pa dpyad/ nang brtol ni byang khog nang du brtol ba/ nang brtol la don snod ma brtol pa khrag ngan babs pa ni/ khong ba'i nang bsog pa/ zhag bdun nam ma shi na sang phod kyi dus tshod de la lo dus zer/ lud pa tsan dan ltar dmar ba rtsa steng khrid pa ste rtsa de'i brgyud mar na/mchin dri khug pa la phog na ldang dub byed/ glo bu dre mig gi rtsa sngon bur phog na skyegs bus 'debs pa sogs rigs 'gre/ char bu ni phyi rug go/ lnga la nad ldog ste je thur song / mchin pa phug pa'am bcad tshe rtsi nyams pa yin snyam/mtsher pa'i cha ga ni mtha'/ mthil ni dkyil/ pho ba'i ther ni srab pa/ gong med chod pa'i zhag gag gsum cu lnga la sa sbyor dgos/ khong bar pho bar na rjes je dmar song ba zug che ba zhig la sbyongs brgyab pas 'bu dkar po nar mo mang po 'khrus te bde ba ma thong ste/ srin long gi 'bu yin nam ma shes/long ther ni lte ba nas g.yas g.yon du tshon do re bcal sa'i long ther gyi gsang de nas phug pa la byed/ has 'debs ha btab pa/ pags rdul ni glog shu/ khrag babs bongs chung ni phyir khrag thon pa bongs chung ba/ rtsa chen chod pa sogs bya gtong gsum bongs longs med par 'chi/ rdo dbyug sogs kyis khrag 'grams pa 'gram tshad le'u skabs bzhin bcos/ zug rngu las
—mde'u lus pa/ sha gnad ma gtogs rma stong cang ma bkab bzhag ces so//mtshon lam thung zhing mde'u gar yod ngos zin na skam pa rma nang nas btang /mde'u len pa mde lag sprad zer/ lha ba byer ba ste rus pa sab sos de 'brad dgos/ so rgyag lta bu'i me btsa' la deng sang rma'i sne gnyis dang 'grams gnyis me btsa' bzhi tshoms 'jog zhag gcig sras dpyad/ khrag nang du babs/ nas 'khyil ba la mkhal khung gnyis dang / lhen 'og tu bru gu re bzhag pus mo brang la sbyar/ ther ma lta bus de steng bsdams pa khrag thon ched/shing lag ngar tsam pa kug kug bzhi re mig tu bsnol ba'i dkyil te mig nang rma 'phrod pa byas steng du phyungs 'di byed ma myong / rmas ma la gza' 'phog nyen che bas gnam mthong sar 'gror mi 'jug nag dub byed/ mgyogs me dang sngo sbyor sogs rma'i lag len thams cad em chi'i rma bcos ltar byed/ji bse ru sha ru bogs nas gsar skyes rgya ru gsum la gwa dor gsum zer/ rnag dus sogs tshad mjug la ga bur nyer lnga gtong / skabs skabs su dngul chu bco brgyad kyang btang ba yin/ khrag khong du bsog pa rnag tu 'gyur ba ma gtogs/ gzhan la kha dri ngan pa sogs kyi rnag rtags dang rnag dus med/sha bal ni steng du bal skya chags pa dri zhim pa de la zer/ sha rul min/ ting khrol ni gdus thag chod pa/ dgun brgyab na dpyid shing tsi kha 'bus dus dpyid brgyab na dbyar char dus/ dbyar rgyab na ston rtsi shing skam dus/ gong mo'i sgo nga / rnga rdzing rnga mong gi bal sogs rma gzhan la'ang sbang [ spang]/'jib ha cang yun ring na sha'u skyes pa 'then nas gcod pas tshod zin dgos/rtsa chad pa rma khar shul gcig tu lnga'am bdun gdab/ rma kha 'tshebs pa ste brtsam yod na phugs pa'i phu 'di red snyam par mi gdab/ spod sna sga bskyom pa ni 'o ma bshig pa lta bu/ rgyu ma 'chus dkyus pa/ 'khril rkyang btab pa rgyu mdud/
yan lag rma/ sgrog rus steng na nywa sha nag po sog pa'i kha 'khor te kha khyi ma ngos tshigs pa'i g.yas g.yon na/ gdar sha dpung pa'i mdun/ nywa/0dpung mgo nas mar 'bur bo de la lug gzhug zer/ lag ngar gyi nywa la sul mang bas nya mo gdang rus 'dra/ chang bzung rked pa dar sbos dpyad/ skyogs ra dpung sogs phrad mtshams/ rmen bu ni phyir mi mngon kyang tshil gyis btum pa/ khyi khros rtsa 'brel mi mthun/ rtsa phal cher gar yod ma shes/ mdzod spu chung 'theb [ mtheb] chung yin nam bai sngon dpyad/ rtsa ba zhi khug pa sogs dpyad/ long tshigs rgya tshigs/ rus lhag dpyi mig brla mgo 'brel mtshams dang / sog pa dpung ba 'brel mtshams su rus pa rgyus pa dang 'brel ba chung du yod dam phran rtse ni rkang lag gi rgya tshigs dang tshigs yan sor mo man de'o//nyer drug byed tshul dpyad/ sgyid khung dang rting chu gnyis rgyud gcig yin kyang gnas kyi dbang gis so sor byas/ byin snying sogs las gzhan pa'i nywa sha tha ma chu rtsa rtsa dkar yin nam/ zho rnying pa skyur mo'i kha zis/ dmar 'byar ser 'byar sogs em chi'i yang yod/ sbang ma gar po phye rjen pa sra snyi gang 'phrod skrangs la blta/ sbre'u/ rma chung rma med/ rgya mtshal cog la ma/ spang rtsi dang rdo sman gnyis ka bsil bas me drod ngan la 'dzem/ skrangs rnag rgyu rnams la skrangs shor dogs 'byar byed na'ang thag ring nas byed pa ma gtogs ma dral bar du skrangs steng 'byar byas na zug shin tu che bas mi rung / wa sbyang [spyang] sogs kyi brun min kyang phug ron brun rnyed na legs shing / de mi rnyed na brun gang yin gyis rnag tu khugs pa mthong / thul rtags ni rnag tu mi 'gro bar skrangs zhib rtags/ rnag tu khugs tshe 'dzub [mdzub]mos reg na mer mer byed cing / brdol sar rkong rkong lta bu'i nyams 'char/ der rang rdol lam men na gtsags bus rdol/ wu ba nang du rlung yod pas phal cher la 'ongs ngan rtags min 'dra/ rnag 'tshing tshe dal bus mtha' nas dbus su btsir
rjes yun gyis lhod pa ma gtogs lag pa myur du blangs na zug chen po 'byung /rnag gzhug skem la dngul chu bco brgyad bsten/ em chi'i rdo sman mgo nas mjug par gtong / bo'u lda yan lag gi sha gseb bsdad pa rnag nas rdol/yang sos yang rdol ba zhig la mde'u 'byin gyi sman zhig blud rjes rma nas btsag [gtsags]bu btang pas khrog khrog zer bas btsag [gtsags]bu mgo kug pa zhig gis len myong / be snabs rdo zhig ngos 'dzin med/ marnyir [mañdzir]rdo lug ru 'dra ba mchu gnyer yod pa mthong / gar yod ma shes/ mde'u 'byin sde srid sogs brag ngos skye ba rtsa ba gcig la sdong bu mang po 'ongs pa ring thung mtho gang tsam me tog sngon po 'dab ma lnga can gang bu gzhu shubs 'dra ba la byed/ shel phreng du yu mo srol go ba [gong]0 zhes sa mtho sar skye ba dbyibs dang mdog nas rngod pa'i yog thod lta bu me tog yod tshe ser log ge byed pa der ngos bzung / mi'i mjug to gzhug chung tha ma'i rus pa/ rtsi stag mo chu ma rtsi/seṅge kha sogs bshad rgyud du bshad/ rma rgan tsha ba mi 'jog pa a byag gzer 'joms/ bye rlon pa dang ba lci bsres pa'i 'byar/ ma la bu thogs ni ngos nas cung zad re khol mur chag pa/ myu gu kha bsreg [gseg]nas chag pa rdum chag thad chod/ rus bas sha lpags phug nas phyir thon pa'ang yod zer/ tshil yu don pos dod phab/ shing chas chag shing / lu bral ni skyon med pa/ chag shing phra sbom sor gnyis tsam ma thug srab ring thung med pa ci tsam dgos pa byas mgo mjug tu bu ga gnyis re byas/ bu ga'i nang du skud pa blangs nas snam bu'i ngos la bar thag cung zad yod pa byas nas sbyar/ bar stongs rnams su rtsi to ci tsam dgos pa bzhag nang du ras tshig rkyang zhig bkab nas lag pa lta bu chag yod sar dkris/ steng srad bus dam lhod ran pa bsdams/ rma yod na rma chag shing bar du 'phrod pa dang / de'i thad kyi snam bu sogs dras nas rma rjen par bzhag chu rnag sogs bzhur ba la legs/ rus chag 'byor
nas skrangs zhib pa'i tshe/ bsdams dgos tshe tsi to rim gyis byang nas sdom/byer zur spangs pa dpyad/ rus chag so zin la deng sang rus wa brgyug pa zer/ lhod na skyog [skyogs] yin nam/ dam ches na skrangs/ lhod ches na chag pa tshigs bzhin rang sor mi sdod/ chu'i sna mi 'byor par 'gros chag pa rjes sor 'byor yang skyon med pa dang ring thung 'byung / dpung ba dang pus mo gnyis steng du 'chor mi srid pa bden/ dpyi mig tu brla mgo'i rus pas 'brel ba la gtug thag sog pa'i dkar yol khar dpung mgo'i 'bur nas rus pas 'brel la gnyen thag zer/ bkan ni 'phul ba dpung tshigs bud na lag mgor thag btags 'then thag pa la dbyug pas bzag mkhrig ma shor bas skam sar bzhag phan tshun 'then bcug steng rting bas mnan na chud pa mthong / spru pa ni spru nag pa/ zor ba ni ram pa yin nam/ sba smyug srab mo/khad spu rtsa chad sa'i sne phan tshun 'byor thabs yan lag gi tshigs shor ba phyir sprad rjes gang shor ngos la me btsa' gsum bzhi re bsgrigs nas btab na phan pa mthong / rnying tshad can tsha ba skyes bde yang skye ba la lus drang bor byas/lag pa g.yas pa mchan khung g.yon nas drang bor bsring ba'i sog pa'i steng gar sleb mtshams de dang / g.yon nas g.yas la'ang de bzhin gzhal ba gnyis dang sdud sgo bzhi spyi gtsug dang lnga la lcags del [ tel] bzhag na phan pa myong grub/ thab la sha dang khol sogs me nang song ba dmar thab 'o zho sogs dkar thab/ chu mer blugs nag thab zer/ gtar ga sogs byas rjes dmar dkar nag po sogs me steng bzhag bsregs/ thab kyis skyon med ces rgyas skor sman rgan byed zer/
le'u zhe lnga pa/ dug gi nad gso ba/sbyar dug su yas dpyad/ rta la rma can zhon na spu'i dug 'byung /srin bu ba pad+ma yin nam/ de dug med pas nad yod sar 'jib nas khrag ngan len pas mchog dug can gyis 'jib na skrangs zer/ zas la 'khrin pa ham pa ji cher 'gyur ba/ sa bon dwangs mar zhugs pa mkhris pa mdangs sgyur dang bsdongs nas snying la gnas sam/ ra gan sogs kyi bslad med pa'i dngul leb mo so nang du skud pas brtod/ 'byung bya 'ug pa yin nam yin nges min dpyad/ rlangs bsrubs rlangs pa ma shor/ nyal bos ldang na reg dug rta bong sha sogs dang po gang sbyang de bsten gnod/ gtar khrag blangs rjes tsha skyes nas ldang na/ chu chung ba dpyad/ ru rak+ṣa/ gsang sman ko ṭa ni ri mgor skye ba'i dres ma gzungs chung de yin/ de'i me tog khu byug gsar du grags pa dang mnyam du 'char bas khu byug me tog zer/ de 'thu tshe steng du ras gur phub gnam ma mthong ba rtsa dang bcas 'byin/ brdung tshe rdo gzhing nang phar la brdung ba nges can dgos bas 'bras bu phyir brdung gsung / yi ge 'bru gnyis ko ṭha yin pas de bzla/ dbyig dug rin po che la sbyar ba'i dugspu sbyor spu sna tshogs la sbyar ba/ dngos sbyar dug dngos sbyar ba zas sogs dang ma bsres pa/ ser thig sgo nga'i nang gi ser thig yin nam/ rdzi dug ni/rlung la bskur ba'i dug tsha gu gul dpyad/ a mṛ ta ni bdud rtsi chos sman zhes rtsa brgyad sman sna stong dang sbyar nas rnying lugs sgrub rgyu yod/ lcags zhun lcags brdung skabs kyi lcags dreg yin nam/ khyung sder yal ga sder mo'i
༷༷༷༷༷ tho reng [rengs] sbyar na lus zungs la dpag/ sna sel ni lto ba sra snyi dpag thabs/ dong ga thog 'bru ni dong ga'i tshigs pa'i bar na yod pa'i 'bras bu/ grang 'dul khan [ khaṇ+ḍa] dpyad/ bzhi nam tshod [tshong] dpyad/char gyis yun ring brlan pa'i nyung [nyungs]ma/ su mi dmar ser gnyis yod kyang dmar po mkhal ma go yu 'dra ba dmar po yod/ gi gu [ gul] gnyis sogs la dbyangs sogs bzla ba yin nam/ sbyar dug can ma mthong / gyur dug ser sha sha mang ngam mo ko nang ser bo can mchog zas de rnams bsres pa mi 'phrod de rgyas par bshad rgyud du yod/ phyi rgyud da lis bzhi/ btso bsregs rjen gsum a rul ste/ des gtso byas bshal/ dug 'di yang mi shes/sha dug sha btsos tshe mdog dmar pa skyon can rtags/ dbre dpyad/ sha 'bru dang rtsam nang bzhag be log dpyad/ 'di rigs bshad rgyud rgyas/mig gi 'bras bu rno 'dal/ sha dug can mi shes/ nyung gzhi nyung ma'i sa bon/'og nas bsu ba ni ru ha lta bus/ gzi mdangs med srad nag pa/ me srin thang ngo'i drag pa yin 'dra/sha nad smyag [smag]shad kyi 'bras bu/ sgong thog me togphra rags khyung sngon nang sman chen sbyor sde'i tshad 'phang na bzi che bas dmad dgos/ khyung lnga sogs kyis bzi drag na 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'char/sing phub sogs dpyad/ pha ba dgo dgo rgan mo'i ja thos/ a sho gan ba spru/se dug rgya rmar grags gsar du byung tshe mtshan ma'i rtser tsag shad yang yang byung rjes rma chung ngu khab mig lta bu dkyil rko 'byung / za 'phrug 'ongs pa 'phrug nas bshus na chu ser 'dzag 'thor na mid thag nang sogs phyogs phyogs su mched/ rnyings nas sen mo'i steng snag tsa [tsha] lta bu'i nag thig 'ongs pa dang / lus kyi steng rme ba lta bu nag po dang skya chag se ba 'ongs/khyab pa de dus sman gyis mi thub/ mid par byung ba la skrag mi dgos/ nam
byung mi shes par rma 'byung ba'ang yod zer/ sman la dang por su mi bzhi pa dang thang chen nyer lnga lan 'ga' btang rjes dngul chu bco brgyad thun bdun brgyad tsam gtong / de rjes em chi'i gab tshig gi khong sman dang 'debs sman stod ja can sogs 'debs/ rgya'i lugs la ze tsha zho brgyad tshur zho drug dngul chu zho gang cung ma longs ba cog la ma zho phyed/ cog la mi 'phen na dngul chu zho gang dgos/ sman so sor zhib brdungs/ zangs sam byung na bal ma bzang pas de'i zhabs gar [dkar] yol dang 'tshams par sman rnams rim par blugs pa'i bar bar du sko chung byas nang dngul chu blugs/ steng gar [dkar]yol kha sbubs pa'i kha mtshams la ba tshwa can gyis 'dag pas g.yis/ de'i phyir thal ba blugs cag cag byas gar [dkar]yol gyi zhabs steng du thon pa'i nang chu blugs pa chu dros pa'i tshe yang bal gyis spor nas chu gsar bas brje dgos/lan si'i 'am spen ma lta bus me dang por chung rim nas lam me lam me bus/rgya spos gsum gyis yun la gdus pas bal ma yin na zhabs skya theg ge song ba'i tshe tshos pa yin pas me rgyun bcad/ 'khyags nas blangs na gar [dkar]yol nang dkar ser dmar ljang sngo'i sab sob chags btsos ru btsos pa'am min kyang nang snying bton te bsnos nas sman btab/ shing bu lta bus legs par brdzis/ ril bu sran ma tsam byas nyin bdun la ril bu gsum re/ de nas nyin 'gar ril bu bzhi re nas rim gyis je mang btang / bdun las lhag mi gtong / de nas ji nyung rim gyis gtong / tshig ro de brdung nas rma steng 'debs dgos pas/ dang po nyin re re lan re de nas gnyis re sogs gsum yan mi 'debs/ lhag 'debs mi nyan shin tu tsha bas rkang pas sar brdeb pa mthong / nus dka' bas zhag re gnyis nas re re skud pa sogs byed/ sman bcos la 'bad na zhag nyi shu skor ram zla re tsam nas ngo lon pa mthong / drag nas kyang khong sman cung yun bsrings na bzang 'dra/ ma la
yod pa'i stobs kyis byis pa btsa' tshe rma bcas 'ongs pa la thang chen nyer lnga mar du sdus pa lan 'ga' dang / mar gyis dngul chu dgu pa sprus ba ril bu bcag sum cha yun ring bsten bcug na phan pa mthong / dngul chu btso bkru byed tshul mang du yod kyang mu zir btul ba las lhag mi dgos/ shel ka ras ram rtsi zangs dmar snod nang zho bzhag ljang gur song ba skam pa/ rma steng ra khrag byugs kyang ra pags rlon pas dkris na bzang ba mthong / rma tsha zug che ba la ra khrag nang tshil btub pa bsros nang rtsam pa btab brdzis pa'i a sas bdug phan pa myong grub/ ra sha ra khu rgyun bsten bcug na sman dug len la bzang ba mthong / sman dug gis mid skrangs lce gad rnyil lug go bye ma nu khrag che na/ ka ra ka gar sogs ma shes/ rgya ma rnying nas ya srin dang bsdongs nas sna chad pa sogs mthong / glo bar byung nas lu ba dang dbugs mi lon pa mthong / deng sang ya srin zer ba gag srin can sna dib pa la nye ba zhig la srin 'joms dngul chu dgu pa phyin pas phan pa mthong /khyi dug bka' rgya mar rgyas/ mi dad chung dpyad/ khro ba'i tshig pa za khyi skad 'byin bar sdod lugs sogs bden/ lham krad lham rtsa/ yon dug che pha lang long bu can gyi sbyor sde de dang za yig sogs byed myong / wa chu 'bab pa'i sar khru gang brkos pa'i 'og gi sa/0 chu snying gar slebs pa brgal ba lo gnyis spangs/
le'u zhe drug pa/ ro tsa ba dang bcud kyis len pa/ro tsa spris kha yag da byid la dug 'don mang po ma nus kyang skam sha sha snag ril mo'i gshag nang bcug kha brtsam me mur nang bcug phyi cung tshig skabs blangs de gas 'thus/ go bo'i sha 'phen rgyu yod na sha dug can rnams la'ang dug 'don ma byas kyang chog zer/ dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu btsong rgyu yod dbyar rtsa lta bu la dgun 'bu'i rnam par yod/ gnyer ma can 'bu ro lta bu mthong / de yod sar ras gur sngon po phub bltas na 'gul zer/ byis pa spyod ran tshe mi nus pa la legs/ sngags skad ma shes/bud med btsal rtsabs shing lcum rtsa/ khye'u sus tho rangs btang / rus thog 'byung sogs ma shes/skad khrel lu gdus thag chod pa mthing ril na nang rkang dmar/bcud len tsi bzhi shug 'bras ba lu mtshe mkhan bzhi/ brag zhun rigs lnga las lcags gyur yin nam bsdus btsag gong bzhin bsdus/ rtsis 'dril dril gtub ba gong sman drug pho cong brag zhun bdud rtsi bzhi/ 'jam pa rtag ngu bdud rtsi 'od ldan zhes me tog ser po 'od 'tsher ba spen gsang skye ba yod/spyan ras gzigs a krong dkar po zer pa me tog dkar khra la ngos 'dzin/phyag rdor rtag ngu me tog sngon po 'dam ma lnga can bstan kyang gdengs med /rgyal mo ka ra shel dkar/
le'u zhe bdun pa/ rtsa chu'i mdo bstan pa/ phyi rgyud/ pha tse re so ni/ re ba'i rgyu gnyis gshibs re 'ong ba de yin/bcu gnyis po rtsa rgyud gcig par mer rgan bshad/ rkang bol de long bu'i mdun gyi thad so ru gdong 'og gi bug pa der 'phar na yun thung ngur mi 'chi ba myong grub/ dpyod dus sogs dus rang rang la mchin rtsa rang tsar [rtsar]'dzin pa sogs kyi khyad ma gtogs rgyu tshul la khyad med/ 'ur ba ni chad pa/nas zan ni go mchil te yul byis [bye'u]/ gong rgal [brgal]de rtsa 'phred la yo nas rgyus pa'i rgyab tu song ba mthong / rlung khrag kun tu rgyu ba dang snyugs grangs dang grangs glang gnyis kyi khyad sogs dpyad/ rlung rtsa mnan na mi 'phar ba'i stongs pa mthong / srin glang la rtsa leb mor 'phar ba mthong /dus gcig la snying la rlung dang rgyu ma la tshad pa byung pa yod pas snod rtsa don la grang pa mi 'gyur ba dpyad/ ut+ta'i sgra ni rna ba'i sgo bcad na 'ur kur zer pa/lce steng nag thigs/ so la dreg pa sna'i 'bur gnyis zhom pa/ smin ma la 'gyu lu 'bab pa ma mchu 'phyang ba sogs 'chi rtags byung na phal cher 'chi yang mi 'chi ba'ang srid mtha' tsam yod/ rgyu grog ni bsam se'u/ ko chu ni na rko'i kha'i zhag tsha mkhris kyi chu ser nag ji ma ji bzhin gar [dkar]yol zhabs kyiri ri mo mi mthong / grang mkhris ni ser la'abag tho thigs pa yol/ de'i ngos la zags na'ang ser mdangs can mthong / chu btang ma thag tu wu ba'i mjug tu dkyil na wu ba gcig sdod pa tshe 'dzin me tog ces tshe brtan/ mi na dkrugs nas bar thag ring po re chu khyer 'ong ba chu drod tsam bsros nas pho
camo'i mtshan ma'i bu ga dang 'dra ba'i bu ga nas gzag nas mdog rlangs me tog sogs blta ba rgyangs chu blta tshul/ kha che smug po can zhig gi chu chu la 'o mas skya mda' btang ba lta bu skya log ge ba mthong ba shi/ bad nad can la chu nang nag shal dang 'ga' zhig la dmar shal yod pa btang phral 'khyil nas gnas pa cung zad nas nag 'dur se 'gro ba mthong ste de rigs 'tsho/ snag tsha sgrungs ba lta bu'i nag po mthong ste 'ga' zhig shi 'ga' 'tsho/ 'di yang bad nad can la mthong /
le'u zhe brgyad pa/ zhi byed sman gyi mdo bstan pa/thang / 'brug rus a krong dang 'jam mo na na gyi gad pa'i nang yod/len rgyu yod rus dbyibs can rdo lta bu yod/ lce la 'byar 'gro ba de'i rtags/zhu mkhan ni zungs ja'i nang gi lo ma ser po can lta bu de med na rgya tshos la khu ba mi 'bab/ ka ped ni shing thog ho li/ bdun thang gi sga sga skya yin/ sa dzi ka nas kyi snye ma thal can yin/ zab 'gran ['gron] thal ni za 'og dang 'gron bu'i thal ba yin nam/ byi tsher ni tsig 'dzin/ stab seng ni bcag na bal yod ba nyo rgyu yod/ de med na sbyar ba ste g.yer bas tshab rung / sgron shing ni cog shing / thal tsha ni shing rul dang lcum khag sogs bsregs pa'i thal ba sel bo'i nang blugs/ sko sko byas steng gi lcam la btags 'og tu snod zed[bzed]/ thal nang chu blugs pa zags pa de gdus nas sho'u ltar chags zer/ya bak+ṣa ra ha ngang chu sngon phyogs na brag byang bstan ngos la dkar po zhig chags pa yod/ de'i gdan gyi tshul du chu'i 'khyags pa lta bu lcer reg na grang nyams shin tu che ba yod/ de mdze tsha yin/ khu ba thon par sbangs pa'i grang thang ni/ tsha sel la byas chog 'dra/ grang sel la nges par bsdu dgos/mang ga bur sna ring ba ni 'then na 'ong pa/ ga bur sman gang la sbyor yang sbyor sde de'i nang du cu gang yod na cu gang ga bur las nyis 'gyur dang /sbyor sde'i nang cu gang med na ga bur dang mnyam pa 'phen/ rgyal blon gsum pa skabs mang por mkho/ ga bur nyer lnga rnyings tshad la bzang / chu srin sder mo mtsho khar yod pa sen mo 'dra ba/ nag tshang a krong rdza mtho sar skye bas 'bur bo re'i steng khyab nas yod pa nag tshang a krong g.yag po'i gtso rdzogs
'dra zer ba yod/ gtso brgyad byis pa sbrum ma rgas pa sogs la bzang / gtso brgyad cha mnyam du sbyar nas sger du snon dgos yod na de skabs ston/ a ru bcu pa sogs dgos/ 'dam bu ka ra dang chu rgyug pa ma mthong / rgyal blon gsum pa tshad pas smyo lab kha lkugs sogs la legs/ mkhris tshad gnyen po'i ga bur dgu pa legs 'dra/ sgog thal skabs thams cad du nus ldan bsregs pa dgos/ 'bu su hang sngo zhig a krong zhes gsal kha med pa thams cad mkhan gser mgo/ gnyan gzer glo tshad de de'i kha bsgyur gtso brgyad legs 'dra/ ar brgyad snying na ba dang rta brdabs kyis stod du btsang la bzang /gi wang dgu pas smug po la phan che ba dka'/ a ru bcu pa mkhal tsha nad can la legs/ grum skabs steng du bong khrag sle tre'i [ tres] gnyis snon/ brag zhun dgu pa mkhris tshad pho bar lhungs la legs/ grang mkhris la'ang bzang /mkhris phye tsha 'khrur legs par rgyun du bsdebs/ cong zhi drug pa brang tsha chu skyug la legs/ ru rta drug pa rgyun du bsdebs/ pho glang gnyan med la zhi drug dang bsre/ rgyu long glang thabs la khyung lnga snon/ smug glang la'ang legs/ rtsa mkhris khur mong lta bu sdong bu gcig la yal ga mang ba yal ga gyes pa me tog khur mang las chung ba ser po brtsegs ma gcig gnyis yod pa bcad na 'o ma 'bab pa/ tig ta brgyad pa tsha mkhris la dgos/ rgya tig med na sum cu tig dang lcags tig ba dong ba 'dra ba gnyis bsres 'phen/ spos dkar bcu ba chu ser thams cad la bzang / 'di steng khyung lnga bsnan pa spos khyung bco lnga yin pas dgos tshe bsre/ mchin rgud ni mchin chu rgyun du 'dzag pa smug po'i rigs ngan/ gur gum bcu gsum glad [klad] gzer la bzang / gur gum mchog bdun rgyu tshad skabs mchin khrag rgyu mar babs nas mi bde ba sdom pa'i mchin pa'i zags sdom zhes legs/ steng du ri bong klad pa bsnon/ bde byed chung 'bring gnyis dmu chu'i skabs dgos/ blon po sum sbyor byis nad dgos/
li shi drug pa glo cham grer babs tsha ba dang rang bzhin gyis gre tsha la legs/ ma mog khug bzhag mur/ kri ka han:sa cham thams cad la legs/ rgun 'brum bdun pa rgas byis la e bzang / kyi lce gsum pa me tog gsum pa zhes gag pa la mid nang 'debs/ lhog pa la 'thungs/ spang rgyan dkar po ma rnyed na sngon pos tshab rung / se 'bru shing tsha sug pi bzhi se 'bru bzhi pa zhes pa thams cad la go dgos/ sga dang gur gum gyis so sor bsgyur ba skabs la sogs par dgos/ lce myang ngos 'dzin med/ chu 'gag chu bsgag pa/ stode rdzings pa sel ba'i da lis brgyad pa na rgyu med par stod bu btsang nas gnya' nas mnan nyams 'char la byin/ sur dkar me tog mi rnyed na lo ma 'phen/sug smel bcu pa mkhal ma'i grang nad thams cad la dgos/ shing kun cur nes dmu chus kha gdong skrangs la legs kyang 'thung mi nus/ byi tang bcu gcig zer ba srin nad thams cad la legs bas sdebs/ da trig dgu pa grang 'khrur legs/ da trig bdun pa tsha 'khru grang 'khru thams cad legs pas rgyun du sdebs/ shing mngar drug pa skyug par legs pas rgyun du sdebs tsha grang la byad med/ril khyung lnga ril bu byed na sa dmar gces btus ltar mnyam sbyor nyer rdza byed/ khyung phye rgyun du sdebs dgos pas til mar ltar a ru zho bzhi ru rta gang shu dag zho gsum sman chen zho do gla rtsi zho phyed sbyar/ khams rus kyis go chod/ tsa pa ru tshwa ngos 'dzin med/ garnya pa tra ma mo rna/ ma slas ma slab ste snyi hra min pa/ lcags phye gang gtong a ru brdung ba'i phye ma dang lhan du chur bsdus zhag gsum bzhi bsnyal bas phye mar gtong na skam 'jug mthing shun mthing chu nang du btul nas sgrungs pa'i khar skya bo zhig chags pa de logs su bzhur/ de'i kha'i chu pho nas snyigs ma skam bcug pa lud pa 'jab 'jib bam rdzab ljob 'ongs/ sge gsher bca' lga byed dgos pas be+e sngon dang mi mthun/
sman mar sbrang shad byed tshul sbrang rtsi gar [dkar] yol gang la chu gar [dkar] yol do blugs gdus/ ras tshag la gzhur sbrang gshog yan lag sogs blang dor khu ba de gdus/ khar zhag 'dra ba chag [chags]pa sbrang smyon yin pas shing bal glan btsir de ji ltar 'tshams blangs/ sbrang smyon 'ongs tshad len mi nus/ da nas bu ram zhib tu brdung ba dang mar rdog gcig 'phang me dal bus bus/ shing bu rtas kha ma zhig gi rgyun du dkrugs nas zangs ngos skag nas chag [chags]mi 'jug skabs shig mer bcug sgra med dang rdo 'khyag steng thigs pa brgyab na skag 'gro ba chu chod rtags yin pas zangs phog shing bus bsdus lag pa tshugs tshe lag pas bsnos/ de nas mi 'ga' yod na thams cad kyis log log re lag tu thogs 'then dril mang 'then ring du byas la/ skabs shig 'then na mi 'ongs bas da dung 'then pas skabs shig chad 'gro de dus dum bu byas 'khyag sar bzhag nas 'khyag tshe zhib mor brdung / sman cham chom brdung gdus khu ba thon tshe tshag [ tshags] la brgyab snyigs ma dor khu ba de la 'o ma gar [ dkar] yol dgu tsam blugs/yun ring dal bus gdus/ skabs shig 'o mas bsob ༷ 〈yig 'bru re gnyis mi gsal〉 rgyab cig mdor/ khu ba'i nang mar khu tsag [btsag] thag chod pa dang tse rgya ma bzhi tsam 'phang / gdus mer bcug tshag sgra med tshe phog 'khyag nas mtha' cung skag tshe kha tshar sman dang bur sbrang phye ma btab/ shing bus bsnos la gar tshugs tshe lag pas legs par bsnos 'dres bcug zhag 'gar za rgyu blangs nas de lhag grod bur bcug nas gseb yun ring nas pa bskyed/ 'o ma'i rtsig [rtsigs] ma ma dor na bldad rgyu zhig 'ongs tsha grang thun mong la mdzo ma'i 'o ma dang mar gtong / mdzo mo yar ma dang be'u khrid gnyis las be'u khrid 'o mar bsil/ 'bri rkang ste ba ru'i nang snying kha tshar byas pa e yin 'ba' sam bsdebs myong / da rgan phyir dgye nang gug gnyis yod/ khu
ba yang yang gdon ni khug gcig btsag yang snyigs ma de chur gdus yang btsag khu ba bre gsum 'ongs pa byas/ sman mar em tshi ltar byed/ thal sman rnon po dmu chu'i mjug skem pa la sbyor myong / 'phrul thal chung ngu skran la legs pas byed/ sman thams cad kyi nyis 'gyur gyi cong zhi blug por bzon zhig gi sngon po chur sgrungs rde'u sogs btsag dwangs ma'i kha'i chu pho snyigs ma de zangs nang skam bcug zhib brdung rta lud zhib brdung dang gzom [gsom]pa'i sol mgal brdung bsres pa la blug por dbyibs rgang 'os kha leb bcas byas skam thag chod nas so btang / sman rnams zhib brdung nang blugs sum nyis gang ba ba tshwa can gyis la tshwa cung bsres 'o ma bsres brdzis pas kha mtshams g.yis blugs bor gyi phyi thams cad 'dag pas g.yogs skam bcug ser kha cung yod pa la slar 'dag pas bsrubs skam bcug gyo mo gcig steng bzhag bong bas g.yogs mer bsregs nyin gang spud pa mi gtong / tshos tshad blug bor blangs thal steng bzhag btud [ bstud ] nas snum na mu zi mi bro na tshos tshad/ tshos pa legs na dkar po 'ongs/ gzhan nus ldan bsregs dgos la khos mgo mjug tu bo ti re bcug 'dag pas lcibs/ lcags sam blugs sor nang bcug ba tshwa can gyi 'dag pas kha zhabs dang steng thams cad g.yogs skam bcug yang gas bsrubs byed pa sogs byas te rta lud kyis me gsos nang bcug bsregs/ zangs thal tsi ta'i steng tho bas ngar phabs kyin brdung srab mor gyu ra tshe dag byed sug dang mnyam gdus skam nas he gris gtubs zangs kyi sum 'gyur gyi tsha la brngos pa dang mu zi gnyis chang gis brdzis 'dag pa ras stong rgyab steng zangs rim par bzhag steng yang 'dag pa rgyab dril skam bcug bsregs/ tshos rjes a ru lan tshwa ltar bu'i chu la btso/lag pas phur na mi zhig par sen mos brul thub pa tshos tshad/ dngul chu ltar zhun gnyis skyi khug srubs med nang blugs mnye 'drer bcug byed ma myong /
zar ma til mar min 'dra/ mtshal dkar la cog la dang dngul chu med pa gnyis yod pas be+e sngon dpyad/ cong zhi mgar pa'i khos kha lta bur spud pa drag po btang nas dmar po gyur rjes ngang ba ltar bur gyur tshe chus bran na zhig 'gro ba man ngag bsil sbyor sogs la 'phen/ chang gis phabs pa grang ba'i gnyen por gtong / skran la tshos tshe rang gar bzhag pa nyin bca' bcu nas phye mar 'gro ba gtong /brag zhun chur sbang nangs dus sbangs phyi dro bcos na ran bas rtsigs ma dor/ khu ba gdus me dal bus bus skabs skabs dkrugs rdo 'khyag steng thisag pa rgyab na skag nas dril btub pa tshad yin/ sa rtar lag mgor skyi khug gon khu ba btsir/ khu nang chu de mnyam blug lo ma tshag rgyab sogs dor/khu ba de gdu/ brag zhu na sbangs yun ring na ril ma 'dur 'gro/ ldum bu zangs rtsi gyang rtsa sogs su skye ba me tog dkar po can/ skyer khan dgos/ khyi la wa ri stod ja gcig pa dpyad/ brag zhun sogs zangs ngos 'dregs song ba sman la mi gtong / rtse 'jam dro 'jam/ tsha ba ni 'thung rgyu ja'am thug pa la rdor [sdor]du g.yer ma btab/rin chen skye rgyun gcod pa byed myong / mdzo dre'i sgyungs [rgyungs]pa ni chu thagmyu gu kha 'bus yin nam snyam yang lnga par 'thu ba dpyad/sngo sman btus 'phral chu nang byan rdo steng shing gis legs par brdung gris gtsab/ steng 'og la ras bkab nyi mas skem rnam rnga cung yod tshe khug ma'i nang bcug ras gur nang ngam phyir btags skem 'jug rtsa sdong lpags rkang sogs dug yod thams cad bral ba dka'/ nus pas las byed pa zhu ba'i dus/ spa 'bru ni spra'i 'bras bu snyi ba ngos 'dzin med/ sug 'dra ni sro lo'i rigs shig bai sngon bca' ba dpyad/
le'u zhe dgu pa/ sbyong byed las kyi mdo bstan pa/bshal mkhan pa sbang ma chur bsros pas byug sogs gal can la byed/a ru mchu ring dang mchu snyung don gcig mchu cung gug pa de la thur 'bab kyi nus pa che sgos bshal che ba byed na rna se ma 'di btang ba yin/ spyi bshal 'jam sbyongs la mi dgos/ chu ma rtsi 'dres pas sbyongs mi skyug nges/ a ru thal tshan du chu bur btod tsam/ dan rog shun pa nag po bshus bar gyi lce bton pa de gnyis dor/ phye nang bcug mkhur ba bsregs/ shrī khan mar skya si'i mar khu'i nang yun ring bsros/ dur byid rkang shun bral/ yos tshan nang bcug drag sbyongs byas na dbugs 'tshangs lus 'dar snying slog tsha ba skyes pa'i nyams byed/ de la rlung gnon phyir me nang mar khu'i thigs pa brgyab pa'i gsur dud phye phur gyis stod nas mar yang yang byugs na babs 'gro/ tsho khu zhag med nang rtsam btab 'thung / shin tu ngan na rlung gsang la me btsa' byed/ ded dpon bzhi sngon byed myong / 'jam sbyongs la em chi'i dan rog drug pa legs pas sdebs/ kha bsgyur la grang mkhris can la gser mdog lnga pa dkar nag bcu gcig tsha mkhris la bong bcu banyi tig ta brgyad pa/ dgu pa/ bcu pa/ ma zhu la zhi byed gang rung / bad kun la'ang rang sman smug po la cong zhi nyer gcig sogs/ skran la sgron thal mang ba/ dmu chu skya rbab la sha ru'i thal ba sogs nad gang yin pa de'i gnyen po sbyongs sman steng bsnan nas btang bas 'thus/ zo yis 'khru ni lus stobs drag zhan sogs thams cad la rang rang dang 'tshams par 'khru zhes pa'o// pus bar mū la spyir kham rus yin kyang ma rnyed na ma nu ru rta'i tshab rung tsam/ ma nu shu zur ma nu'i rigs
zhig yin kyang ma mthong / dmu chu'i kha bsgyur byed myong / chu dug ngos 'dzin med pas de min mi rus btsa' ma nas lcam 'bras bar gnad kyi man ngag bdun cha mnyam sbyar ba sbyongs sman steng thun gcig bsre ba'am sbyongs sman btang phral thun gcig btang na shin tu legs/ sgos bshal 'di rnams lag len ma byas kyang dur byid tsam dang thar nu tsam yod tsam gyis sbyongs mi nus pas ded dpon bzhi nyung ngu'am de min dan rog nges par bsre dgos/ dan rog tsam yod pas 'thus/ byang khog khrag 'bab ni mtshon khrag la go dgos/sbyongs sman thur mgo gsum tsam chus sbrus ril bu sran sbos tsam dril res gcig la mid bcug snga phyi byas na sbyongs pa'i nus pa'ang snga phyi 'byung /rgas dang zungs ngan rlung gis dogs pa can la sbyongs sman bskol ba ji 'jam du 'gro bas legs/ phye ma yin na kha bshal dgos/ shel kur mur mi smra mi 'gul tsog pur sdod pa sogs dgos/ gnyis gsum 'khrus nas tshwa btab pa'i chu bskol yang yang 'thung / rlung la dogs la rus khu sla mo'i lcag ded dpon bzhi sogs sngon la dug 'don skabs tshegs lam 'dzem par legs par tshos bcug na sbyongs skabs na zug mi bskyed pas 'jam pa mthong /gdon skyug pa'i rgyu yin pas 'grul ba bsrung / ma 'thung gong sun pa 'thung rjes yig log pa sman gyis dkrugs pa dang mi 'khru na sman stor gang gi gnyen por gtong ba'i nad de'i zug mngon gyur du ma byung na nad stor/ na 'gyu ste chung ngu ma gtogs che ba ma byung ba 'byams la 'bras thug ldud myong / mjug tu gcod ran tshe ma zhu bad kun dmu chu sogs la gcong dgos tshe gro bye'i [phye'i]thug pas gcod/ rlung can la sha khu'i nang phye thug byed/ mkhris pa la nas phye'i thug pa dang 'bras thug sogs btang ba yin/ gal te ma chod na /sbyin sogs 'dir bshad legs 'dra/ tsha rjes bsil gyis bcad/ grang rjes drod kyis bcad/ gzer ni mi sbyongs par g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu gzer
mig 'byung ba yin snyam/ pho log glang thabs pho nang gzer zug drag po brgyab cung bzhag yang 'phar ba/ 'khru skabs khong ba'i nang dkrugs nas dang po'i nad gzhi yod sar zug 'byung ba legs pas skyon med/ g.yos su ma byas pa 'gag to dang khu sogs kha mo ma yin pa/ zhi grum chu bsres dang 'grig zho phrum zho rnyings sla ba yin snyam/ zho ro ni ras tshag [tshags]la btsag nas chur khu thon pa/ skyugs rgyu min zhes skyugs pa ha cang mnan na sbyongs sman glo rtsar shor nas mi rus bas ha cang mi gnon/ bad kun la bshal skyugs gnyis ka res gcig la byung na shin tu legs/phral du ma zhu dang phral du mi 'phrod zos 'phral du bad mkhris rgyas ba lto snum rnams la sngon 'gro/ nad grang yang ma zhu'i gnas su 'dus rtags thob na yar nye sa yin pas skyugs sla bas sngon 'gro mi dgos pa yin nam/ mkhris nad can la sbyongs rgyab na ser po 'dres pa'i chu nur po skyugs pa mthong /mkhris ba shor na ro shin tu kha ba'i ser skya sngags/ skyugs pa chang [chung]chung dgos na shu dag pi pi ling rgyam tsha gsum phye ma 'thung na skyugs nus zer/sna sman sna klad pa'i sgo yin pas snabs kyang klad pa'i zags chu yin/ rdzi 'khor dpyad/ kha mtshul ba gre phugsha'i grogs su 'o ma dang 'o grogs su mar dgos pas gsum ka byed/grod pa'i kha'i spu gu'i phyi'i dkyil du 'phang lo lta bus 'thogs yod pa bya/grod pa btsir nas sman sbu gu'i kha dang mnyam pa byas nas dbugs bton/'jam rtsi'i lcag chu skol 'og nas gtong ba yin nam/ skyi tsher sa dma' sar skye ba tsher ma'i mgo gyen la bstan pa de ma gtogs khos mo yog 'dra ba de yin/yog mo a 'ga' yan zer/rtsa sbyongs spu 'thums ches pa bza' btung nang gi spu dril nas bkag pa/dri chu rang log ni rang gi dri chu 'thung ba yin nam/
le'u lnga bcu pa/ 'jam rtsub dpyad kyi mdo bstan pa/gtar ga rtse rgur ni lce 'bam gshag spyad [ byad]/ so drang brang can dpyad/ rims gsang la gtar mi rung / sbyar dug sman gyis ma bsad pa dang / gnyan tshad ma chog pa la mi gtar/ stongs tshad sdong zla rlung yin pas mi rung / rims gtar mi rung na dpyad/ mtshan ma'i tog dang mig 'bras mi na pa la rngabs ra byed rung bas dogs te yin nam/ don la mtshon gyis zin pas byang khog tu khrag babs pa la don rtsar der gtar ba yin nam/ rtsa chen rnams gtar na 'bras gsum thang dgung gsum tsam la btang ba yin/mkhris pa rtsar byer mig ser la gser mdung dngul mdung gtar bas khrag gi khar chu ser po 'khyil ba mthong / glo rnag can la glo snying 'dom rtsar gtar bas khrag gi nang la rnag gi ri mo 'khyil ba mthong / nyi ma bsro me la ldeb 'gro ba las ka sogs kyis dros 'jug mgo rtsar gtar na smin ma'i steng man khebs pa byas lag phyis sum sdebs [ltebs]sam bzhi sdebs [ltebs]btang smin phrag steng nas thig gus bsdams ltag pa nas shing phus dkyus rim bzhin lag phyis bsnol ba'ang 'then nas sdebs [ ldebs] mi 'chor ba byas te bsdams na rtsa 'bur 'ongs/ spubs rtsa yin na des kyang mi gsal bas sor mo gcig gis mnan nas yud yud thams cad la reg pas rtsa yod sar mer mer byed/ de steng rtsa phran la smyug kha byed dgos pas sen rjes yo ba zhig phabs/de gdab dmigs yin/ dpral rtsa skra mtshams kyi dbus na yod pas bsdams pa tsam gyis mi gsal bas 'tshol dgos/ skra mtshams nas yar sor bzhi

rtsom pa po ngo spyod mdor bsdus/gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po smra bsam rin chen nam ming gzhan la ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhes pa ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug dang nyi shu pa'i stod du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas chen zhig yin snyam/ khong gis slob dpon 'brong byang pa mtshan smos par dka' ba bstan 'dzin tshe ring ngam stobs ldan dbang po sogs bsten nas rig gnas spyi dang sgos su gso ba rig pa'i thad la nang byan chub par sbyangs/ rang lo so brgyad klu mer 'byor pas rang nyid dang rigs mthun pa'i lha rje/ slob bu rigs brgyud bcas par phan slad lhag bsam kun nas bslangs te khro bor 'bod pa shing mo glang lo'i snron zla'i gral tshes bug gzugs dang / res gza' dkar po/ rgyu skar snga char byi bzhin phyi r+shar+sha hūm̐ (sbyo/shā byi r+yaṃ m+p+raṃ rnyipa pa'i gaspran rilha r+shatāspri snodhihā phruna' ṭ+wāṃ snapa (( ji /lha pa zab bcud man ngag nyer mkho gces bsdus su 〈sem smyon nyams myong dran pa'i gsal byed 〉ces pa 'di brtsams nas 'gro ba'i las don gnyer/ yid skyo ba zhig la sku nyid kyi yab yum gyi mtshan dang / gnang rigs rjes sbyangs kyi snod ldan slob ma su dag bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus yig cha zhib tu ma rnyed/
oṃ swasti/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan song sdug bsngal skyobs// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i// rnam sprul 'tsho byed gzhon nu pad ma 'byung // bīgs ba pa dang g.yu thog mi dgu sogs// rgya bod mkhas pa rnams la phyag bgyid do//rgyal ba sman mdzad ston pa gang de yis// bstan pa rgyas par byed pa bdud rtsi'i mchog / skye dgu'i yi ga bde bar rab 'byor nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces rgyal ba sman bla'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ em smyon ra bzi ba smra bsam rin chen nam ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zhes 'du shes gsum pas nyam thag bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig gi nad sems bskyed rgya che'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang bdag skyur chang la sred pa che zhing rkyen [skyes]stobs kyi mthu chung /sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan cher med pas/ mkhas grags 'dod pa'i rtsom dang bshad pa ni// rnam par rtog pa las ngo tsha gzhan khrel rgyu// lhag bsam dag pa'i phan pa sems bskyed blos// lag len sla byed slob dpon mkhas pa bsten// drin gyis bskyangs pa'i skyes 'di'i dgos pa ni// ra bzi'i byed por skyon gyur mang ba dang // dpal ldan rgyud sogs gzhung don ma gsal ba//༈ lag len mthong brgyud brjed du 'phangs pa'i rigs// ra bzi'i skyon du drangs pa'i gsal byed du// nye bar mkho ba'i thang phye ril bu las// tshad nad smin thang sgang gcog rjes bsdu ba'i//( gnad 'a gag shes par bya ba'i zin bris 95
