dang po/ rims tshad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/ma nu sle tres cha mnyam sbyar ba la// kuṇ+ḍa ka ri nyis 'gyur gtong ba ni //tshad ldan ku ṇ+ḍa 'i sbyor ba zhes pa yin// sga skya dri thon bsnan pa ma nu bzhi//bad kun skya smug stong tshad khrag gzer dang // rims tshad smin sdud sel bar mchog tu gsungs// de steng a bar skyur gsum nor bu bdun/ / rims 'khrugs tsha ba'i nad rnams sel bar byed// de steng tig ta spang ñtsa hong len bsnan// bcu thang zhes bya mkhris nad gsar rnyings dang // rgyas tshad stongs tshad glo 'khrugs gab tshad dang // chams [ cham] rims 'grams 'khrugs gzer thung la sogs pa// mdor na tsha ba'i nad rigs mtha' dag la// smin sdud sel byed thang chen 'di rang mchog / gong steng dmar gsum cung zad bsnan pa yi// thang chen bcu gsum phan yon gong steng la// grang khrag mkhal skyed la yang gnod mi 'gyur// de phyir thang chen 'di rang lhag par mthong //bdud rtsi sleb chog sbyor ba 'di ltar bya// klung gi phag pa'i ril ma rnying pa ni// nus ldan bsreg pa gtso bo cha bcu drug / rims dug tshad rnying sel ba'i spang tsi do// rims nad spyi yi snying po de ba lnga// mgo nad sel ba'i mgo thang gsum pa dang // rgyu long snod tshad sel ba'i iṇ+ḍa bzhi// pho mchin mkhal tshad sel ba'i byang sems dmar// mkhri sa nad zhi sbyongs lha mo g.ya' kyi ma//tshad gsar gnyan nad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo gcig / kha 'bus bdud tsi lo ma rtse mo mchog / gla tsi gu gul gnyis po thun re sbyar// phan yon chams [cham]tshad rims nad gsar rnying dang // stod gzer klad gzer gag lhog rims// rgyu gzer snod 'khrugs dmar ser za khu dang // be+e snabs la sogs 'khru ba sel bar byed// khyad par mkhris pa'i tshad pa mtha' dag la// sleb
chog bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba 'di nyid mchog / yang na/ de ba gser gyi me tog par pa ta/ ga dur a ru sbyar ba'i de ba lnga/ / spang rtsi bong dkar chig thub gla gul bsnan// bal nad rims kun 'joms pa'i spyi sman yin//sman ser che dang 'bring dang chung gsum las// skabs su mkho nges pa'i chung ba 'dir// tsan dan dkar po ut+pal bong nga dkar// ghi wang gla gul a ru gser mdog dang // 'a dzin pa brag zhun sle tros ka ra sbyar// khrag mkhris gnyan nad ma lus thams cad kun// sman mchog 'di yis mi sel gang yang med// mi yi dbang po rnam rgyal grags bzang lugs//glang po don gyi gur khang du// ba tig hong dkar ghing / tsan/ gum/ cu/ shata/ len/ bong / gdan bting [steng]du// yon tan a bhi lha mo ru/ ba ru/ skyu ru bzhugs// sle ri ma yi tes/ ga nu/ skya dga' ston drangs// le brgan klad gzer khong khro'i rims// khyams stod khyams smad nyul ba yis// tsha ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel// le brgan dar dkar gos gyon nas// gaṅgā'i dri chab gtsang mas dbul// gtso nor chu rgyun zhes kyang bya// sprin bral zla zer zhes kyang bya// tshad pa gsar dang rnying pa la// bsdu gsod byed pa'i man ngag mchog /bha ra ta yi rnam snang ni// nus ldan bsreg cha bcu drug la// puṣar mu la [puskar mū la]rgya mtsho ste// tig ta zung la sman mchog gzugs// 'di la rtsa ba'i sman bzhi zer//: tshad rims gsar rnying gang la yang // smin sdud sel ba drug zer ba 'dug gsum ka byed// de steng go ro tsa na me// zhe sdang zla ba hong len mig / gaṇ+ḍa ser po zung 'jug steng // sbyor ba 'di yi phan yon ni// tshad pa spyi 'joms sman gcig po// bdud rtsis 'chi ba nges par zlog / gtso bo brgyad kyi gzhi ma la// kha bsgyur ldan pa'i sman mchog 'di// bi ji'i po ti kha ser gyi// yang snying 'khor lo'i lde mig yin//
gtso brgyad gla ba gu gul dang // stag sha shu dag bcu gnyis po// gtso po bcu gnyis sbyor ba zer// nyin zhag gcig la thun drug gtong // gzer gyi nad la bdud rtsir mtshungs// khyad par gnyan la bsngags pa yin// gtsang stod dar ma mgon po'i lugs// rgyas tshad thog babs gsod pa la// 'di las lhag pa'i sman gzhan med// des kyang tshad pa ma zhi na// 'di steng ga bur ka ra bsnan// ga bur bcu gsum sbyor ba zhes// nag po gsum sgril smin pa la// 'di rang zab gnad khyad par 'phags//gtso bo bcu gsum sbyor ba la// gtso bo brgyad steng sro lo dkar// ga dur shing mngar gla rtsi dang // gu gul sbyar ba gung gnyis su// bskol grang chu yis phul la btang // glo tshad me ltar 'bar ba la// myur du bde ba'i dpal la 'god//rje btsun gu nār [ṇar]gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// man ngag zab bcud rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gtso brgyad sbyor ba kha bsgyur mang mod kyang //'di ni nyams bcos gdengs ldan myong grub ma// go bde ma sgrib gsal por bkod pa la// gtso brgyad rgyud chen nang bzhin sbyor ba'i steng // spang rtsi 'bras bu gsum dang ba le ka / hong len ma nu ga dur sro lo dkar// shing mngar spang rgyan dkar po pa yag rtsa// dmar gsum sle tres 'bri ta sa 'dzin dang // gu gul bdud rtsi lo ma stag sha nag / a krong par sbyar spyi 'joms rje'u'i sbyor/ / bskol grang chus 'phul rims tshad ma smin dang // rgyas tshad 'khrugs tshad khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims dang // chams [ cham] rims 'grams 'khrugs gzer thung la sogs pa// mdor na tsha ba'i nad rigs mtha' dag dang // lud pa dmar ser dud khu skya sob sogs// ma chod yun du sbyong ba'i glo nad brgyad// gsar rnying ma lus sel ba'i bdud rtsi yin//mchog tu rtsegs pa'i nad la thengs pas mchog / ma brjed snying la sems pa'i
'tsho thabs 'di// sman pa'i tshul 'dzin bstan 'dzin tshe ring pas// nyams myong bu slob nad pa'i gsos su sbyar// 'gro kun phan bde 'byung ba'i dge legs stsol//gtso brgyad rin chen g.yu ral zhes bya ba'i// sngon chad yi ger bris pa med na'ang // snod ldan rig byed 'dzin la phan phyir bkod// rab dkar ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la// nyi gdung [gnyis 'thung]dbang po 'dzin pa'i khri steng na// 'char ba'i [ kha'i] mdangs 'phrog gzhon nu 'brum ser can// rtsa ba gnyis ldan dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing // yal ga 'dab ma brgyad la sku rgyab stod [ gtad ]/ / gser mdog legs 'ong lha mos legs par 'khyud// kun kyang byang sems dga' ba bde la rol// 'jigs byed ha la 'bar ba'i stag dang ni// rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya'i 'khor gyis bskor//myur mgyogs bsod ldan pho nyas spyan drangs nas// tsha ba rnyings rnyogs dreg grum rkang 'bam dang // sa gsum gzhi bdag 'byung po dgra bo'i gdon//skad cig nyid la 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin// de phyir drang srong snyan brgyud gdams pa mchog / rig byed rgan po la yang yod ma yin// sman pa'i gzugs brnyan kun la med do bu// rin chen srog 'dzin yin no snying la chongs//
gnyis pa/ tshad rlung gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/lci snum bsil ba'i a gar rigs gsum dang // khyad par bsil la rtul ba'i tsan dan gnyis// 'du ba cha snyoms bzang drug 'bras bu gsum// sbyor ba de la rab tu gces pa'i gtso// blon 'bangs 'khor du bkod [bskor] ba nyi shu gcig / ma nu kuṇ+ḍa ka ri sle tros dang // tig ta hong len sga skya ba sha ka /gu gul dkar nag gla rtsi ko byi la// sha chen 'dzim pa tsher sngon snying zho sha / na [nā]ga ge sar ru rta a byag gnyis/ se 'bru sro lo dkar po ka ra sbyar// sbyor ba 'di ming a gar sum cu lnga/ / tshang zhing ma zlos tshad du sbyar ba'i phye//tshangs pa chen po'i tshe yi rig byed las// rig ldan drang srong zhal nas snyan khungs [khung]brgyud// gong sman bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun// go bde mgrin ngos las 'ongs gdams pa 'di// rlung mkhris bad gan 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad// stod gzer dbugs 'khril gnyan tshad rlung gsum 'thabs// glo skam thes sud grum bu bar rta dang // stod tsha smad grang stod sman [smad]go log dang // bla gnyan thor nad gnyen pos bcos mi len// gang la gang mtshams rta yis bsgyur byas na// phan yon gong bshad nad la theng mchog [thengs chog]yin//a ga ru dang snying zho sha / tsan dan dkar dmar dzā ti dang // cu gang gur gum sro lo dkar// ka ra sbyar ba khrag rlung 'thabs// mdun rgyab gzer dang glo sog sel// drang srong mu khyud 'dzin gyi lugs// drang srong ar brgyad cha gcig la// nor bdun thang phye cha gnyis bsres// a gar bco lnga'i sbyor ba 'dis// khrag rlung stod 'tshangs dbugs 'byin dka'// tshad gzhug rlung
nad ( can ) la bsngags//ko byi mas [ sha ] pho ru rta a gar nag / a ru gser mdog cu gang gur gum dang // spos dkar ka ra sbyar ba'i ko byi bdun/ / khrag ngan stod du rgyas pa'i nad rigs dang // dbugs thung dbu gas 'khril gzer chen stod rgyangs sogs// rkang 'bam gyen bzlog nad la mchog tu bsngags// a rogs mdza' bo snying la chongs//gur dmar gzer mgo bcu yi gang // btsan rgod lta bu ru mtshon 'phyor// rgol na gzer gyi dgra bdud chod// grogs po bzhi dang 'bral med gyi// rgun gyi 'bras bus sna drangs nas// bal po ser po'i chibs ldan pa//skyon med 'bru bcud dpung bshams nas// nang du rgyal po gar byed dang //phyi ru blon po bro 'khrab dang // mon pa 'o dod 'bod pa dang // gshong zhing than pas brdungs pa dang // sgra 'dzin nang nas skad 'don dang // lus la rtse ber gyon pa dang // snying gdab pa ngag nas bab stod gzer ba col smra ba dang //g.yal stong 'ong ba lce skam pa sems rgod brtul zhugs rna ba 'ur ba 'don pa dang //'dar sir ba rmugs pa dbyings su yal cal col mang ba ba sogs// tsha ba me la shing rgyab ste// rlung bus skyod pa'i 'jig sa zhe sdang sdug bsngal gnyis ka pa la// gdon mi za ba'i 'joms byed 'di// gnyid yer ba kun la med pa'i khyad chos yin//bsil sbyor thal ba ngo bo rlung la tsha bcos thal//'brong rtse a gar brgyad pa'i sbyor ba la// a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha /ru rta sdebs pas rlung khrag spyi la phan// a byag bsnan pas lnga pas gzer la phan// li shi [sha ]bsnan pas rlung khrag spyi la phan// ri bong snying bsnan brgyad pas smyo 'brog sel//
gsum pa/ bad tshad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/tsan gnyis gi ru pal gser a// su ka li gur dzā cu bong // gla nyung pi sha lga tig dom/ ma 'u spri [pri]ltar bse yab sdebs// bse skyur mtshan mo'i 'od can congazhidakar// sbyar tshad bla ma'i zhal las zhus// dug smug mkhris pa mchin par rgyas// mchin mkhris bar gyi nad rnams dang // bad tshad sel ba kho bos mthong //spang rgyan dkar po ar [a]gar snying zho sha / tsan dan dzā ti cu gang sro lo dkar// ru rta 'bras gsum tig ta ba sha ka / li shi shing mngar cong zhi dang bcas pa// spang rgyan bco lnga'i sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis// cham tshad gre bar bab dang dbugs mi bde// bad rlung stod rgyangs mid 'chus sel bar byed//khyad par bad tshad sel la 'di rang mchog /
—bzhi pa/ 'dus nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/cong zhi brag zhun ltar bu 'u su dang // ma nu kuṇ+ḍa ka ri sle tres dang // lha skya se 'bru sbrang sbyar zla bcud dgu / smug po byer rgyas 'gying 'dril la sogs pa// 'dus nad gso dka' mtha' dag 'dul bar byed//cong zhi se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling // ma nu 'u su ut+pal pri yang ku /bse yab ltar bu skyu ru ba sha ka / a ru gser me dug nyu nga bong nga dkar// ghi wang tig ta ru rta tsan dan dmar// brag zhun sbyar ba cong zhi nyer gcig pas//pho mchin ro rgyab sbrags shing tshigs pa na// brang tsha chu skyur mkhris pa rgya bshal skyug / khrag mkhris pho bar lhung ngam stod du gzer// smug po rgyas dang gab cing 'khrugs pa dang // rang gzhan gnas su bzhen [ zhen] cing rnying pa sogs// 'dus nad smug po'i rigs kun sman mchog yin//kha che'i gur gum thang gi gtso bo la// a bar skyur gsum ma nu pa tra dang // puskar mū la rgya tig hong len dang // kyi lce bong dkar 'u su par pa ta//me tog lug mig mkhris ['khri ]shing gser me tog / ldum bu re ral phag khrag gaṅgā chung // ut+pal ba sha ka dang pri yang ku / brag zhun se 'bru sug smel bse yab rnams// sbyar ba gur gum nyi shu rtsa lnga'am// thang chen nyer lnga zhes su grags pa 'dis// dug dang smug po tshad rnying byer ba sdud// 'du ba tsha grang snyoms dang dang kha 'byed// rlung mi skye la bad kun mkhris pa sel//'dus nad gab 'gying gyen thur rdol ba la// 'byung bas lus 'khrur 'dus nad gso ba ni// cong zhi mdzo 'or 'dam btags grib skams bya// ghi
wang bzang drug ut+pal tsan dan gnyis// gla tsi gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung //tig ta bong nga a ru ba sha ka / ru rta skyu ru se 'bru pi pi ling // brag zhun dom mkhris lcags phye pri yang ku / gangs thig [thigs] gu gul rtsa gnyis mi sog thal// dngul chu mu zi dri chen ko byi la// hong len ma nu lug ru smyag po ste//ka ra bzhi 'gyur rang rang sman rtas dbul// dug dang sprug khur tso chu rtsa po khrag tu 'khru skyugs dang // gab tshad rnyings tshad 'grams 'khrugs 'thab pa dang // 3ma zhu glang thabs srin dang chu ser skran// ldan 'dus nad rnams 'joms pa'i rdo rje ste// nad 'gyings zho ltar chags pa thur du sbyong // pho bar babs na ma nu bzhi thang btang // se 'bru bzhi pa ltag pa sprad pas 'joms//
4lnga pa/ gcong nad kun gyi rtsa ba ma zhu ba gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/ma nu gcig la lga skya gnyis// a ru gsum la lcum rtsa bzhi// cong zhi lnga la bul tog drug / phan yon ma zhu gsar rnying dang // dug dang pho ba'i me drod nyams// gyen log bu dang sha thogs dang // long srin rigs lnga smad rlung mchog / dri ma skams pa rlon par 'gyu ra//'gro ba'i mgon po rkang gnyis gtso bo// chos kyi dbyings las g.yo ba med kyang // sems can phan phyi ra gdams pa zab mo'i// gsang mdzod phye nas brtse bas 'dir bshad// phyog mo grub pa'i sbyor ba 'di la// bdud rtsi cong zhi phul 'o mar 'dam 'thag grib skam bya gang gzhi byas// ha las kha 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba// mchin pa'i kha 'dzin gur gum shing tsha// mkhal ma'i kha 'dzin mdangs bskyed sug smel// pho ba'i kha 'dzin drod bskyed se 'bru// grang ba'i kha 'dzin nal sham pi ling // rlung gi kha 'dzin sga skya mtheb tsam// rlung khrag kha 'dzin sha rus [ru]gong mnyam// ma zhu'i kha 'dzin rgyam tsha sho tsam// bur dkar rta la bskyon pa'i phye mas// lhen dang lcags dreg skran dang ma zhu// dug ro la sogs pho mchin nad gzhi// ma lus ba mo nyi mas phog bzhin// sel byed man ngag kun gyi yang snying // khyad par stobs 'phel lus mdangs rgyas shing //dbang gsal rgas sra bcud len mchog yin// bdud rtsi chang gi gnyen po 'di nyid// bag med 'thung kyang 'di nyid thun re// mod la 'ju zhing myos par mi 'gyur// sman nus 'dzin phyir gsang ba'i rdzas mchog / kur+sha pa ṇi sbrum ma
'jug cing // se [so]skyes brjod dka' gdams pa'i nus mthu// lce brgyas bskal ba stong phrag du mar// smras kyang zad par nus pa ma yin// thams cad mkhyen nyid brjod pa'i gnas yin// so [ se] 'bru bzhi dang lnga pa brgyad sogs// tsha grang bab bstun sbyar btang mkhas gzigs//
drug pa/ skran nad se ga ba dran pa'i gsal byed/tshwa bsreg sbyor ba 'di ltar byed// ba tsha med pa'i gan tshwa de// sngo mdog ro mnga' [mngar]'byung ba yin// de nyid khram brdungs khyor ba do// g.yag rgod sha ni mtheb chen tsam// zhib brdungs ba zho bre gang la// btab ste btsos dkrug chu chod dus// rdza snod nang blug kha sdoms ni// du ba ma shor bong mes bsreg / ltar bu legs pa srang chen gang // bu ram dkar po zho lnga la// pi ling zho ni gsum sbyar ba'i// de gsum ba chus sbrus pa ni// ril bu sran sbos tsam pa dril// zho tshod longs pa tse gur btang // phan yon rgyud gzhung ji bzhin las// ma zhu lhen dang lcags dreg dang // bad gan grang ba'i gzhi 'brel ba'i// khrag skran sel byed ngo mtshar che// gzhan yang kha bsgyur ro nus sogs// gnyen po gang bston gnad du che//ltar bu bcu bdun sbyor ba la// ltar bu sga skya a ru ra// sbrul sha 'o ma gser bye ma// brag zhun se 'bru gur gum dang // lcum rtsa ba spru ga bur nag /mdze tsha rgya tsha rgyam tsha dang // ze tsha ya bak+ṣa ra dang // cong zhi rgod btul la sogs pa// tshwa sna'i rigs ni lcags slang du// rdza phor bkab ste bye 'dam dpyad// du ba ma shor bsreg phye dang // gar nag yan gyi sman 'di ni// ltar bu ma gtogs skyes [tres]sam bya// sman kun gyi ni phye ma dang // gtso mnyam chus sbrus ril bu bya// phan yon mo nad khrag skran dang // mngal skyon bu ro lus pa dang // lhen dang lcags dreg ma zhu sbos// tshabs nad ma lus sel bar byed//
rgyaru bco lnga'i sbyor ba ni// rgya ru gtso yin bse ru sha ba'i rwa// tshal dkar bcas pa bsreg tshul gong dang 'dra// gur gum dzā ti se 'bru gsum//tsan dan sug smel ba spru gsum// dmar gsum shug tsher ga bur nag / sdig srin sbyar ba'i phye ma 'di// ltar bus sbrus la ril bu bya// phan yon khrag tshabs rlung tshabs dang // mo nad khrag 'gril rtsa nad dang // yan lag byer ba'i chu ser dang // dmu 'or skya rbab kun la mchog /rdo zhun rgyal po'i sbyor ba la// rdo zhun rigs lnga gang yin kyang // ma nor ngos bzung ldan pa la// sol mes yun ring bsreg pa yin skran gyi sman/ / ma na bzhi pas khu ba bya// ser thon ngad bsad dwangs ma la// ma tshos rdo phye til tsam yang // ma shor dgos pa gal che'o// de nyid gtso bo yin pa la// khrag nad can la ltar bu yin// mkhris ldan mi phag brun rnying ni// nus ldan bsregs pa'i thal ba yin// bad kun can la khong [kho] rang mchog / rlung ldan bca' sga dzā ti sdebs// pho ba'i nad la se 'bru shis// mchin nad gur gum shing tshas sel// pi ling rgyam tsha sug smel sbyar// mkhal nad grang ba'i yul rnams 'joms// skran gyi grong khyer chen po zhig / thor byed me rlung chu rlung gi/ 'phrul 'khor rdo rje'i thog lta bu// 'joms byed pha lam 'di lta ste//gcong chen skran nad ces pa la// gnyen po 'di 'dra zab gnad kyi// yang zab don dang ldan pa yin// rdo zhun rkyang ma'i ril bu yang // skran thog lcags bzang rgyab dang mtshungs// the tshom mi bya gdengs ldan ni// phyag bzhes rnam par dag par shog /
bdun pa/ dmu chu gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/'di ru skran dang dmu chu ma gtogs pa// gzhan rnams ma bris dmu chu bcos thabs kyi// khol du phyung ba'i dran pa'i gsal byed ni// rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kun chu ser khrag / de yang dwangs ma khrag mkhris glo mchin zags//mcher zags smug po'i zags chu la sogs pa// de rnams brten [rten] can rgyu yi dmu chu'i rgyu// de'i rkyen ma zhu ba la rjes zas spyod log / tsha ba'i rjes la gtar dang ba sil sbyor thal// ngal dub rjes la chu mang 'thungs pa dang //rlan steng nyal ba la sogs me drod nyams// sngon las gdon rkyen dbang gis dmu chur 'gyur//dbye ba chu rigs bco lngar gsungs mod kyang // skabs 'dir rlung mkhris bad kun khrag byer bzhi// de yang tsha chu grang chu gnyis su 'du// 'on kyang de gnyis 'dres las ldan pa bshad// chu yi gnas pa phyi nang bar dang gsum// phyi chu sha mdangs bar na gnas pa ste// nang chu rgyu long snod kyi steng na 'phyo// bar chu lpags 'og sha stong khyab par gnas//de ltar spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi rtags dang po 'jug dang bar du smin// tha ma rgyas dus 'tsho 'chi brtags pa'o// dang po 'jug dus shed chung pho ba ltem// dbugs rgod snying 'degs zas kyi 'ju stobs chung //lce chu rnyil dkar 'gro 'dug gsus pa ldeg / bol gong ngar gdong chu so bcu drug dod[mdo]/ / pho ba grang [brang]zhol kha gdong mig lcibs dang // chu yi mkhar brgyad g.yo zhing skrangs pa yin// bar du chu ru smin nas gsus pa
khengs// bem tol rgyab [brgyab]na thol thol phrig phrig 'ong // tha ma rgyas dus 'tsho 'chi brtags pa ni// dbugs ngal dang kha bde la skom dad chung // zug med lus yang mig dkar dri chu sngo// rtsa rgyud snyoms la shed che 'tsho bar 'gyur//'chi rtags dang kha mi bde skyugs pa dang // blo mang mig ser dbugs thung skom dad che// dri chu dmar ser bska [ska]la nyung ba dang // zungs zad lus stobs shor na spang par bya// bye brag rlu nga gyur 'khrog 'ur 'phel 'bri byed//zug che chu sngo dri chu sri la sdom// mkhris pa mig ser sha sngo chu babs chung // rtsa grims chu mdog mar khu btsod khu 'dra// bad kun dbugs 'degs skrangs che 'ju stobs chung // lus lci gnyid che rtsa byings chu mdog sngo// khrag byer rtsa grims chu dmar dang ga 'gags// ro stod rtsi [rtsib]logs gzer skams lus po lci// tsha chu rtsa grims chu mdog dmar ram ser// glo ser mig ser lhen snar slog pa chags// gsus pa che la rtsa yi dra bas khyab// yan lag phra la skam pas yi dwags bags ['dra]/ / lce steng ba [ bad] dang skom dang zug gzer che//grang chu rtsa dal chu sngo skom dad chung // pho ba sbos 'khrog byed cing skabs su 'khru// mgo lus yan lag skrangs che mnan rjes 'ong // sbom la rag pas mgon po lta bur bshad// zug med dang ga bde la mig sprin dkar// de nyid 'dres las ldan pa'i chu nad de// rtsa ni khar bying gting na cung zad grims//chu mdog dmar ser ldog pa shin tu dka'// phal cher mi ldog pa nyid shas cher mthong // pho yul nyid dang chu la 'phel 'grib byed// mdor na tsha grang gnyis 'dres ldan pa'i rtags// mkhris pa las gyur tsha chu mi 'tsho spangs//bad rlung las gyur grang chu gso sla nus// nad gzhi gzhan bral rten med bcos pa sla// ldan pa'i chu nad dag kyang 'tsho ba mang /bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag sogs// rgyas par gsungs kyang mdor bsdus spyi bcos la// nad ni me drod nyams las 'byung ba'i phyir//
dang po mngon tshul byung dus pho ba yi// gzhi 'dzin me gso se 'bru bzhi pa'i steng // gur gum bsnan pa chu tshan dbul la btang // pho ba'i me drod bskyed cing ma zhu 'ju// bad ldan be snabs rtsa sbubs 'gags pa sel// dwangs ma ma zhu lus zungs rang sor 'jug / dri chu'i bungs che pho ba bde bar 'gyur//nad gzhi 'jug tshabs chung na de stengs su// lcam pa bsnan par se 'bru nyi dga' zer// chu bskol 'phul bas nad 'di lhogs [ bzlog] pa'ang srid//yang na bde byed 'bring po tshad ldan ni// bsil gsum ut+pal se 'bru pi pi ling // shing tsha ka ra bzhi 'gyur cu gang bdun// tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'byed par byed// rgun 'brum shing mngar glo nad rnying pa sel// zhes pa tshad ldan 'di rang mngags [bsngags] par bshad// tsha chu'i rtags che grang chur bsgyur ba la// shing mngar 'u su lcam 'bru dang // glang sna srad dkar skyu ru drug/ 'di drug a bhi drug thang zer// tsha chu'i lam 'byed grang chur 'gyur// kha che'i rgya dar ser po'i gur nang du// lho bal sprin dkar brtsegs pa'i gdan khri'i steng // bod kyi bon po sngon po'i na bza' gsol// phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams nas ni// tsha chur ma 'jigs nga yis skyob par byed//gsungs shing dpon blon bdun po yod dam zer// gur gum dang ni 'jib rtsi dang // ut+pal gser me bong nga dkar// ba sha ka dang skyu ru bdun// 'bol sman bdun zhes bya ba yin// tsha chu'i rtags rnams 'di yis sel// de yi dri chu'i bungs che pho ba bde// me drod gso zhing thog mar 'di bsten na// grang chur ma gyur srid kyang tsha rlabs gcog /dmu chu'i nad la dwangs ma chu 'dren ni// se 'bru bzhi steng gur gum gser bye dang // sdig srin 'u su lcam pa'i 'bras bu bsnan// skyu ru ra ni kun dang mgo snyoms sbyar// chu rigs bco lnga 'dren cing skem par byed//bde byed chu bsgyur chung 'bring che// dang po cu gang bdun pa'i steng //
de dang bong mnyam a bhi sbyar// chung ngu'o de steng gser bye dang // klu glang sdig srin dkar po lta dka' lcam pa ba kun dka' gnyon〈kusu lhab nardzabar dang gze ma dang ni de kun dang // bong [bongs] mnyam am bha 'bring po yin//chen po de steng dung 'dra 'buskyogs dang // 'khor bsgyur sngon mo chab 'dren bsnan mnyam am bha sbyar// phyi ma 'u skyur lha mo yi// thang gis 'phul btang tsha grang ngam// rtsa sbugs 'gags sbyong zags pa dang // ldan 'dus la sogs chu rigs kun// gsang ba'i lam du 'dren pa'i mchog /bde byed 'bring po'i steng du ni// gze lcam sdig srin skyu ru ra// brag zhun bsnan pas 'or skya rbab// dmu chu lam nas 'dren par nges//gzhan yang ra mo she [shel]gyi gsang ba'i sman// ma dhu be+eḍūr+ya dang ki ṣa ba se 'bru/ che dī ba/ byi sran nag po bya ma sleb gong btus/ / grog ma'i gzugs can mu zi mdog med sran nag bya ma sleb gong btus dang // nang blon shing tsho kan rtsa me lha pi ling gsol rda ri [gseg]brdar ris sug smel dang // phyi blon rin chen sna lnga'i phye ma dang // khrag skem skyu ru ra gsum med pa la gser bye las byed ka ka ru// rtsar rgyug shing mngar chu sman gzugs kyi rnam par gnas// bcu gsum cha snyoms zhes kyang tsha grang gi / sbyor tshad bsil drod man ngag ldan shes na// dmu chu gtsor gyur skya rbab 'or la sogs// chu nad tsha grang ldan 'dus mtha' dag la// thengs pas chog pa'i lag len 'khel [ khel] mchog ma// ra mo she [ shel] lugs mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin//dang po rang phyogs me drod gso ba dang // gnyis pa gzhan phyogs grang chur bsgyur ba sogs// 'di ni gnad 'gags shes dgos nyams myong yin//bcos tshul lnga ldan rgyud gzhung ma 'gal bar// rang lugs dpyad bcos rdzing 'or sbyong ba'i sman// rgyud du chu bshal lnga dang chu sbyongs gnyis// gsungs kyang lag len 'khyor bde'i chu bshal bshad// dur byid rgyal po yin pas thun
tshad lnga// zangs dreg dang [dong]ga 'bu skyogs chu ma tsi// sdig srin sngon bu khron bu nyi dga'i 'bru// byang pa a ru mchu snyung srad dkar rnams// thun re ba chu'i khaṇ+ḍas ril bu dril// gnyis gsum 'khrus nas zhal shes lcag gis bskul//sre long brda' tsam thug pas rlung kha mnan// dag na yang zhing 'ju sla lus zungs gso// zungs bzang nad lhag lus na sbyang ba bskyar//li shi'i 'phrul bshag gnad kyi gdams pa ni// ba mdzo gang rung dar ba bre gsum la// gsum gnyis gdus pa'i dwangs ma bre gang tshe// li shi bum can bzang nges srang gang la// lab son zho lnga zhib btags zhag gcig bsnyal//zhag po gsum mam lnga bdun bsten pa na// them bral rdza ma'i chu ltar 'dren nus so//yang cig chu nad gzhi 'dzin 'ol bsgyur sogs// gnad 'gag ma log gzu bor gnas byas nas// nad pa gom pa mang tsam snga dgong bcag / de yi skang nad chu ser 'bras nyams byed// 'di yi skabs su la phug 'phrul bshag zhes// la phug phyi dreg 'bud ['phud] la rtsa ba dor// zhib par brdar la gtsang ma'i ras la btsags// lbu snyigs lhad phud dwangs bsgyur dkar tshad gang // gsang sman khrag skem dar gan zla nang btus// chab 'dren gzhon nu zla btus gong ge phyed// rtsa lam snyen byed ku su ma dang mi// 'ju byed tshwa rnying phran tsam bsnan byas la// la phug khu bar btab ste zhag gcig bsnyal//dbyar dus mi rul dgun dus mi 'khyags pa'i// 'bam gyi sman dkar gtong dang khyad med pas// lag len mthong brgyud gnad 'gags ma 'khrul na//la phug 'phrul bshal mthong ba don ldan 'di// rnam dpyod gnad zab sngon chad yi ger med// gnad 'gag shes pas nyams su longs dang kyai// bslu ba med pa'i gtam 'di kho na'o// rkang pa'i skrangs che sbang gar bag phye byugs//pus mo man chad byugs la deb btang bcings// zhes pa'ang 'di skabs so//
brgyad pa/ lus stod dbang po gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed /mgo mig kha dang rna ba sna lce so// don snod lpags dang chu ser la sogs pa// gsang nad thor bu'i nad rigs rnam grangs bstan// dreg grum rkang 'bam reg dug la sogs pa// spyod lam rnam bzhi'i nad rtags rgyu rkyen sogs// gsham du gsal ba yod do yid la zungs//mgo nad la/ mgo thang gsum steng g.ya' kyi a byag dang // 'dzin pa bsnan pas mgo bo'i tshad nad ni// gzhogs phyed ya ma 'khyug cing gzer ba 'joms// nad tshabs che na de steng gu gul dang // dom mkhris bong dkar gangs thigs khur rtsa dang // 'khun pa dros 'debs rdo dreg sbyar ba yis//mgo nad khrag mkhris ya ma'i nad rigs kun// klad gzer rgyas pa yar la gtod par byed// tshig thub gla ba gu gul stag sha ba// shu dag byi tang 'dzin partsa ru ma// e dros [kros] rta byas ril bu bra ril tsam// lnga bdun dgu sogs lus zungs 'ju stobs dpags// gnyan srin kun 'joms khyad par skrangs pa'i nad// sman gtong gnyid log dus na rnag tu khug / mgo chags [chag] gsang ba sman sbyor ni// srid pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis//sbal rgyab pho mo gangs thig [thigs]ser// pa ti pa ma ti la ka / kuṇ+ḍa ni la gsang ba'i sman// klad skyon che na nya phyis dang // dom mkhris ghi wang gur gum sbyar// phye ril gang 'os dus bzhi ru// chang gis 'phul bas mgo chag dang //rtsa byer yan lag chag grum sogs// zla phyed tshun la gsos par nges// zab
gnad la mo'i lugs gcig yin// nyi zla glang g.yag rtse rgod 'dre gsod thigs// ri dwags stag can dgu yi sbyor ba 'dis// don snod nang gi thig bsrungs rtsa kha sdom// kha lkugs pa yang 'byed pa yin//mig nad la/ mig nad skyer pa'i bar shun bsdus pa'i stong// gsher tshag ga bur dom mkhris 'bigs byed nag / ma gi'i kha tshar btab pa'i khaṇ+ḍa bsten//skam tshag spang mthing rgyam tsha ni ngam li// li shi dom mkhris gla tsi btab pa yis//khaṇ+ḍa tshul bzhin byas pa chur sbyangs bsten// thun mongs [mong] skam tshags [tshag]nad rigs dang // sha ro sha mdzer ling tog la sogs sel// nad rnams kun 'joms rdo rje dang // rlung khrag 'thabs pa'i mdze can dri// rtsa tshad sel ba'i me tog dmar// khrag tshad sel ba'i bsil sbyor sngo// gdon nad 'joms pa'i 'dre 'jig chu// gnyan nad 'jo mas pa'i ma gi ta// khyad par sman mchog drug po 'dis// steng rlung 'khrugs byed gdon rnams dang //spung tog sha mdzer na ba dang // ya ma dkar nag khra gsum 'joms// khu tshur 'bum gyi yang snying yin// btsod dang rgya skyegs rnam pa gnyis// gur gum dang ni dom mkhris gnyis// tsha la btul ma byang bul gnyis// a ru gla ñtsa rnam pa brgyad// zhib par btags la dar dmar gtums// li phor nang du chu gtsang sbyar// zhag gsum sbangs la mig tu gtig / rgyal mo chu 'byed ces kyang bya// long ba rgyun gcod ces kyang bya// gdams pa 'di dang ma bral na//thur mas 'byed ni mi dgos so// mig nad sro ma mun sel zhes bya ba// skyer khaṇa shel gyi gur khang dang // ma gi ta yi dris bsgyur ba'i// bud med nu zhos bran byas na// mig gi 'grib dang mig gi 'bu// sha mdzer rab rib la sogs pa// mig nad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi// gnyen po 'di 'dra gzhan na med// nga la yid ches rnyed pa yis// slob ma kun gyi sems la zhog / yon tan mgon po'i nyam thag bcos//
kha nad la/ nag tshur seng phrom a ru'i grang thang gi/ mkhur bkang bsten pas kha dang rnyil gyi nad// sel bar byed pa dpal ldan rgyud las gsungs//dzā ti rdog gcig snying zho gsum gyi rtsis// go yu bzhi la gser mdog rdog po gcig / khyi la wa ri cung zad bsnan pa yis// rnyil gyi nad gso so rtsi'i gdams pa mchog / 'di yang nye bar grub pa ngo mtshar che// so la srin shor dpal ldan rgyud don las// zi ra bca' sga shing kun byi tang ka / rgya tsha sbrang sbyar ril bu so stong bzhag / srin 'joms yun bsten so yi bcud len mchog / gsungs pa'i rnam dpyod 'di yang khyad par 'phags//sna nad sel ba/ sna na shu ba skyes pa la// ti tsha mar dkar sbyar ba byugs// sna bug nang 'gag sbyong ba la// 'gron bu bsreg thal byang pa dang // rgya tsha dri chur sbyar bas sbyong // khrag 'chor ba tig til tsam zhugs// 'khan skya tshos khur dom mkhris btab// khong btang ro stod chu yis bsgrang // bal rtsim [tshil]can gyis bcad par bya// gnya' yi mgo ro khrag gcod ni// brag skyes mtshe ma'i [yi] khaṇ+ḍa dang // tshos kyi khaṇ+ḍa so sor bsdu// dom mkhris gur gum na [nā]ga chung // shing tsha shing mngar 'bri ta gdab// tshe [mtshe]yi khaṇ+ḍa sum gnyis la// tshos kyi khaṇ+ḍa sum cha gcig / gzhan ma drug po drug cha re// ril bu lung thang tshad tsam dril// gcig gnyis gsum sogs nad tshabs bstun//smug pos bskyed na lcags khus phul// gzhan rnams gangs chu grang mos phul//'di ni khrag zags ma chod pa'i// rigs gang yin yang kun nas sdoms//khyad par gyen thur mtsho rdol dang // bu gar khrag 'dzag zla mtshan 'byams//rtsa chad rtsa kha ral dang bye// mdor na mtshon gyis bsnud pa'i rma// mgo bo gcod [bcad]kyang khrag mi 'chor// sna khrag smin mtshams dbyug bcos bya//ghi wang gur gum ut+pal ba le ka / tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka / gser gyi me tog ka ra ghi wang dgu / de yi steng du 'u su pri yang ku / skyu ru ma nu glang chen
bcu gsum steng // gyen thur gnyis nas [kur]smug po'i mtsho rdol nas// zla re zla gnyis khrag ni ma chod cing // sman dpyad gzhan gyis gso bar ma nus na//chu grang gis 'phul sman thun lnga yis chog /rna ba'i nad sel ba/ sgra 'dzin rna ba'i dbang po'i nad zug la// ru rta a ru ra yi khu ba yis// rna ba'i rnag khrag zug gzer 'joms par byed// 'on na gla shing kha ru tsha// ru rta la phug lcag chos 'bru// rnag 'dzag dur rus [ru]shu bul rgya// ka ra sbyar blug ye'us 'bru// kun la yun 'das phan dka' na//'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar sbyar// bug pa'i phyi nang tshon re bsreg / yang na a ru ra yi thang // gzer na rlung yin 'ba' chas bdug / sgog skya btsos la blug par bya// 'on na gla shing kha ru tsha// ru rta ug chos la phug dang // rma bya'i mdangs rnams mar khus sbyar// blugs la sob sgra byung na 'bru// rnag 'jig dur byid ru rta dang // shu dag shul tog rgya tshos dgos// gla rtsi shing kun sman chen gsum// zhib par btags la snum dang sbyar// rnar blugs ya ma yul nas 'don// sman chen khram brdungs mar la sbyar// thig [thigs]pa gnyis gsum drod 'jam pa// rna ba'i nad la gtig gyur na// rna nad sel ba ngo mtshar che//lce nad la/lce skrangs kha khengs chu 'dzag cing // zas mi thar na khyung lnga bsten// lce skrangs rnag tu ma song na// kha lce gur gum ghi wang dang // cu gang thun re nya tsha dang // sbal sha shing kun lan tshwa klad// lce myang tsha rnams thun phyed tsam// ras sam dar gyi khud du bstum// lcer sbyar shing leb srab mos mnan// kha chu khong du ma song bya// rnag khugs rang brdol 'byung bar 'gyur//yun du bsten pa shin tu gces// gzhan yang khyad bcos 'di 'dra yod do ang // rgya tsha gsum 'gyur sgog gcig de yi phyed// gla tsi chab gcig btang ba'i ril bu ni// dar dmar gtums la lce skrangs thog tu bzhag / lce 'bam
gnyan gag ji ltar yin na'ang // ma lus kun sel khyad thogs lan tshwa zhes//lce skrangs lce chung spyi skra 'then// le btag khrag dbyung sel bar byed// gre 'gags bong nga shing mngar dang // spang rgyan bsdus khur cu par btab// a ru btso bsreg thang gis 'phul// yang na de steng ru rta dang // a ru li shi ru rta dang // gsang sman gnyis ldan a ru'i thang // btso bsreg byas pas dbul bar bya//mchu la bad gan chags pa na// a ru sge gsher thal ba ni// mar sbyar byug pas sel bar 'gyur// mchu la sho re mtha' dras dom mkhris byug / dar gyis brtsams la hel srab spyin chus sdoms// gad mo mi rgod bldad mi dgos pa za// sha za li yi sbyor ba bsten//
rnadgu pa/ glo rnag gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/ltar bu pa yag 'bri ta gsum gyis 'dren// rtsa ba'i sman la ma nu ru rta sdebs// cu gang a krong sro los glo tshad gcog / glo nad mchin mkhris rkyen blangs tshad pa ni// rgyun la song ba'i rtags ldan byung gyur na// pri yang tig ta kyi lce hong len bzhis// mchin tshad sel zhing glo rnag sngon 'gro yi// yar 'dren bcu gcig zab pa'i gnad gcig go /yang gcig glo rnag gso ba'i gdams pa la// glang chen chu 'thung lta bu'i 'dren sman gsum// ru rta dzā ti pha la pa yag pa// dzing khung 'gegs pa lta bu'i gcod sman gsum// 'bri ta sa 'dzin shu za dom mkhris gsum// me tog chu blugs lta bu'i gtso sman bdun// zi ra dkar po sro lo a krong dang // a ba shing mngar rgun 'brum cu gang bdun// rgya tshos sran ma'i me tog wa glo gsum//'di gsum glo rnag spyi yi gzer 'debs yin// yang na gtso brgyad bdun thang tshul bzhin sbyar// de steng star bu rgun 'brum li ga dur// shing mngar spang rgyan dkar po pa yag rtsa// a krong wa yi glo ba zi ra dkar// bdud tsi lo ma sbyar ba'i nyer lnga pas// tshad pa che chung glo dang rus la zhen// glo chen 'gogs dka' dbugs thung gyen mi 'pher// glo yis brgyal zhing 'tshangs nas dbugs sdud dka'// 'gul na glo skyugs byed cing nyal mi bde// lud pa mang du lu zhing nyabs tshul [sna mtshul]'gags// ro stod tsha khag [zhing]lci la brgyal zhing khengs// tshad gzer tsha subs glo ba khrag rgyas sogs// glo nad kun la sman 'di thengs pas chog /
bcu pa/ snying rlung gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/dzā ti dgung sngon yangs pa la// li shi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// sha pho ru rta'i glog phreng gis// mkha' klong mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms yang na gzhung gi ar brgyad steng // li shi sha chen ri bong tsit+ta bsnan// srog 'dzin bcu gcig pa zhes snying rlung dang // smyo 'bog sel ba sems kyi mchog / srog rlung gso ba sems kyi bde ba bskyed//
bcu gcig pa/ mchin nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/jighi wang dgu pa gzhung bzhin la// pri yang ku dang skyu ru ra// sle tres ko byil bzhi po bsnan// ngo bo mchin nad las skyes pa'i// stod tsha smad grang go ldog dang // dmu chu 'bam sogs gang 'gro med// dreg dang grum bu'i bla gnyan byed// srog 'phrog 'chi bdag nye ba la// ltas ngan g.yang du 'gug pa yi// sman mchog zab gnad kho bos mthong // mchin nad tsha ba'i sman sbyor rin po che// g.yu rnying mu tig byu ru mtshal dkar bzhi// tsan dan dkar dmar ba le ba sha bzhi// ghi wang ru rta ut+pal bong dkar bzhi// dzā ti li shi tig ta ba ru bzhi// cu gang gur gum ge sar bse ru bzhi// gla ñtsa sbyar ba'i g.yu rnying nyer lnga pa// chos sman sug smel bsnan pa'i nyer bdun pa// de nas gong gi sman rnams spyi bzhur gyi// khu bas 'dam btags legs par byas zin nas// gla ñtsa ril bu dril bar gdab par bya// mchin nad le brgan ldem bu dug 'thab dang // chu shor rkun bu 'or lhung kha lud dang // gzhung steng [rengs] mchin grum nag po hal skem dang // mchin dri dkar nag gnad mchin rtsa byer 'joms// ji
bcu gnyis pa/ mcher nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/sman la ka ko la dang cu gang dang // ba sha ka dang gur tig gser me tog / na [nā]ga ge sar a ru 'om bu dang // rgya skyegs ri tshos sug smel ru rta dang // bong dkar bre ga brag zhun 'jam 'bras dang // skyu ru spang spos zhib btags bskol grangs dbul// mtsher nad tsha grang med pa sel ba'i mchog /mi yi dbang po rnam rgyal grags bzang lugs// mtsher nad tsha ba rkyang pa tshig rgyud gas// gur gum ghi wang cu gang gtso bo la// gser gyi me tog li shi a ru ra// pi pi ling sdebs mtsher pa'i tsha ba sel// mtsher nad sel ba'i a ru bdun pas kyang // mtsher pa nad [ bsnad] 'grams tsha rgyas sbos gzer 'joms//
bcu gsum pa/ mkhal nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/0 dpal ldan rgyud gzhung a ru bcu pa'am// de steng rtsa lnga 'bras bu drug dang ni// bre ga go yu gla rtsis mkhal nad kun// grang ba'i nad chu dang ser grang grum ni// sked 'khor ma lus sel ba'i gdams pa 'di// 'ba' sam lha yi lung du bstan pa yin// a ru bcu steng dom mkhris dang // ghi wang gser bye ba sha ka / yung skyer skyu ru gze ma sbyar// khrag ngan thig le 'dzag pa dang //mchin khrag 'or du lhungs pa dang // rlung mkhris bad gan 'dus gsum gyi//za khu gcod par byed pa yin// yang gcig a ru bcu pa'i steng // 'bras sna gsum dang gser bye ka ka ru// a tsha [ dzha] ka dang gla rtsi sman chen rnams//sbyar bas a ru bco brgyad pa zhes grags// phan yon mkhal rtsa 'grams byer dang // tsha babs grang ba smad byer dang // khrag tshabs skyed pa 'khor ba dang //smug po mkhal mar babs pa dang // chu ser grum bu'i nad rnams kun// sel snyed 'di ni drang srong lugs//mkhal ma'i nad la go yu dgu sbyor bshad// gtso bo mkhal ma go yu bzang po gcig / zho sha brag zhun gla tsi 'bras sna gsum// sug smel bre ga nub mkhal re bu ram sbyar// mkhal ma'i nad sel nyams stobs rgyas byed la// tsha ba'i stobs ldan gur gum shug tsher bsnan// ka ra sbyar phye tshos gsum thang gis dbul// zla ba'i stobs ldan duḥ kha'i tsha gdung rnams// bsil dang bde ba skyed pa'i dpal 'byor thob// grang ba'i nyen can duḥ khar gyur pa na// tsha gsum tsha [ tshwa] sna gsum dang bur dkar sbyar// a rag gar chang 'phul
btang nyi ma yi// dkyil 'khor rgya sa pas me drod bskyed pa ltar// zungs bdun dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dga' ba thob//ro rkyang las babs byang sems dkar dmar gnyis// nyes gsum duḥ khas thur du phab pa na// nyi zla rgyan du bzlog pa'i gdams pa bshad// ba sha tig ta hong len dkar bong tsan dmar khrag 'khrugs sel// se 'bru sug smel smad kyi grang ba sel// gur gum dom mkhris yung bas rtsa kha sdoms// rgya shug zlosno k+ti m+p+raṃ dri lha lham hā byi(ma// [snashā parnyi]gaXr daXpa// ga~X ༵༵༵ dzom t+t+waṃ ༵༵ dbul// phan yon zab khyad lag tu long dang gsal//gsang nad sel ba/ gsang nad pho mtshan skrangs la khyung lnga yi// tshad ldan steng /snye snye| t+t+waṃ //| ste///|| pyā wa // / wa /pyā/ || nye// | yung skyer bre ga dang // gze ma sbrang sbyar gar chang 'phul la btang // chu kha sra bar the tshom med do kye //
bcu bzhi pa/ pags nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/spos dkar bco lnga zhes bya'i sbyor ba la// spos dkar bcu steng gtum po a ru ra// kha g.yer can dang shug tsher stag sha ba// gar+bha ra dang shu dag gu gul rnams// rtsi bzhin btags la bskol grangs pa gas dbul// chu ser ko ler babs pa dang // tsha 'brab tsha 'khyug tsha khrig sel// khyad par chu ser nag po'i rigs// ma lus yul 'byin 'og gdon dang // dreg grum rkang 'bam nad la bsngags//chu ser pags la gram pa'i nad// za 'phrug gso ba'i gdams pa ni//mu zi btul ma zho drug la// a ru gser mdog zho gang sdebs// bong nga nag po tshwa 'debs tsam// chu ser sman gsum thun bzang re// zhib btags chang gis 'dam btags bya// gsum par yar chang gis 'phul btang // nang gi chu ser phyir 'phul nas// thor phran gsar pa mang du byung // de dus phyi nas byugs pa ni// mar du mu zi spos dkar bskol// ngad yal btsan dug thar nu dang // tsha ba gsum dang mu zi ser// lus bkrus byugs pas 'phral du sel//
bco lnga pa/ dreg nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/dreg nad rgyu rkyen gnas dbye rtags bcos lnga// rgyu rkyen khrag 'khrugs byer ba'i zas spyod brten [bsten]/ / nyin par gnyid log skyid par 'dug pa dang // drag shul rkyen gyis rlung khrag 'khrugs las 'byung // gnas sa gsar dus pags pa khrag la gnas// phal cher rkang pa'i mthe bong gtsor smos te// mthil sogs long tshigs man dang lag pa yi// gru mor gnas la rim pas mched pa de// tha ma rnying nas rtsa chu rus tshig [tshigs] khyab// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun bzhi//de rtags mngon tshul brla sked tshig [tshigs]rnams na// g.ya' 'gul chag snyam tshor med lci ba ste// yang yang ldang zhing slar lci 'gyur ba yin//skrangs shing dmar la drod che sra la srab// shin tu na zhing zug che skad ngan 'chor// khyad par rlung gyur gzer 'phrig 'phel 'grib byed// mkhris gyur drod che dmar la reg mi bzod// khrag gyur tsha 'brab mdog dmar 'brul bar byed// bad kun las gyur g.ya' lci tshor ba med//de yi bcos thabs spyir bsdus 'di ltar ro// dang po sle tres 'bras bu gsum gyi thog / brag zhun bcas pa'i lnga thang lan 'ga' btang // phyi la sran phye'am skyo ma byug pa [par]bya// de nas khong du gnyan 'joms khyung lnga dang //spos khyung la sogs srod dus bsten pa dang // gu gul bcu par sle tres bongs cher bskyed// ltag pa sprad pas nad 'di gdong lhogs 'gro// des kyang ma zhi tsan dan dkar dmar dang // ghi wang bzang drug chu ser sman gsum dang //—
ge sar rnam gnyis tig ta sle tros thog / spyi bzhur 'bras bu gsum dang gla rtsi dang // spang rgyan be do ba sha ka dang ni// bong khrag ka ra sbyar bas nyi shu lnga//dgung gnyis seng ldeng khu bas 'phul la btang // skabs su se 'bru lnga pa bsten pa yis// dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser rang sar skems// dreg nad ma lus 'joms pa mkhas pa'i lugs// byugs sman bhi ṣa shu gla chu thar dur//zhib btags dmar zal ba chur sbyar te byugs// srad nag zhib brdungs ba gcin sbyar lums sam// yang na sle tres ba gcin shu dag lums// yang yang gsor bdug zug gzer 'phral du gcog / yang cig dreg nad sngags bcos la// om phal po pha la sod/ pha la po ma sod/ kon kra byin kra sod/ ti tshe ta tshe sod/ ze mo na tre sod/ rda u nan bham sod/ sngags mkhan lha yi nga rgyal dang // ldan pas brgya rtsa bzlas byas la// mgo la byung na yar phus btab//rkang par byung na mar phus btab// yang / nag po rbad thu na ya rbad/ thu ma ril rbad/ ma hā pañtsar rbad/ he thum he thum rbad/ na ga na ga rbad/ ces pa mang du bzlas la btab/
bcu drug pa/ grum bu'i nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/grum nad rgyu rkyen dbye ba brtag bcos bzhi// de yang tshad pa'i nad rigs gang yang rung // bcud shor nyin gnyid gtar sngas drag shul gyis//tsha ba byer zhing phal cher smad du lhungs// chu ser bsdongs zlar bcas pa tshigs la zhen// sha rus rtsa rus la khyab grum bur 'gyur//dbye ba sha trem rus trem rtsa trem dang // chu trem trem dkar trem nag drug gsungs kyang // mdor bsdus grum bu dkar nag gnyis su 'du//rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi rtags grang shum yun ring sha lpags brtse// gdong snum mgo bo rked pa spyi [dpyi]mig zug / shed chung sgyid skyur sha dros rngul kha snyi// rus tshigs sha rus khol zhing chu rgyus gyong //'gul tshe lhag par na zhing skad ngan 'chor// chu dmar rtsa 'khyug khrag mgyogs gting na rgyug / dgye dgu mi shes khyad par mtshan mo thu// nyin gnyid mi thub mtshan mo bya ltar yer// bye brag grum dkar zug chung rtsa chu grang // grum nag zug che mdog nag rtsa chu tsha// g.yo skam sna khrag 'dzag cing snying mi dga'//nad 'di sngo la zhugs na skya la thon// skya la zhugs na sngo la thon pa tsam// na ma thag nas sle tres 'bras bu gsum// stab seng sha ru'i thang btang byer mi srid//nad 'di lam nas ldog pa srid pa rtsam// gal te gdong ma lhogs kyang bcos pa sla// 'bras gsum sle tres tig ta song ldeng khaṇa// chu ser sman gsum ma 'khrugs mgrin bzang mtshal// zhib par btags pa'i phye mas grum bu sel//a ru bcu steng sle tres bong khrag bsnan// grum bus mkhal sked zug la bdud
ñtsa 'dra// sbyor ba zung 'di mkhas pa'i zur brgyan no// se 'bru lnga steng chu ser sman gsum dang // bong khrag bsnan pa nang nub chu skol dbul// pho ba'i me drod bskyed cing grum bu sel// sle tros bong mtshal sbyar ba tshigs la 'jug /rjes rmar [ mar] dres thag sug pa nus ldan bsreg / btab pas ske mas po 'di yang zab pa'i gnad// zas spyod tshwa dang rul sungs dkar dang dmar//gsar dang rnying po sha dang de bzhin dmar// snum zhing lci ba'i rigs dang drod bcud chang // me nyi nyin mo'i gnyid dang rlan grang spangs// mdor na nas dkar rtsam pa ma sungs pa'i// zan dang thug pa las gzhan btang mi bya//ga bur nyer lnga grum gzhug rnyings tshad sel// a ru bcu dang bsres na 'di la bzang // grum bu zug gcog bya ba brang ti'i lugs//
bcu bdun pa/ rkang 'bam gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/mthong bcos myong grub 'bam gyi zin bris bkod// rgyu rkyen dbye ba brtag dang bcos thabs bzhi// rgyu ni chu ser dkar nag khra bo gsum//dwangs ma ma zhu log las chu ser 'byung // yan lag bzhi lnga phal cher rkang par 'bab// rkyen gyis bslab pa dam tshig nyams pa dang // mna' zos dug sbyor las dang rlan yul bsdad// sa brko rdo slog shing gnyan bcad pa dang //btsan bdud khros dang bad gan la bstan [ bsten] pa'i// brten med glo 'bam zhes bya 'byung //dbye ba dkar po nag po khra bo gsum// re re la'ang dkar nag gsum gsum bshad// lpags babs bad smug tsha ba babs par 'dod// bad gan skya bo yin pa dang // sha la babs na bad kun dkar po'o// rus babs bad smug tsha ba babs par 'dod//de la sngon tshul nad kyi brtag pa ni// stod 'tshangs lan 'ga' 'byung ba'am// lus kyi drod nyams ba spu bye zhing gzengs// reg bya grang zhing nyag la rtsa ni dal// de'i rtags dkar po rlung las gyur pa'i rtags// mgo lci phrum ser khyer la ba spu ldog / rtsa dal chu sngo drod dang zug gzer chung // mdog dkar skrangs po gsob cing mtheb rjes len// nag po khrag mkhris las gyur rtsa ni grims// chu ni btsod khu mtshal zhabs du kha'i mdog / yang na smug nag tsha log tsha stobs che// bol gong pir mgo sgyid khung la sogs skrangs// skrangs mdog dmar nag mthug che mkhregs pa la// 'brum thor mang zhing chu bur smug
tshonag 'byung // yun ring lon na rma 'byung rus myag 'gro// rtags gnyis 'dres pa khra bo'i sha mdog de//0 zhug pa'i sgro 'dra me lce ris su 'byung // de rnams dkar nag khrag bo'i brtags pa yin// nyes pas dbye na phyi ma bad kun 'dod// babs sa gnas dang sbyar te brtag pa ni// sha dang rus kyi treb can skrangs// rtsa dang chu rgyus la babs brkyang bskum dka'// skam zug che dang rus babs skrangs mdog nag / tshabs che yun lon rnyil mdog sngo skya rul// khrag 'dzag rnag dri kha zhing sna shu 'byung // gting nas gzer zhing dran pa mi zin dang // rkang la zin pa mi 'tsho pho nya yin// de bzhin snying la zin pa'i rtags ldan dang // nag po'i rigs gcig rkang pa btsan thabs su// kha dog smug sogs chu sgang thol thol 'ong // zug gzer che rnams bdun nam dgu mi 'da'// lto ba [ bar] zin na mi gtub [ btub] pho nya yin// de rnams gso ba mi brtsams tshogs gsog bskul// nad rtags ma longs gso ba the tshom na// sngon 'gro ba dmar chu yis sku khrus gsol// gar babs gnas der rang rtags gsal ba ni// dmar thig ri mo sha mdog log / 'gyur nas 'bam nad mi 'gyur rtags su bzung //gong gi pho nya'i ltas kyis ma zin na// bcos thabs dkar chog rim gro 'bad pa dang // gdon rtags ldan na yas glud gtor ma'i rigs// khyad par klu gdon dag la mngags pa gces// de nas gnyen po zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi// zas ni nas rnying rtsam pa g.yos byas dang // skom du phye thug tsha rdor [tshwa sdor]med pa la// dmar zal ba yi mar gsar dri med btab// ja 'jam 'o rdor [sdor]tshwa med bsten pa dang // gnyan mgo chog nas dang khrid ba zho dang // rlung shas che na sre long sog yu'i thug / spyod lam me nyi drag shul nyin gnyid dang // 'gro 'ong nyal po rta zhon them skas 'dzeg / 'bab sogs 'khrugs pa'i spyod lam spang bar bya// bsil ba'i gnas su lus sems dal
bar bsdad// ma 'khrugs dal bus brkyang bskum byed du 'jug / rtsa chu'i tsha ba chog nas dal bar bcag / sman gyis bcos pa khong sman byug sman las//skabs 'dir bsdu sman babs sman la sogs pa'i// blun tshig kha shas lag len bcos nyes rgyu// zob zob ngang la ldog pa dang // bde ba zin zhing mi 'tsho pho nya ba// thig nag 'bam nag 'dzam [ 'dzom] pa'i bla gnyan gyis// sems 'gyod skyes kyang phyis la ldog pa dka'// sman ni dang po sle tres skyu ru'i thang //tshar gsum btang na khrag gi shed dmad cing // cung zad 'khums nyams byung yang nges par bsten// de nas gnyan gyi ngar gsod 'bam rigs la// gtso bo sman chen bzang po zho drug dang // gser mdog rus pa dor ba zho bco brgyad// ru rta lhad med zho dgu shu dag ni// zho drug skar lnga gla rtsi skar ma lnga//k+ti wang gur gum lhad med skar ma do// gu gul zho do lo brgyad bdud rtsir sbyar//'dam btags nyin gsum byas pa kha dog ni// nag po lcags mdog mthing nag bra ril tsam// bdun dgu bcu gcig lus zungs na tshod dpag / sman nad thengs gsum thon nges ga tong ba yis// gnyan mgo chog rtags rtsa dal grangs nyung zhing // chu mdog ser la lbu ba cher [chil]gyis 'ong // zug dang skrangs po'i gnya' yang cung zad chog / 'di dus lab bcos gsang sman bsten pa gnad// 'on kyang dang po zhag gcig thang gi dus// bar du zhag gsum 'bam chung bsten pa dang // de nas rtags dang sman gyi 'gro tshod sbyar//la phug 'di nyid 'dzam gling las can gyi// bsod nams dag las 'byung ba'i lo rgyus ni// rgyas pa tshogs bdag glang snar gnyer kha gtad// pho mo gnyis las pho rigs la phug de// rtsa ba dung gi cha dang 'dra ba yod// 'bam nad chu ser byung na nga bos zer// mo rigs 'char pa'i nyung ma kha smug de// dug nad skyi byung nga yang bos so zer// de gnyis sangs rgyas drung du khas blangs mthus//skabs 'dir la phug rul skyon med pa dgos// la phug phyi dreg 'bud
['phud] la rtsa ba dor// zhib par brdar la gtsang ma'i ras la btsags//‘ dkar tshad gong las nyung ba med pa la// lbu snyigs tshar gsum legs su phud pa dang // dwangs bsgyur legs bsags bal khu snyigs ma kyang // shin tu mi hūm̐ gtong lbu snyigs gras su phud// dwangs bsgyur ldan par khrag sman gzhon zla gnyis btu nu de// rtsa lor bcas pa grib skam cha bcu la// chab 'dren gzhon nu de yi zu gsum tsha [cha]gnyis// rgyam tsha ku su ma ni cha re re// klu bdud rdo rje'i dri tsam tshobasnan byas pa// lab khur btab pa legs dkrugs zhag po gcig / bsnyal 1 bar bye rlon dkyil du kha khebs ni// dbya ra dus mi rul dgun dus mi 'khyag /pasnrosna //rtogasprab parjosnam sbyangasdo sna zuXsurdzu gaXn baXg bste/ dpa rtsisang ba//sgyudzo n+d+ra lhalha rigacig bsnyal la bzhag / nangs par tsha ting kha ru slebs pa'i dus// gong gi /gsang sman ma 'khrugs 'di shor na pho ba na bas nyes skyon che nges yod pas zab gting risnyigs bzhag / dwangs ma gang byung bdud rtsir mos la btung // ma rngul gos /sbyo ༈ r+sha (sna lha( /snapa ga/ spyan snang ba dzor+shab du shārnyinā tsha) spyan re ba/shā/ /kyi swāhānā ) dang bstun la sbyar bas 'grub// skabs su se 'bru lnga pas me drod bzung //rinab mo gnyan 'joms dag kyang rung bar bshad// glang chen bcu gsum ltas ringan g.yang 'gugs sogs// nad 'di bad gan khrag ngan gzhis bskyed pa'i//ri skabs su mkho bar byed pa gnad 'gags yin// stod du log dogs ko byi ribadun pa yang // cung zad bsnan na khyad par 'phags pa'o// gong gi la phug ཿ lbu ba sman snyigs la// chu rtsa rgya skyegs zhu mkhan bul tog dang // sga tig nag kepo sbyar la skrangs pas [sar]byug / 'bam rigs kun la gong gi gsang sman dang // byug sman 'di nyid bsten pa'i phan skyed ni// lcags phye khab len ltar 4du mtshungs pa yod// byug sman spyi 'joms rgyas pa'i sbyor ba la// sbal rgyab
mdung rtse ldong ros cong zhi dang // dri ldan byi mgo rdo rgyus rnam pa gsum// gru bzhi rtsag yug [btsag yugs]rdo sman gang 'dzoms dang // brag btsan shu re chu spru ming can nag / phab dur lug ngal sngo dang kyi lce ba// lcags thar stag sha nag po btsod mdud rnams// zhib btags dmar zal ba chu'i rta la bskyon// byugs pas gnyan nad 'bras rigs kun 'joms shing // grang khrag stod nad smad lhungs 'bam rigs la// phan yon che zhing rgyud lung la bsten pa'i// nyams myong gdengs ldan zin bris bkod pa 'di// 'gro kun phan bde 'byung ba'i dge legs stsol// rkang 'bam nad 'di rgyu rkyen rnam grangs kyis// mang por gsungs pa'i phyag len sna tshogs dang // spyi nad ngos bzung dka' la ltar snang 'khrul// da yod da med nad kyi 'tsho ba la// bcos thabs bdud rtsi bum bzang la sogs dang // mi dgu'i phyag bzhengs ngo nor ma 'khrul thog / rang gi cung zad nyams myong thogs pa yi// drang srong dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bka' mched las// sman dang byugs sman 'di las ma dgos par// dgos med dpyad sogs ring pa'i pha mthar 'khyams// de bas drang srong khyad ldan zhal gdams dang // rang gi thos bsam nyams myong goms 'dris sogs// gnad la khel la shes ldan sems la chongs//
bco brgyad pa/ reg dug bcos thabs dran pa'i gsal byed/0lugs 'di bal po paṇ+ḍi rdo sgom la// sman mo mkha' 'gros bka' rgyas tsheg brgyud bstsal// yi ger mi 'bri gsang sgo byed dgos thos// bdag gis kun la phan phyir lhag bsam dang // nyams myong goms 'dris gdeng yang cung zad thob// des na bu slob nad pa'i skyed chen du// reg dug nad gzhi tsha grang ji ltar yang // sman ni ri bsi kyangs su ra zho gang // srog gi snying po bcu drug gnyis// ma ru rtse ni nyi shu gcig / rtse mo'i grang ldan zhib btags phye// shing bcud gsum pa chu bcad pa'i// tang mnyam rta byas ril bu ni// sran sbos tsam dril tho rengs su// re re zhag bdun gtong bar bya// de bar zas ni ja thug gang la'ang // tshwa bul spangs shing zhag can chang mi 'thung // nyal po ma spyod spyod lam de ldan na// myur du gso ba'i gdams pa gzhan na med// kun gyis shes na mkhas pa su yis byed// 'di 'dra zab gnad gsang chen bla na med// lugs 'di'i byug sman 'di ltar byed pa la// snying zho go yu thal tshan bsregs pa dang // khyi la wa ri dkar shas che ba de// po sor zho gsum dag las mi nyung bar// ra 'o phul gang tsam la med pa gtims// de nyid skam dus zhib btags phye ma la// ba ru la phug brag zhun de'i phyed tsha[cha]/ / mi thod zho gang rgya mtshal skar ma lnga// sam thal pha la rdog gnyis dzā ti yi// dri thon btang na chog cing rma rlon la// skam 'debs rma skam chu gtsang sbyar byugs pas// ji lta bu yi rma shul ma lus kun// sel byed 'a di bas lhag pa mthong ma
myong // dngul chu la sogs skyon dogs g.ya' med kyang // sman 'di khong nas kha la shin tu rgyug / nad rlangs phyi ru thon phyir kha rlangs 'don// ja thang gis ni kha so bkru bar bya// go yu snying zho ba ru ra gsum po// go rims bzhin gyi mang nyung yod pa la// dzā ti bsnan bungs che tsam bsnan pas kha nang skams 'debs bya// dbang med chu skye kha chu phyi la 'dor// zhag bdun song nas reg dug nad gzhi ni// ming gi lhag ma tsam yang lus mi srid// de phyir 'di la brten [bsten]pas mkhas par 'gyur// yang na gong gi byug sman de steng la// ku ku ra dza zhes bya kha dog nag / rgas gzhin ma ltos gnad dang mtshon phog sogs//ma yin dus shi'i leb rgan ma rul ba// ma sungs thal tshan dros kyis zhag rnams ni// legs par bsten nas ma ki ta yi dri// thon tsam grogs dang sdebs pa'i bsnan byas na// khong sman la sogs gtong yang mi dgos pa'i//gsang ba'i gdams pa yi ger btab pa la// sman mo bka' dang brgyud lung ma 'gal bar// gzhan phan rgya che'i 'gro don spyod par shog /
bcu dgu ba/ skad 'gags gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/bcos thabs 'bras gsum tshar bong spang rgyan dkar// g.yer 'bru sogs [sog] ma dkar me'i tshig [tshig] thang btang // cu gang li shi ltar bu brag zhu na tig / shing mngar a ru sro lo rgun 'brum dang // skyu ru ba sha ka dang spang rgyan dkar// bzhi sbyor khrag la bcod [btsod ]mdud bad kun la// pi ling smug por ma nu 'khrugs hong len// mkhris par bong dkar rlung la sle tres te// chu ser spos dkar 'du ba'i shas sbyar la// rlung la myos khu khrag mkhris gangs kyi chu// bad kun sbrang chu la sogs bshad na'ang // kun la chu khol phul ba nyes pa med// gre ba skad 'gags nad sel spyi sman yin//tshangs dbyangs skad kyi gdams pa bshad pa la// dgos pa sman dpyad zas spyod lnga yis bstan// dang po dgos pa'i don ni 'di lta ste// dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi lus can// lha chos pa la 'gro rnams grol byed pa'i//dam pa'i chos rgyun lung dang smin byed dbang // grol byed khrid sogs mchog dman kun 'bel dang // dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus su tshogs bshad rigs// mi chos pa la sgrung dang gtam smra dang // khyad par thun mong zung du 'jug pa'i las// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro mchod pa'i dbyangs// mang po'i tshogs dbus 'bel gtam bya bas mtshon// gang la'ang che dang 'gyur khugs ldan pa sogs// ngag gi yon tan ldan pa skad 'di gnad// 'di la lus kyi tsha grang ldan 'dus sogs// chas kyi che chung btang la snyoms dgos pas// khrag mkhris can yin chur gzhug g.ya' kyi'i thang // bad rlung sbrang rtsi cong zhi'i
khrol bu bsten// de rjes grang nad med la g.yer ma dang // sog tshig [tshigs]skyu ru gsum thang lan 'ga' bsten// de nas ghi wang cu gur li sug dang //shing mngar sre long gser mdog cong zhi dang // ru rta star bu spang rgyan dkar po rnams// ka ra dang sbyar 'dzam gling 'brug grags zhes// zur sman chen po dharma swa ma'i [mi'i]lung // yang na skad sman 'brug sgra zil gnon zhes// 'du snyoms rtsa kha 'byed pa'i thang btang rjes// ngo bo spang rgyan dkar po gsum 'gyur la// a ru cha gnyis gur gum ghi cu gang // sro lo rgun 'brum shing mngar tig ta dang // se 'bru a krong cha mnyam gsang ba'i sman// zhib btags ka ra dkar po'i rta la bskyon// star bu'i chu yi 'bras bu lug thang tsam// re gza' phur bu dar dus sbyor ril bya// zla ba'i mar ngo nas bzung zla gcig bston// che snyan 'gyur khug grogs dang sdebs nas sbyangs// de ldog grong dang dbyangs glu len pa spangs// de yis mchod 'os mnyes shing mkha' 'gro 'du// dam can khul zhing dgra dang bgegs rnams thul// snying dang 'gyur ba'i sgra dbyangs thos ma thag / dbyangs snyan rta dbyangs sgra snyan zol la brten// sa gsum g.yo zhing ber ba 'brug gi sgra// zil gnon skad la skrag nas mes po yang // chu gter gdong gi blta zhing srid rtser bros//
nyi shu ba/ brugs bu gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/skyigs bu zas spyod gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs// gyen rgyu'i bu ga 'gags las byung bar gsungs// dbye ba zas 'byung phran tshegs zungs 'byung dang // chen zab mo zhes rnam pa lnga ru bshad//de rtags zas byung ring [rings]thabs zos rjes 'byung // phran tshegs zas zos rjes 'byung mod la chad// zung 'byung tshig [tshigs] ring zhu dus nyis bstud 'byung // chen po shugs drag mig har tshig mi thon// zab mo lte ba'i 'og nas bstud 'byung sangs[ga sang]/ / nyam chung zungs zad glo rdol rgas pa la// skyigs bu chen po shugs drag 'byung ba spangs//bcos thabs dang po 'bru mar bsku mnye bya// yang na chu grang hub gsum btung ba'i rjes// nya rus rnying pa'i dud pa bdug la sel// shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa ngag la nyan// nad tshabs che la skyugs 'khrus 'jam pos sbyangs//dbugs mi bde bar bshad du rngub par bya// zhes pa g.yu thog dgongs pa a ga ru// gu gul dkar nag gnyis dang byi tang ga / gla sgang spang spos rdo dreg gla tsi dang // shing tsha ru rta rgya spos spra tshil rnams// du ba bral ba'i me la bsreg pa'am// yang na spos dkar ldong ros mar sbyar ram// yang na a gar mar sbyar dag la gsung // nu zho tsan dan sbrang rtsi'i sna sman btang // gcig bgrangs dbugs thub bsdams pas rlung 'khyims sel// ma tshor 'jigs skrag dngangs pa'i cho ga bya// cha [chad] dka' spyi gtsug mtshogs sgo ske stong dang // tshigs pa brgyad dang nang long 'phar rtsa bsregs// zas spyod rlung gi dus bzhin shes par bya//
nyer gcig pa/ mes tshig rma gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/ri [ ra] ril nus bsregs mar nag sbangs pa yang // mes tshig tsha 'brab 'phral du bcog [gcog] par byed// sbang glum btsir ba mar nag btab la bskol// byugs pas mes tshig rma rgan 'phral du gso// bul tog dud pa bya bal mar bskus nas// nyi mar bsregs pas tshabs chung nyin gcig dang // che yang nyin gsum tshun la drag ces thos// bul tog chu la sngags 'di lhapa (rgya bzlas/ oṃ dz+nyā tsā kra hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas lus byugs me yis tshig pa
nyer gnyis pa/ nu skrangs gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/ mtshal gyi nya gzugs tha ma yi ge nya// dgu bris skrangs mnan gyi [kyi]lce seng ldeng dang // 'bras gsum ba sha ka dang spang [sbang] ma rnams// bsdus thang btang ba nu ma skrangs nad sel// yang na skrangs po 'ba' chas bdug kyang bshad//
nyer gsum pa/ bse dri gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/rgyu dbye rkyen dang bcos thabs bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni tshe sngon gtsug lag khang la sogs// byin can skyes chen rnams la dri ngan 'thul// de sogs mi dge sngon las las byung ba'i// pha ma'i rigs brgyud khye'ur skyes las byung //dbye ba rigs la yod dang 'gos pa gnyis// 'gos par rkyen ni stan gos lus nas 'byung // rigs la yod pa tshogs gsog la sogs kyis// las sgrib ma sbyangs dag la dka' na'ang // rkyen 'gos la sogs bcos kyis btub pa rnams// bcos thabs bkru 'byar byug tsi rnam pa bzhi// mi chu ba chu gangs chus lan 'ga' bkru// tang kun sar 'byar spru nag stor 'dra ba// me tog dril bu'i 'dam 'byar zhag re'am// zhag gnyis tsam re bsten pa de rjes su//gla rtsi yung ba shu dag sbyar byugs la// phye yis skam phyis de rjes bal dkar 'phyi//shug pa spang spos ba chur sbyar byugs la// sne ral tshod ma bsten la rngul dreg bton// puskar chus bkrus snum phyis spu sgo dbye// ti tsha shug thal spang spos rngul 'don bya// gur gum li shu sug smel a gar nag / 'ba' zhig spang spos shug pa'i phye ma rnams// tsan dan bgrung chus dam tsi 'ga' btang bas// tshe rabs dri ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yis// bse dri rlung gis sprin gtor bzhin du gyur//
nyer bzhi pa/ cher lhog gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/dug shing rigs kyi tsher ma lus la zug / rlan la phyin dang chu brgal gdon sogs kyis// rkyen byas lhog thabs skrangs shing zug skye na// bcos tshul byas par rnam pa mang mod kyang // mdor bsdus snying po sgos bcos 'di ltar bya// de ltar sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi yis bstan// tsha grang brtag pa nad gzhan kun dang mthun// spu rtsi'i thang btang ghi waṃ thang phrom dkar// gla rtsi gu gul shug tsher ba bla dang // ko byi zhib btags lo brgyad dri chus dbul//gnyan gsar tsher ma'i dug dbal myur du bcog [gcog] / tsher ma lus pa rtsa gnyan la zug pa// 'then na khrag shor ma chod 'chi nyen yod// 'on kyang gzhan du rang gzhan le [e]thon blta// rang byung dag tu thon pa'i dpe yang yod// de yis chas dang 'grig rnams 'di ltar byed// rma de deb pa'i dar dmar bzang po de// gru bzhi gcig la dkyil du rma khung gtad// lug tshil bzhag par bsdad la mar bsres dor// spang spos gla sgang go snyod rtsi bzhin btags// mar tshil de dang sbyar la byug par bya// de nas rma nang gla rtsi bzang por btab// rjes la rma dar dmar tshil can de bkab// gla rtsi rgyun du med kyang skabs su gdab// de yis 'bu chung mi yong rtsa nad 'joms// 'bu la bya rgod spos kyi phye ma btab// yang na rta rkang lug rwa bsregs gzhob 'debs//smo ༷pa/ spya pyā ༷༷khyiX ༷ two nāṃ/dī ༷ spya | ༷slo
gsungs// zas ni phye thug tshwa nyung byas la btang // gtar bsregs rjes la rtsi mur bar bya// de yis rtsa nad 'jib cing lus shed skye// mjug tu gzhan 'gyogs rang le bzhin du bcos// spyod lam nyin gnyid drag shul sha chang spang //
nyer lnga pa/ 'khru nad gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/aṇ+ḍi bzhi thang bil ba btab pas bcad// spyi ru brag zhun dgu pa tshad ldan la// 'bras dkar sla ngar ser tsam brngos pa yis// chu skol sor chu'i khu bsa'aphul byas na// tsha 'khru grang 'khru rgyu rgan yin yang gcod// 'khru skyugs gnyis ka bcos pa'i srung skud ni// oṃ nag rbad shag rbad rnar ping yer rbad/ces pa byung na gong bsnyen khri khrag [ phrag] bskyal [ bskyar]/ / dgos dus skyugs skabs bshad pa'i ra khyi lug / gsum gyi spu de phyi la gsum sgril bkal//rdor mdud gsum btab nang gi skas mgo dang // skas gsham rkang 'og g.yas ga yon ma nor ba// skyugs kyi dus bzhin brgya bzlas 'khru rnyed [ rked] pa//skyug la skyed [ske]btags 'khru skyug gcod par byed// yang na rgya nag rgya nag yig 'bru 'di// sa ti ma ra ya phaṭa ཿ bris la gsham dril ltor btang 'khru ba gcod// bsil la yang ba'i kha zas nyung tsam bsten// spyod lam bsil spang dro sar spu dugs bsten//
nyer drug pa/ skyugs pa gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/zas zos rjes la chu grang gdong bkru gtor// khor du puṣ+kar mū la pu shel rtse// sog ka ba bcas 'bras khur btab btang byin// sbrang hrū 'bras yos phyi btang btab la btang // yang na go snyod spod nar kha ru tsha// ka ra sbrang dang sbyar bas skyug pa chad// yang na a bar sbrang rtsi 'bras yos btab//shing mngar drug dang ltag pa sprad la btang // ske steng [stong]mtshog steng brang kha [khar]chur [chu]grod bdug / tshabs che lhen gsang ske steng [stong]bsreg par bya// sngags kyis bcos pa chu rdo grang mo la// oṃ naṃ le rtsa la hri/ zhes bzlas btab la ske stong mnan pas chad// bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas su dal bar bsdad// mi sdug yul dang dri nga ring du spang //
nyer bdun pa/ dri 'gags gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/a ru lhum rtsa bul tog bsdus pa'i thang // dri ma skam pa gang yang rlan par byed// yang na sman chen rgya tsha zho re re// shug tsher re ral spang spos gur gum bzhi// zho do gla ñtsa ghi wang dom mkhris gsum// bzhi nam tsam re mtshal gyi na bza' gsol// ril bu spyi 'joms rdo rje can zhes pa// zur sman mkhas pa'i lugs yin phan yon ni// ma smin pa dang byer sdud la sogs pa'i//grangs 'das gsungs kyang rtsa chu 'gags pa la// khyad thon 'dug pas 'di nyid bsten par bsngags//
nyer brgyad pa/ rtsa dkar nad kyi sgos bcos dran pa'i gsal byed/de nas rtsa dkar nad la gyes tshul dang // rgyu rkyen rgyas par bshad kyang snying por bsdus// de la rgyu rkyen drag shul 'grams pa'am// rims dug tsha ba rtsa la babs pa'am// mtshon gyis bcad brdungs rlung 'khrugs rtsar zhugs pas// de nyid rtsa dkar nad du 'gyur ba yin//dbye ba 'grams mtshon tshad babs mkhris ldan tsha// bad rlung las gyur rtsa dkar grang rkyen can// de rtags kha mig yo la sle zhing 'phrig / dran nyams lkugs sam yang na dbang po 'khrul// yan lag bshal sbrid tshor bral snying lag 'dar// rengs 'khums rwa ltar dgye'am gzhu ltar 'gug / tsha 'am grang ngam dri rkyu rlugs sam bsdam// de sogs ngo mtshar nad rtags du ma ston// nad 'di'i rtags [brtag] thabs mi shes gza' ru 'khrul// 'on kyang tsha na dod che zug gzer che// grang na skrangs shing drod chung shes pa 'khrul// stobs ldan 'chi la 'bring po bcos pas 'tsho// tshab tshung [tshabs chung] yun lon rang bzhin 'tsho bar gsungs// sman ni bsam 'phel nor bu 'i sbyor ba zhes//'du ba cha snyoms sman rgyal bzang po drug / shing gi rgyal po dri ldan rnam pa gsum tsan dan gnyis dang a ga ru/ rtsi yi rgyal po srog chags las byung gnyis ghi wang gla rtsi/ / nya phyis chu dang gangs bse ru kyi rus pa 'bras mchog gsum a bar skyur/ /spos sna kyi ling rgyal po zi ra dkar nag gnyis gnyis bzhi// chu sman gsum rgya tsha sdig srin gser byed/ dang ru rta rnam pa gnyis// shing bcud mas 'dzin bye ma ka ka ru//
sbyar ba chu skol 'phul ba gung gnyis btang // rims 'khrugs tsha ba rtsa byer rnying pa dang // dreg grum mdze dang rengs 'khums mkhal rtsa bsnad//'grams 'khrugs rtsa la byer zhing zhen pa dang // bcos mang brdug pa'i nad gzhi kun la bsngags// khyad par rtsa dkar nad kyi gnyen po yin// dwa lis kyi lce shing mngar khaṇ+ḍa la// chu ser sman gsum seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa dang // gur gum sug smel 'bri ta sa 'dzin dang // li shi pi pi ling dang tshos gsum dang // re skon brag zhun ga dur sbrang rtsi sbyar// yan lag rtsa dkar stod smad kun byer nad// mkhal grum smad mi bde ba kun la mchog / rtsa dkar nad la phyi nas byugs pa la// sbal rgyab btsag yug [yugs]lan tsha [tshwa]mar gsar byugs//rtsa nad zug gzer ma lus 'phral du gcog / bdud rtsi lnga dang gla ril chang btsos sogs// rtsa dkar gnyen po los yin mchog tu gsungs//
nyer dgu pa/ rma gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/dang po rma gsar zhag gsum sbang mas 'dul// chang 'gag sbang mas rlung 'dul chu ser 'jig ['jib]cing bla gnyan med// sings po'i sbang mas rma yi bad kun sel// chu nas bton pas khrag mkhris tsha ba 'joms// drags na rma 'byer sha'u rlig pa 'phyed// byad dang mthil bzhi chu rgyus 'brul bar byed// nang brtol tsha ba rul [sdud]cing rul myags mchod [mched]/ / de phyir sbang ma gnas dus shes pa gces// yang na phying pa chu sbangs dkris la srad bus bsdams chu 'byar gzer rma gsar rigs la shin tu mngags 'dul bya bsdams// de 'og skrangs pa shar na 'jib// bsil 'jib tshan dang sro lo kyi lce dang // lug ngal par pa ta rnams zho sbyar dang // dod 'jib chang 'gag sbang ma mkhan phabs g.yer// lcam 'bru bsres sogs rma yi tsha grang 'dri// 'on kyang rma rnams phal cher tsha ba ste// 'di la grang ba 'byung ba nyin skar bzhin// bsil bas blug cing brug dang bdug byas na// me la chu ltar skrangs pa zhi bar 'gyur// yug shing gur gum dom mkhris a byag tsher// li dri [khri]sbyar ba'i sman 'di bsten gyur na// byang khog rma dang yan lag rtsa chad gso// 'di ni myong bas grub pa zab pa tsam// lcam 'bru g.yer ma go snyod tshwa dang phabs// chang 'gag sbang btsir btab la 'bru mar dang // btsos pa'i a sa ba 'di ni// rma gsar rma rnying gang la phan pa yang // myong bas grub pa yin te bris pa dge / rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rma rtsi'i khaṇ+ḍa yang // rma rigs kun la khyad thon zab pa yin//'di na mgo ske don rma la sogs pa// gzhan na bcos thabs yod phyir 'dir
ma bkod// nye ba'i drangs bshad rma bcos 'di ltar mdzod// rma rnams tsha ba skye zhing zugs [zug]dma' na// gsar bcud zas kyis lus zungs gso ba bsngags// zho yis tshad pa bcog [gcog]cing kha zas len// 'on kyang nan ltar snag bungs che na gnod// chang gis chu ser rnag skyed de// rma gzha' chu rgyus rengs 'khums 'dul na mngags// chu nyid tsha ba gcog cing dang ga 'byed// skrangs shing gdon dang pho ba na la dug / nya phag sha yis rma kun bshig par byed// mde'u dam dang rma 'bras 'dul la btang // ri bong bya sha rma byer rus mdzer 'gogs// sha rnying mar rnying nang khrol sgo nga rjen// rma rnams ku na la gnod de spang bar bya//
sum cu pa/ 'bras 'dul bkab spyod bzo lugs dran pa'i gsal byed/dur rus rnying pa mi rta khyi gsum tshil zad nas tsum [tsam] brdung // sla ngar rdza phub du ba ma shor bsregs// thal ba zhib btags mar nag spos dkar sbyar// me chu yun bsdu dul tshad rnag dang 'dra// ngad yal tshe na sbrul mdung cog la ma// tsha la cong zhi rgod btul phye ma btab// 'bras rigs kun 'dul hel ge bkab la bzhag / zhag gsum song dus gsar pa re yis spo//skabs sbyor 'dod na khyim bya'i sgo nga gsum yang na lnga/ / tshos par btsos la ser sprin logs su bton// ser sprin lcags snod cogs [skyogs] sam gang byung du// dal bus me btang sna tshigs [tshig]snum la 'gro// de ldan 'bru mar blug la dkrug cing bskol// spos dkar gnyis la bu ram cha gcig sbyar// rtsi bzhin btags pa'i phye ma sgong snum btab// skrangs po 'bar 'bur chu ser nad rigs la// shog bur sbyar bkab bkab sbyor gsum pa zhes// ma hā tsi na'i lugs bzhin nyams myong grub//
so gcig pa/ khri dug gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/dngos dug rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dug gnyis las// mi rgyu bong nag thang phrom bse shing dang // rta spu rnams yin rgyu bar khyi dug dang // sbrul dang srin bu sbrang gi dug la sogs// rnam grangs rgyas bshad mang bar yod na'ang //gzhan rnams 'bri ru ma khoms [khom] khyi dug bcos// rgyu dang mtshan nyid rtags bcos bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni skyes bu spra yas thim pa'i dug / rgyu ba'i nang tshan khyi rgya mig bzhir thim// de nas mched pa'i khyi dug ces grags sam//ngo bo snyigs dus pad+ma ta yi rigs// sha za 'phung byed kun 'gro nag po zhes//khyi spyang snying zhugs 'gro bar 'tshe ba las// shi ba ngan song skye ga'i [ba'i]smon lam btab// de phyir 'di yi 'dzems bcos 'bad pa gces//mtshan nyid khyi de 'on long kha chu 'dzags// kha gdangs mgo bo dmad cing mjug ma phab// 'khyom zhing phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba yin// de yi mche bar dug babs rmugs pa dang // dbugs la dug babs kha rlangs 'phog pa'o// mig la phog pas mthong yang dug rgyu'o//brtag thabs dug ldan mi ldan tshabs che chung // ldang ba'i dus dang 'tsho ba dka' sla bcas// bdun du yod las dang po khyi mdog ni// khra bo nyi dros phyi dgung kha nag dang // dmar po nag phyed nyi phyed nyi rtse shar// rgya bo nam langs dro kha sngon po yis// dgongs dang tho rengs ser pos nam langs dang //dros chen dus la zin na dug dang ldan// dus gzhan kun la zin kyang dug mi ldan// dkar po sna dmar nam du dug dang ldan// de yi zos zin rtags la rma
gsar dus// skrangs mdog smug nag mi sdug ra ri dang // skrangs shing rma yi nang du rmen bu chags// 'bar 'bur kyang kyong can dang khyad par du// khyi yi mtshul ba la sogs dbyibs ldan dang // yang na khrag med sbu gur 'dug pa dang // chu bkrus 'o ma blug na mi chags dug / gzhan yang kha rlangs dri la sogs pa yi// dug de phog rtags dang po mgo bo ni// kha dang gdong pa dmar la lus kun brtse// grang shum byed cing mi dad chung ba 'ong // bar du rgyas rtags khro tshigs reg mi thub// chu nang 'bab dang rdzing 'dra'i snang ba dang //lce dang mtshul ba ri so snang ba smyo// tha ma smin rtags snying mi bde ba dang //mig rtsa nag gam srin mdzub sen mo sngo// smyo zhing 'bog la me long chu mthong dwangs// lud pa dkar po zho shi mgron bu 'dra// yang na smug nag skyugs cing mig mi 'dzum// ser mdog ser la lce ring nag nge can// chu mdog dmar po mi 'gyur dri chen nag / khyi skad 'byin la mi la rmugs stangs dang // sdod lugs la sogs khyi spyod ji bzhin byed// yang na khyi smyon mche ba dud pa ral//rgya skyegs bse ru btul ma ma nu dang // lham skrad rwa gzhob lo brgyad dri chu yis// lto stong phul btang g.yal dang sbrid pa dang // zas skom 'ja' tshon mthong ba dug yod rtags// sman dpa' 'o ma mi chags mdog nag po// rta nga [rnga]tsam pa gting zug 'bur kyong mang // dug yod rtags yin de las ldog na min// de dag rtags ldan tshabs kyi che chung dang // rtags med dog [dogs]zos yin min brtags pa'i phyir// zhogs pa nyi ma la nas thon pa'i dus// me long g.ya' bral phyis la a ru dang // bong nga dkar dmar gur gum chu yis rgyab [ brgyab] la byugs// oṃ mu na ye ram ram tshag phye/ stom zhi/tsag phye/ ram ram/ a te mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di stong dang nyer gcig btab// li sder steng du me long bzung byas la// nad 'di [pa'i] kha nang nas 'bru chu khyer zhing // g.yas su mda' dar khyer la gom brgya'i bar//
dbugs bsdams rgyugs la chu nas 'bru gnyis so[po]/ / me long la btab ha gsum hub gsum 'debs// lce yis 'dag pa'i rnam pa gsum 'byed bcug / g.ya' kyi mda' dar rgyab btsugs bal gyis skra mtshams bskor// spyi bor 'jag ma'i phon gcig zug par bya// bal 'dab gcig la sngags 'di nyer gcig btab// o ma hā me gha ra dza swā hā// nyi mar kha bstan nad pa khyi tshugs 'dug / me long li sder chu la bltas pa yis// mtshul ba lce ring la sogs khyi byad gzugs// shar dang spu skyes kha mig yo na che// gang rmugs khyi yi mdog mthun g.ya' dang ni// 'ja' tshon shar na dug tshabs 'bring du brjod//me long hril por dkar song chung ba'i rtags// me long ma nyams dug med rtags su bzung // li sder chu bkrus mgul dang rjes 'brangs yod// ldang dus dkar po zhag bdun nag po ni// zla gcig khra bo zhag po bcu drug dang //sngon po nyer drug dmar po zla phyed gsum// ser po zla gsum kham nag zla ba bdun// rgya bo lo gcig zla phyed sngo nag dang // stag 'dra lo gcig zla ba brgyad nas ldang // mang na zhogs pa nyi ma shar ba'i dus// nad pa'i kha lag snying kha bkrus pa'i chur// phye btab khyi bzung bcos pa dpung pho g.yas mo g.yon mgor 'dzin// dum tsam sman pa'i mdun du lteb dkar de steng du// mkhar gong srin med gsum dang de stong du// bzangs [zangs]sder chu gtsang blug la stod lan nad par par// lag g.yas mda' dar kha ru dung srin med//bcug la gom rgya'i [ brgya'i] bar du bang btang nas// kha yi dung de chur bcug nad pa de// khyi 'jog byas la gdong par dar dmar g.yog / cung zad sangs nas dung la bltas pa yis// mdog dmar khyi gzugs 'od 'khyug myur du sdang // khyi spu zing dang rnga ma mja' ['ja']tshon can// zla ba'i dus ldang kha rlung bun pa 'byung // spu rigs 'khyug dang chu nyog song ba de// lo dus ldang ba'i rtags yig [yin] dung mdog la// skyon med dug med khag
theg ḍā ki'i gdams//bcos thabs dang po bar dang tha ma gsum// dang po rma de byung 'phral de nyid la// kha yis 'jib dang rngabs rwas drangs pa dang // sor bzhi'i gong du zas 'jag dam par bsdams// rta gseb sngon po'i rta sbangs sar ma lhungs// btsir nas mar dkar btab bskol sna bug g.yas// bkag blug dug ro mi ldang myong ba'i gnas// zhag lon rma la rma de lcags kyis bsregs//de 'og zhun mar bskol ba rma nang du// rgya tsha skyer shun dud pa btsod kyis byug / yung skyer bong nga gla hrū mar sbyar byug / de steng rta sbangs zho sbyar rma 'jibs bya// de nas bar gyi bcos tshul bstan pa ni// bzang po drug dang a gar snying zho sha / a ru lug la gsang ba'i sman rnam gnyis// pha wang long bur re ral ghi wang dang // smug po sbal rgyab gu gul dkar nag dang // dung thal rma bya'i sgro mdongs gla rtsi dang // chos sman bong dkar skyer shun mnyam// a dkar dzā ti gsang sman gnyis skyed pa'i// khri dug mang sbyorab nyer lnga'i sbyor ba 'di// zhag bdun bar du nyin dgung myos byed 'phul// zla dus bzung ba'i snga phyi'i zhag gnyis re// rang dang bcas pa'i zhag lnga bsten par bsngags//tha ma sngags bcos skar rdzogs gnam ma mthong // blangs pa'i chu la sngags 'di khri phrag bzlas// oṃ ki ki tsa tsa raṃ raṃ/ skya ring mche ba'i dug sod ces pa ni// gong bsnyen 'bum song ba yis 'debs pa dang // smyo yang myur du 'tsho zhes myong ba'i gnas// yang na rgya shog gtsang mar rgya snag gi / oṃ oṃ khri mi khri ko ma khri ne ni swāhā/ zhes pa mjug nas dril ba'i za yig gam// yang na cang cing hur nan khyi kha tham// zhes pa'i za yig so yis ma rig [reg]par// tho rengs gyur mig [khyur med] nad can gsos pa dang // ma byung bsrung ba la yang mchog tu gyur// yang na zan la sho mig ldan pa bzos// ag sod yig sod/ mug sod/ mug sel sod/ khyi dug sod/ ces btab khyur mid byas
pas khyi dug sel// bsrung ba khyi smyon mche ba nas tsam bcag / sla ngar rngos pa sto stong btang ba dang // tsakra mu khyud rims pa gsum du bskor// khyi smyon mche ba dug sod ya// zhes pa lte bar bris dang rtsibs brgyad la/ ra sa ma ra ya sod kha tham zhes dang de yi phyi ma'i mu khyud la/ o mu raṃ raṃ/ lam khyi raṃ raṃ/shag ti raṃ raṃ/ yab khyi shes tsakra raṃ raṃ/ zhes bris de mtha'i me ri g.yon bskor dang // khrag shas che na stod sman [smad] skabs sbyar ba'i// rtse'u chung long rtsa gtar ba 'ga' re mthong // rim gro dkar chos bzhi dang drag po'i dbang //brus dang gtor ma bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bya// kor ler na ba hor gyi me btsas gdab// thul rtags khyi bsad khyi de nyi ma shar// bshal skyur gos dkar gyon dang 'jig lha rjes dang nad pa gnyis kur pa rmi// zas ni lang dus phye thug rdor [ sdor] med dang // de nas chab tsha la sogs babs dang bstun//spyod lam dam tshig khyi gtam mi smra zhing // zhe sdang 'thab rtsod chu dang zam pa dang // rta bzhon grang dang bser bu 'dzem par bya// bzhad gad g.yang sa cang dang 'khrig pa dang // khyad par chu rnying ngan pa lo gnyis spangs// log nanon khyi spu chur sbangs sngags 'di bzlas// oṃ badz+ra kro rda hūṃ kuklu rā dza kha tham/druṃ sa kha tham/ kuk+ka rā dzā'i nad zhi bar gyur cig ces pa btab cing khyi smyon 5che ba dang // spu druṃ sngags bcas sker btags lo dus bar// sngags rgyun mi bcad 'bring yang zla gsum bya//
so gnyis pa/ bshal gyi lag len dran pa'i gsal byed/nad kun spyi bshal 'thor bu'i sgos bshal dang // mgron po lam bshal gnyan bshal le tshan dang // dug bshal gcig dang rtsa sbyong sna 'dru [khrid]sogs// btang thabs skyon yon rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// dang po rung dang mi rung nad gzhir brtags// ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa dang //thub dang mi thub lus shed brtags par bya// rung ba rims 'khrugs tsha ba smin rgyas dang // dug dang snod tshad ma zhu skran nad dang // skya rbab dmu chu bad sprug chu ser mdze// dreg grum srin nad rab rib rma rnying sogs// phyi nang phal che'i nad la bsngags pa ste// khyad par mkhris pa'i nad la mchog tu bshad// mi rung dgun dus zungs zad rgas pa dang // gdon can sbrum ma rlung nad me dod nyams// gzhang nad thur sel log dang skyug lang can//zug rngu khong du las [lus]la btang mi bya// ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa ni// gnad [nad]gang smin 'dus bshig slong rgyas dus sbyangs// de ltar ma yin sngas na nad mi 'drongs// dus gsum sbyangs phyis nad ro brtas par 'gyur// de phyir sbyang ba'i dus tshod shes pa gces// thub dang mi thub lus shed brtag pa ni// zungs zad stobs med zas kyis bor ba dang // rtsa yi shed shor yun stod sbyong mi thub// ci'i phyir mi de'i nad la srog gnas pas//sbyongs gzhan nad slong slar yang dang ga 'gag / sbyong ba drags na nad srog gnyis ka 'jam [ 'joms]/ / de phyir bkrus sman mi btang dug dang mtshungs// de 'dra 'jams tsi ni ru ha spel bsngags//
