btang thabs sngon 'gro dngos gzhi phyi rjes gsum// sngon du 'gro la ring dang nye ba gnyis// ring ba'i sngon 'gro glo bur nad min la// thang dang phye mas byer bsdu 'dril ba bshig / zhen pa 'gog dang gab pa slong ba dang // ma smin smin par byas la btang bar bsngags// nye ba'i sngon 'gro gza' skar tshes bzang la// mkhan pas nang [sbang] ma chu 'jam bsros pa yis// lus kun dag par bkrus rjes mar gsar dang // 'bru mar tsha grang nad dang sbyar byas te// lto ba ma gtogs bkru [bsku]mnye them ['them]par bya// rlung shas che dang lto ba sra ba la// zhun mar lhor btang a ru mchu ring mur// 'jam tsi mes gtar [mas btang]rlung gzhig bad mkhris bslangs// mdor na bshal dgra rlung yin de 'dul gces// shin tu nye ba gtong gong zhag gcig nas//gro sran sngo dang nya phag rul skyur dang // 'o ma la sogs gang gnod zas kyis bslangs// gtong nub zwa tshod rdor [sdor]thal med pa btung // de yis nad slong lto snyi rlung kha gnon// dngos gzhi sman gyi sbyor sde btang tshul dang //lcags [lcag] dang 'don tshad log gnon rnam pa lnga// sbyor sde kun tu rgyug pa'i spyi bshal dang // thor bu nad kyi sgos bshal rnam pa gnyis// dang po sna sel ded dpon kha 'a dzin gsum// sna sel a ru mchu ring lcum rtsa dang // chu ma rtsi dang rgyam tsha pi pi ling // bsdus thang dro 'jam nam gung btang byas pas//'bru ['khru] nus rgyu 'khrog ci yang med dang gsum// de las lto ba sra snyi dpags byas te// ded dpon thun tshad che chung shes par bya// ci phyir zhe na lto sra thun chung pas// nad slong phyir mi thon te nyes pa che// lto snyi thung chos [thun ches]mi chod lus zungs 'joms// des na lto ba brtag phyir sna sel gces//lto snyi mi skyug rno 'jam grogs su 'gyur// ded dpon a ru chur nyung [mchu ring]dan rog dang // shi ri khaṇ+ḍa dur byed rnam pa bzhi / a ru ra ni thal tshan gseb tu 'dul// dan da rog po lce 'don phye la gdul// shrī khaṇ+ḍa mar dkar
nang du gdul// dur byid rkang shun dug phral yos su gdul// cha mnyam zhib btags ril bur dril ba yis// rno la grags [drag]ste stobs ldan nad kun 'joms// yang na thar nu dur byid a ru ra// lcum rtsa sngon bu khron bu shi ri khaṇ+ḍa// dan rog dan khra dong ga ba chur bsdus// sna ma tshig pa'i khaṇ+ḍa rno la 'jam// mi skyug mi 'byams lhen dang rlung mi skye// nad dang sbyar nas drag zhan zo yis 'khru// dgun dus sbrum ma rgas dang zungs zad dang // lam kha'i mgron po la yang btang du btub// gtso bo de la 'khor gyis kha bsgyur ba//tsan dan a ga ru dang snying zho sha/ sdebs pas snying gi tsha ba sbyong bar byed//tsha la shing mngar rgun 'brum a krong sdebs// glo ba'i nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin// gur gum ba sha ka dang brag zhun sdebs// mchin pa'i tsha ba 'khru bar byed pa yin// ya bak+ṣa ra thal tsha pi pi ling // sdebs pas mcher nad 'khru bar byed pa yin// lcam pa sug smel dbyi mong sdebs pa yis// mkhal ma'i nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin// ma nu rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang gsum//pho ba'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // sdebs pas mkhris pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed// snya lo btsod dang kha ru tsha sdebs pas// rgyu long snod nad sbyong bar byed pa yin// byang pa sdig srin spos dkar sdebs pa yis// rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed pa yin//dbyi mong srub ka byang pa sdebs pa yis// mgo skyon rtsa nad sbyong bar byed pa yin// li ga dur dang dom mkhris nyi dga' sdebs// stod kyi rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed// rgya tsha sdig srin sug smel sdebs pa yis// smad kyi rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed// se rgod bar shun dbyi mong so ma ra// pags pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// me tog lug mig bil ba a 'bras sdebs//mgo bo'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// a wa a ru ra dang lcags dreg sdebs// mig gi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// ga bur tsan dan ghi wang
sdebs pa yis// tshad pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha na le sham// sdebs pas grang ba'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed// 'bras bu gsum sdebs tsha grang 'dres pa sel// spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra//sdebs pas chu ser nad rnams sbyong bar byed// khyung sder re ral bong nga dkar po sdebs// dug gi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// bse yab 'u su puṣ+kar mū la sdebs// bad kun smug po'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed// dbyi mong srub ka shu dag sdebs pa yis// skran gyi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin//gla gor zho sha sngon bu dzā ti pha la sdebs// dmu chu'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// nim pa rgya tsha dzā ti pha la sdebs// skyug pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// zar ma shu zur zom rtsi sdebs pa yis// pho long sbos pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed//༄ dzā ti pi pi ling dang na le sham// gyen log rlung dang rgyu long 'khrol ba sbyong // byi tang ga dang g.yer ma ma ru rtse// sdebs pas srin nad ma lus sbyong bar byed// gur gum dbyi mong so ma ra dza sdebs// dreg gi nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin// ru rta mu zi rgya tsha sdebs pa yis// sha rus rtsa yi 'bras nad sbyong bar byed// a sho gan d+dhā [dha]'om bu ya bak+ṣa// sdebs pas bu snod nad rnams sbyong bar byed// mi ru sa btsa' ma ya bak+ṣa ra sdebs// tsam [rtsam]pa ma 'khru nad rnams sbyong bar byed// ba spru sdebs ( pas ) sbrum ma'i bu mi 'chor// chu ma ñtsa dang sdebs pas skyug mi srid// dngul chu dung thal rgya tsha sdebs pa yis// mi skyug mi 'gying myur du 'bigs par byed// myang rtsi pras [spras] dang sdebs pas 'byams mi srid// dri chu chu rug sdebs pas chu mi ga shed[gnod]/ / nyi dga'i 'bras bu sdebs pas kha mi skom// kha bsgyur sum cu gnad kyi man ngag bdun// 'di ldan nad yul 'byin par the tshom med//drag po bcu drug sbyor ba ni// btsan dug gla rtsi gu gul gsum// gri sha shog shing shu dag gsum// thar nu chu rtsa dur byid gsum// cu gang k+ti wang gur gum
gsum// sman mchog rgyal po a ru ra// sman chen bzhi 'gyur cu gur gla// ghi wang gtso mnyam sha chen gul// nyis 'gyur shu dag dur byed [byid] gnyis//sum 'gyur re lcag chu rtsa thal// gtso bo lnga 'gyur zhib tu btags// lo brgyad dri chus bra ril tsam// bdun dgu bcu gcig nad stobs sbyar// klad par babs pa'i mgo gzer dang // gag pa dang ni lhog pa dang // khyad par nag po sum 'dril zhes// mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad la bsngags// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kun// 'di yis mi 'joms ga la srid// rma gsar sbrum mas spang bya yin//ser po dgu yi sbyor ba ni// thar nu bra ban ti kha byang blta'i tshig skyes zhes pa'i// me tog ser po gser gdugs can// ston dus rtsi skam khaṇ+ḍa bya// rgyal po yin pas bungs cher bskyed// hong len ma sad [ sungs] ma rul ba//btsun mo'i tshul dug dbang btsan// zab lag bzang po blon po'i tshul// re lcag pa yi [ni]'bangs kyi tshul// gu gul gla ñtsa stag sha ba// shu dag rnams ni dmag ma'i [ mi'i] tshul// kyi lce bong dkar kha lo bsgyur// gser mdzod gnyis nas dgos 'dod 'byung // thub pa chen po mnyes pa'i tshul// sman mchog a ru bzhi 'gyur sbyar// zhib par 'dam btags ril bu ni// che chung bra ba'i ril ma tsam// chu bdun dgu bcu gcig la sogs pa// dar ma rgas byis lus zungs dpag / stod du babs pa'i tsha gzer dang // smad du babs pa'i rgyu gzer dang // gag pa dang ni lhog pa dang // khyad par gnyan tshad rigs la bsngags// cham pa nad la bdud rtsir mtshungs// 'go ba'i nad la gnad dgur byugs// khong du gsum gsum btang ba yis// lus la rdo rje'i go khrag [khyab]thob//bdud rtsi bshal sman sbyor ba 'di lta ste// kun 'joms sman rgyal bshal sman bcu gcig la// gtso bo a ru gser mdog bzang ba gcig / sman chen
—brgyad cha gu gul thun bzang re// brag zhun thar nu dur byid mtheb tshigs tsam// shu dag ru rta thun re dan rog lnga// byang bul thun gcig gla rtsi dri thon tsam// sbrang bur gang rnyed rta byas mdze bos sbrus// ril bu bra ba'i ril ma tsam du sgril// nyer gcig bdun dgu bcu gcig nad stobs sbyar// khrag dang mkhris pa rims 'khrugs kun la bsngags// ma zhu lhen skran thal bar rlog par byed// shu ba 'bam gnyan ma lus rtsa nad 'byin// chu ser pags pa'i nad la bsdod brlag med// rlung gi nad la bdud ñtsa lta bur mtshungs// sbrum ma la yang mi gnod btang du rlangs[rung ]/ / shin tu nad brgyad [rgyas]'ju ba'i gang zag la// drug cu yan chad nang re bzhin du btang // rgas dang gzhon dang nam zla tsha grang med// brgya [ rgya] lam mgron po la yang btang bas mchog / sbyor ba sman gyi khyad du 'phags pa 'di// slob dpon klu sgrub zhal gyis bzhed pa yin// dug gi nad 'di sbyong bar byed pa la// sdud byed sman thun bzhi'am lnga'i bar du// bsten las ring ba'i sngon 'gro 'di la min//khrus dang bsku mnye byas rjes sbyong ba'i sman// ko ṭha btu dus brdungs sogs dag [dam]tshig kun// zur du brjod las ma nyams tshul mthun de// re re bzhin brdungs de nas khyor [khyon]gcig tu// brdungs la 'bras nyag bdun btags chu gtsang bya sgong gang dang // sbyar ba ras dkar dri med khud du btums// rin chen la sogs gas med snod du btsir// gsang ba 'bru gnyis rab tu gnas par bya// btang thabs 'gru la bsrung snum zas zhag gsum spangs// gnod pa'i zas bslang nad pa shar phyogs kyi// char gtogs sa bdag ngan med mgo bo btad [gtad]/ / sman pas rten 'brel sha mar kham gcig za// chu yis kha bshal bdun dgu bcu gcig song // nad pa'i zo dang sbyar te sngon ma zhu// phyi ma rim gtong thun re mon khre re// gtang ste de 'phral mgo 'jug [mjug]log la nyal// de nas tsog pur langs te mi smrar
bsdad// gzer 'khyug 'khrog dang mngar dwangs sna tshogs 'byung // dang po sdud pas lus kun na ba dang // bar du gsod pas pho long 'khrog pa 'byung //tha mar nad rnams bar [thur]du 'khru ba ste// ma phigs thun chung bungs skyed byas te sbyong // gong du mid pa'i mon khre tshos pa'am// shun pa bud na dug nad dag pa yin// khyad par nad rnams dag na nges par chad// nad zhan [zhen]rnying pa zungs ngan gsar bcud gso// yang yang ma dag bar du sbyang bar bya//rtsa bshal ni byang pa dmar khra bar gshog ldan pa nyi shu gcig / bar gshog spang na sna myur gang las 'byung // de yi dug 'phrog shing mngar pi pi ling /nas tsam gtong ba mkhas pa'i phyag len yin// rgya tsha mtshal dkar tshwa la ha shig rdo// lcam 'bru sdig pa thun bzang re rer mnyam// kha sgyur gang dgos sna 'bru re re mchog / lung rigs myong ba grub pa'i gdams pa'o// zab mo'i gnad dang mi ldan rmongs pa yis// kha sgyur thun ches gtso bo'i nus pa bcom//mang du byin pas khams log skyug par 'gyur// 'di ni sran tshad tsam gyis don chen 'grub// lcag dang log gnon la sogs spyi dang 'dra// shin tu zug che 'ba' stangs zhen pa na// mthu chen 'bru bdun shing mngar mtheb tshig [tshigs]tsam// rgya tsha thun tshad zhib btags chang bskol dbul// dug dang bcas pas zug gcog lhug par 'bab// tshul 'di rtsa ba bshal sna 'bru ma zhes bya//
so gsum pa/ gtsug bshal gcod pa dran pa'i gsal byed/ya ma mgo gzer steng skyon phog pa'i skyon// mgo 'dar gzer zug mgo skyon langs pa dang // srin dang chu ser gdong sogs mgo nad dang // rtsad gdon drungs nas 'byin pa'i gdams pa la// thar nu mtheb tshig [tshigs]tsam dang byang khra bcu// dan rog bzhi dang dur byid thar nu tsam// ru rta gser mdog rgya tsha gla ñtsa bzhi// thun re kun kyang phye ma su da sbyar// smin steng dkris la mig tu ma song bar// skra gzhar mgo bo khyab par byug pa yis// steng du phying pa srab mo sbubs can gyis// zhag gcig nyid la chu sbur chu ser 'bebs// dmar 'dag song yang 'jig pa'i bsam pa bshol// zhag bdun lon dang chu ser chad pa dang // srub chus bkrus la zhun mar gsar pa byugs//rin chen gtsug bshal mgo skyon kun la 'gro//rgyal po thar nu rta bzhon dur byid lcags kyu 'dzin srub lnga'i 'bras bu/ / btsun chung thal rda rje [thal ka rdo rje] stag bzhon byang khra dbyug pa 'phyar seng ldeng ste khaṇ+ḍa/ /rgan po dbyi mong 'bru g.yag zhon dan rog tsha [tshwa]rgya tsha rgyab khur// lag na dri zhim spang spos dud thogs// kun kyang zhib btags gsang chus bran glum klad pa/ /gar sla rwa [ra]yi zho tsam gyis// srab mthug ba ko'i tshad du byug / de steng zan bron [ dron] zhwa mo g.yogs// ngar ldan bum [ nub] gcig 'jib tu btub// chu bur gang byung bcar la btang // spyi bo rin chen gtsug bshal te//gdong la byung la gdong bshal 'byung // yan lag skor [kor]le 'i bshal du
sbyar// phan yon ya ma mig 'grib mdze// tshigs chu pus btigs lce spyang mgo / 'bras dang dreg grum kor le 'khyug / ba spu mtsho mo yur 'dren zhes//chags [chag]sman —mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin//'dam chings oṃ ā tha/ byis pa la sogs brdab lhung mgo bo yi// rgya bsrub bye sogs chings kyis bsdam dgos la// dud pa sbang gar zho dang brag zhun phabs// g.yer ma gla rtsi go snyod gang 'dzoms bsags// bag phye zhib mo chur bsdus phul gang la// sa spyin zhib mo phul gang btab la sbru// bong spru ser po btub pa khyor do btab// tshe [mtshe]bsdus khu ba gar mo spyin chu yi// gar sla gzugs thub sha yis bzod tsam gso// mgo yi skra gzhar khyab byug ras kyis bsdam// rma kha yod na de la 'dam tu 'jug / khong sman gtar 'jib me rtsa [btsa'] skabs dang bstun// 'di la chings shul dman pa mi 'byung zhing //dam skyon lhod skyon mi 'byung mkhas khyad yin// dharma swa mi'i nyams myong kho na'o//'dam bu'i man ngag yo ā tha/ 'dam du 'jug pa'i man ngag bshad par bya//mchod rten na bza' bla ma'i bdud hrū dang // mtshar skyer bar shun 'om bu shing dang ni// g.ya' shing rdo ring chu ra rang 'thag dang // khyi phag mdangs pa skyed bu 'og gi sa// wa kha'i rde'u zhib btags phye ma la// sa spyin nyis 'gyur bltos pa'i 'jim pa yis// dgos pa'i rgya 'khor rwa dbyibs lnga ldan sbyar//oṃ nad sogs/ dbal zhi pa ra sa ra 'ub tshum/ zhes pa sum brgya bzlas pa'i sngags// chur sbyar rus gzer chu ser la sogs pa// mgo skyon 'byin pa'i gdams pa mthar thug go / 'di la dbyibs khog spubs 'dra bar byas na rlon pa de dag rma lasbyor ba'am/ dbyibs rwa co ji bzhin byas la skam pa dang kha la spyin bkus[bskus]/ de rma la sbyar nas rtse mo khas 'jib/ shug pa gzags pa rgag pa'i lugs gnyis yod de/ dbye 'dra ba phyag len rgyun ṭasnga ma la mdzad pa legs so//
so bzhi pa/ rlung nad lce spyang gi bcos dran pa'i gsal byed/oṃ ā tha/ rje la gus btud zab mo'i gdams pa bri// rlung nad nyi shu'i nga nas lce spyang mgo / rlung khrag chu ser pus mor zhen pa'i nad// shin tu /so dka' de rtags gso ba'i thabs// rang gdornga chu rgyus sna nas sbal nag /ra// dmar khrar skrangs shing skya sob ba spu'i khung // gsal bar mthong dang 9na la phyin tshe rtse [brtse]/ / thur la mi phebs brkyang bskum shin tu dka'//jin po la las gnyan dang grum bur 'dzin// mkhas pa'i phyag len ma nor so thabs ni// dang por skar chus reg bya nyams par bran sor mo btab pa na mi ra ba tsam/ / mar dkar 'ol skol tshan mo seng ldeng dang // spos dkar tha dkar rje so ma ra phyis bran pa pus mor bcings// de steng phying pa snum ldan mer sros bsdams// nyin zhag gcig bzhag de yis ma phan na// lho shing rgya tsha ga byang khra rtse mo spos kyis bran// dur chamanyam zhib btags chu sbyar ba ko tsam//da dmigs khyab byugs de steng glum nye'u glan// de steng pags pa rlon pa nga byug dkris// de steng snal mas bcing la zhag gcig bzhag / de nas cing bkrol chu bur rus pas brtol// zhag gsum yan par bzhag cing 'bru ra byugs// 'di yang phyag sman mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes te// snying 'dra'i ba ma byung na legs par ster// dge bas 'gro kun bde ba'i mchog thob ’ga /
so lnga pa/ rten 'brel thabs kyi lba bcos dran pa'i gsal byed/rten 'brel thabs kyi lba bcos byed 'dod na// lo zla byed pa'i nyer dgu dus gsal tshe// de yang rten 'brel khang sgo'i shar lha'i nang // nas bre gang dang yol mdud rdog gsum bzhag / sman pa nang dang lba can phyir bzhag la//dang po yol mdud steng nad pa'i rkang g.yas bzhag / don dam mi bden kun rdzob bden zhes thos// gnyis pa nad steng [ pa'i] rkang pa g.yon bzhag la//ngag nus kun rdzob mi bden don dam bden// byas nas nang du log nas spyi yol la// yol mdud gsum nas dum re bcag pa la// bre yi nas steng nad pa'i lo grangs kyi// tshom bu bkod de rang nyid yi dam gyis// bsnyen sgrub song ba'i nga rgyal ma bral bar// lci ba'i me kong [sgong]pad ma 'dab brgyad bskyed//tshom bu re yi spyin bsreg bye ba dang // snang srid lha 'dre sha lhag khyer gcig byas// nad pa nang du bos la lba ba dang // o [ol]mdud gsum la sngags 'di sum brgya 'debs// oṃ sa ra pa ra si ri si ri na ma zhi zhi swā hwa/ yol mdud gcig ni 'phral du za ru bcug / gcig gi [ni] skar ma rdzogs dang yol mdud gcig / tho rengs skar ma ma yal tsam la za/ 'di ni rten 'brel thabs kyis bcos pa yin//gzhan yang khyim po lkog nad ces bya bar// ser po zab lag ces byar gzhi blangs la// nu zho 'dzeg pa'i btsun mo mdzes ma la// chu rlung 'thabs pa'idapa' bo skyon byas la// ba 'or skyo ma tsam bskol lum bu [lums su]bzhugs// nad rlangs phyir thon 'bar 'bur byung na 'tsho//
so drug pa/ ro tsa'i gdams pa dran pa'i gsal byed/rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten las dam pa'i chos// ji srid bskal brgya'i bar du 'dzin pa'i gdung // mi nyams 'dul khrims ldan pa ma yin pa'i//'dod ldan skye bo dga'o ba'i g.yo yin pas// 'bad par rigs [rig]pa de yi gdams pa bstan// sman ni sha yi rgyal po da byid de// lus kyi stobs bskyed khu ba 'phel mchog yin// de yang mdos/ sprug ngo dmar seng ljang gi / mig lam 'tsher zheng [zhing]mgrin thung chu zhing [zheng]gab// bcad na tshil bu'i rang bzhin da byid smug / ser skya 'od che bzang rigs cung zad dmar//mgrin dang mjug ma ring ba da byid ser// khyad par da byid smug po mchog tu gsungs// de la dug bong zhal shes sman gsum bsnan// gyen 'gro sha ring nad sbal sha yi min// sbyor ba mang du gsungs kyang skabs 'di ru// bcu gsum pa ni da byid smug ser gnyis// sram gyi sha dang brag gi rtsangs pa dang //khyim bya phug ron mchil pa nas zan mgo / gtsang nya thang phrom dbang po lag pa dang // nye shing pa dang cong zhi bu ram sbyar// khu ba zad pa 'phral du skyed byed de// nub re la yang bud med brgya spyod nus// gzhan yang ra thug 'bras bu 'o mar btsos// ka ra ril bsres zos na de dang 'dra// zho spros zos snying ka ra 'bras bcas zos// rgan po yin kyang gzhon nu lta bur spyod//da byid dzā ti rnam pa gnyis// lug thug la sogs rlig pa'i sna gang rnyed//khyim bu dkar po nas zan bya sgong bcas// rtsi bzhin btags pa rtsa ba'i mar//kha tshar byas la lto stong kham re zos// sa bon gso zhing pho mtshan rgyas par byed//
da byid nas zan sha dang ra lug gi / thug 'bras mkhal zho gla gor zho sha dang //khyimakhya dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sdig srin dang // dbang lag a ru ra rnams cha mnyam sbyar// sbrang bur mar bcas btsos la ngad yal dus// kha tshar btab pa'i mar ram lde gu bsten// pad ma ge sar ut+pal sngon po dang // ka ra sbrang sbyar lte bar byug pa yis// 'dod pa ci 'dod bzhin du las su rung //gzhan yang rgya bod mchil pa de pho yi// klad pa mar sbyar zos na ro tsa byed// dbang po lag pa zhib btags ka ra sbyar// ba 'or bskol bas 'phul btang ro tsa mchog /ba yi 'o ma legs bsdus khaṇ+ḍa la// da byid smug po rgya mchil de pho'i sha /thug 'bras zho do gser mdog nye ba'i shing // til dkar 'od ldan cong zhi zho re'i tshad// dbang lag zho gsum sbyar ba'i ril bu ni// lung thang che ba tsam re tho rengs mur// lus kyi stobs bskyed bkrag mdangs dbang po gsal//'dod ldan skye bo'i dga' ba zad mi shes// tshe ring nad med rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs//yang na cong zhi mar dkar bu ram dang // shing mngar gla tsi dom mkhris 'o bu ['om bu] phul// 'dis kyang 'dod pa chog mi shes pa 'byung // u pa snyan dhi dzā ti'i me tog dang // dzā ti li shi shing tsha bcas pa rnams// til nag sbrang dang sbyar ba'i ril bu ni// mthe bong mgo tsam bsten pas 'dod pa 'phel// sro ma seng ge i pa bhan dhi 'bru// sbyar ba zo sa pas thig le 'chor 'gor gdams// seng ge dkar mo'i pho bong ma rul ba khyi dkar 'bras/ / bsil gyi rgyal po'i thang chu ma nyams pa ga bur/ / ri bsrung kha che gur kum phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsa mchog dang // rong ldan shing shing mngar dang g.yu yi pha wang brun phug ron/ / zhib btags sbrang smyon byar ba legs bkrus nas// chag brgya bsten na rdo rje sbom ring mkhregs// dgos pa nad med lang tsho ldan pa yin// dus
tshigs rnams su nyal po dgag pa min// 'phral du sems dga' bu tsha'i brgyud bskyed cing // stobs ldan bud med kun la thogs med 'gro// dgos 'dod kun la zhags pa mchog tu grags/
so bdun pa/ stobs zad rgas pa bsring ba'i bcud len nye bar mkho ba dran pa'i gsal byed/stobs zad rgas pa bsring ba bcud len la// phan yon sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis yod de// phan yon tshe ring nad med lus stobs rgyas// dbang gsal blo rno dran gsal ro tsa byed// sbyar ba nad gzhi'i gnyen pos 'jam bshal btang // ma sbyongs bcud len dri bcas tshos dang 'dra// de nas rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga yi bcud// sa yi dwangs ma brag zhun sha yi gsos// rdo yi dwangs ma cong zhi rus pa'i gsos// shing gi dwangs ma bu ram stobs kyi gsos// me tog dwangs ma sbrang rtsi mdangs kyi gsos// rtsi yi dwangs ma mar dkar bcud kyi gsos// shug 'bras ba lu mtshe dang mkhan pa bzhi// dgun mi skams pas tshe yi gsos su gyur// 'di dgu'i bcud longs srog gcod nad dgu grol//rgas pa'i rtags nub bcu drug lta bu'i lus// seng ge'i rtsal la glang po lta bu'i stobs// rma bya'i mdangs ldan mgyogs pa cang shes rta// tshe srog nyi zla gnyis dang mnyam par 'gyur// de yi sman mar sbyor ba'i lag len bshad// pho cong bzang po nas tsam brdungs la btsos// khu ba bre gang lcag [lcigs]skyur brag zhun chus// sbangs pa'i dwangs ma bre phyed bdud rtsi bzhi// so sor bsdus brtsegs khu ba khyor ba re// ma 'dregs bsdus pa'i skyo mar dmar zal ba'i//bzhos thog 'o ma bsre [bre]gsum blug cing dkrugs// gong bzhin bsdus pa'i skabs su ba mar gsar// srang bzhi btab dkrugs chu chod dwangs snyigs byed//mer bcug sgra med rtsig rtsig mdzum [mdzub] mos tshugs// dus der bsil
ba'i gnas phog bu ram dang // sbrang dkar legs par btul ba srang re'i phye//lhan cig tshad bzhin sbyar ba gong sman drug / stobs bskyed dbang lag mig gsal rtswa a wa/ drod skyed sman sga re [ro]tsa gangs sbal sha / zhib btags kha tshar 'debs pa mkhas pa'i lugs//
so brgyad pa/ rims nad nag po gsum 'gril gyi bcos dran pa'i gsal byed/sems can 'dren mdzad bod kyi lha gcig po// nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa'i tshogs 'joms shing // zla ba'i 'od kyis tsha zer zhi mdzad pa'i//'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po gsum 'gril bcos pa'i yig chung bshad// de la rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa gnyis//rtsa ni kha rgyug gting grims khong na 'dar// chu mdog dmar ser khong nas ldog pa 'byung // rngams [rngam]pa rgod la phal cher rlung rtags bstan// 'di ni skya nad dus su 'byung ba yin// gnyan tshad rgyas na gong rtags 'dra ba'i steng // mchin mkhris steng gzer mig ni dmar ser 'byung // de dus chu ni mar nag 'dra ba yin// lce skam bad che so dreg chags pa dang // lce ni skams shing gas na khrag 'dzag rnams// gnyan tshad rlung gsum rgyas pa'i rtags yin no// nag na lce nag por song tsha ba phal cher don la shor// 'di dus spyod lam smyon 'gros byed pa 'byung // mi shes rmongs pas 'dre srog rtsa la 'babs pa yin skyon —yin zhes zer// zhag po drug dang bdun nas 'tsho 'chi byed// de la [las]thal na bcu gnyis 'da' mi byed// 'di ni nag po gsum 'gril rtags su 'dod// de skad myong bas grub pa yin no ang //gnyis pa sman gyis bcos thabs bstan pa ni// dang po rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam par bya// mi dom mkhris pa sman gyis 'bros 'phrang bstabs [bsdams]pa mkhris chen brgyad pa zer gla rtsi bong nga dkar// rgu drus stag sha chos sman g.yung ba zer
ba brgyud na yod thod pa rnams// lo brgyad dri chu sbyar la thengs 'ga' btang //sdud sgo mtshog ma drug pa bcu gsum pa// dpyad kyis 'bros 'phrang bsdams pa ltag khung pur 'gram mtshogs sgo nang long 'phar rtsa spra ba lnga yis bsreg / 'di ni dpal ldan rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin// gnyan tshad rgyas na rog 'tsho ba'i mkhas pa'i sbyor ba spru// sman gyi rgyal po ga pur dkar po ga pur rang yin yis// rgyas pa'i tshad pa ma phus 'joms par byed// sman gyi rgyal po ga pur sgog skya nus ldan bsregs pa nag po pes// snying khrag gab pa'i tshad pa 'joms par byed// sman gyi rgyal po ga pur naya' kyi ma sngon po yis// snod kyi mkhris pa'i tsha ba 'joms par byed// sman gyi rgyal po ga pur smug 74po yis// mkhal mchin babs pa'i tsha ba 'joms par lhod// ar nag snying srog tshad pa 'joms par byed// bsil cu gur lam [li]nasum glo mchin tshad pa 'joms par byed// ba sha spang rtsi hong len khrag rakhrugs 'joms// a byag tsher sngon gzer dang chu ser 'joms// bong nga —kar pos rgyu long tshad pa 'joms// 'brug rus rus pas tshad pa 'joms sgar byed// mi thod btsa' mas mgo bo'i nad rnams 'joms// sug smel rdzan snod kun gyi kha sman pa 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsungs 'dzin byed// se 'brus pho ba'i nad rnams ma lus 'joms// bong nga nag nasatsam pos gnyan rims tshad khu 'joms// 'dzin nas phyed tsam pas khrag gi gzer rnams 'joms par byed//spya gul gag lhog gnyan gzer sa gdon 'joms// stobs ldan dpa' bos sha stan 'bras 'dul gnyan nad 'joms// a ru gser mdog 'du ba cha snyoms )da// 'di ni ka ra dkar po'i rta la skyon// ga bur drag po nyi shu rtsa gsum // /: sman mchog rgyal po'i sbyor ba 'dis// stod du babs pa'i gzer thung nga // smad du babs pa'i rgyu gzer 'joms// steng gdon gza' dang 'og /don klu// snying srog babs pa'i smyo 'chal dang // mkhal mchin babs pa'i /zer ba 'joms// tshad rims rna ba 'on dang gnyid 'thibs dang // rgyu
gzer khrag 'dzag rtsa sgo'i khrag 'dzag dang // don snod 'grams 'khrugs thams cad 'joms par byed// gsar pa rnams la gangs chus phul la btang // mkhris nad can la bskol grang tshigs su chu yis phul// zungs ngan byis pa rnams la chang gis 'phul// kun la chang gis 'phul kyang ya 'ud med//ri thang gso ba zla ba myong bas grub// gsar pa rnams la sman thun gsum re chog / thun tshad gser zho re yi bungs dang mnyam// ri thang mtshams su zas spyod spyi dang mthun// man ngag 'di ni kho bos myong bas grub//
so dgu pa/ glo rnag gso ba dran pa'i gsal byed/glo rnag bcos pa'i zin bris mang po yang sto bdag gis mthong thos yod kyang gal che 'diltakhyung po rtogs ldan pa yis gcod tshul nika kho bos nye bar mkho ba'i dran pa yis| gsal byed gdengs ldan 'di gang gong du 'tshams/ bdud rtsi gang bshams pa sngo sngo mthong ba lag len dgosa'abur ba sad ma byung ba btus la grib skams legs par byas na [nas] rtsi bzhin btags/ ba zho la thun lam pa re btab la sngas 'og tu bcug la sang tho rengs btang / des ni dang por sod/ bar du 'dren/ tha mar gcod/ glo rnag rtsa ba nas 'don pa la sman gzhan btang mi dgos so// za sa spyod bsil bsten spyod lam dal bar bsdad// glo rnag bcos pa'i man ngag myong bas grub//
bzhi bcu pa/ bla gnas brtsi tshul dran pa'i gsal byed/thabs shes ro rkyang dbang gis ni// byang chub sems kyi khams 'pho ba//yar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang byas te// skyes pa'i g.yon dang bud med g.yas//de yang tshes gcig rkang pa yi// sor tshigs dang por yi ge a// gnyis par i dang gsum par ri// bzhi par long bu u yi gzugs// lnga par pus mor li yig nas// drug par spyi yi mtshams su a// bdun la lag sor dang por e//brgyad par sor tshigs gnyis par ar// de bzhin dgu la gsum par o//bcu par mkhrig ma'i tshigs su al// bcu gcig pa la gru mor ha// bcu gcig [gnyis] dpung par ya zhes brjod// bcu gsum pa la snying gar ra//bcu bzhi mgrin par yi ge waṃ// bco lnga pa la dpral par la// bco lnga bcu drug mtshams su ni// spyi bor i gyi gzugs kyis so// slar yang bcu drug ltag par lā// bcu bdun pa la gnya' bar wa// bco brgyad snying gar ra yig gzugs// bcu dgur dpung pa'i tshigs su yā// nyi shu pa la gru mor hā//nyer gcig mkhrig ma yi ge al// nyer gnyis sor tshigs gsum par au//nyer gsum tshigs pa gnyis par ar// nyer bzhi sor tshigs dang por i//nyer lnga spyi ru mtshams su ā// nyer drug pa la pus mor t+pa// nyer bdun long bur u zhes bya// nyer brgyad sor tshigs gsum par ṛ// nyer dgu sor tshigs gnyis par ī// gnam gang sor tshigs dang por ā// gnam stong dang po tshes gcig mtshams// rkang pa'i mthil du a yi gzugs// 'di dang am gyi dus su tshe// byang chub sems kyi mgo lus kun// khyab phyir shin tu
mnyam pa ste// blo ldan rnams kyis rtogs par bya// yang bla gnas nye bar mkho ba lugs gcig la/ pho la yar ngo'i tshes gcig la// rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gnas// gnyis la bol gong gsum la nywa// bzhi pus steng / lnga gyid khung /drug brla sha bdun dpyi tshigs/ brgyad la mkhal g.yon/ dgu rtsibs [rtsib]steng / bcu dpung g.yon/ bcu gcig lag mar[par]/ bcu gnyis lag mthil/ bcu gsum ske/ bcu bzhi rna lag 'gram/ bco lnga spyi gtsug gnas so// mar ngo la des rigs par dpyad/ pho la mar ngos tshes gcig g.yas par brtsi zhing / mo la de bzhin g.yon du shes par bya// nya stong spyi por gnas kyang lus kun khyab pas 'dzem par bya// de yang rgyud sde rin chen dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ni sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i gsung yin la/ rig byed ni tshad ma min par gsungs pas snga ma kho na ltar 'pho bar nges mod/ 'on kyang las snang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / skabs thob gtso bor bshad pas phyi ma yang yang blang bya bar rigs so|zhes rig gnas chen po lnga'i nang tshan nas mchog tu gyur pa gso ba rig pa la nye bar mkho ba dran pa'i gsal byed 'di dpal ldan rgyud gzhung lag len la zhib mor thos stsal zhing / 'ga' zhig mkhas pa mang po'i dgongs bzhed so sor yong ba yid la brnag kyang / rang gi slob dpon gyi zhal rgyun la goms 'dris dang nyams myong gis gdeng cung zad thob pa rnams 'brel chags su bkod pa 'di/ gangs ri'i khrod du mkhas mang shes bya ni// ma dros rgya mtsho lta bur brjid na'ang // blo chung rus sbal spu rtser shes tshul gyis// slob rgyun gang yin dran pa'i gsalda byed du// mkhas rnams gzigs mor bzhad gad 'phel ba'i rgyu// rlung mkhris bad kun nyes gsum la sogs pa// so so'i go rim rgyab kyis phyogs pa 'di// em smyon rig pa ma zin rgyu rkyen gyis// sna tshogs spu tshogs gang shar smyon pa'i lugs// 'di ltar bgyid pas sman bla drang srong tshogs// brgyud pa dgyes pa'i byin rlabs mthu dpung gis// 'gro kun nad
kyi tsha gdung ma lus pa// bdag gi mang tsam thos pas grol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bka' drin gsum ldan gyi slob dpon 'brong byang pa mtshan smos par dka' ba bstan 'dzin tshe ring ngam stobs ldan dbang po zhes pa de nyid kyi zhal mnga'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun ji snyed cig myong ba'i tsha grang go ldog med tsam gyi bcos yul shes pas shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang yul gru chen po lha ldan du 'gro ba rnams nad kyi zug rngus mnar ba mang ba'i rnam g.yeng la brten bdag gi mthong thos gdeng ldan myong grub yod rigs blo rmongs pa'i tshigs bcad dang rnam dpyod 'dra 'grig pa bzhag med na'ang / lag len yod med o zob min pa'i rang blor gang yod dbul po'i phye khug bzhin dkrugs nas sde tshan du bkod pa 'di/bka'i blon po 'brong rtse ba'i zhabs 'bring tha shal ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nam ming gzhan smra bsam rin chen zhes 'bod pa rang lo 〈ldeklu mer 'byor pas rang nyid dang rigs mthun pa'i lha rje/ slob bu rigs brgyud bcas par phan slad lhag bsam kun nas bslangs te khro bor 'bod pa shing mo glang lo'i snon [snron] zla'i gral tshes bug gzugs dang / res gza' dkar po/ rgyu skar snga char byi bzhin phyi char gro bzhin dang 'grogs pa'i nyin lha ldan gasto la'i nye 'dabs 'brong shag shag chung bdud rtsi'i re skong du res pañtsa a mṛ tas ra ro/ res smyo res rnam g.yeng gi dbang du song ba bcas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyis rigs pa chad chod ngang nas bgyis pa'o// sor mo'i zlos gar ba rang gi mched grogs bon zhabs dge bsnyen ming can gyis bris pa 'dis kyang mkha' khyab gyi 'gro rnams bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig gi tsha gdung kun zhi nas mthar thug rnam mkhyen sman bla'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dza ga snyam//
spo/ / reg zig ne'u le'i rkyal pa/sman bla don grub/’
rtsom pa po ngo spyod mdor bsdus/gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po kong rong sman bla don grub ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos te spyi lo 1675lo la bkra shis 'bras spungs su sku 'khrungs/sku na chung dus nas blo rig shin tu bkra zhing / rig gnas spyi dang sgos su gso rig gi las la dung zhen che bas bka' drin zla med kyi sman bla tshe dbang dang / slob dpon gzhan phan bde chen rgyal po/ drung 'tsho ba sangs rgyas/skyabs mchog 'gro mgon chen po la sogs bsten nas/ gso dpyad kyi gzhung dang lag len la gsan sbyangs mdzad de/ brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma mang dag cig mchis pa las grags che ba shrī bha dra'am dpal bzang zhes pa sogs bskyangs/khong gis g.yu thog yon tan mgon po dang / brang ti yab sras/ zur mkhar khu dbon gyi bzhed srod man ngag gsang mdzod kyi zhal phyi ba dang gnyis su med pa rnams chu bo rgya mtshor thims pa dgos pa med pa ltar mkhyen te legs par bsdus te 〈dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i na ngag kun las zab gces yang bcud bsdus pa phan bde 'bum phrag 〉ces bya ba dang / nor bu'i bang mdzod dang 'dra ba'i 〈reg zig ne'u le'i rkyal ba 〉zhes pa sogs mdzad pa ma zad/ sngon dus gsar ma g.yu thog mgon pos thugs sras mchog gyur sum ston ye shes gzungs la gsungs la gsung 'phros kyi tshul du gnang ba byin rlabs che ba'i bla sgrub chos tshan so lnga'i grangs su bkod pa dpe thog tu tshig
donago bde zhing lag len gnad du 'dril ba snang yang blo 'dzin dka' bar brten lag len gzhan phan dar rgyas cher ma snang bas de dag thugs kyis ma bzod par 〈〈'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel tshigs su bcad pa kun gsal nam mkha' 〉〉zhes pa zhig kyang phyogs sgrig gnangs/ gzhan mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i gdan sa'i dwags la sgam po'i sprul sku nor bu rgyal mtshan gyis sbyin bdag byas nas sman bla don grub nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad de rgyud bzhi'i par sgam po par ma zhes pa gsar du par brkos gnangs/
spyi don dang po/ reg zig ne'u le'i rkyal pa las rdo rje pha lam gyi lhan thabs rin po che'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//oṃ ā thā/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren don kun grub pa nyid// lha mos sman mchog phul ba thugs rjes bsnoms// mtshan dpe zla med be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od//sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las las// rig pa'i ye shes bzhi dang yid las skyes// zhus len [lan]rgyud bzhi sku lnga lhun gyis 'grub// rigs lnga drangs [drang]srong chen por gus phyag 'tshal// khyad par phrin las bya grub las kyi rigs// phrag dog la sogs rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i nad// ma lus drung 'byin phyi rgyud mdo bzhi gsungs//drang srong don yod grub par gus phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i zer dang tsan+da [tsaṇ+ḍan]dri bsung ltar// sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs 'phags bod paṇa grub kun//gcig bsdus dkyil 'khor khyab bdag g.yu yi thog/ yon tan mgon po'i zhabs la spyi bos mchod// sangs rgyas gnyis pas mang mang lung bstan bzhin//rgyal rigs sku 'khrungs mkhas grub yongs kyi mgon// gang 'dul der ston dug gsum nad sel sman// bla ma zur dkar chos rje khu dbon rgyal// bzang bzang zab gnad mang po rdo rje'i rgya// gsal gsal gang la 〈yig 'bru gcig mi gsal〉ngor tshangs dbyangs gsungs// lhang lhang 'brug gi mgrin rnga'i sgra bzhin du// lhug lhug stsol mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skyongs// ༷༷༷ 〈yig 'bru gnyis mi gsal 〉mang mang skye bar rjes bzung mthus// brtson pas yang
yang mkhas grub zhabs la gtugs// shes pas zab zab man ngag mtha' yas kun// brtse bas mang mang skyobs phyir sbyin gyis longs// ༷ ༷ 〈tshig rkang gcig mi gsal〉/ / dzis [rdzas]kyi ngo bro rdo rje pha lam dpe// thog med gcod bstar nus pa ji bzhin du// nad kyi rnam grangs lag len grangs med kun//phyi rgyud phrin las lag len bco brgyad nas// stong dang rtsa gnyis cho gas mi 'joms med// slar yang lhan thabs rin chen ༷ ༷ 〈shog ngos gcig mi gsal/〉 brgyad brgya brgyad pa zur du bzhag pa'i lhag/ yongs grub tshe nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po// 'byung ba 'di skabs gso yul 'bring po yin//de ltar rnam grangs du mar phye na yang // nyes pa gsum du 'dus phyir nyes pa yis// dbye ba brgya dang rtsa gcig yongs grub sbyar// mdor bsdus bcos dgos brgya dang rtsa gcig go/༷ 〈tshig rkang gcig mi gsal〉/ / mdor bsdus sman dpyad zas spyod bzhir 'dus pas// sman la zhi byed bsil sbyor brgya re gnyis// drod sbyor nyis brgya zhe drug kun bsdoms pas// bzhi brgya rtsa brgyad 'byung zhing sbyongs byed la// drag sbyor re bdun 'jam sbyor nga brgyad bcas// bsdoms pas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung // dpyad la 'jam po brgyad cu rtsub po brgya// bcu bdun dril bas chig brgya go bdun 'byung //zas la phan zas brgya dang nyi shu drug/ gnod zas bco brgyad dril bas brgya zhe bzhi// spyod lam cung zad drag pa nyi shu drug/ dal ba brgya dang gnyis bcas brgya nyer brgyad// kun bsdoms stong dang rtsa gnyis nges par 'grig/gso thabs lag len sum brgya drug cu yang // mdor bsdus brtags thabs gso tshulha padzo hūm̐ dī rnyi gadzosna ba// cu gsum las// sngon 'gro lnga la lag len re re r+sharnyi sa// padzo dh+ri ༵ gh+nā snatānā m+bhi dang hūm̐ ༵ parnyi rnyi//gas spyashākhu [marnyid tsi] gadzosna t+ta~X/ /
sogs [sog] ma dkar me'i tshig [tshig] thang btang // cu gang li shi ltar bu brag zhun tig / shing mngar a ru sro lo rgun 'brum dang // skyu ru ba sha ka dang spang rgyan dkar// bzhi sbyor khrag la bcod [btsod]mdud bad kun la// pi ling smug por ma nu 'khrugs hong len// mkhris par bong dkar rlung la sle tres te// chu ser spos dkar 'du ba'i shas sbyar la// rlung la myos khu khrag mkhris gangs kyi chu// bad kun sbrang chu la sogs bshad na'ang // kun la chu khol phul ba nyes pa med// gre ba skad 'gags nad sel spyi sman yin//tshangs dbyangs skad kyi gdams pa bshad pa la// dgos pa sman dpyad zas spyod lnga yis bstan// dang po dgos pa'i don ni 'di lta ste// dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi lus can// lha chos pa la 'gro rnams grol byed pa'i//dam pa'i chos rgyun lung dang smin byed dbang // grol byed khrid sogs mchog dman kun 'bel dang // dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus su tshogs bshad rigs// mi chos pa la sgrung dang gtam smra dang // khyad par thun mong zung du 'jug pa'i las// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro mchod pa'i dbyangs// mang po'i tshogs dbus 'bel gtam bya bas mtshon// gang la'ang che dang 'gyur khugs ldan pa sogs// ngag gi yon tan ldan pa skad 'di gnad// 'di la lus kyi tsha grang ldan 'dus sogs// chas kyi che chung btang la snyoms dgos pas// khrag mkhris can yin chur gzhug g.ya' kyi'i thang // bad rlung sbrang rtsi cong zhi'i
gnon gcig dang bcu gcig sngo sbyor la// yan lag bdun te zhi byed lnga bcu bdun// de yang sde tshan lnga ru ma 'dus med// thal sman phye ma khan+da lde gur bsdu// sman chang thang la rin chen ril bu bsdu// sngo sbyor thang phye gang la gang dgos bsdu// gnyis pa las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum chos la// rung min bsten thabs rnam gnyis legs nyes dang // log gnon dang bcas bdun dang bshal dngos la// rung min ran min thub min rnam pa drug/ sngon 'gro nye ring shin tu nye ba gsum// sna sel ded dpon khaṇ+ḍa kha 'dzin dang // gnad kyi man ngag btang tshul btang dus lcag/ rlung gnon rnams la re re tsis pas dgu// 'don tshad gsum dang log gnon rnam pa bzhi// bya ra lnga dang rjes gcod spyi bye gsum// skyon gnyis yon tan gcig ste so drug go/ skyugs la rung min sngon 'gro nye ring gsum// sngon 'gro mi dgos gcig dang dngos gzhi la// drag 'jam gnyis dang btang tshul lcag 'don re// log gnon lnga dang rjes gcod rnam pa gsum// phan yon gcig ste nyi shu tham pa'o// sna sman rung min sbyar thabs phan yon dang // btang thabs re re lnga dang sna sbyangs la// mi rung phan yon sbyar ba btang thabs dang // log gnon gnyis te drug dang 'jam rtsi la// rung min sbyar ba gsum dang btang thabs gcig/ btang dus phanayon nyes dmig [dmigs] re re dgu// ni rba ha la rung min sbyor ba gsum// phan yon gnyis dang btang ba'i thabs tshul gcig/ thebs dang mi thebs lcag gcig bcu gcig go/ rtsa sbyangs sngon 'gro nye dang ring ba gnyis//sna sel mdung sman byang pa sbyar tshad sna// btang thabs theb rtags lcag rnams re re brgyad// log gnon drug dang rjes gcod phan yon re// bco brgyad de ltar sbyangs drug sngon 'gro bcas// bdun dril lag len brgya dang bcu gnyigs so// rtsub po'i dpyad la gtar kha brdeg thabs ni// rung min ran min sngon 'gro rnams gnyis gnyis// dus gsum dngos bzhi [ gzhi] snyal thabs
gdabs [gdab] thabs te// gdabs dmig [ dmigs]rgyas bsdus gnyis dang dmigs gsal [bsal] gcig/ khrag pra dbyung tshad re re log gnon drug/ skyon bzhi yon tan gcig ste nyi shu brgyad// me btsa' spra ba cho ga rung min bzhi// gdab thabs bzhi dang phyi rjes phan yon bcu// dug [dugs]la rung min bsil drod phan yon lnga// lum [lums]la rung min thabs gnyis phan yon lnga// byug pa rung min bya thabs phan yon lnga// thur ma rung min gnyis dang cha dpyad gcig/ gsang sa spyi bye gnyis gnyis cho ga gcig/brtegs [brdeg] thabs lag tshod gnyis gnyis 'chi ltas gcig/ log pa gnyis dang phan yon bcas bcu drug/ dpyad drug bsdoms pas drug cu re brgyad do// de ltar rtags [ brtag] thabs brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang // gso tshul zhe bdun zhi byed nga bdun dang // sbyongs byed brgya dang bcu gnyis dpyad re brgyad// kun dril sum brgya drug cu re drug 'byung // drug po shugs las thon phyir klan ka bral// zhes phyi rgyud rdo rje pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las le'u dang po'i dang po bsdoms tshigs kyi lhan thabs so//dang po/ reg pa rtsa'i lhan thabs/reg pa rtsa la spyi don bcu gsum las// dgu pa nad med rtsa rgyud mu tig phreng // ji ltar mi snyoms gyur na rkyen ngan ljong [sdong ]/ / gang [gong]jirgal nang po ma tshang rang tshe thung // sdod 'then nor dbul gzhi rtsa sngon nas dril//nazhan yang tha mal rtsa rgyud gsum po yang // pho rtsa sbom rag [rags]mo rtsa phra lhor gnyis// tsha rtsa drag rgyas 'gril mgyog [mgyogs]gnyis su 'khrul// de bzhin sbrum ma'i bu rtsa 'bur 'dril dang // tsha ba grim khung [mkhung]rtsa gnyis 2khrul so gsal[bsal]/ / byang chub sems rtsa rgyun ring 'jam mnyen dang //
grang rtsa zhan bul lhod pa 'khrul so gsal [bsal]/ / bcu pa tsha grang la shan 'byed pa la// rtsa rgyud mgyog [mgyogs]bul ji ltar 'phar gyur kyang // je cher mnan pa'i grim khrang [mkhrang]tsha ba dang // mgyog [mgyogs]kyang lhod stong ngo bo grang ba yin// nor 'phrang drug la khrag rtsa sbom khrung [mkhrang]dang //rlung rtsa sbom yang mnan na stong pa gnyis// sbom mam rgyal [rkyal]byed cha nas 'khrul so gsal[bsal]/ / rgyas tshad rgyug cing mnan na grim pa dang // stong tshad rgyug kyang mnan na stong pa gnyis// rgyug pa'i cha nas tsha grang 'khrul so gsal[bsal]/ / bad kun bying byed mnan na lhod pa dang // khrag rgan bying yang mnan na lcags skud 'dra// bying byed cha nas tsha grang 'khrul so gsal[bsal]/ / de ltar ma 'khrul nad ngos so sor bzung // zhes phyi rgyud rdo rje pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las reg pa rtsa'i lhan thabs te dang po'o//gnyis pa/ mthong ba chu'i lhan thabs/mthong ba chu la sa bcad rnam pa brgyad// zhib tu brtags na kun tu gsal gyur yang // deng song [sang] nye bar mkho ba snod kyi mdog/ dmar ser nag po'i ri mo tsam yang spang // thag ring khyer ba'i zhag lon chu snod kyang // dkar yol dzi [rdza]shing gtsang ma'i snod du khyer// btang dus tsam bsros blugs pa'i sgra la rtags// sho sho rlung yin cur cur mkhris pa yin//tig tig bad kun ldan 'dus rig pas brtag/ chu mdog ma nges ci ltar 'dug kyang rung // ku ya spris ma 'thug cing lbu ba chung // sen mo snum med gtsang mar chu thig [thigs]blugs// sran ma lta bu 'dril na tsha ba'i chu// pad+ma lta bu tshal zhing ku ya dang // spris ma srab cing lbu ba che na grang // lar ni stong hatshad chu mdog dmar dngas dang // khrag tshad chu mdog dmar la gar ba nyog pa
gnyis// kha dog dmar po'i cha nas 'khrul so gsal [bsal]/ /0 bad kun smug po smug la garadug [dugs]pa dang // chu ser chu mdog smug kyang [cing]dngas pa gnyis// kha dog smug po'i cha nas 'khrul so gsal [ bsal]/ /mkhal tshad chu mdog dmar la dwangs rnyog pa dang // mchin chu chu mdog dmar la smug nag dngas pa dang // mcher tshad chu mdog dmar la ljang ngam smug pa gsum// dmar po'i cha nas na lugs 'khrul so gsal[bsal]/ / grang ba'i mgo phur gab tshad ku ya mthug/ bad rlung grang ba ku ya med dam srab// chu mdog sngon po'i cha nas 'khrul so gsal [ bsal]/ / de dag ma 'khrul nad ngos so sor bzung // tsha chu ltar snang ldog tu ma btub na// ga bur ['ur] blugs nas bun long bskol te lta// de bzhin grang chu mi ldog pho ris dang //da li [lis] dbyi mong dka ra po'i phye btab bskol// slar yang grangs su bcug la bltas pas gsal// de nas gal chen gnad 'gags 'khrul so bzhi//rtag [rtag sa]dang ngo bo gnyis ka tsha ba dang // rtag sa dang ngo bro gnyis ka grang ba dang // phyi rtag [ rtags] tsha la ngo bo grang ba dang // ngo bo tsha la phyi rtag [rtags] grang ba bzhi// nad gzhi'i ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal//rtags kyi ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis bsal// bcos kyi ltar snang 'khrul so gom [goms]pas bsal// gom [goms]pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so bskyed kyis bsal// bcos bskyed ltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal// chu mdog ltar snang 'khrul so ku yas bsal// ltar snang lnga phrug tsha grang 'khrul so bsal// lce skam phan chad rlung 'bud yod pa yin// skam la rid na rlung las tshad kha mtho//skam la nag na rlung tshad phyed mar gnas// dmar la skam rtsub rlung nyid zang ma yin// ser la skam khog rlung dang mkhris par ldan// skya la skam khog bad rlung tsha ba yin// skya glegs [gleg] mdog med tsha ba byer zhing rnyog/ dmar 'jom ['jam] rlon zhing mnyen na nad dang bral// man ngag ldan pas zhu
'khyags mthong bas bsal [gsal]/ /gzhan yang blta reg dri bas ngos zung [bzung]la// lta ba'i sdom ni lce chu mig dang khrag/ kha dog lud pa 'khru skyugs ba spu skrangs// rnag spra rus mdog rtags [ brtag] pa bcu gnyis so// lce mdog dmar la skam pa rlung yin te// ser pos g.yog na khrag mkhris gnyan tshad yin// skya gleg 'jam rlon bad kun grang ba'o// chu mdog sngo zhing lbu ba che ba rlung // dmar ser ku ya mthug pa khrag mkhris tshad// dkar la mchil ma 'dra na bad kun no// mig har rlung la dmar ser khrag mkhris te// dkar po bad kun gyen log 'chi ltas so// khrag mdog dmar nag lbu ba che ba rlung // chu ser ser po dri che mkhris pa'i khrag/ dmar skya mchil 'dra bad kun mtshal 'dra zungs// lpags [pags] mdog sngo skya rlung yin dmar ser la// snum pa khrag mkhris skya sob bad gan no// lud pa skya sob rlung yin dmar po khrag/ ser po mkhris pa 'byar bag bad kun no// 'khru ba kur 'khrog rlung yin dmar ser mkhris//lbu bcas tsam pa be snab [snabs] bad kun no// skyugs pa rlung gi stong skyug mkhris pa la// dmar ser bad kun chu skyur gang zos skyugs// ba spu gyen log rnag yod khung bu rlung // skrangs po sngo skya rlung yin khrag mkhris la// dmar ser drod che skya sob bad kun no// rnag mdog sngo zhing dri ma che ba rlung // dmar ser dri ma che ba khrag mkhris gnyan// mdog dkar dri chung gar ba bad kun no//rus mdog dkar mdangs dmar smug skyon med de// skya ser sngo nag g.ya' chag skyon can yin//reg pa'i sdom ni rtsa rgyud drod gsang skran// rde'u dmu chu skrangs rnag zug rngu dang // chag thon gsang sa brtag pa bcu gnyis so// rtsa rgyud rgyal [rkyal]stong rlung yin grim mgyog [mgyogs] mkhris// bying gud bad kun grang ba dag tu 'dod// sha drod mi skom rlung la mkhris pa tsha// drod chung 'jam pa bad kun
shes par bya// gsang ba nyes gsum stod smad don snod gnad// me gsang thur gsang ji bzhin nad ngos bzung // skran ni phyi skran mthong la bar skran zin// nang skran zabs su zhugs pas zas la 'khrin// rdo'u chu sri so tham khu tshur bcang // dran med rgyal [brgyal]zhing sha skam byin sha chung // 'phangs ['phongs]su mdzub mos brtags pas 'phyo n+da 'dred// zug n+da rting [gting]zug sha sman nal nul 'byung // dmu chu phyi nang bar chu tsha grang ldan// phyi chu skrangs che bar chu skrangs pa chung // nang chu dbug [dbugs] 'tshang rtse chung drag tu sprug/ tsha chu rtsa chu tsha la skom dad che// grang chu rtsa dal chu sngo skom dad chung // skrangs po skye 'bri mi brtan rnag dka' rlung // dmar po zug che rnag myur khrag mkhris gnyan// skya sob zug chung rnag dka' bad gan te// rnag ni ma smin skrangs po sra zhing mkhregs// smin nas mer mer byed pa 'bri mig 'ong //se ba rgod po'i rgyab 'dra rnag yod phug/ zug rngu rma nang mde'u yod med rtags// dal bus rma skor mnan na bzod pa chung // chag pa ma la bu thog chag pa dang // smyug gu kha dang sdum chag grum pa bzhi// de yang rma can rma med brtags par bya// thon pa dgye rgu mi shes shing ltar gyong // chag thon gnyis kur ma 'chus drang por 'then// chag kha chag mtshams bral te nyag ge 'byung //de ni rang 'grig bsgrig la shing chas bcings// thon pa gang 'bur 'phul la bde ching [chings]bya// gsang la rang gsang mda' gsang rnag gsang gsum//de rnams gang rung rnag chu e 'debs lta//dri ba'i sdom ni rgyu rkye na nad yun dang // ldang dus gom [goms] pa me drod lto ba stobs// skom dang gnyid gzer dran pa bcu gnyis so// rgyu ni yang rtsub bsil bas rlung bskyed cing // tsha skyur snum dro zos na mkhris pa bskyed//lco snum bsil btul [rtul]bad kun bskyed pa 'i rgyu// rkyen ni sems las lto dang gnyid chag rlung // drag shul nyin gnyid rkyen gyis mkhris pa bslong
[slong ]/ / rlan grang dal ches slong rkyen bad kun no// nad yun zla ba phyed tshun gsar pa ste// nyi shu bar ma zla gcig phar 'das rnying // blo bur nad la nyin zhag dus tshod dpag/ ldang dus dgong dang tho rang [rangs] ldang ba rlung // gung gnyis mkhris pa srod snga bad kun ldang // gom [goms]pa bsil gnod drod bcud 'phrod pa rlung // drod gnod bsil ba 'phrod pa mkhris pa ste// lci snum bsil ba gnod cing tsha dang rno// yang rtsub 'phrod pa bad kun grang ba'o// me drod rlung gi mi snyom [snyoms]mkhris pa che// bad kun grang ba me drod chung ba'o// lto ba rlung gi sra la mkhris pa snyi// bad gan can ni lto ba bar mar 'gyur// gzer zug nges med 'pho ba rlung yin te// phur pa btab 'dra par zug khrag mkhris gzer// sboms [sbom] thems gtan [brtan] pa bad kun na lugs 'dod// dran pa gsal ba rlung yin za zi mkhris// mi gsal rmongs pa bad kun can du 'dod// de ltar rtags [brtag]thabs sum cu rtsa drug rgyu// ma 'dus stong dang drug brgya'i nad mi srid// khyad par ma smin rims la drang [grang]shum dang // rgyas nas gnyan tshad 'jug [mjug]nas stong tshad rnams// mi 'byung mi srid tsha ba gso skabs 'phrul// rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshod dang // gnas sa nyin zhag zas zos gom [goms]pa bcu// 'di bstun sgo nas 'khrul med ngos bzung gces// des ni nam yang 'khrul med pha khol gsungs//gso tshul dgu yis nad dang gnyen po sprad// ma rtog [rtogs]dogs bcas gdengs ma thob pa'i nad// byi la 'jab pa lta bu'i sad mdas bcos//ngos zin nges pa rnyed cing gdings [gdengs] thob na// spo la dar phyar lta bur dngos su bcos// gnyen po thog tu mi 'bab nad lam zungs[gzud]/ / rta rgod dkyus su 'dzud pa lta bur bcos// sngar bcos nad la dman lhag log pa gsum// brtag la bskyar [skyar] mo nya len bzhin du
bcos// stobs chen nad la sman spyad [dpyad]zas spyod bzhi// lag gtod mi sha 'phrang 'phrad lta bur bcos// stobs chung nad la spyod lam zas sman dpyad// skas gdong [gdang]lta bur mas 'dzegs rim pas bcos// rkyang pa'i nad la dpa' bos dgra 'dul bzhin// de gzhil gzhan la gnod med sbyor bas bcos// ldan 'dus nad la 'du ba cha snyoms ces[gces]/ / gtso bos dme shor 'khrugs 'dum lta bur bcos// kun la gnod bya la sogs chos bcur sbyar// mdzo khul lugs [lug] khal lta bur mtshams 'tsham pas bcos// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las mthong ba chu yi lhan thabs te gnyis pa'o//gsum pa/ zhi byed thang le'i lhan thabs/gnyis pa gso thabs lag len bco brgyad la// zhi byed sde lnga sbyongs byed le'u bdun// dpyad drug dang po zhi byed thang sde la// gnad kyi tsha sel bcu bdun rigs kyi brgyad// kha 'thor bcu gcig chig thang bcu bzhi ste// tsha sel lnga bcu grang sel sbyor sde'i rigs// bcu gcig chig thang bcu gnyis nyer gsum bcas// spyir sdom thang sde bdun cu don gsum las// mgo thang gsum steng nya rus go snyod sdeb// thang gis bad rlung mgo 'khor sel bar gsungs// phag thod 'u su sngo sga sdebs pa'i thang // bad mkhris mgo 'khor chang nad sel ba'i mchog/ mgo thang gsum steng g.ya' kyi a byag dang //'dzin pa bsnan pas mgo ba'i [bo'i]tshad nad zhi// gzhog [gzhogs]phyed ya ma 'khyug cing gzer ba 'joms// nad tshabs che na de steng gu gul dang //dom mkhris bong dkar gangs thig [thigs] khur rtsa dang // 'khun pa dros [gros]'debs rdo dregs [dreg] sbyar ba yis// mgo nad khrag mkhris ya ma
gnyan tshad kyi// klad gzer rgyas pa ar la gtod par byed// gzhan yang rlung shas che na sle tres bsnan// rgyas tshad gtso bo brgyad pa thang 'dis phul//khrag shas che na 'bras gsum bsnan la btang // gser mdung dngul mdung 'tshog [mtshog] gsang gtar ba shis// tshad gzhug rlung kha mtho na gu gul bsnan// lcags phye lnga thang dngas ma mig tu blugs// khong btang stobs chen yun lon mig rtsa gtar// mig nad rims la nyer ma 'dug spang rtsi bcu gnyis pa// lcags phye lnga pas phul btang bde ba gter[ster]/ / ru rta gnyis thang khong btang rna bar blugs// tshabs che ljon shing gtar zhing bu gar ga bur gseng // yun lon 'ba' sam sman mar bsten pa bsngags// skyer khaṇa gdus khur gur dom phye btab btang // smin dbrag mes bsdom gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor bya// gzhu rgyud sngas la mgo 'phyang gan rkyal nyal// chod dka' dar thod zor pa spru ma dang // shing tsha a yu puṣ+ṭha'i ring [ reng] bu rdzangs[brdzangs]/ / yang na gla tsi dom mkhris thun re re// khye'u lo brgyad chur sbyar bud med btang // bu mo lo brgyad chur sbyar skyes par btang // sna khrag nges par chod ces mkhas dbang gsungs// snya lo gsum dang in+d+ra bzhi thang sdebs//de steng lo btsan bsnan pas mkhas khyad thon// a ru bzhi pa'i steng du shug tsher dang // gze ma sum steng rgya tsha bsnan pa zab// 'bras bu gsum dang ma nu bzhi thang bsdeb// gdus grang btang bas rlung khrag 'khrugs rims la//chu dngas nor bu chu steng bzhag pa bzhin// nad rnams ma lus rang bzhin dngas par 'gyur// des na 'di la nor bu chu dngas zer// ma nu bzhi thang tshad ldan man ngag tu// ma nu sle tres cha mnyam ka ri mnyamakan ta ka ri de gnyis mnyam/ / sga skya tshwa 'debs sbyar la zhal shes so// glo tshad rims la sga skya ga dur rjes// de steng go snyod sro lo bsnan pa yis// ma smin tsha ba smin cing rlung rims sel// ba tig hong dkar sdebs pas rgyas tshad 'joms// stong tshad
dzā ti thang [thong]tsher bal tshi sbyar// gab tshad mthong sgo pi ling sbyar ba'i phye//rnying tshad spang tsi spyi zhur hong len sbyar// rnyog tshad sing ldeng [seng ldeng] thang khu ba chus bya// 'gram [ 'grams] tshad ba sha spang rtsi hong len sdebs//'khrugs tshad tshos gsum ba sha ka yis 'joms// rims tshad de ba ga ser me par pa ta// dug tshad bong nga dkar dmar yu gu shing // de dag dngos bstan gsungs shing shugs bstan du// sngo sbyor blon po spun mang kha bsgyur sdebs//rgyas par ma nu'i 'khrul 'a khor chen mor ltos// sle tres gsum steng kyi lce spang tsi dang // gu gul sdeb pas dreg la lhag par phan// chig thang phabs kyi thang gi sa tsam [rtsam]pa 'ju// dbyi mong tshig thang sngo ngad ma zhu —'ju// 'bras dang zho btsos gang rung 'khru ba gcod// gson khrag dron mo gang rung khrag bog sel// go snyod thang gis mig mi phyed [phyid]cing sel// gu gul zho gnyis sgog skya srang brgyad sogs// tshad ni dkon mchog skyabs kyi don khrid las// sman gyi tshad ni son cha rdog gcig la// zho gang de brgyad srang gcig spar ba gang //srang gnyis khyor gang srang bzhi snyim pa gang // srang brgyad bre phyed bcu drug bre gang ste// snga phyi nyis 'gyur skam po'i gzhal tshad yin// rlon pa'i sman rnams de yi nyis 'gyur bzhug [gzhug]/ chu sogs gsher ba srang gcig lag mthil gang // srang gnyis khyor gang srang bzhi snyim gang phul// chu srang bcu drug phul bzhi bre gang ngo // zhes pas kun la de ltar shes par gyis// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las zhi byed thang le'i lhan thabs gsum pa'o//bzhi pa/ phye ma'i lhan thabs/zhi byed gnyis pa phye ma'i sde tshan la// rgyal po ga bur sbyor ba bcu gsum
dang // blon po gur gum bdun pa bcu bzhi la// tsan+da [tsan+dan] bsnan pa brgyad pa bcu bzhi dang // ga bur bsnan pa dgu pa bcu bzhi bcas// khyon bsdoms zhe gnyis rje'u gtso bo brgyad// kha bsgyur bcas pa bcu dang sna tshogs dmangs// kha 'thor so gcig tsha sel dgu bcu drug/ grang sel rgyal po se 'bru sum cu tham// blon po da lis bcu bzhi rje'u bdun// sna tshogs dmangs sbyor bco lnga grang sel kun// sdom pas re drug kun dril brgya re gnyis//de la dang po ga bur sbyar thabs drug/ lnga pa bdun dgu bcu bzhi sbyor ba ni// bdun pa bdud ñtsa bsil zhun sbyor ba dang // dgu pa zla zer dri med sbyor ba dang // bcu bzhi rin chen zhags pa'i sbyor ba dang // nyer lnga tsha ba gting 'don rgyal po rnams// ༷ 〈yig chung 'ga' mi gsal〉/snyan ming mkhas khyad ngo mtshar bzhi phrug [sprug]lugs// kha bsgyur zla zer dri med sbyor ba la// ga bur spang nas gla gur gtsor bskyed na// gnyan tshad glo tshadagazer thung nad la mchog/ drug pa ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga la// gtso bo ga bur thun skyed ka ra ni// gtso bo'i drug 'gyur sbyar ba kun la 'dre ['gre]/ /bsil sbyor steng nas drod gsum shing tsha 'phri// hong len bong dkar tigha ba sha ka/ bsnan pas rgyas tshad 'joms pa'i tho ba yin// sro lo shing mngar rgun 'brum a krong bsnan// glo tshad mun 'thib sangs byed ston zla yin// spa yag ltar zhun rgya ru sa 'dzin bsnan// glo rnag 'dren byed 'phrul gyi zhags pa yin//zangs thal mu zi phur thal rgya mtshal bsnan// glo rnag skem byed nyi ma lnga pa yin//pi ling lde tshos mu zi zangs thal dang // phur thal bsnan pas bad gan ljan ljin lu// glo rnag skem la rta gdong me dang 'dra// bse ru kha sha rgya ru sha ru bsnan// rlung glo 'thing [thang]po 'gogs shing glo rnag skem// yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga bsil sbyor steng // mu zi zangs thal rgya ru gwa dor gnyis// sro lo shing mngar rgun 'brum ltar bu sdeb// sbrang rtsis ril sde gang rung btang ba yis//
glo rnag 'dren skem kun gyi rgyal po yin// chu srin sder mo ge sar rnam gnyis phri//khyung sder dkar sprug dpa' bo dka ra ser bsnan// dug tshad dmag dpung 'joms pa'i rnam rgyal yin// se 'bru bse yab 'u su ltar bu bsnan// smug po tsha ba rgyas pa'i gnyan [gnyen]po mchog/ ar nag ut+pal ge sar spang spos phri// sbal rgyab cong zhi chu ser sman gsum bsnan// sha ru [rus]rtsa yi 'bras nad drung nas 'byin// ut+pal ge sar rdo dreg spu shel phri// dngul chu sing lding [seng ldeng] chu ser sman gsum bsnan// klu gdon chu ser nag po bya khyung dngos// gong ltar phri steng gza' dug dkar nag dang // gu gul dkar nag ti lo'i sha khrag bsnan// steng gdon gza' la phyag na rdo rje 'gran// dug nyung bong dkar btsod mdud mon cha ra// ka ped sdebs pas rgyu gzer rnying pa'i rigs// tsha 'khru chu bo gyen bzlog 'khrul 'khor yin// ar nag dzā ti shing tsha zi ra dkar// ge sar chu srin sder mo 'bu sug phri// smad 'bras gsum dang sdig srin shug tsher can// btsod mdud brag zhun mkhal ma zho sha bsnan//dngas ma smad lhung mkhal rtsa 'gra ma ['grams] byer sel// ge sar chu srin sder mo spu shel phri// se 'bru da li [lis]sha ru dur thod thal// bsnan pas tsha chu grang chur bsgyur zhing skem// spang spos ge sar rdo dreg 'bras gsum 'phri//lcags sbrul a wa mdung rtse lcags phye dang // go snyod skyer khaṇa sdeb pas mig gi nad// dmar tshag ling tog sha 'dzer bcos sdug [rdugs]sel// gong stong [steng]da byid sdig srin dbang po lag/ bre ga snang ba dgu 'gyur 'bras bu rngo//sdeb pas dar ma khrag mkhris 'khru skyen gyis// de ltar kha bsgyur bcu drug gzhung nas gnyis// kun mkhyen brang ti'i khyad chos e ma ho//stod khrag sro lo bcu gcig bsnan pas sel// ༷ 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉ba 'os phul// mtshal dom a wa mdze tsha bzhi// lud pa rnag khrag lu na bsnan// dmar na mtshal dom rgya skyegs bsnan// rnag khrag 'dres na rgyu chen
bzhi// shu mo za yi snan [bsnan]sbyor mchog/ bdud tsi gang gsham [gangs sham]ñtsa bzhin btags// ba yi 'o mas phul la btang // glo gso rnag 'dren gcod pa'i mchog/ bde [bden] rdzun lag tu long na gsal// sro lo spang rgyan zi ra dkar// cu gur ghing tsan+da [tsan+dan]gnyis// ut+pal shing mngar a krong dkar// spa yag ltar bu glo rnag 'dren// gtso cher rgyud kyi dgongs pa long // mchin nad tsha ba bcos pa'i thabs// ba sha gur gum brag zhun thang //gur gum mchog bdun dag gis sel// gur gum gi wang ba sha ka/ ut+pal pri yang brag zhun sbyar// tsan+da [tsan+dan]ga bur tsha stobs dris// mchin tshad rab 'bring tha ma sel// gtar sbyangs gang 'os rig [ rigs] pas dpyad//mchin nad grang bar gnas 'jog bsten// bde byed snyom ldan bzang po drug /se 'bru da lis tsha ba gsum// shing tsha gangs thig [thigs]tsha la dang // ma nu pa tra la phugs [phug]'bru// kun dang cong zhi gser mdog mnyam// phye ma chu 'am thang gis dbul// bad gan skya smug lhen skran dang // sha [ k+ṣa] ya mig ser mkhris pa'i rigs// rno dbyig dug sogs sprug po'i skran// bad mkhris las gyur pho mchin gyi// tsha grang nad rnams sel ba'i mchog/ gangs thig [thigs]gi waṃ chang dang sbyar// mchin lu glo mi lu la bsngags// mcher tshad a ru bdun pa'am// mcher tshad sel ba'i gur gum bdun// tsan+dan ga bur tshad stobs sbyar// grang nad rgyam tsha bzhi thang ngam//gnyis pa blon po gur gum bdun sbyor la// tsan+da [tsan+dan]bsnan pas tsan+da [tsan+dan] brgyad sbyor dang // de steng ga bur bsnan pas ga bur dgu/ /bcu bzhi sum 'gyur bzhi bcu zhe gnyis sbyor// tsha ba'i nad rigs mi sel ga la srid// khyad par byis pa'i tsha ba kun sel mchog/gsum pa rje'u gtso bo brgyad pa la// gzhung nas 'khrul 'khor dgu dang man ngag tu// gla gur shu dag stag sha sbyor ba'i phye// stod lugs gtso brgyad
bcu gnyis khyad sbyor can// gnyan tshad rgyas shing smin dang smin long med//rtsa grim mig chu dmar ser skom dad che// mdor na khrag mkhris gnyan tshad rigs kun 'joms// de nas shu dag 'phri la 'dzin lo sdebs// zur lugs gtso brgyad bcu gnyis myang [myong]grub ma// gnyan rims kun la me steng chu ltar 'joms// gtso bo brgyad dang nor bu chu dngas bsres// sprin bral zla zer tshad rnying ldan tshad sel// de steng ltar [ ltar]bu rgun 'brum li ga dur//shing mngar spang rgyan dkar po spa yag rtsa// a krang [krong]wa yi glo skam zi ra dkar// bdud rtsi lo ma sbyar bas nyi shu lnga// tshad pa che chung glo dang rus la zhen// glo chen 'gogs dka' dbug [dbugs]thung gyen mi pher// glo yis rgyal [brgyal]zhing 'tshangs nas dbugs bsdud [sdud]dka'// 'gul na glo skyugs byed cing nyal mi bde// lud pa mang du lu zhing sna tshul [ mtshul]'gags// ro stod tsha zhing lci la rgyang [brgyangs]shing khengs// tshad gzer tsha sub [subs] glo ba khrag rgyas sogs// glo nad brgyad la sman 'di sleb pas chog/bzhi pa sna tshogs dmangs sbyor so gcig la// a gar brgyad pa zhes sam srog 'dzin brgyad// de steng 'bras gsum ma nu bzhi thang sdeb// bcu bzhi rlung khrag gzer dang stod 'tshang dang // ma smin ri thang mtshams la bdud rtsi 'dra// de steng tsan+da [tsan+dan]gnyis dang bzang po drug/ gu gul ba tig hong len ko byi la// sha chen 'dzin pa tsher sngon a byag gnyis// se 'bru sro lo dkar po ka ra sbyar// sbyor ba 'di ming a gar sum cu lnga/ / rus khu chu chang 'du ba bstun la phul// rlung mkhris bad kun 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad//stod gzer dbugs mkhris ['khril] gnyan tshad rlung gsum 'thabs gli skam thang bsud grum bu bar ta [rta ]dang // stod tshad smad grang stod smad go log dang // bla gnyan thor nad gnyan [gnyen]po bcos mi len// gang la
gang mtshams ['tsham] rta yis bsgyur byas na// phan yon gang [gong]bshad nad la theng [thengs]chog yin// zhi byed kun gyi rgyal po srog ster 'di// rgyal khams kun la dkon te gces par bzungs [zungs]/ / dam med rgya yis btab po sa mā ya// tsan dan brgyad steng ltar bu ru rta dang // de steng spang brgyan [rgyan] a krong zi ra dkar// ut+pal hong len sug 'dra spa yag rtsa//'bri ta sa 'dzin sbyar phye sbrang gis bsgyur// 'di ni glo sman mang sbyor chen mo ste//glo rnag skems 'dod de steng go dor gsum// dngul chu zangs thal sdebs pas khyad par 'phags// rlung ldan dzā ti pi ling sde tshon [tshan]sdebs// glo tshad yun ring rnying zhen ga pur sdebs// khrag 'khrugs che na tshos gsum thang gis phul// bad gan che na se 'bru da li [lis]sdebs// chu nad nyi 'bru da lis sdig srin sdeb// glo nad brgyad kyi spyi 'joms chen mo'o// gi wang dgu steng 'u su spri yang ku// skyu ru ma nu glang chen bcu gsum pa// smug po mchin tshad rgyas dang gyen brdol la// chu grang phul btang sman thun lnga yis chog/ dgu steng 'jib tsi bong dkar skyu ru sdebs// mchin tshad kun sel tsha chu grang chur bsgyur// gi waṃ dgu steng tsan+da [tsan+dan]su mi sman// gla tsi bse ru mtshal dang a ru ra// dbang po'i ril bu mthong brgyud ldan pas sbyar// dug nad mchin par rgyas te skrangs pa sel// ghi wang dgu steng bdud rtsi sum sbyor sdeb// tsha mkhris kun la mchog tu phan pa bsngags// a ru bcu steng bzang drug smad 'bras gsum// bre ga gla rtsi go yu rtsa ba lnga// sbyar ba 'ba' sam lha yi lung brtan [bstan] zer// mkhal 'gram ['grams] byer rgyas lhung dang 'gram ['grams]pa sogs// mkhal gcong mkhal ma'i nad rigs spyi 'joms zab//bcu steng sdig srin gze lcam khu byug rtsa// sdebs pas chu 'gags tsha ba kun sel zhing // khyad par rde'u'i chu lam drangs par 'gyur// brag zhun dgu steng go [ko]byil dres ma'i 'bru// tshig thub phur nag khaṇ+ḍa sdebs pa yis// gnyan
rims pho bar babs pa'i glang thabs 'joms// ༷ 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉tsan+da [tsan+dan]bsil gsum mtshal// ha bo gang chung ri dkon [skon]bdud rtsi lo// sbyar bas gnyan rims rgyu gzer dmar ser ljang // za khu la sogs ji ltar 'khru yang 'joms// yang na gur gum gla rtsi bdud rtsi lo// rgyu gzer rang thod 'dzom yang mchog tu phan// 'khru mdog bsgyur byed dmar nag bya rkang tshos// ser na dug nyung dom mkhris be+e snab [snabs]la// sug smel thog rus smug na re ral dang // khrag rkang za khu skyi 'bru mi mkhris sdebs//zhes kyang gang tshogs gang la gang dgos sbyar// gnyan tshad chog [chogs]nas 'khru nad spyi ltar bya// 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉nyi shu gzhir bzhag la//de steng khyung sder re ral bong nga dmar// ༷ 〈 tshig rkang gcig mi gsal〉/ / g.yu rnying mu tig lcags phye bse ru mtshal// sbyar ba'i phye ma ldum gsum thang gis phul// ༷ 〈tshig rkang gcig mi gsal〉/ / ༷ 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉 med pa'i chu rgyun dngos// se 'bru bse yab ma nu ltar bu lnga//brag zhun spri yang re skon lug ru smug/ skyu ru chu rtsa smag shad chu bskol dbul//'dus nad smug po byer rgyas 'gying 'dril sogs// bad tshad smug po 'joms byed tshangs pa yi// dam bca' 'di ldan 'khor lo'i mtshon dang mtshungs//bad rlung gnyis kyi tsha ba mgo phur te// grang ba'i 'og tu tsha ba gab pa la//dang po gur gum bsnan pa'i se 'bru lnga// yang na bad smug sel ba'i se 'bru brgyad// da lis sbyar btang bad rlung mgo phur bshu// de nas tshad rtags dngos su ston pa'i dus// rnying tshad spyi ltar bcos sam rgyas tshad ltar//bcos pas gab tshad dud khung rgya skad [skar]'byed// lo zla yun 'das rnying pa'i tsha ba sel// ༷ 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉ga dur ba le ka/ rgya spos spang spos rdo dreg 'bu sug hang // mi thod 'brug rus ga bur ba skyur sdeb//stod smad don snod sha lpags chu rgyus kyi// tsha ba 'gram ['grams]'khrug rgyas
stong gab rnying rnyog/ 'gram ['grams]dug tshad rnying 'byer zhing zhen pa kun// sprin bral zla ba nor bu chu dngas 'dra// a gar 'bras gsum sle tros stag tsher sga// big paṇa go snyod spos dkar ge sar gsum// sre long thong [thang]phul stong tshad me rlung khams// lce bsil sa chus 'joms gyur gdon mi za//gzhan yang se 'bru skyu ru brag zhun btul// lcags phye dom gyi mkhris pa spri yang ku// gangs thig [thigs] khur mang chu rtsa mi sog thal// dngul chu mu zi dri chen go [ko]byi la// ma nu hong len lug ru smug po rnams// ka ra bzhi 'gyur rang rang sman rta sbyar// dug dang smug po khrag tu 'khru skyugs dang // gab tshad tshad rnying ma zhu glang thabs sogs// ldan 'dus nad rnams 'joms pa'i rdo rje yin// bzhi tshan dgu dril 〈yig 'bru lnga mi gsal〉/ / kun la dngul chu dug phral btul ma dang // dbang po'i ril bu dam ldan rnyed na bsres//lcags la ngar dang gser 'gyur tsi bzhin du// man ngag bsil sbyor nas pa stong 'gyur bskyed// ru rta drug steng spri yang re skon pa// ut+pal 'u su sga dang byi tang ka/ bya thal sdeb pas g.yu dril bcu gsum pa// smug po gyen du rdol dang thur du lhung // ma zhu pho bar lhung dang khong tshad lhod// ser po chu skyur skyugs dang sgreg bcams sel// yang na gi wang gur gum brag zhun sdebs// ru rta dgu po smug po tshad rgyas sel// drug steng bse yab 'u su ltar bu dang // ma nu ut+pal spri yang cong zhi sdeb// a ru brag zhun 'du ba spyi ru snyoms// 'di yang 'dus nad smug po'i spyi sman yin// drug rting [steng]tshig thub gla rtsi ko byi la// dres 'bru sbyar bas srin glang mi len no// tig ta brgyad steng g.ya' kyi dug mo nyung // nim pa gur gum sbyar ba'i phye ma dang // se 'bru lnga pa stag [ltag]sprod de rjes sbyangs// sha [ k+ṣa] ya nag po za phrug spu byi sel// brgyad steng 'dzin lo gla gul stag sha sdebs// gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug mig ser sel// brgyad steng a ru brag zhun skyu ru ra// gur gum dom mkhris ga dur
dug nyung sbyar// gung gnyis btang bas gser sku 'dra ba'i nad// sel byed zla ba'i chu rgyun bla na med// spos dkar bcu pa skyer pa seng ldeng thang // phul bas dreg grum zug rngu myur du gcog/ gur gum bcu gsum steng du sug smel bsnan// byi tang ma ru lang thang chig thub dkar// khang [khong] srin glang thabs rigs dang ya ma 'joms// bcu gsum steng du dbang ril dzā ti dang //drod sman bsnan pas rgyal blon bcu drug ste // sbyor ngan 'joms pa'i gnyan [gnyen]po bla na med// gur gum bcu gsum brag zhun lcags kyi phye// spri yang ku dang su mi bong nga dmar// cu gang dzā ti suklel a gar nag/ dpa' ser 'om bu se rgod ka ra sbyar// sbyor ngan ma lus 'joms pa'i gnyan [gnyen]po yin// bcu gsum steng du 'u su bze [gze]ma dang // rgya tsha sdig srin gser gyi phye ma sdebs// gur gum bco brgyad mchin mkhris tsha ba'i chu// mkhal sgang [lgang]chu 'gags 'bam rig [rigs] nad yul 'byin// yang na gur gum bcu gsum gzhung bzhin steng // gser gyi phye ma sdig srin 'u su dang // lcam 'bru rgya tsha gze ma dung 'dra'i 'bu// 'ug sgro se 'bru spri yang chu ma rtsi// sngon mo chab 'dren sdebs pas nyi shu lnga// mchin pa zag [zags]dang sbyar dug chur gyur sogs// tsha chu kun la rdzing bug brdol dang mtshungs// 'di ni dam ldan sman pa'i khong snying yin// rgyas par kho bo'i reg zig 'khrul 'khor ltos// de nas cu gang bdun steng skyu ru ra// bung [bungs] mnyam sbyar ba bde byed chu bsgyur chung / / de steng gser bye sdig srin nyi dga' dang // mchin sman tsi'u gze ma 'u su la// khrag skem gtso bo kun dang mnyam sbyor 'bring / / chen po de steng dung 'dra 'khor los bsgyur// am+bha kun dang mgo mnyam sbyar ba'i phye//chu rigs bco lnga 'dren cing dang ga 'byed// tsha ba mi skye bad rlung rang sar zhi//de phyir bde byed sbyor ba khyad par 'phags// 〈yig 'bru drug mi gsal〉ga bur sdebs// bu chung tshad pas stod khun ['khun]lu ba sel// gnyan dang
gdon la gla tsi gu khul sdebs// li shi drug dang rgun 'brum bdun pa bsres//'argun bcu gcig phan yon khyad par 'phags// de steng srog 'dzin brgyad sdebs spos dkar phri// spang brgyan [rgyan]bco lngas bad rlung glo nad dang //khrag 'khrugs stod 'tshang gre 'gags sel ba'i mchog/ 〈yig 'bru bzhi snadzo gh+nā pa〉spra ༵ shā snrisnroshā thalaze//ga shārnyi hūm̐ gārdzu ny+pha spug sbyir+sha ma༈༈ /rdza/ sasbyo snanab gh+nā hūm̐ yin// sbang skam byi sa shar bltas chang btsos bdug/gnyis pa grang sel se 'bru sbyor ba ni// se 'bru rgyal blon gsum dang mtshon cha bcas// se 'bru bzhi gcig lnga gsum drug pa gcig/ brgyad pa bcu bzhi bcu gsum cur ni [nis]gcig/ brgyad steng dong gra bsnan pa'i tshad ldan ni// se 'bru thun bzhi dong gra thun gsum la// pi ling thun gnyis shing tsha sugral re// sbyar ba tshad ldan mkhas pa'i 'grel bshad lugs//gcig shos se 'bru gtsor bskyed gzhan cha mnyam// gur gum bsnan pas dngas ma gnas su 'jog/ yang na se 'bru thun gsum shing kun phyed// lga skya thun gnyis kha ru tsha thun phyed// ltar bu thun gcig sbyar ba tshad ldan no// de nas brgyad pa dang po'i tshad ldan ni// dong gra bsnan pa'i lnga pa tshad ldan te//dzā gul ka kol thun re sdebs pa'o// gzhan yang se sug shing tsha zho re re// pi ling zho gsum gzhir bzhag kha bsgyur rnams// zho re rang rang kha 'dzin thun bskyed sbyar// chang bran 'dam btags ril bu sran ma tsam// lnga bdun dgu sogs chu bskol phul la btang // dharmā swa mi'i ril dkar sum cu ste// phan pa'i yon tan gzhung las zab khyad rno//gnyis pa blon po da lis zho gang la// nal sham zho do shing tsha zho gsum dang // suklel bca' sga pi ling bzhi la drug/ rim bzhin bur dkar srang gang tshad ldan no// gzhung nas kha bsgyur lnga dang man ngag tu// lcags phye
sdebs pa skya sbab [rbab]'joms pa'i mchog/gsum pa rje'u gnod sbyin rgod ma kha// rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog pun ṭa ri// sdeb pas grang mkhris ma zhu mig ser sel// 'di dang gzhung nas kha bsgyur drug ste dgu//bzhi pa sna tshogs dmangs sbyor bco brgyad la// suklel bcu steng rgya tsha ze'u tsha// gser bye mo des lgang pa'i rdo skran bshig/ shu dag ma nu srang re bca' sga phyed// khar tsha zho do sbyar ba tshad dang ldan// grang ba'i chu la shing kun cur ni'i [nis]steng // zangs thal sbyar ba skem sman man ngag zab// da trig bdun steng skyin [spyin]bzang skam po sre// shing mngar drug steng pu shel bsnan pa zab// byi tang bdun pa'i so ma ra dza de// 'di skabs mi gsal thang phrom dkar po'i 'bru// mgo srin sha tshil sbyar ba sna la bdug/ gzhang srin mar rnying sbyar ba'i reng bu gzhugs[gzhug]/ pags srin snum dang sbyar ba'i lde gu byug/ mngon sum me 'dra gcig nas lnga bar bskyed// kun mnyam a ru nus ldan bsregs thal sbyar/spyi don gsum pa 'jug [ mjug]gi lag len la// lug nyi span [spen]pa rigs ldan zin phung med// zla ba gro zhun la sogs bzang 'jam ['dzom]dus// yangs gtsang dben zhing mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i gnas// shar phyogs kha bltas sman bla'i gzungs sngags bzla// rigs lnga'i rang gdangs 'byung ba lnga yi sman// skye dgu'i 'byung ba 'phel zad snyoms pa'i phyir// sbyor ba tshad med cha mnyam gtso nyis 'gyur// gzhan rnam [rnams]thun re kha 'dzin phyed thun tsam// tshad bshad gang [go nga] du bshad pa'i tshad bzhin sbyar// gang yang gtso bo'i sman ni med thabs med// spyi khyab re re chad lhag skyon yod min//de ltar dpags nas phye ma sbyar ba'i thabs// gtan btun [ gtun] thab [thabs] shes yab yum snyom 'jug las// sman rnams byang chub sems kyi
bdud rtsi'i rgyun// sman gyi lha mo'i glu dbyangs rtags [rtag]tu blangs// sna la rwa shing gtun rdo'i rtsib sgang sprad// seng ge'i khrab brdung tshul du byas la mnyed// rdo sman cham chom brdungs nas gnad la mnye// stag mo'i ngar btags mchog tu shis pa yin// rtsi sman rnams ni bsgrung brdungs phye ma bsres// byan mo'i zan mnye lta bu mchog tu shis// kur bur sbrang tsi nam mkha'i mthongs su bsnol// khyim bya'i gshog brdung ji bzhin bskor ba shis//'dod chags rnam dag bya dkar dang sgros spungs// zhe sdang rnam dag stem rtse ngar mas bsdar[brdar]/ / gti mug rnam dag phag gi ze bas rlongs// sgo gsum sman tshag thog gsum dar la btsag/ dug gsum rgyu 'bras nad sel sku gsum thob// rang gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing don gnyis 'grub// 'gro kun 'chi med go 'phang bkod par bsam// sman rta rnam gsum 'du ba'i shas dang bstun// rno khyad 'don dgos gnyan tshad 'dres la spang // tsha sel gung gnyis grang sel srod dang snga// rlung sman dgong thor [tho]gnyan [gnyen]po 'phrod pa rkyen// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las zhi byed gnyis pa phye ma'i lhan thabs te bzhi pa'o//lnga pa/ ril bu'i lhan thabs/zhi byed gsum pa ril bu tsha sel med// grang sel khyung lnga kha bsgyur bcas pa dgu// kha 'thor bcu gsum dang bcas nyer gnyis gsungs// de la dang po bya khyung rnam lnga yi// bya khyung sbyor tshad 'khrul 'khor zhi sbyangs bshad//dang po lo rgyus rgya gar shar phyogs kyi// rgyal po sang gha pā la rje 'bangs la//klu srin gdug pa'i gnod pa sna tshogs byung // rje 'bangs dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus pas// thugs rjes gsang bdag sprul pa khyung gcig byung //
yul de'i ri bos spo zhig bzhugs pa las// nad gdon gnod pa zhi nas bde ldan 'gyur// nam zhig khyung de mya ngan 'das zhes pas// rgyal po'i nam mkha' lding la 'di skad zhus// bdag cag da bar bde skyid khyed kyi drin// da ni mya ngan 'das na ji ltar bgyi// zhus pas mkha' lding dbang po'i 'di skad gsungs// kho bo mya ngan 'das rjes snying dang khrag/ sha rus rgyus pas ril bu dpag med bgyis// lus la bcang dang khong du btang bas bde// nam zhig de yang zad par gyur pa na// 'byung lnga'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs kyi gsung // sha rus rgyus pa snying khrag bya khyung lnga// bzhi gcig gsum gnyis phyed dang sum cha sbyar// zhes gsungs a ru zho bzhi ru rta gcig/ shu dag sum gnyis sman chen zho phyed dang // gla rtsi sum cha sbyar ba tshad ldan no// de la bde skyid med na sha gnyis phri// yang na sha snying bzang po zho bzhir mnyam// gzhan rnams gang [gong]ltar sbyar ba drag khyung zhes// 'jam 'bring drag po'i tshad ldan lung gis grub// sbyar thabs a ru btsan dug mi spyod [ bskyod] chus// 'dam 'thag nyin cig kha dog smug ching 'byung // de steng ru rtas sbyangs pas nag sing 'byung // de steng shu dag sbyangs pas sngo sing 'byung // de steng gla rtsi gu gul kha tshar btab// nyin cig sbyangs pas rgya snag bzang po ltar// mdog bzhi thon nas ril bu sran chung tsam// ril chag thon nas 'bru lngas dbang bskur za// de steng gzhung nas bdun dang man ngag la// srung dang gso ba zhi sbyangs rtsa lto bzhi// dang po mnyam sbyor khyung rgod drag po la// sa bcud ser po rtsi can gshog sgro rgyas// 'dre 'jig rgya li snag tshas spyan mig dod// rang lus go la nam mkha' yang [yangs] pa la// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor zungs [zung]'jug ltar 'khor na// 'gos rims ya nga'i mun pa kun srung byed// srin nad ga bur mchu la dngul mu sder// sman gyis rgyal po bzang drug gshog sgro la//gi'u wang dang ldang [ldong]ros rwa g.yas g.yon// a byag stag sha gnyis po
spyan mig zungs// 'di ni bsil sbyor zla 'od nor bu'i khyung / / gnyan rims tshad gzer tsha chu tsha ba'i skran// srin dang ya ma so [pho]glang thab [thabs]shu 'bras// gza' mdze chu ser nad gdon ma lus 'joms// gnyan nad chu sman ral gri khyung gi mchu// sro [so]ma rā dza thal rdor rwa g.yas g.yon// seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa spos dkar sder mo la// bzang drug gshog sgro sa bcud 'dre 'jig spyan// yongs su rdzogs pa'i dngul khyung me dbal can/ / gnyan rigs sa gdon gag lhog zas su za// gza' mdze sde brgyad dmag gi g.yul ngo bzlog/dug nad ma rtog [gtogs] bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'joms// yon tan rgyud kyi rin chen sbyor ba yin// de nas khyung lnga khyu [chu] rta zhon pa la// lag na seng ldeng dbyug rdo thog [thogs]pas kyang // nus pa gang [gong]'dra rno myur sman mchog yin// 'bri ta sa 'dzin a dkar sin+dhu ra// gser phye shing mngar nya phyis bzang po drug/ klu bdud dkar nag sbyar bas bcu dgu pos// steng 'og gdon gyi rtsa dkar nad du byung // rengs 'khum zha 'byar tsha tsag grang shur sogs// stod smad phyi nang rtsa nad thams cad dang // rkang 'bam rtsa byer nad kyi gnyan [gnyen] po mchog/ gzhan yang mkha' ldeng khyung chen lus tshangs [tshang] la// mtshal gur nya dang dom mkhris gshog sgro rgyas// tshos gsum sder mo rgya snag mkhal zho mchu// lus zungs dngas ma 'phrog pa'i jag pa la// rdo rje pha lam mtshon cha e ma ho// gnyan gyis yan lag khol bur skrangs pa la// khyung lnga gu gul stag sha ming can dang // a byag spang spos sha chen thang phrom pa// cha mnyam sbyar ba'i phye'am ril bu ni// sman nad thon pa yang yang zhu btang bya// gzhan yang a ru bcu sdebs ar khyung zhes// mkhal tshad rtsa 'gram ['grams]gnyan ldan ma lus sel// ru rta drug sdeb rus [ru]khyung bcu pa ste// gnyan tshad pho bar babs pa'i glang thabs 'joms// gtso bo brgyad sdebs gnyan tshad 'thab pa'i nad// gnod bya bcu po gang du zhugs
kyang 'don// khyad par bal nad tre tre ho la bsngags// spos dkar bcu steng dngul chu seng ldeng [ldeng] da nga // khyung lnga sbyar bas spos khyung bco lnga 'dis//dreg grum chu ser rkang 'bam zha rengs 'khum// gnyan rigs skrangs po mdze rigs bco brgyad 'joms// gur gum bcu gsum bsdebs pas gur khyung zhes// mgo srin ya ma nag po don glang dang // chom [cham]rims ya ma sna nad sel ba'i mchog/ byi tang bdun sdebs 'chi med srin sel che// stod smad phyi nang srin rigs gzhang 'brum sel// li shi drug sdebs h+la khyung bcu pa yis// gnyan tshad gre bar zhug [zhugs] pa'i gnyan gag dang // lce rtsa yol gong skrangs shing thor pas 'gags// de la zhi sbyangs gang 'dod ngag ltar sbyar// gsum pa ༷ 〈yig 'bru gnyis mi gsal〉/ / dang po a chu sha re stag gcig sogs[bsad]/ / kun kyang mkha' lding khyung gis zos gyur nas//rang dang mnyam pa'i gshog pas myur spyod [bskyod] nas// gag lhog gnyan gzer nad rigs gdug pa'i sbrul// zos ro thur sel chu bo'i gzhung la bsgyur [bskyur]/ / 〈yig 'bru bzhi mi gsal〉rigs gsum mgon po dang //bya khyung rigs lngas mnyam pa'i thugs rje las// gag lhog rgyu gzer gnyen [gnyan] glang gzer thung sogs// nyon mongs lnga bdo'i nad rigs thams cad sbyangs// 〈yig 'bru gsum mi gsal〉 nad sbyangs pa bya khyung la//rgya tsha sdig srin mtshal dkar byang pa sdebs// btsun mo dkar 'dzin yul du gnyan 'bras zhugs// glo ba khrag gis brgyang 'dra'i nad kun sbyang // ༷ 〈yig ('bru bdun mi gsal〉khyung lnga bzang drug sgro gshog rgyas// byang pa rgya tsha sdig srin mchu lto la// sgro mdong gu gul rus sbal sha rus rwa// chu ser sman gsum seng ldeng sder mo skyon// bya khyung nyi shu lnga po'i ril bu 'di// gza' gdon mdze nad rnying pa skrangs rdol 'bras// gnyan rigs dreg grum rkang 'bam rtsa dkar sogs// chu ser nad rigs chu bo'i rgyud nas 'dren// ༷ ༷
