〈yig 'bru 'ga' mi gsal〉 zab yang rgya mtsho las/ nyer mkho nyer lnga shes brtson skyogs kyis blangs// tshwa sna bcu gcig cha mnyam thun gcig dang // tsha ba gsum po cha mnyam thun gcig dang // 'bras bu gsum mnyam thun gcig thun gsum mnyam// bu ram mgo bsdur [bsdus]ril bu phyag bzhes so// gu ling 'bras ril 'jam 'bras zho gang la// da trig srang phyed gzhan sdom zho gang dang // btsod mdud ser tsam brngos pa zho do la// se 'bru srang gsum sbyar ba tshad ldan no// mar chang bu ram ting khrol ril bu ni// mar dang bu ram so sor srang bco lnga// chang bre dor bskol chu chod ting khrol sgra// byung tshe phog la ngad yal sman btab dril// tsha ba lnga ni gsum btab tsi ṭa [tra]dbyi//shing tsha sumal gharnya pa tra dang // ge sar bzhi la dri bzang bzhi zhes bya// se ba rus ni pus mo'i steng skabs yin// ril bu che chung gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar// snum med rin po che'i snod gtsang du// snum ldan lag pa gtsang mas legs par dril// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las zhi byed gsum pa ril bu'i lhan thabs te lnga pa'o//‘drug pa/ lde gu'i lhan thabs/zhi byed bzhi pa lde gu'i sbyor ba la// tsha sel bco lnga grang sel rnam lnga bcas// khyon dril nyi shu de nang bsil bzhi ni// cu gur li steng sug smel bsnan pa legs// mkhris pa mchin pa sna tshogs zhes pa'i skabs// dug dang gcong shi rul dri spang bar bya// lcags phye bcu gcig tsha ba sum cha gcig/'bras bu gsum po cha mnyam thun gnyis la// tsi ṭa [tra]byi tang ga dur cha mnyam gsum// lcags phye spos dkar cha mnyam brgyad 'gyur sbyar// mthing shun mthing spang 'dod kyang snyug rtsi legs// sbyar thabs sbrang sogs gang yang
chu bskol btsag/ slar gdus chu chod sna ma tshig pa'i dus// mar khu chu chod lbu snyigs phyung pa'i dngas// ngad yal bsres la sman btab 'dres par dkrugs//ka ra la sbyor zhib btags sman bsres la// khye'u gso ltar 'ju tshod je cher tshobskyed// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las zhi byed bzhi pa lde gu'i lhan thabs te drug pa'o//bdun pa/ sman mar gyi lhan thabs/zhi byed lnga pa sman mar tsha sel la// sbyor ba bcu bzhi grang sel rnam dgu bcas// khyon dril nyer gsum ba yi rnam lnga ni// ba gsar sman rir rtsa rkyang zos pa'i chur// lci ba sbyar nas bskol khu ras la btsag/ de steng zho bsre phyed bsdus 'o ma blugs// phyed gdus mar btab sman mar spyi ltar bya// zho sha'i mar gyi gu gul dkar po'am// 'bras gsum a ru'i phyed cha ba ru ra// ba ru'i phyed cha skyu ru ra sbyor ba// 'ba' sam mar steng da byid smug po dang // gtsang [rtsangs]pa mchil pa phug ron lang thang rtse// lcang [cong]zhi tsha ba gsum dang 'bras sna gsum// dbang po lag pa dzā ti sdig srin dang // surmel bu ram sbyar ba'i bcud len 'dis// mkhal ma'i nad sel nyams stobs bskyed byed cing //khyad par gcin snyi sa bon 'dzag pa gcod// de steng lcags phye a ba rtag ngu sbrul// gur gum go snyod mdung rtse sbyar ba yis// seng ge'i rtsal dang glang po'i stobs ldan zhing // dbang po mkha' lding bya rgod mig la 'gran// sbyar thabs sbrang bur so sor chu bskol btsag/ dngas ma chu chod sna ma tshig pa'i dus//phog la ngad yol [yal]'then pa la cha ltar// dkar po gyur tshe grang nas phye ma bya// ka ra phye ma zhib gtsang btags pas 'grub// kha tshar sman rnams zhib btags dar tshag [tshags]drang // sman gzhan skam rlon so sor thang brdungs
ltar// skam po chur sbang rlon pa bsres la btso// ras la btsag nas khu ba yang yang bton// ro nus thon nas dngas ma gud du gdu// sum cha lus tshe 'o ma sum gnyis blugs// phyed 'dus [gdus] dus su mar btab chu chod tshad//dngas snyigs bye nas mer btab chur sgra med// gong mo'i skad 'byin mdzub mo tshugs pa dang // tshig ma dril btub dus mtshungs 'phral du phog/ mar khu snod bzang bcang la tshig ma dor// zhun mar phyed khengs dus nas rims pas dkrugs// dkar por gyur tshe kha tshar sman btab dkrugs// 'dres nas sman rta'i phye btabs [btab]: 'dres par dkrugs// sman mar rab ni kha ba sgong [bsgongs]pa 'dra// gzungs sngags byin 'bebs bkra shis spyi ltar bya// tho rangs kham re 'ju tshod rim bskyed bzab[zab]/ / de yang ba ra mdzo mo 'bri lug mar// ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi bsil drod bstun// tshad med so skyes ci bya rtol [gtol] med phyir// bre srang mgo snyam [ mnyam] mar srang gang re la//mngar gsum phul re btang ba mkhas pa'i rgyun// dper na kha rus bre gang lta bu'o// 'di ni 'tsho byed gzhon nus sangs rgyas la// sman mar srang mda' sbyar nas phul ba'i tshul// 'dul ba lung las byung ba ji ltar ro// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las zhi byed lnga pa sman mar gyi lhan thabs te bdun pa'o//brgyad pa/ thal sman gyi lhan thabs/sde tshan chung ba'i dang po thal sman la// tsha sel med pas grang sel spyi la gsum// kha 'thor bcu bcas sbyor ba bcu gsum la// bye brag cang [cong]zhi 'phrul thal ni// a ru gser mdog tsha la dang // rgyam tsha bong dkar pi pi ling // 'di rnams zho re ljid mnyam la// mu zi dul ma zho yi phyed// pho cang
[cong]bzang po zho bcu btang // 'di rnams phye ma btags byas la// zhi [ zhig]ka sa yi kong bu ni// me thub snyug dong dbyibs lta bu// kha gcod rim pa gnyis ldan gyi// sum ga nyis sman gyis gang bar blugs// sum cha stong pa lus par bya// kha yi srub [srubs]ni sol 'dag gam// skam pa'i [po'i]phye mas dam par bsdams// rlang [rlangs]pa mi 'chor man ngag yin// de nas sol me bzang po'i dbus// bcug la sbud pa dal gyis 'bud// drag [drags]na kong bu gas nyen che// phyogs bsgyur nyi ma phyed du bsreg/ tshos tshad mu zi'i dri sangs yin// de nas kong bu phyir phyungs la// dron mo de la mnam pa yis// dri ma med na tshos tshad yin// zhes so zur sman chen po'i gsungs// gzhan yang slob dpon 'phags dbon gyi// rin chen tsha sbyor 'phrul thal sogs// nas ldan bsreg pa'i sman rnams la// kong bu'i sa sbyor ma shes na// ser ga gas te nus pa 'chor// de phyir sa sbyor man ngag bri// zhi [zhig]ga'i sa la dkar nag gnyis// dkar po cu gang 'dra ba la// gseb na rdo rgyus 'byung ba yod// nag po 'thing 'tsher sol phye 'dra// de gnyis sa yi mchog yin te// ma 'grub sa skyin [spyin]gang zhibs [zhib] pa// phul gang sol phye de dang mnyam// rta sbangs phul phyed zhib par btags// 'dam btags nyi ma gcig tsam bya// snyug dong dbyibs bya thad krang [drang]la// kha gcod chu zhwa lta bu'i tshul// kyang [kong]bu'i phyi ru sor gcig bstum// skam nas sum gnyis sman gyis bkang // sum cha stong pa bzhag par bya// de nas kha gcod dam du bsdams// gang [gong]gi sum sbyor skyo ma ni// gar sla zho tsam srub [srubs]su byugs// slar yang grangs ni mang du bya// de nas kong bu'i phyi rims su// phye ma tshwa dang bsres pa ni// zho tsam yang yang byug la skam// sol me bong me lce ba sogs// rang rang gzhung bzhin bsreg par bya// tshos pa'i tshad la 'ga' gsung yang // 'phrul thal bco lnga grag [drag]pa dang // 'bras
sman rnams ni yun bsring dgos// ma tshos nyes che dug sbyor yin// khyad par 'phrul thal tshos tshad ni// dkar po cu gang lta bu gces// bco lnga grang [drag]pa sngo skya 'gyur// rin chen thal ba ma rtog [gtogs] pa// tshos na nus pa khyad du 'phags// rin chen tshos thal nus pa 'chor// 'di ni mkhas pa'i zhal gdams yin// tsha bsregs sbyor ba rgod sha g.yag rgod yin// bhā ba rims sel shing sngon stabs [stab]seng ste// za 'og gos chen thod pa mi thod do// yang gcig thun mong min pa'i men [ man] ngag ni// gser gyi sbrang gshog zho gang ljid mnyam pa'i// mu zi skyo mas thams cad khyab par byugs//so btang rdza yi ga'u kha sbyor gyi// nang bcug phyi nang sol thal bsres la dril//gci [lci]ba'i me sgong nang du tshos par bsreg/ rdza mdog dmar por song ba tshos tshad yin// zangs kyi thal ba'i sbyor ba'ang 'di gas 'grub// yang na zangasakyi sbrang gshog srang phyed ni// len [lan] tshwa srang gnyis mu zi zho do dang // bab la zho gang re ral zho phyed btab// thog mar zho btsos zangs shog [gshog] g.ya' dag bkru// ga 'ur tshwa bkram de steng zangs shog [gshog]bzhag/ de thog mu zi bab la re ral gsum// rim bzhin brtsegs mar bkram byas kha bcad de// zan za gsum gyis yun las cung lhag bsreg/sman gzhan thal ba ma 'dres dag bus blangs// zhes gsungs zangs bsreg thal ba des 'grub bo// dngul gyi sbrang shog [gshog]zho phyed thal ba'i thabs /sdong [ldong]ros zho gang skyo mas ma lus byug/ legs par dril la lug gi ril ma yi// phye ma yis kyang legs par dril ba yis// kung [kong]bu kha sbyor nang du 'khyug med bsdoms// 'dags ['dag] pas dril la bsreg lugs gang [gong]dang 'dra// zha nye ra gan thal ba'ang de gas 'grub// cis kyang ma grub sdong [ldong]ros bab la rjes// lcags kyi phye ma zho gang thal ba'i thabs / tshwa dang bsres la gtun gung [khung]nang du bsnun// dkar por song ba g.ya'
dag tshad yin la// kyang [kong]bu'i nang du ril ma'i phye mas bka nga // dkyil skyong [kyong]bab la zho gang phye ma blugs// de yang dkyil skyong [kyong]byas la lcags phye blugs// de nas rims bkab 'khyug med kha sbyor bya// sol phye 'dam pa bsres la phyi nang byug/ gong bzhin bsreg pas thal bar 'gyur ba yin// sbyor ba 'di yis li yang thal bar 'gyur// mu zi bab la sdong [ldong]ros mang ba mchog/ de skad slob dpon chen po dpa' bos gsungs// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam slan [lhan] thabs rin chen 'khor lo las phye ma'i nang tshan thal sman slan [lhan]thabs te brgyad pa'o//dgu pa/ khaṇ+ḍa'i lhan thabs/sde tshan chung ba'i gnyis pa khaṇ+ḍa la// grang sel ma gsungs tsha sel bcu bdun la// dang po 'ba' sam khaṇ+ḍa lhan thabs ni// ngo bo bsil sde tshos [tshogs]tshad la// khyad par stobs ldan bsil ba'i sngo// gangs ri g.ya' ri rdza ri dang // nags ri spang ri srib ngos kyi// chu sle shin tu mtho sar skye// kha bska mngar ba'i ro ldan zhing // sos ston skye dang skam pa bul// dri ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams// tsha ba sel bas ci mang bsags// de la gces pa'i gtso bo ni// zla zil sha lang spu rtse shel// be do phag ldang gaṅgā khyung [ gaṅgā chung ]/ / stong zil sing [seng]zil g.yu 'brug zil// gnam lcags zil pa rtsi dmar zil// sngo sprin zil pa skra bzang zil// rgod spos re ral khur mang rtsa// tig ta rigs gsum dug mo nyung // ha bo bong dkar par pa ta// ldum bu [mde'u 'byin]rta lpags spos gsum dang // gser [gsor]mchu snyi ba ba sha ka/ stag sha rdzi [lji] dug srad ma gnyis// glang sna lug ru dkar dmar ser// g.yag ru [rug]ma nu lug chung pa// 'dams ['dam]bu zi ra gser
dngul skud// dpa' ser dgu drus myang rtsi spras// tsher sngon rtsi'u u shi ra//sro lo dkar smug a bi ṣa// shing mngar a krong ut+pal sngon// seng phrom dar kun ba le ka/ 'u su spang brgyan [rgyan]bye'u la phug/ shang dril dkar dmar mthing ser btsod// spor dang ga bur zangs rtsi ba// a wa bre ga shug pa tsher//'om bu bya kri skyer pa dang // stab seng se rgod tang kun pa// sle tres byi tsher nim pa'o// shin tu gces pa'i snying lta bu// nus pa'i khyad par ldan pa ni //gangs snying [ rnying] rab bsil g.ya' ga bur// gangs mkhris me bsod [gsod]zla thig [thigs]gnyis// bsil dang bsil shugs bsil chen po//mkhris 'joms khrag 'joms gzer 'joms gsum// gangs bcud chu bcud bsil ba'i bcud// sngo bsil ldum bsil bdud tsi bsil// zla zhun gangs zhun g.ya' zhun dang // g.yu zil mthing mdog dung phreng can// gser phreng dngul phreng zangs phreng dang // mthing phring [ phreng] pad dkar nir ma ka/rin brtsegs pad brtsegs bdud rtsi brtsegs// bsil byed rigs ldan ldum ga dur// srog ster 'chi bslang [slong]lus srog gnyen// sbrul dang mtshan ma [mchin pa] yan lag gi/ bcad 'byor rin chen ming srin [sring] gsum//bdud rtsi stobs ldan bde byed brgyad// la sman dkon pa tsam 'byor la//yul sman mod pa srungs cher bskyed// 'bras gsum brag zhun lcags kyi phye//lcags dreg bzang po tsam 'byor bzang // mkhris sna tshogs tshad thun re la//se 'bru tshan dhe ljam [rgyam]tsha gsum// gser zho re re'i ljid mnyam btang //de rnams gangs chu slad med la// khaṇ+ḍa tshul bzhin byas pa la// sbyor ba'i ga bur zer ba yin// 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu ltar// sman rta'i kha bsgyur rim pa yis// tsha ba'i nad rigs ma lus la// sel byed 'di 'dra gzhen [gzhan]med gsungs// ri dang klung gi rta lpags ser smug gnyis// re ral rgyal blon btsun mo bcad 'byor ni// yu gu shing dang stag sha rang lugs
bzhed// sngo yi tsha ba dbyi srub lce tsha gsum// shug 'bras rgya shug 'bras bu smin pa legs// thar nu rtsad chod nus pa thim dus brko// sbyar thabs gzhung nas gsal phyir brjod mi dgos// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las lde gu'i nang tshan khaṇ+ḍa'i lhan thabs te dgu pa'o//bcu pa/ sman chang lhan thabs/sde tshan chung ba gsum pa sman chang la// tsha grang ma gsungs dngos gtan [bstan] bcu dgu dang // shugs bstan nad dang gang 'phrod mtha' las 'das// ldang pa'i grang ba rgya tsha'i tshwa chang ni// 'byor na tshwa sbyor chen mo mchog tu shis// gtso po drug ni dug ler rnam par dang // re ral spang rtsi 'om bu hong len dang // tigha gtso drug ces gsungs pas shes// zan chang sbyor ba ra mnye lca ba dang // gze ma lcam pa phye btang tsam pa bsres// gzhan rnams gzhung ltar byas pas lag len 'grub// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam rin chen 'khor lo las thang gi nang tshan sman chang lhan thabs te bcu pa'o//bcu gcig pa/( log gnon rin po che'i lhan thabs/zhi byed kun gyi log gnon rin po che// tsha sbyor gcig dang grang sbyor la bsten pa'i// sbyor ba cig thub bcu gcig kun rgyug brgyad// nyi shu log gnon gsum las tsha sbyor rnams// thal sman sbyar thabs gang rung bstan pas shes// rin chen grang sbyor dngul chu btso bkru ni// 'jam mgon bla rta tshe dbang gis// dang po dngul chu gle hel mnye// tshwa dang bul tog cha mnyam la// tshan dhe pho ril sman sga la// nyi ma phyed phyed g.ya' phyi'o// ba chu mi chu rta chu
dang / nags mtshur tsha la tshwa sna la// nyi ma phyed phyed g.ya' khu 'don// bar bar ltar bu sing skyur tshur// so phag phyed dang chu dron gyis// g.ya' khu sbyangs shing dgongs mo'i dus// ltar bu chu dron nang du bzhugs[gzhug]/ gtso bo snod nang cang [cong] zhi bting // lug tshil rkang mar 'o spris dang // sing skyur ltar bu stobs ldan bzhag/ tshur rnams ba chur btab la btsos de nas 'bru mar chang gis btso// de steng sbal rgyab mdung rtse dang // pha wang long bu khab len dang // gser rdo dngul rdo ti tsha dang // sdong [ldong]ros bab la bang [bong]dmar dang // ltar bu rnams ni btags la btso// bar skabs chu dronadag gis bkru// de nas dug phye mar nag la// gci [lci] ba'am bang [bong]ba'i me dug gi/ rlang [rlangs] ma shor ba yun ring btso// ber ka 'dzin pa tshad du 'dod// de nas lcags snod bzang po'i nang // bsha' [gsha']nag zha nye gang rung ni// rang gi bzhi char mnyam pa'i ljid// mar nag dang bcas sol me btso// ltar bu ba chu bkrus pa yi// gong bur snang ba tshos pa'i tshad// gsungs pas lag len thang khrid gces// byang sems dkar dmarakhye'u bu mo gnyis// grang [grong] pa'i chos kyis ma gos dkar dmar khams// ma rnyed cong zhi brag zhun tshab rung zhes// chos sman zhes pa bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// gsar ma'i bdud tsi ril bu sgrub pa'o// phya tshan gsum ni mi rta khyi gu pho// skyes phral khong brun yin te zho brun yin// sbal pa nag po tshe gcig lus gnyis sha/ khyi smyon mche ba rgya snag gcan zan [ gzan] stag/ rab [rabs]chad mdzo pho drel pho brgyung pa ste// brgya sbyin 'di skabs rang lugs dbang po lag/ gnyan po'i sman drug pi ling pho ba ris// cong zhi nags [nag]tshur bul tog ltar bu drug/ yang na mu zi ltar bu pi pho dang // rgyam tsha sga skya sbyar ba drug la bzhed// de gnyis rang lugs mkhas dbang 'grel bshad lugs// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las ril bu'i
nang tshan zhi byed kun gyi log gnon rin po che'i lhan thabs te bcu gcig pa'o// ༷〈yig 'bru 'ga' mi snang /〉/ / thang phye gang 'tsham khong du bsdu ba la// gces pa'i yan lag bdun ldan sngon du 'gro// dngos gzhi thun mongs rgyal blon drug pa dang // blon po sun [spun]mang sbyor ba nyi shu brgyad// grang sel bcu gsum kun 'dus spyi 'joms gcig/ dril bas zhe gnyis zhi byed sde tshan rdzogs//bcu gnyis pa/ lngo sbyor gyi lhan thabs/burnya sangs rgyas zhabs kyis bcag pa'i gnas// khyad par zla ba yar ngo'i dus bzang ni// dpyid zla 'bring po'i dus la babs pa'i tshe// sman gyi lha mo thams cad drod du g.yo// de nas ston zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad nyin//0sman gyi bla dang drong [ drang]srong thams cad 'tshogs// sman rnams nas mthu ldan par byin gyis rlabs// de nas bcu gsum nyin par snga dro'i dus// sman gyi lha mo bdud rtsi srung mdzad ma// 'khor bcas byon nas sman rnams byin gyis rlabs// bcu bzhis dus su sman rnams mthu dang ldan// bco lnga'i dus su nya rgyas sman nas rgyas// gzhan du btus na nus pa mi 'byung ste// ma byin blang pa'i nyes pa dag dang 'dra// 'di ni rin chen 'khrungs dper gsungs phyir te// sman bla'i gzungs sngags rten snying ye dhar bzla// gzhan yang rtsa [lca]ba ra mnye a ri spung nyer [nye ]shing 'grel pa 'tsham pa nas nye shing mal du lca ba rta rgod mdzad snang / rtsa ba brgya ba dang // ba spru la phug sgog skya btsang [btsong]rtsa drug/ lo ma sngo yi tsha gsum da las zwa// me tog ra dug 'bras bu thang phrom nag/ ltar bu gze ma lcam pa rnam pa bzhi// ze tsha bul tog byang gi mtsho tsha gsum// thal
ba lcang [cong]zhi rgod btul rgod brun gnyis// chu tshan phul ba grang nad ma lus sel// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las thang phye nang tshan sngo sbyor gyi lhan thabs te bcu gnyis pa'o//bcu gsum pa/ las lnga'i sngon 'gro rtsam 'chos kyi lhan thabs/sbyong byed las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum chos la// rung min bstan [bsten ]thabs spyi la phyi nang gnyis// bye brag rnam lnga dus tshod rigs bzhi dang //legs pa'i rtags dang phan yon nyes pa'i skyon// log gnon dang bcas bco lnga bstan pa la// 'bru rigs so ba dngas chang a rag 'dod// blta [brta]bya zhes bya stobs bskyed byed pa'i yul// de dag zos rjes snum bsten stod la shis// zas gong snum bsten lus kyi smad la shis// zas bar snum bston de bzhin bar la shis// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las sbyangs byed las lnga'i sngon du 'gro ba snum 'chos kyis lhan thabs te bcu gsum pa'o//bcu bzhi pa/ bshal gyi lhan thabs/las lnga'i mchog gyur bshal la brtags pa dang // btang thabs skyon yon bzhi ste btang thabs la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi phyi rjes bcad pa gsum//de la sngon 'gro gsum dang dngos gzhi lnga// sbyor sde kun rgyug spyi bshal drags [drag]'jam gnyis// re rer kha bsgyur sum cu sbyar ba yis// drag 'jam bsres pa'i drug cu man ngag bdun// dgos [sgos]bshal bcu gsum btang tshul rnam pa bzhi// lcag drug 'don tshad gsum dang log gnon lnga// phyi rjes
spyi dang khyad par rnam pa gnyis// khyad par tsha rjes grang rjes gsar rnying bzhi//phyi rjes log gnon sbyangs la legs nyes sogs// gzhung don zhib phyir dgongs pa longs pa gces// 'gying na dug [dugs]ni tsha [tshwa]dang bong ba yos// nad ltor skyur bag chang 'jam btang bas sbyangs// tsha 'byams dmar ser mkhris phye sbyor bas bcad// grang 'byams dri med da trig bdun dgu'am//se 'bru da lis dgu ling sbyor bas bcad// tshad gzer ma nu ru rta'i grang thang btang // chu rdo rmo lcag [lcags]skar chu drod bkang bdug/ phye ma ga bur gtso brgyad gang 'os sbyar// grang gzer 'ba' cha chang bran bya bra bdug/ bshal sman blo [glo]shor las kyis ma shi na// gnyan gzer 'khrugs kyi le'u lta bur bcos// yang na kho bo'i glo tshad rig zig ltos// srin khros pho log gnyan [gnyen] po bya khyung lnga// 'khrul 'khor dang bcas gnyan srin glang thabs bcos// spru ma phur mang [mong] rta sbang dugs kyis bdug/ bla gnyan 'gyur ldog gang gang de des bcos// ༷ 〈tshig rkang gcig mi snang 〉/ / yab rje drang srong chu lha yis// nags khrod dka' thub brtan pa'i tshe// bram ze rgan po mkhar ba la// brten cing 'byor bas dben pa zhig/ nad kyi nyams thag gyur mthang [mthong]nas// de la tshad med snying rje yis// kun nas blangs te bden tshig bor// rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje las// bskul ba'i bden tshig dngos 'grub na// 'byung ba chu yi dngos po la// bzang po sman gyi nas ldan pa// nad ldan dbul po 'di dag gis// zas skam [skom] sman gyis dam pa zhig/ de nyid sa 'dir 'grub gyur cig/ ces brjod de ma thag tu ni// rang byung sman gyi chu mig grub// bram ze nad pas bstan [bsten] pa yis// nad las grol zhing lus stobs rgyas// tshe yi rig 'dzin gru ba par gyur// 'chi med sman gyi tshe chu de// ri bo ma la ya na yod// de la nges pa rnyed nas ni// drang srong chu lhas slar yang ni// 'di mtshungs chu sman sna tshogs pa// yul khams
kun tu dar bar shog/ khyad par sman dang sman pa'i tshogs// dkon pa der ni rab rgyas shog/ de yis 'gro ba'i nad zhi zhing // tshe rgyas bde la 'god par shog/ ces sogs bden tshig gyis bskul zhing // sngon gyi rgyal ba'i byin ngarlabs dang // sems can rang rang bsod nams mthus// deng song [sang]yul khams kun tu dar// nges tshig nad rnams zhi ba dang // lus la phan phyir sman zhes bya// brlan gsher dngos po grub phyir chu// dbye ba 'byung chen rnam lnga yi// nang nas chu chad gcig po la// 'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid tshangs[tshang]/ / cha shas nus pa'i khyad par gyi// rnam pa lnga ru yam [yang] dag bshad// ngos 'dzin spyir ni sman chu kun// rwa gzhob dri bro g.ya' la dngas//cung zad gar ba'i nyams ldan no// shar logs nas ni shar du babs// ro mngar chu dreg nya lcibs sngo// lci gar 'thung tshe gnyid 'phel byed// lus bkrus snum dang 'jam pa ni// rlung sel sman chu dam pa'o// byang logs nas ni byang du babs// ro kha chu dreg nya lcibs ser// lci sla 'thung na gnyid chung 'khru// lus bkrus bsil dang dngas par byed// mkhris sel sman chu dam pa'o// lho yi phyogs nas lho phyogs 'babs// ro skyur chu dreg nya lcebs dkar//yang zhing 'thung na skyugs par byed// lus bkrus rtsub dang skya ba ni// bad gan sel ba'i sman chu mchog/ mtshams nas mtshams su bltas te babs// ro dang kha dog gnyis gnyis 'dres// de yi bye brag thun sdebs pas// 〈tshig rkang gnyis tsam chad〉 lhan [ldan] pa sel ba'i sman chu mchog/yul gyi dbus nas nub tu babs// ro dang kha dog kun 'dres shing // 'thung tshe phog dug chung la 'jom [ 'jam]/ / yang na mod la 'khru skyugs byed//'dus pa sel ba'i sman chu mchog/ yon tan cha shas mang nyung las// mtshan nyid cung zad 'dres pa la// mthun sbyor phan yon gnod byed la// bzang ngan dbye ba mkhas pas dpyad// kun kyang sa gtsang chu gzhan dang // shing
nags dug rigs sngo ldum med// nyi zla rlung phog ro dra [dri] gsal// dkar phyogs skyang [skyong] ba'i lha gnas bzang // phan yon sman gzhan sbyor ba la//ma ltos chu nyid gcig po yis// nad kun zhi dang sbyangs byed cing // lus zungs rgyas dang tshe ring byed// sman dpyad gzhan dang bstun pa na// rno myur mchun [mtshun] che nyes pa chung // lhag par dus ngan snyigs ma la// gso rigs [rig ] gzhung gdams nyams khrid kyi// zab chos nub nas 'ol tshod mkhan// lag len zol sbyor dar ba'i tshe// sman bla rig 'dzin thugs rdze yis// nus stobs lhag par rgya sa pa dang // sman chu gsar rdol 'byung bar gsung //bsten thabs khrus dang bsku mnye bya// gzhi bdag chu lha sman skyong la// gsol mchod byas la sdong grogs bcol// thugs dzes mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das// sman bla'i mtshan brjod skyabs 'gro bya// nad ldan 'gro la byams pa dang // snying rje dga' ba btong [btang]snyoms bsgom// mkhas dang mthun pa'i kha zas kyi// khu ba thams cad sman chus bya// zungs ngan rgan po rlung ldan la// nyung za yun bsrings rim bskyed btung // zhag re zas chu 'theng 'gros bya// zungs bzang nad rgyas zas skyung la// chu 'thung re zhig skyugs bkag nas// rtsa ltos sbyongs la ci thon bya// rjes su bshal skyugs gnyis gas drangs//de yang grang shas che ba dang // pho ba ngan la bskol la btung // tsha shas che dang me drod bzang // de la drang [ grang] mo kho na shis// khrag 'khrugs tsha zugs [zug]che ba na// bkru sman gyis ni chu mda' bran// rlon [slon]'khrus sman chu gsum sbrag gis// sde bzhi'i khong gcong drag po'i tshogs// rtsad nas 'byin pa'i zhal gdams la// bkrus sman rnon po'i ril bu ni// sman chu bskol nas 'phul la btang // mal gos dron mo'i byibs la bsnyal// lan gnyis gsum du 'khru phebs na// skyugs bkag chu yi 'khru ba bskul// bco lnga tsam nas skyugs yang drang // thor bus kha rlung skyes pa na// rus rnying sman chu
bsdus pa'i lcag/ mthil bzhi bsku mnye bsur [gsur]bdug bya// nad dag chu rgyus 'khru na bzhag/ mtsho rdol 'byams dang 'gying 'dril sogs// geg [gegs]sel rjes gcod srung sdom ni// lto sbyangs cho ga ji bzhin bya// sbyongs legs yon tan 'byung ba mkhas khyad yin// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las bshal gyi lhan thabs te bcu bzhi pa'o//bco lnga pa/ skyugs kyi lhan thabs /las lnga gnyis pa skyugs la ༷ 〈yig 'bru gsum mi gsal〉/ / kha 'dzin bdun dang log gnon rnam pa lnga// gzhung nas gsal zhing dom mkhris btab ste btang // mtsho rdol chu ba [lo]ha bo zhu mkhen [mkhan]drug/ phye ma gur gum cu gang dom mkhris dang // 'u su spu shel rtse yi sbyor bas bcad// glo rtsa 'grams na btsod dang rgya skyegs gdus// gur gum cu gang shing tsha shing mngar dang // sran me'i me tog dom mkhris phye btab bsdams// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las skyugs kyi lhan thabs te bco lnga pa'o//bcu drug pa/ sna sman gyi lhan thabs/las lnga gsum pa sna sman zhi sbyongs gnyis// zhi byed lnga dang sbyongs byed gnyis te bdun// dbus dkor mtheb mdzub sbyor ba'i bya ba rdzogs// se gol skad gcig [cig] bya ba zla zer lugs// khrag shor sman dang me btsa'gtar sogs ni// khang [khong]sman sna khrag rang skem gur gum dang // dom mkhris sa rdzi ka dang shing tsha rnams// sbyar ba rgya yi dar them bzhi pa ste// khrag
shor rgya mtsho tsam yang gcod par byed// gur gum dom mkhris zab mgron thal ba rnams// spru ma reng bus mgor skyon snar yang brdzangs// bud med gsang spu sram dang rta yi spu// shog gur dril ba'i dud pa sna nang bdug/ 'di gsum sbyor bas sna khrag chod nges kyi// ltag rtsa smin mtshams dpung gsang me yis mnan// 'di lta'i man ngag gzhan la yod ma yin// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las sna sman gyi lhan thabs te bcu drug pa'o//bcu bdun pa/ 'jam rtsi'i lhan thabs/las lnga bzhi pa 'jam rtsi gtso bo gsum// kha 'dzin drug gi bsgyur bas bco brgyad do// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las 'jam rtsi'i lhan thabs te bcu bdun pa'o//bco brgyad pa/ ni ru ha yi lhan thabs/las lnga lnga pa ni ru ha yang gtso bo gsum/ kha 'dzin drug gis bsgyur bas bco brgyad yin// gce'u rtsa ba'i sbub [spubs]la mthe bong shong // rtse bug sran ma shong tsam sor brgyad pa// rked pa rtsa ba 'khor lo dkris pa yin//zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las ni ru ha yi lhan thabs te bco brgyad pa 'o //bcu dgu pa/ log gnon rtsa sbyongs kyi lhan thabs/log gnon rtsa sbyongs sngon 'gro nye ring gnyis// dngos gzhi dgu dang
lcag gsum log gnon drug/ phan yon gnyis bcas lta rtog them par bya//dang po da byid sdig srin sumal dang // nyi dga' a 'bras gser gyi rtsa khu byug/mkhal zho brgyad sbyor phye ma rtsa lam sbyangs// dngos gzhi byang ba bdun pa rgya ru dgu// sna khrid glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang // dug dang chu ser nad la sogs pa'i sman// kha sgyur sum cu sbyar bas drug cu zab// rnon po rgya tsha sdig srin gser bye gsum// ra yi wa gdong 'dra ming mdo mo'i rus// byang pa'i dug ni bar gshog dkar po dbyung // yang na lo brgyad dri chur nyug tsam sbang //de nas ras gtum yos tshan nang du brngo// yang na chang zan gtum la ser tsam bsregs// khyad par dpal ldan lhun grub rgyal mtshan gyis// bar gshog spang pas rno myur ga la srid// de yi dug 'phrog shing mngar pi pi ling // nas tsam btang ba mkhas pa'i zhal gdams yin// de dag log gnon steng gi log gnon zab// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin po che 'khor lo las sbyongs byed las lnga'i log gnon rtsa sbyangs kyi lhan thabs te bcu dgu pa'o//nyi shu pa/ rtsub dpyad gtar ga'i lhan thabs/dpyad kyi dang po gtar ka spyi don lnga// dang po cha byad legs pa'i yon tan dang // gnyis pa rung dang mi rung ran min bzhi// gsum pa gtar thabs sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes// sngon 'gro nye dang ring ba rnam pa gnyis//dngos gzhi bsnyal thabs gdabs [ gdab] thabs gdab dmig [dmigs]dang // khrag pra dbyung tshad log gnon rnam pa drug/ phyi rjes khrag gcod zas skam [skom] spyod lam bslab// bzhi pa gtar skyon sman [ dman] lhag log nyes bzhi/ lnga pa gtar legs yon tan rnam pa dgu// blo zhib gzigs pas lag len gnad du dril// tsha ba'i nad kun gtar bar gsungs na'ang // tsha
ba gtar du mi rung rnam pa bdun// ma smin tsha ba gtar na rnyog par 'gyur//khyad par rims la gang gtar don la babs// 'khrugs sogs ngan khrag ma phyed gtar ba yis// zungs khrag shor bas rlung skye tsha ba byer// nad khrag lus pas tsha ba'i ro mi thon// stong tshad gtar na rlung 'byos ['phyo]zug gzer skye//gnyan tshad gtar na khrag shul srog rtsar 'jug/ dug tshad gtar na byer te ro mi thon// zungs ngan tsha ba gtar na srog gtan [ rten] chad// dog dang rtsa mdud bla gnas sar mi gtar// gsung don rtsa gnad gnyis 'dom kha brag mtshams// de bzhin gnad du dog pa kun la'o// bla gnas rtsis lugs rgyud sde rnam dag dang // rgya nag me bcos gu ṇa nā tha'i gsungs// dgongs pa spyir btang mthun yang dmig sa gsal du// rgyud rgyal dus 'khor don bsdus zur mkhar nas// thabs shes ro rkyang dbang gis mi/ byang chub sems kyi khams 'pho ba// yar ngo sngon 'gro dbang byas na// skyes pa'i g.yon dang bud med g.yas// de yang tshes gcig rkang pa yi// sor tshig [tshigs] dang por yi ge āḥ 'gre'o/ / gnam stong dang ni tshes gcig mtshams// rkang pa'i mthil du a yig gzugs// 'di dang i gi dus kyi tshe// byang chub sems kyis mgo lus kun// khyab phyir shin tu gnyan pa ste// gtar tshe rma lhog skrangs pa dang // bsreg na zha rengs 'khum dang 'chi// blo ldan rnams kyis rtog [rtogs] par bya// 'on kyang long med nad kyis zin pa la// dbang med gtar bsregs dras 'drud byed dgos na// gu gul dud pas bdug cing spang spos byug/ oṃ tsak+ṣu de wa hri ma gi swāhā/ brgya'am bdun gsum bzlas btab nyes las grol//slob dpon chen po pad+ma gces phreng gsungs// gtar rtsa bcu don bdun nges pa'i grangs// mtshog gsang sna rtse mthong [thong] rtsa gsum// rna ba'i phyi nang ljon shing bzhi// ltag rtsa ltag ral gser dngul drug/ lce mig so rtsa rtse'u chung brgyad// de ltar nyer gcig mgo ske la'o// dpung rtsa sgang rtsa drug mgo dang //
snod ka ru thung glo snying 'doms// glo mchin mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa dang //bad mkhris chu ser bsha' [gsha']rings dang // drug 'dus skyor gong srin lag gi/ rgyab rtsa gnyis gnyis phran bu drug/ sum cu rtsa bzhi lag par ro//rkang pa rtsa chen sgab rtsa gtar// rta mthur byin gzhug byin skyogs [kyog]dang //gdong rtsa long rtsa yob gong dang // rgyu rtsa gnyis gnyis bco brgyad do// sbub [sbubs]la pho ba'i rwa gnyis dang // pho mtshan 'gram rtsa gnyis te bzhi// de ltar dril bas bdun cu bdun// 'khrul med yi ge'i lam nas so// khong khrag phyi la 'phul ba'i men [man] ngag ni// thang sbyor 'bras bu gsum dang ba le ka / ut+pal sle tres tig ta bang [bong]nga dkar// ga dur ba sha ka yi gdus grang btang // tsha ba khong gsod phyir phul khrag ngan 'byed// khrag ma chod na —mthe bong g.yon pa'i ngos// oṃ khrag nyag ram rbad chod/ bzlas btab rma kha mnye bas chod par 'gyur// rdo dreg spang spos mon lug go snyod phye// zan don sbyar ba a sa ba yis bdug/ de ltar lag len zhib tu ma slabs par// dal 'byor gson khrag thon tshad dbyung ba la// mkhas drag zer ba'i ngo mtshar rna ma rtogs [rtog] za// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las rtsub dpyad gtar ga'i lhan thabs te nyi shu pa'o//nyer gcig pa/ me btsa'i lhan thabs/dpyad kyi gnyis pa me btsa' spyi don bdun// gnyis pa tsha ba bsregs par ma bshad kyang // tsha ba bsreg pa'i nad rigs rnam pa drug/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad la 'bros 'phrang bsdom// rtsa stang [stongs] tsha ba 'phrang kha so pas bcad// tshad gzhug rlung 'bud sbud pa me yis mnan// rlung rims 'dar bu g.yer bu mal du gzhug/ lhog pa'i tsha ba gnyan thog gnyan dbab
cing // tsha rjes grang bar log na me drod gso// de dag tsha ba'i tsha ba bcos zhes bya// gsum pa mi rung pho mo'i srid rtsa ni// ldang pa'i chu rtsa srid rtsa srog rtsa gsum// mtshan dbrag bar gyi dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnas// bzhi pa me dmigs sman pas btsal ba ni// en [ an] stong tshigs pa rgyab srang [gsang] nyi shu la// nad stobs che na bcu gsum bsreg dgos gsung //mdun srang [gsang]nyer gnyis mgo dang yan lag la// nyi shu rtsa dgu dngos gtan [bstan]bdun cu gnyis// shugs gtan [bstan]brgya dang bcu bzhi gdab tu rung // lnga pa spra ba me sbar skyabs 'gro ni// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma shākya thub// rig gsum mgon dang drang srang [srong]nyi shu gcig/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu klu sgrub dpa' bo dang // bai —ra tsa na mi dgu la sogs pa// rgya bod drang srang [srong] rgyud [ brgyud] par bcas rnams la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dri zhim mdangs ldan bdud tsi gser gyi me//nad gdon 'jig par byed pa drag po'i mda'// stong gi lha dang 'og gi klu la min// bar gyi gnyan la mi 'debs ko long bsdom// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la 'debs pa yis// grang ba'i drod bskyed tsha ba'i rgyu lam bsrung // rlung rgyu'i sgo kheg rnag dang chu ser skems// na ba'i dbal bcog [gcog] khrag srin gzer khyug 'joms// 'khru dang skyugs dang khu khrag 'byams pa gcod// ma zhu lhan [lhen]dang skya sbab [rbab]dmu rdzing gzhil// rus chags [chag]gas grum zhom rdib lugs su 'dzud// gnod byed gdon bgegs ma lus rtsad nas phyungs// myur du nad las thar bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi'i ye shes thob par byin gyis rlobs// sman rgyal go 'phong ['phang] thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsol gdab gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i pho [phu] mchil gyi// thud [thu]yis gdabs [gdab]pas nad sel gnod pa zhi// gzhan rnams gzhung chen dgongs pa ko ba bsla[sla]/
zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las rtsub dpyad me btsa'i lhan thabs te nyer gcig pa'o//nyer gnyis pa/ 'jam dpyad dugs kyi lhan thabs/dpyad kyi gsum pa dugs la spyi don bzhi// bsil dug [dugs] bcu gcig drod dug [ dugs] bcu dgu gsungs// skar chu tho rangs skar ma ma gyes gang [gong ]/ / bla gnas nyi ma'i 'od kyis ma phog pa// nus pa chu bsil gzhan la [las] khyad par 'phags// ci phyir drang srong ṛ khu'i [ṣi'i] mthu las sogs// de yang mdo sde mya ngan 'das pa las// byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po des// byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i mdzod de la// smon lam mthu yis 'di skad ces smras pa// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams//sems can na ba g.yog rnams med pa dang // nad rnams du mas reg pa'i sems can la// de dag don du bdud rtsi'i char sgang [snang] zhing // thams cad nad las yongs su thar phyir du// sman dang bdud rtsi'i char pa phob [phobs]gcig go/ zhes dang gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa las// nyi ma'i 'od kyis gdung pa dang // zla ba'i 'od kyi bsil byas pa// ṛ ṣi 'char ba'i dug med do// zhes pa khrum [khrums]stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes// don dam zhib bshad 'brel ['grel] pa zla zer gsal// kun rdzob chu lha'i bu ni bum skyes kyi// gtam rgyud bstod 'grel 'dod 'jo la sogs ltos// gzhan yang chuyi sman zas la// dbyar char dang po ma gtogs pa// mkha' la [las]'babs pa chu mchog yin// ma dros mtsho las babs pa'i chu// mngar dang bsil dang 'jam dang yang // dri med gtsang dang tshims par byed// mgrin dang lto bar mi gnod pa// chu yi yin [yan]lag brgyad ldan du// dam chos
'dul ba lung las ga sungs// ston zla 'bring po'i yar ngo la// drang srong ṛ ṣi mkha' la rgyu// de yi smon lam bden pa'i mthus// chu dug thams cad sa la thim// yin [yan]lag brgyad ldan yon tan gyis// cha shas chu rnams kun la khyab// dus der skyes bu rtsal ldan gyis// chur zhugs 'du ba spyi snyom [snyoms]yin// lu ma 'khyil chu rul bas min// shugs drag brdab pa'i 'bab chus bya//dang po rin chen snod bzang du// bcus pa'i khong bsrung phul gang btung //de nas sba rlong [rba klong]'khrugs par zhugs// bkru zhing rba yi 'phyar rgya bya//nad yod sa der nan gyis bran// thon rjes rngul 'don man ngag bya// de yang rim par yun bsrings la// rdzogs mthar zhun mar bsku mnye bya// phan yon rgyas tshad me dbal gsod// rnying zhen 'gogs shing byer ba gdon// 'gram ['grams]'khrugs dbye bas dbyung dang mnyam// chu ser rma rgan 'bras lhad 'byin// sha lhad sngo nag tsho ches 'dul// lpags [ pags] rtsub khye ma 'brum thor 'joms// lus yang sha 'jam mdog legs shing // ro tsa drod skyed tshe mdangs rgyas// chur zhugs 'du ba spyi snyoms kyi// lag len khyad par 'phags pa 'di// dge 'bum rnam 'phrul drin las rnyed// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las 'jam dpyad dug [ dugs] kyi lhan thabs te nyer gnyis pa'o// nyer gsum pa/ lums kyi lhan thabs/ dpyad kyi bzhi pa lums la spyi don bzhi// dreg bzhi zhes pa dreg nad thog mi [ma'i] gnas// rkang pa'i mthe mo lag pa'i gru mor 'dod// chu tshan rigs lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// ma rtogs [ gtogs] chu lums gnyis dang bcing lums la// tsha sel brgyad dang grang sel bcu gnyis gsungs// chu
lums sems can spyi mthun bsod nams las// grub pa'i chu tshan rigs lnga'i lo rgyus ni// chu tshan 'byung khung [khungs]gling bzhi'i mtha'// rdo sol 'bar ba'i lcags ri ni// rta gdong rgod ma kha bya ba// nyi ma bdun gyi drod ldan pa'i//lcags ri nag pos 'khor ba yod// de dang 'phrad na rgya mtsho yang // yud tsam zhig gis skyems par byed// de dang nus pa rjes mthun pa'i// rdo sol yod pa'i sa phyogs der// srid pa brlan gsher chu khams rdol// lhan cig thug pas chu tshan 'byung // nges tshig me khams chur rgyas pa'i// brlan gsher chu yi dngos po la// tsha dbal me yi ngad ldan pas// chu nyid tsha dbal ldan phyir ro//dbye ba chu dang rdo sol gnyis// med pa'i chu tshan 'byung mi srid// de la sman gzhan grogs kyis bsgyur// rnam pa lnga ru yongs su grags// mu zi'i chu tshan mu zi mnam// kha dog ljang ser dri dug [dugs]che// sa phyogs der yang mu zis khyab// chu ser sha bkra mdze 'bras sel// cong zhi chu tshan dri med dngas// sa phyogs der yang cong zhis khyabs[khyab]/ / ja chang gis [bsings]kyang ro mi bsgyur// smug po dug dang tshad rnying sel// tshur gyi chu tshan tshur bro zhing // sa phyogs de yang tshur gyis ༷khyab// chu mdog sngo nag cung zad snyogs// 'bras skran rde'u lcags dreg sel// brag zhun chu tshan brag khar 'byung // brag zhun 'dzag thig [thigs]rjes mngon zhing // mdog smug ro kha dri mi zhim// smug po dreg nad chu 'gags sel// rdo zho'i chu tshan rwa gzhob bro// sa phyogs rdo zhun sngo skyas khyab// ma zhu 'ju zhing me drod bskyed// bad kun lhan [lhen]dang dang lcags dreg sel// phan yon dug tshad byer rnying 'don// dreg grum 'bam 'bras rengs pa 'dul// 'bras dang sur+ya'i rnag chu skem// dgye bo 'gugs shing sgur bo skyong [rkyong ]/ / skom [skem]po rgyas dang sbom po dbri// chu ser 'or dang dmu chu skem// sha lpags rtsa rgyud thig [thigs] lhad 'don// dri sbyongs bkrag legs lus 'jam byed// bsten thabs dang po grang po zhugs//
9de nas rim pas je tshar btang // bklu zhing nad yod sa der mnye// lhag par khong 'bras skran yod na// dal bus 'thung zhing pho bskor bya// shes na rlung bzung 'khrul 'khor rgyag/ zas dang spyod lam nad dang bstun// drod la sgor zhing brlan grang spang // chu nas thon ma thag pa la// dro ba'i gos kyis mal du dbyibs[byibs]/ / thug tshan yos [yog] 'thung dbus [pus] brang sbyar//rngul thon gos brje brlan rnams phyi// zhal gdams thabs mchog 'di med na//lus nad ba spur mi 'drong bas// mgon po snying gi bu la bstan// rjes su dal bus yul [yun] bskyung la// nad babs lus shed sbyar ba yis// phan pa'i nges pa brtan po ni// mngon sum ma mthong bar du brtan [bsten]/ / rjes srung lto sbyangs 'dra ba la// khams dang sbyar ba'i bsku mnye dang // lus zungs rgyas pa'i cho ga bya// khrag mkhris 'dren ['dres] pa'i nad dag la// dang po gtar sbyangs legs brten [bsten] nas// rjes su chu tshan dal bus brtan[bsten]/ / grang rlung chu tshan 'thung rjes su// ngal ba gsos la me btsa' gdab// sman chu dang ni chu tshan gyi// nus pa sos dang dgun stod che// de yi rgyu ma tshan 'byung ba gzhan// ma 'dres rang khams rgyas phyir ro// dbyar ston sa chu'i nus pa yang // me rlung gyis bskyed gyen du rgyu// de tshe rgya mtsho khol ba yi//zil rlung [rlangs]'dres pas nas pa chung // dgun dus sa chu rlung gsum gyi//stobs rgyas 'khyags shing thabs ['thab] pa las// nus pa spubs su gzha' bar byed// 'di na blo rmongs 'dod ldan 'ga'// sman chu chu tshan nang tshigs [tshags]kyi// 'byung ba tsha grang 'phel 'bri yi// phan yon byed las mi shes shing // rten 'brel don la rmongs pa rnams// shes la mi 'dri rang bzo yis//'a dod pa'i chu sman brtan [bsten]rnams ni// phan med gnod pa rin gyis nyos// ci [kye]hud 'khrul rmongs snying re rje// de dag rnams dang rjes 'jug la// phan pa'i bsam pa dkar pos bkod// 'di yang sman ston mkhan chen
gyi// legs bshad thos pa ji bzhin no// ༷ 〈tshig rkang gcig mi gsal〉zhes bya ba ni/ brgyad pa la sogs gzhung chen rnams nas gsungs//bdud tsi ba lus pags pa mnyen par byed// bdud tsi 'om bus rus pa'i dug rnams 'don// bdud tsi mtshe yi lus zungs brtas par byed// bdud tsi mkhan skyas lus kyi 'byung ba 'dul// bdud tsi shug pa yon tan brgyad dang ldan// nye bar mkho ba chang dang phab yin te// zhes pa g.yu thog shog dril skor gsum dang // rin chen 'khrungs dpe las kyang mthun par gsungs//de phyir bdud rtsi lnga yi lums// dreg grum yon [yan]lag rengs 'khums skyong [gyong ]/ / skor [ko]le'i na skrangs 'don pa'i mchog/ dug dang tsha ba rnying rnyog sogs// sha pags rtsa rus la zhen pa// ma lus ba spu'i bu gar 'dren// gsungs pa'i lag len cha lag bco brgyad kyi// smra [dmar] khrid lag len bco brgyad nang du gsal// 'on kyang drin chen bla ma'i phyag bzhes de// rang gi nyams myang [myong]lag len snying thig bskod [bkod]/ / kun gyis gtso bo bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// de steng rtsa dkar mkhal 'grams gla pho ril//chu ser skrangs 'bras ra mnye nyer [nye]shing pa// tshad rnying byer 'grams spang spos rdo dreg dmar// stong tshad kun la 'bras gsum tshos gsum sdebs//smad grang kun la rtsa ba lnga dang sbyar// btsab brdung chu dang chang gis tshos par btsos// gar sla zho tsam phog la tsha 'jam dus// phabs phyes bran la gos dron btum nas bsnyal// zhag gnyis gsum nas skyur mnam lbu ba che// de nyid rlangs lums byed nas smra [dmar]khrid ltar// yang na rgya thabs [thab]me lce mi mngon pa'i// steng du zangs chen kha snyoms bang ba brtsegs// de steng gra rgyang steng du gseng can gdan// 'jam stong nad pa gos dor bkon [bgon]te bsnyal// mgo bstul rngul 'don thon tshad bal gyis phyis// khams log byung na rlung gnon bku [bsku]mnye bya// de ltar phan pa'i yon tan thob par
bya// chu lums byed na sman ro tshags la btsag/ nyin re chu tshan zhugs pa ji bzhin bya// mtshan mo khu tshig lhan gcig bsnyal la bzhag/ bcings lums byed na chu chod gar pa de// gang na'i sa ru bcings la pags rlon dkris//rlan lums chu tshan bcings pa'i phan yon ni// gang [gong] du bshad pa ji bzhin 'grub bo gsungs// gzhan yang dar mo'i men [ man] ngag bka' rgya ltar// gtso bo 'du ba spyi snyoms bdud rtsi lnga// chu tshan 'byung ba'i rgyu gcig rdo sol rkyen lnga 'ong zhi brag zhun mu zi rdo zhun mtshur la// dbang gsal stong tshad sel ba'i 'bras bu gsum abar skyur/ / tshe bsring bcud len gtso bo rtsa ba lnga ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru gze ma/ / 'gram ['grams]'khrugs khrag tshad sel ba'i dmar po lnga tshos gsum mdzo shing tsan dan dmar/ / chu ser 'phul 'dren skem byed shing sna lnga seng ldeng skyer pa se rgod sgron shing smyug rtsi/ / gzhen [gzhan]yang rdo rgyus gsum dang sbal rgyab rigs// rdo sman gang 'dzoms chu ser sman brgyad so tha gnyis til gnyis zi ra gnyis gu gul dkar nag gnyis sbyar// de yang rdo sman thams cad rtsi bzhin btags//rno 'don rgyu gcig med du mi rung rdzas// nus pa bskyed phyir chang du gdus khus bsring [bsings]/ / ro ma lus na slar btags sngar bzhin bya// kha tshar gzhan rnams skam po'i phye ma gdabs [ gdab]/ / rlon pa btsab brdung bya thabs gang [gong]ltar shes// gnang rigs sman rgyal bhud+dha a yu nas// rgyal khab chen por mdzad dus zhal nas zhus// phan pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phag sa pa mthong // zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las 'jam dpyad lums kyi lhan thabs te nyer gsum pa'o//nyer bzhi pa/ byugs kyi lhan thabs/dpyad kyi lnga pa byugs pa spyi don bzhi// dngos gzhi snum byugs sbyor ba
bcu bzhi dang // lde gu bcu bzhi dang bcas nyi shu brgyad// gzhan rnams go bla [sla]tsan dan mar khu ni// shug pa'i rkang mar 'dzer pa gzhog cing btub[gtubs]/ / de nyid skyon med rdza yi bum par blugs// mthil du bug pa bya mig gsum phug cing // steng gi kha gcod dam par bsdoms pa'am yang na rdza slang dkyil du bug pa phug/ bum pa bzlog steng rdza 'dam sbyar kyang rung //'og tu khru gang dang mthil rin chen snod// bcug la bar mtshams 'dam pas 74so/ rnga na bsgams//(/ bum pa lco ba'am bang me sgang kun mes(/(/ tshos par bsregs pas shug phye sol ba 'gyur// rin chen snod de mar gdus ci rig [rigs] khengs// tshul 'dis rus zhun bdud rtsi mar khu dang // bcud 'dus la sogs lag len khyad med 'grub// yang zab tsan+da [tsan+dan]chang bran sla ngar brngos// bum nang steng phyogs shu 'bras phag tshil sbyar// reg dug ra tshil 'bras la 'phyi ba'i tshil// mi tshil la sogs skabs sbyar man ngag zab//gsang rgya bri bar phangs kyang brtse bas bris// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las 'jam dpyad byug pa'i lhan thabs te nyer bzhi pa'o//nyer lnga pa/ log gnon thur ma'i lhan thabs/dpyad kyi log gnon thur ma'i dpyad mchog las// spyi don bcu gcig gsungs pa'i lag len rnams// dang po don snod yul sa ma shes na// gang la nad zhugs dpyad kyi mig mi phyed// rtsa gnad mi shes dpyad la 'jol mi nus//sman pas lag sgra [dgra] spang phyir rtsa gnad gces// de phyir byang khog yul tshad yid la bzung // gsung pas gtso bor men [man] ngag yon tan rgyud//rma ler lnga dang rtsa dkar byang chub dgos// de ltar min kyang zur mkhar khu dbon lugs// zin bris gsum mam bshad rgyud lus thig tsam// med du mi
rung nan tan gces par gyis// bye brag snying la gsang pas bcu gcig dang //glo gsang nyer gnyis mchin dri'i gsang sa gcig/ mchin mcher gnyis la gsang sa brgyad re dang // bad rlung gsang re mkhal srang [gsang] nyi shu gcig/ pho ba mi 'gyur gsang dgu bcur 'byin gnyis// tshig [tshigs] pa bcu gcig pa dang srang [gsang]bcu gnyis// bu snod srang [gsang]gnyis long la srang [gsang] sa lnga// rgyu srang [gsang] bdun dang smad kyi dbye srang [lhaswāhā ]gnyipa//rgya dzodz+ra ༵༵ pasna ༵la[ papa dzā] /pa snapa gh+nā sbyon gswā gnyis 〉ji par mkhal srang [gsang] dpyi yi 'khor mig la// mkhal 'bras steng nas bcal bas sor bcu drug/ mi dbang sā ra'i ser rjes 'brang legs// 'ga' zhig 'grim bzang sman pa'i gso skabs 'gyeng // thur ma'i le'u dgos pa med do zer// des na lag len bco brgyad mi shes par// sman dang btsag [gtsag]cha 'dzin pa khrel rgod do// zhes phyi rgyud pha lam lhan thabs rin chen 'khor lo las dpyad lnga'i log gnon drag po thur ma'i lhan thabs te nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o//phyi ma'i rgyud la le'u nyi shu lnga gsungs don// mdor bsdus rtag [brtag]thabs gso tshul bcos thabs gsum// brtag thabs reg mthong gnyis kyis nad ngos bzung // 'khrul bzhi [gzhi] gal 'gags bzhi yis dpyad 'phrang bsal// gso tshul dgu yis nad dang gnyan [gnyen]po sprad// gso thabs lag len bco brgyad nad dpung gzhoms// sum cu rtsa gsum lag len snying po dril// 'di dag phyi ma rgyud kyi bsdoms tshigs [tshig] yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don la le'u so sor sa dpyad [bcad]dang bka' 'grel zhor la thon cing slar yang blta reg dri ba bsdoms tshig sum cu so drug sogs rgya bod stod smad snga phyi mkhas pa'i men [ man] ngag zab dgur zur brgyan te gzhung tshigs
[tshig]'bru don 'khrol zhing brtag bcos gang sa nas klog pa tsam gyis lag len thog tu khel nges don kun 'grub par brtan [bstan]zin no//'dir cung zad smras pa/ ༷ 〈yig 'bru 'ga' mi gsal〉tshigs 'phreng [tshig phreng]lo 'dabs ['dab]tshogs// dwags kyang byar po dbus gtsang lho byang nas// snga phyi rjes bzlos mang po'i rtsod pa kun// zur sman mkhyen spyod [ dpyod] ral gri'i 'khrugs thag chod// de phyir legs bshad 'tshol ba'i ring lugs nas// sdom tshig khog 'bub lhan thabs nyin byed shar//lugs gzhan 'byung bya smra bcad 'gogs par gol// phrag dog khengs sems ku mu ta yang zum// la las gzhung don 'chi med bum chu 'pho// khung [khungs]med rang bzo'i bshad kyang zog po 'gugs// mkhas brlom [rlom] 'chad brtsod [rtsod] brtsam [rtsom]'dod nad pa de// log lam dus min 'chi ba snying re rje// phal cher tshigs [tshig]sbyor me tog mdzes par yongs[yong ]/ /lag len 'bras med nad pa ci yis gso// mkhas 'ga'i gzhung nas zin bris men [man]ngag bsres// bstan bcos lus tshangs [tshang]lhan thabs gang la ldan// lung 'di g.yu thog brang ti yab sras dang // zur mkhar khu dbon mthar phyin slob rgyun gyi// men [man]ngag mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zhal phye nas// gzhung la brgyan 'di phan bde'i rtsa lag lugs// gzhan yang drin chen mkhas dbang du mi [ ma'i] rgyun// yi ger bri ba phangs kyang nus par phangs// nyams thag nad pa brtse bas ma bzod par// bu slob don du nag po 'gro shes bkod// tshig gi sbyor ba rab dben kyang // don gyi lan len rab mchog 'dis// sdug bsngal mtsho las rab bsgral te// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub cig/ de ltar don yod phan pa lhur len gso pa'i gzhung // rnam mang la brtan [brten]mi 'jigs srog sbyin chos lugs 'di// dam pa'i drin las ring nas gom [goms] pa'i mthu ldan zhing // lhag bsam dkar po'i
bkod 'dis kun kyang bde chen mchog thob shog/ zhes pa 'di ༷ 〈yig 'bru re gnyis mi gsal〉mkhyen spyod [dpyod]rnam par yangs pa'i mthu dang ldan pa/ a bo bsod nams tshe ring gis mi dbang chen po o rang gi drungs 'tsho'i phyir du 'di ltar bgyis/ zhes yang yang nan cher lha rdzas dang bcas te bskyur [ bskul] zhing / gzhan yang rigs [ rig] byed 'di don gnyer 'gas kya nga bskul brda byung bar brtan [ brten]/ rab nyi'i zil gnon chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi ston mchog chos 'khor ba'i dus chen nas mgo brtsam kyang / nad pa'i don gyi gtso sa 'khrul g.yeng sna tshogs kyi le shor lus pa slar yang me lug cho 'phrul zla ba gser kong nas rnam par rgyal bas nan cher bskul zhing ngos shog 'bebs pa dang blang bya ste dbo zla ba'i dmar phyogs yul 2 4grangs kyi tshes bzang zla ba gro bzhin sman gyi 'grub sbyor nyin dge bsnyen sman bla don grub 'bod pas bkra shis 'bras spungs su rdzogs par bris pa 'dis kyang lus can mtha' dag bde ldan du gyur cig/ maṅgā laṃ/ bha warnyu/lha rje nyam las gsung rgyun/ phag gru sbyor ba gong ltar steng // bu [bul]tog phab dang rdo thal bsnan// skya smyag ldan 'dus la sogs dang // dug ro lcags dreg kun la phan// zab khyad nyams myong mang po la// ngag rgyun de la gces par zung [ bzung ]/ / cong zhi drug dang ru rta drug/ sbyar bas rnam rgyal dgu pa zer// 〈sna ring ngos gcig chad pa 'dra/〉/ / sid [si] tu d+marma ka ra'i sna sman/ rgya mtshal tsan+da [tsan+dan] dkar dmar a ka ru// li shi gur gum ghi wang ka ko la// bong dkar ru rta sug smel spang spos dang // gla ñtsa 'u su 'bras bu gsum sbyar ba// tshang shing ma bzlos tshad du sbyar ba'i phye// sman rnams srang gang sna tha srang do sbyar// 'di yis mi sel nad rigs gcig kyang med// / /
spyi don gnyis pa/ reg zig ne'u le'i rkyal ba las 'di na dreg grum mdud pa bgrol ba'i man ngag shog dril 'phrul gyi sder mo bzhugs so//༷ ༷ 〈 yig 'bru 'ga' mi gsal〉 mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthus//mgrin gcig tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis smon lam 'bras// ༷ 〈yig 'bru 'ga' mi gsal〉 rab bskul ba'i// 〈yig 'bru gcig mi gsal〉 mkhar char gyis bdag sogs sa 'dzin skyong // 'gro drug gtso bo dal 'byor mi lus la// las skyed 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i dred [dreg]grum zhes// mi bzod zhags pas dam du bcings rnams la// mdud grol 'phrul gyi sder mo'i shog dril bri//de la rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags bcos dang // rjes gcod bla gnyen [gnyan]bdun las dang po rgyu// rlan bsnum [rlam] yul du dal rjes drag shul gyi//rlung khrag 'khrugs dang ma zhu chu ser rgyas// la la klu gnyen ji[gnyan] btsan bdud ma rung dang // chu nad yin zhes yul mi phal cher na// gnyan tshad spyi dang khyad par bal nad rims// srin bu rnyog tshad sogs kyi ngan khrag lhung //chu ser rtsa rgyus sha rus la babs rgyas// dreg grum rkang 'bams 'bam sogs kyi rgyu ru snang //rkyen ni rang bzhin klu gnyan sa bdag dang // btsan bdud 'bras ['dres] pa las byung nye ba'i rkyen// sa brlan chu las rtsog [ btsog] grib sogs kyis bskyed//
dbye ba grum bu dkar nag rnam pa gnyis// babs sa sha rus rtsa chu bzhir zhugs brgyad//rtag [rtags]la spyi dang bye brag rnams [rnam]pa gnyis//spyi rtag [ rtags] grang shum yun ring sha lus brtse// gdong snum mgo mjing rked pa dpyi mig zug/ shed chung sgyid skyur kha 'bol [sha 'bros] rngul kha snyi// rus tshig [tshigs] sha rus khol zhing chu rgyus gyong // 'gul tshe lhag par na zhing skad ngan 'chor// chu dmar rtsa 'khyug phra mgyogs ting [gting] nas rgyug/ bye brag brum [grum]dkar zug chung rtsa chu grang // skrangs pa skya sob grang khol byed pa yin// grum bu nag po zug che rtsa chu tsha// skrangs dmar tsha ba che zhing skom dad che// shar babs nywa bzhi skrangs shing sha 'gul 'khrigs//rus babs tshigs kha skrangs shing rkang rnams khol// rtsa babs khrag shas che zhing rtsa nag sbo// chu babs chu rgyus gyong bar rengs 'khums skam// dreg nad rkang mthil lag pa'i gru mo skrangs//0 dang po 'khol na snying [ rnying] nas ched [mched]par 'gyur//bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// dang po sle tros brag zhun a ru'i thang // yang na 'bras gsum sle tres seng lding [ldeng] tig/ spos dkar brag zhun thang gis gdong bzlog byed// spos dkar bcu steng khyung lnga dang // dngul chu seng ldeng bsnan pa'i bco lnga dang // phyi [phye]ril gang gso chu bskol 'phul la btang // yang na dngul chu mu zi seng ldeng dang // bzang drug chu ser sman gsum ru rta rnams// sbrang sbyar srang phyed brgyad kyi sbyor ba zhes// stod smad phyi nang chu ser tsha grang dang // grum bu dkar nag spyi sman ngo mtshar che// yang na rin chen sbyor ba dngul chu dang // mu zi seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa bzang po drug/ chu ser sman gsum gu gul bya khyung sbyar// gi wang nag po tshan des tsha grang bsgyur// klu yi gdon 'joms chu ser rtsad nas skem// yang na
khyung lnga chu rta zhon pa la// seng ldeng dbyug thog [thogs]bong 'tshal mtshal]na bza' gsol// klu gnyan dreg grum 'jom ['joms] pa'i dpa' bo yin//zhi dka' gnam lcags zil pa'i rtsa ltos sbyongs// gnam lcags zil sa bcud dngas ma dang // stag chung dmar khra chu yi snying po mnyom [mnyam]/ / myur mgyog [mgyogs]pho nya sprel bzhugs [mjug]ma gi ta// li khri 'od 'phro g.yu 'brug ze ba rnams// e kro ta sbyar chu ser mdze dang 'bras// mkhal rtsa 'gram ['grams]byer greg [dreg]grum rengs 'khums dang // ya ma mo [mgo]nad tsha ba rnyings rnyogs sogs// zhi sbyongs gang 'dod lag len mde'u khar gdags// sngon 'gro phyi dzes las lnga spyi dang mthun// de dzes tsan+da [tsan+dan]dkar dmar gi wang dang // bzang drug chu ser sman gsum ge sar gnyis//tig ta sle tros spyi bzhur 'bras bu gsum// gla ñtsa spang brgyan [rgyan]be do ba sha ka/ bong khrag ka ra sbyar ba'i nyi shu lnga// gung gnyis sing lding [seng ldeng]khu bas 'phul la btang // skabs su se 'bru lnga pa ltag pa sprad// dngas ma gnas 'gyog ['jog]chu ser rang sar skem// shin tu gnyan che stag seng kha sprod bsdab[bsdeb]/ / sle tros seng lding [ldeng]nags stod stag mo 'phyo// lha la gser tig sder bzhi 'dzum drug rgyas// mgrin bzang mtshal gyi ngar skad sgrogs pa'i steng // dngul mdog gangs ri seng chen 'gying ba la// spos thal so ra g.yu ral ngom zhing ngar// sbyar tshad stag seng srang re gzhan zho re//gdams nas mi spyod rdo rjer zhal sbyor bya// thun tshad bra ril tshad tsam gsum mam lnga// sman tshad thon tsam zhu tshod chu bskol 'phul// dug smugs [smyag]mo nad ma gtogs nad rigs kun// mi sel med kyang khyad par steng [steng]gdon dang // 'og gdon klu gnyan sa bdag btsan bdud kyi// rgyab byas gnyen [gnyan]rigs mtha' dag tshim la 'bebs// yang sgom nu ma skrangs yang chu ser grum// gag lhog glang po'i spyi bo ltar 'phel ba'i// shes brtson sa
'dzin rtse nas gsar du thon// phyi nas sle tres ba ci [lci] sa myag byugs//yang na bi sha shu dag chu thar dud// zhib btags dmar zal ba chur sbyar te byugs// de dag kun gyis grum bu g.yul las rgyal// mchog tu grum bu nag po'i gnyan [gnyen]po mchog/ bye brag grum bu dkar po bcos pa ga bong khrag zho gsum skyu ru zho bzhi dang // ma nu zho drug ka kol zho bcu dang // gser mdog chu ser sman gsum thun re sbyar// grum bu dkar nag khra gsum dus gcig 'joms// dper na rgyal po rta zhon lcags kyu thog[thogs]/ / btsun chung rta zhon lag na dbyug pa phyar// rgas po g.yag zhon rgyab tu tshwa rgyab khur// dri zhim spos thog kun kyang gsang zhos bran// gar sla zho tsam ba ko'i tshad du byug/ de steng zan don g.yog la zhag gcig bzhag/ chu bur byung yang bcar la sug chus bkru// spyi bo'i gtsug bshal gdong la gdong bshal 'byung //yan lag tshig [tshigs]la kor [ko]le'i bshal du 'byung // phan yon ya ma mig 'grib mdze nad dang // tshig [tshigs]chu pus btig rlung nad ce spyang mgo/ 'bras dang greg [dreg]grum chu ser kor [ko]ler 'khyug/ ba spu mtsho mo yur 'dren mkhas pas chad['chad]/ / sman dngul chu seng ldeng so ma ra//thal ka rdo rje gu gul dkar nag gnyis// skyer pa'i bar shun sngo yi tsha ba gsum//byang ba rtsa ba lnga dang bang [bong] bu'i khrag/ srang do chu ser 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin// nad gang ldang ba'i gnyan [ gnyen] po sdebs te bstan[bsten]/ / zhes pa skabs 'dir sle tros brag zhun dang // nag po khyung lnga dkar po se 'bru lnga// bsdebs btang nad 'dis spyi sman myong bas 'grub//zas ni dkar cher rgyas la yon [yen]la gtad// skabs (su )sbyangs shing sman rgyun bsring // dkar po grang shas yin pas lus zung [zungs] gso//bdud rtsi lnga 'am gla ril chang btsos sam// mu zi chu tshan zhugs shing sman gzhugs [gzhug] bsring // spyir na nad 'di skya zhugs sngo la thon// sngo la
zhugs na nad la thon gsungs kyang // brtson par bcos na myur du thon pa myang [myong ]/ /rjes gcod gdong rtsa byin g.yon gang (nye )gtar// tsag tsag lhang lhang na sar rlabs [rngabs] ru 'dzug [gzug]/ tshigs skyongs [skrangs] gzer mig 'dril na me btsa' bya// gze chang rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar bya// bshul chags sha yis zungs gso nad zhugs [gzhug]chod//gzhan yang bla gnyan rtsa dkar mkhal rtsa sogs// bcos thabs sman ni bya khyung lnga pa la// bye [byi]ru mu tig brgyan btag [rgyan btags]li shi dang //dzā ti a ka ru yis lus drod rgyas// sin+dhu ra dang khab len shing mngar gyis//sgro mchu ldan pa mtshal gyis na bza' gsol// tsha grang sbyor sde gnad dang ldan shes na// phyi nang rtsa dkar nad rigs kun la bsngags// gza' dang klu gdon bcos sdug [rdugs]gnyan [gnyen]po mchog/ spang spos shug tsher spos dkar go snyod byugs// mkhal rtsar ar khyung sbyor ba stag [ltag] sprod bstan [bsten]/ / gzhen [gzhan] yang mkhal grum sman gyi bcos pa la /dngul chu byang khra rgya tsha rnon po gsum// sman chen shu dag shing kun rnam pa gsum// se 'bru nyi sga [dga']mkhal zho rnam pa gsum// shug pa tsher can spang spos re ral gsum// a ru ra dang ru rta sdig srin gsum// gze ma sug smel gser gyi bye ma gsum// 'bras sna gsum dang chu ser sman gsum sbyar//rgyune sbyongs thon tsam lus zungs sbyar la btang // mkhal grum zha rengs 'khums la 'di rang lhag/ rgyas par gzhung chen rang rang le'u shes// de ltar ༷ ༷ ༷ 〈yig 'bru re gnyis mi gsal〉man ngag 'od mtshod ['ol tshod]las// shes brtson nags [nag]smyug gis bsrubs tsi bcud 'di// ma chad grogs bkul [bskul] gso ba'i snying nor dang // nyam thag dreg grum nad pa'i rlung non mdzod// de ltar smrar pa sman pa ltar snang yang // skye dang skye
bar g.yu thog dgongs don gyis// bla med go 'phong ['phang] thob nas don gnyis 'grub// mi spyod rgyal po'i zhabs drung 'khod par shog/ maṅga laṃ/
spyi don gsum pa/ reg zig ne'u le'i rkyal pa las dbang po ril bu'i lag len khrigs sdebs 'chi med chu bum bzhugs so//oṃ a thā/ srid dang zhi ba kun gyi mgon gcig pu// bstan dang 'gro ba yongs kyi phan bde'i dpal// rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i nad 'byin pa //thub dbang sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// sman mchog rgyal po dbang po ril bu yi// lo rgyus ngos bzung dbye ba btang thabs dang // dam tshig phan yon phar phyin grangs kyi gtam// gzhung gdams gtam rgyud lag len myong grub bri//'gro drug gtso bor gyur pa'i mi lus kyang // lan gcig lnga brgya'i tha mar babs dus kyang // 'byung po rnams kyi blo bur ye 'grog ['brog]btang // ma mo mkha' 'gro'i nad ngan yams su 'bebs// mu stegs gdug pa'i rdzas kyi sbyor ba byed// gsungs pas sngon dus lha dang lha min gnyis// bdud tsi 'dod nas rgya mtsho srubs [bsrubs] pa las// skyes bu skra ser mig nas me 'bar bas// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can don te tshangs ( pa ) yis// hūṃ brjod skra yal [pra yas]rgyu ma'i [mi]rgyu la thim// zhes pa rtan [brtan]g.yo kun gyi dug rigs byung // de tshe yang yang bsrub pas nyi zla dang // chang dang nor bu kostu thor thos rta// 'chi bdag med pa'i bdud tsi shel bum thon// de las brtan g.yo snang srid sman kun dang // bdud tsi bum pa nga bdag ma 'cham par// lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa'i lo rgyus sogs// mtha' yas mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang por grags// de gnas gangs ris [ri'i] bdag po mgrin sngon gyis// sems can kun la gnod 'tshe bya ba'i phyir// dug lnga'i
mdangs las 'byung ba lnga yi dug/ sbyar thabs brten [ brta na] g.yo'i rdzas ngan du ma bshad// mu stegs 'khor gyis bsdus shing rgya cher spel// ༷ lha mo ༷ 〈yig 'bru re gnyis mi gsal〉brgya byin gyis// thugs rjes ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs 'phros// brtan g.yo 'byung bas khyab pa'i dngos po kun//'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman bcud ma lus pa// gcig tu bsdus nas rnam dag thugs bskyed kyis// ha la de nyid gang du dar ba'i sar// sman mchog 'di nyid shin tu dar gyur cig/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi rten lus can la//rdzas sbyor ngan pa'i bar chad sel bar shog/ ces gsungs nam mkhar gtor ba'i gtan tshigs 'bras// mtha' 'khob dug rigs dar ba'i yul kun tu//sman bcud sa rdo rtsi shing chu la sogs// gang la babs pa srog chags gang gis zos// ril bu dril bas dbang ril zhes pa grags//ngos bzung srog chags gang yang rung ba dang // khyad par gla ba glang chen ra rgod dang // gnas ni pho long grod pa'i nang du 'byung //de yang kha dog dkar dmar dngas ser sngo// ji ltar dgongs gzugs mdog bkrag 'od 'tsher bas// gzhi gdan dar gyis kha dog len nus shing //btsan [bcad]na shun pa rim can zad pa'i nang // rde'u shing bu chu bal nyal nyil 'byung // chu thig [thigs]byung na bdud ñtsa mngon sum 'dod// de yang bteg na lci zhing bcangs na bsil// mur na mi zhu zos na sa mi tshag [seg]/bro ba 'di yin mi gsal khyad chos ldan// 'khrul med dbang bo ril bur mkhas pas bzungs[bzung ]/ / rdo skran smig [smin]dang rnag skran skam pa la//blun pos dbang ril 'dod pa mkhas pas spang // ༷ 〈tshig rkang phyed tsam mi gsal 〉 dmar po blon// dngas ser rje'u rigs sngon po dmangs rigs zhes// rim pas gang [gong]ma mchog yin 'og ma dman// 'on kyang rma bya glang chen gla ba bzang // ra phag mdzo rtol las byung ngan par brjod//
btang thabs zlum por btang dang phye ril sbyar// lug [lugs]gnyis gang byed ngar 'dogs rno 'don ces [gces]/ / gang yang gza' skar zla ba gro bzhin sogs// bzang 'dzom lugs gnyis span [spen] rigs min pa'i nyin// dang po rgyu skar 'od kyis gdug pa'i chu// khye'u bsod nams ming bkra shis pas blang // dzā ti drod sman kha che gur gum sbyar// 'chi med ril bu dag dang lhan gcig tu// gas chag g.ya' 'ang rin chen snod du blugs// dri ngan nag med dar dkar kha gtsor gtum// slar yang gro 'bras btum la zhag gcig bsnyal// de yis lcags la ngar gyis blud pa ltar// dbang po rig bu'i yon tan stong 'gyur bskyed// sgo ldan lha shing rkang dmar me dud lags// dzā ti tsan+da [tsan+dan]dan gur gum a ka ru// bsreg pa'i dud pas dug can nad pa rngub// de yis gdon bral rtsa 'byed sman sna khrid// dper na rno ngar mtshon la brdar gyis 'dra// de nas nad pa shar phyogs kha bltas la// sman bla rig 'dzin brgyud par skyabs 'gro bya// sman pas gsol 'debs gzungs sngags bkra shis brjod// ril bu ngar 'dogs sman chu'i rta la skyon// khong du btang rjes dal zhing 'ju la btan// rgyab chos 'grul 'dzem rim gro dkar chos bya//zhag gsum lon nas bshang lam ma thon nas// ko ṭa'i 'phrul bshal stag [ltar]bu lnga bshal sogs// lus zungs bstun te gnyen po'i bshal gyis sbyar[sbyang ]/ / rgyu khug 'dus na bros 'ded shes dgos gsungs// thog ri bud dam nad dris bstum nas 'byung // slar yang bkrus skam ngar 'dogs sngar ltar bya// dar dmar btum la rin chen snod du bcangs// dgos dus gong bzhin btang bas zlum khrid 'grub// yang na phye ril gzhan yang sbyar ba'i thabs// bse ru bzhi bdun dpa' bo brgyad pa'am// gur gum bcu drug bcu gcig nyi shu lnga// gi wang dgu dang glang chen bco brgyad dang // bse ru bcu bdun nyi shu rtsa bdun dang // mang sbyor chen mo ril nag che 'bring chung //
man ngag bsil sbyor zla shel che 'bring sogs// gang 'phrod sman sbyor gang de gtso ba'i tshad// ngar logs [ 'dogs] gang [ gong] bzhin bya [ byas] te legs par bsre// gtong dus sngon 'gro rno 'don dus sman ga ces//gang yang nam mkha' mi mthong zhing // khyad par nyi zer skar chu'i dam tshig yin// 'dre can dme yug dam nyams shan pa'i rigs// khyi dang bud med byi la'i rig sa mthong spang // rin chen dbang po ril bu'i dam tshig yin//gzhan yang bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rdzas sbyor dug/ rgyu dang mi rgyu brtan g.yo dngos gyur rigs// zas skam —[skom] snum zer rlang [rlangs] pa rlung gi rtags// ji ltar gyur kyang thog mtha' bar kun gyi// lha yi dbang po bdud tsi ril bu 'di// gang gsham sman dang sdeb sam stag [ltag] sprod kyis// dug nad gshin rje'i dmag dpung mthar bskrad de// skye dgu'i tshe srog mtha' ru phyin par nges// gzhan yang bad mkhris ldan 'dus smug po gcong // tsha ba rnying rnyogs mo nad rtsa byer sogs// nad mang yun ring bcos sdug [rdugs]'du ba 'khrug/ kun gyi gnyen po bla med zhar las 'grub// zas spyod sman dpyad yon tan rgyud la bstun// 'di don smra ba'i rnam dpyod dben gyur kyang // 'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal po khri srong nas// da lta gang [ gangs] can mgon po bskal bzang bar// gnang ba rigs kyi sman rgyal gnya' ba'i gdungs// rig chos zungs [gzung]'dzin mi dbang lhun sding [sdings]nas// gso rigs [rig]bstan 'dzin dar rgyas don mthun gyis// bka' mchid lha rdzas spyi bor bcings pa po// shar phyogs byang khog stod kyi mgrin bzang la//bkra shis 'bras spungs lha rje'i khur babs pa// sman lha don grub 'bod pas jo shaka drungs[drung ]/ / lag len khrid [khrigs]sdebs grang [drang]tshig bris te phul// don 'di 'gro ba yongs kyi srog skyob nus// dge 'bras mi bskyod rgyal po'i drungs 'khod shog/ maṅgā laṃ /
spyi don bzhi pa/ reg zig rna'u le'i rkyal pa las rang la bsten pa'i slob gsar rnams la bslab bya snying thig don mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//oṃ a thā/ 'dir gso ba rig pa'i chos sgor zhugs nas phan byed kyi thabs tshul dpag tu med par bslab nas bstan 'gro sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o snyom [snyam]pa'i gang zag rnam [rnams]la/ bslab bya snying thig don mo bri bar bya ste/ de yang rtsa rgyud las/ kye grogs po dag shes par gyis shig/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang / na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// chos dang nor dang bde ba bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// 'gro ba gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod pa dang / gzhan gyi spyi bos [bor]bskur [bkur]bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// zhes gsung par/ de yang bshad rgyud las/ 'gro drug gtso bor gyur pa'i mi lus la// mi na gnas dang na ba gso ba dang // tshe ring chos nor bde ba bsgrub pa'i phyir// zhes gsungs pa de ltar mi 'dod pa'i 'gro ba ni gcig kyang mi 'dug pas nan tan du slob dgos par slob bya yon tan ni/ gso ba rig pa'i don rnam [rnams]mdor bsdu na/ gso bya gso byed ji ltar gso ba dang // gso ba po dang rnam pa bzhi ru bshad// ces gso ba po sman pa la bslab pa'i rgyu ni drug ste/ rgyu ni
blo ldan bsam pa dkar ba dang // dam tshig ldan zhing rnam pa bzo ba dang //bya ba la brtson mi chos mkhas dang drug/ ces drug po de dag rang bzhin rgyud la gnas shing / sngon nas tshogs gnyis brlabs chen bsags pa'i skyes bu'i thog mar/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing // rig byed smra ba kun gyi rgyu//ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya// zhes chos blon 'jam dbyangs pa'i gsungs ltar rgyud las kyang / rgyu ni 'bri klog mtha' ru phyin par slob// chod dang mi chod de la bstan [ brten] par snang // de rkyen slo/bas [slob] dpon brten [bsten] te mtshan nyid dang // bsten pa'i thabs dang bsten pa'i dgos pa gsum// zhes sa bcad gsum gyis 'chad par/ mtshan nyid rgya cher mkhas dang man ngag ldan// ngang ring zol chung brtse la bskur [bku ra]'os bstan [bsten]/ / zhes slob sa [slob]dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang / bsten thabs dgos pa med pa'i [par]blo gtad la// ngo lkog med pa'i bya ba sgrub par bya// spyod pa thams cad de yi yul dang bstun//drin du tshor na rgyun du bsring bar bya// zhes bstan [ bsten] thabs dang /dgos pa myur bar lobs dang mkhas par 'gyur// grogs la brtson bya zhu dang dri ba dang // gzung dang bsam pa le lo bya ba min// ci yi phyir na de nyid bar chod dgra// goms pa mthar dbyung mthong thos blang ba ste// thams cad zhen 'dris the tshom spang par bya// zhes gsungs pa sogs bya byed sman pa'i le'u'i 'grel pa snga phyi rnams dang bsgrags nas tshigs [tshig]don sems la bcang ba ni shin tu gal che/ gzhan yang dge bcu bsgrub dgos te/ mgon po byams pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang // nyan dang klog dang len pa dang //'chad dang kha bton byed pa dang // de sems pa dang bsgoms pa dang // spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyis// bsod nams phung po gzhal du med// zhes gsungs par dge ba chos spyod bcu por nyin mtshan rtag tu nyam [nyams] su
len cing / spang bya mi dge ba bcu ni/ srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem pa dang // rdzun dang ngag 'chal tshig tsub dbyen sbyor dang // brnab sems gnod sems lta ba phyin ci logs[log]/ sdig pa'i las bcu lus ngag yid kyis spong // zhes lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum ste mi dge ba'i las bcu po srog la babs kyang dus rnams kun tu spong dgos pa'o// 'phral du slob gsar rnams kyi nyams len rgyun khyer la'ang / tho rengs zla tshes bcu gsum gyi zla ba nub dus dang / nyi shu drug zla ba shar ba skar tshad bzung ste lang ba'i phyi tha byas nas/ sman bla rigs lnga'i rgyud 'debs sogs mdor bsdus tsam byas rjes gsar 'dzin rnams sger du sbyangs shing / nam longs nas yi ge mthong bstun gyis/ dpe 'dzin shes rab dang bstun pa'i mtha' gtad kyi sha [sho]lo ka gsum re zhog [zhogs]rgyug sprad res gyis/ sha [sho]lo ka gsum re ma zin na slob gral du ma zhugs/ grwa pa dmigs gsal [bsal]bud pa'i de phyin nyi gros [dros]nas za 'thung thon rjes gtso bo'i sman gzhung / 'grel pa man ngag lag len gyi dgongs don thog tu 'khel zhing the tshom sel bar gyis/gral rim gzhung rgya dang bstun nas sdod lugs kyis de bzhin bya spu rim non gyi dpe bzhin skyong khur yong bar gyis/ zhor gsing [gseng]du'ang bshad rgyug'dzin rgyug bris rgyug nad pa'i don dang / nang gi mi nor sar/ gang phyir blo thub yong bar dgos/ dgongs mo mun mtshams za 'thung mgyogs myur thon nas rgyud gzhung gtso bo'i ston pa'i bshad sbyangs/ sger sbyang gang dgos 'bru don rang gi sems dang / tshigs [tshig] sbyor gzhan gyi rna bar [ba]gsar bar/ snyan 'jibs gdangs dang ldag par skyel/ de yang tshes drug gi zla ba nub pa dang / bcu dgu'i zla ba shar bar skar tshad bzung ste nyal ba'i snga tha gyis/ slob grwa 'dir zhugs nas zhu 'khril ma byung bar gang 'dod kyis 'gro sa med/ de las bzlog pa'i rku rdzun dbyen gsum gyis mtshon rang
gzhan 'di phyi 'phral phug phyi nang gang du yang gtam don ngan pa'i dgra mi byed pa srid na/ bca' yig zur gsal gyi don ltar byed rgyu ko lang mi byed go bar gyis/ de lta bu'i blang dor nyams len slobs [slob]gnyer byas pas phan yon shin tu che ste/ snod dang ldan pas rgyud 'di sus 'chang ba// tshe 'dir btsan phyug dar gsum 'dzom pa dang // 'gro ba spyi'i [ spyis] khur dpal grags thob pa dang // phyi ma byang chub go 'phang thob par bsngo// 'gro kun nad kyi sdug bsngal bral ba dang // dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen las thar bar bsngo// nga yi bka' btsan byin che dar ba dang // ji ltar bsngo ba smon lam 'grub par bsngo// zhes gsung pa'i bden tshig dang / rnam dkar gyis mthus 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis kur 'byung ba bshad rgyud las/gnas skabs 'bras bu tshe 'dir skyed pa dang // dbang dang longs spyod dga' bde thob par 'gyur// zhes dang / mthar thug 'bras bu g.yo sgyu 'dod pa rnams// spang nas nad pa gso ba la 'jug pa// bla med sangs rgyas sa la bgrod 'gyur zhes// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po'i bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs shing 'dul ba lung las/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nu khyed//rig byed 'di la bstan [brten]nas sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes dang / gang zhabs kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos/ phra mo'i srog chags 'tshe ba lhur blang dge/sgrub 'phral 'di phyi rab myog khe spog la// gzhol nas sangs rgya sa sgrub rten 'chi bdag las// rgyal bas srid gsum bsod nams kho mi shong // zhes dang /rje sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ mdo rgyud kun nas gzhan phan smon lam la//'bad par gsungs kyang mngon sum phan pa ni// gso byed las lhag gang yang ma mchis pas// rang don spang nas gzhan don bsgrub par 'tshal// gsungs pa sogs dang mthun par mdo rgyud bka' gter bslu ba med pa thams cad nas gsungs par brten/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sman dang sman pa nyid dang
